jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: JOB TITLE: **AI Engineer** Location: Solon, Ohio (Remote up to 2 days per week) Main responsibilities: * Provide dedicated technical execution capacity for the Filling, Can and Plastic business's artificial intelligence (AI) program, turning proven concepts into deployed solutions with measurable business results. * Structure data and build, configure, test and implement AI solutions together with business Process Owners, who keep ownership of the business problem, process definition, user validation and adoption. Reporting to: * Business Line: Filling, Can and Plastic * AI Program Lead Main missions: * Structure, clean and prepare business data for AI use, including technical documents, engineering drawings, product information, historical email, customer relationship management and document management records. * Select the right model, platform and approach for each use case across leading AI ecosystems (such as Microsoft Copilot, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and OpenAI ChatGPT), balancing capability, cost, security and ease of adoption. * Build and configure AI solutions such as knowledge assistants, AI agents, document and quote generation, and workflow automation. * Work with Process Owners to translate mapped current and future processes into practical technical solutions with clear acceptance criteria. * Coordinate development and testing: prepare test cases, evaluate outputs for accuracy with business users, and iterate before release. * Implement solutions with the Process Owner, including controlled data sources, user access, user guidance and handover for ongoing use. * Deliver a portfolio of initiatives across the commercial\-to\-engineering workflow, including product configuration, Bill of Materials generation, proposal and quote automation, sales and customer knowledge, field service intelligence and spare parts quoting. * Connect individual solutions into a shared data and AI foundation so they can work together over time. * Support content improvement and adoption of AI solutions already in use. * Measure and report the impact of each initiative on workforce capacity, quality, speed and adoption. * Track developments in AI models, tools and frameworks and recommend where new capabilities can add business value. * Document solution architecture, data sources and procedures so knowledge stays with the business. Scope: * 100% dedicated to the business's AI program * Deliver a portfolio of concurrent initiatives across Sales, Proposals, Project Engineering, Technical Support, Field Service and Sales Administration * Be responsible for the technical quality, testing and implementation of AI solutions; business accountability remains with Process Owners * Work within controlled\-data and information security guidelines Working relationships: * **AI Program Team**: Program Lead and functional leaders from Project Engineering, Service and Product Management * **Director of Product Lines**: deliverable objectives and governance * **Cloud and Data Platform Director**: implementation architecture and architectural governance * **Central Research \& Development**: AI architecture guidance and specialist development support * **Business Process Owners and users**: Sales, Key Account Managers, Proposals, Project Engineering, Technical Support, Field Service, Sales Administration * **Information Technology**: data access, security and licensing Knowledge \& competencies required: * Deep, hands\-on working knowledge of Microsoft Copilot (including Copilot Studio), Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and OpenAI ChatGPT, and their enterprise, agent and developer capabilities. * Broad, current knowledge of other modern AI models, tools and frameworks (for example open\-weight models, agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol and similar), with the judgment to choose the right one for the job. * Hands\-on experience building solutions with large language models: grounding on company documents (retrieval\-augmented generation), prompt and context design, tool use and AI agents. * Experience with low\-code automation and cloud AI services (such as Power Automate, Azure AI, Google Cloud Vertex AI or Amazon Bedrock) is highly desirable. * Strong data\-structuring skills: cleaning, organizing and transforming structured and unstructured data (documents, spreadsheets, email, database exports). * Programming skills in Python or a similar language; comfortable with SQL, application programming interfaces and advanced Excel. * Understanding of how to evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, consistency and reliability. * Strong technical, analytical and logic skills * Ability to understand business processes and translate them into practical technical solutions * Familiarity with enterprise resource planning, customer relationship management (such as Salesforce), product configurators or Bills of Materials is a plus. * Awareness of data security, access control and responsible use of AI with confidential company data * Organized and methodical; able to manage several projects at once and prioritize to meet business objectives * Autonomous, pragmatic and results\-driven; builds practical solutions quickly * Clear communicator, able to work with non\-technical users and write user guidance and documentation * Pedagogical mindset and ability to transfer knowledge * Proficient in spoken and written English Profile: * Degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar field * At least 1 to 3 years of hands\-on experience with AI, data or automation, including internships, co\-op or significant project work. * A portfolio of completed AI or automation projects is highly desirable. Jobs Specifics: * Initial 6\-month contract, 100% dedicated to the AI program, with potential conversion to a permanent position based on delivered value. * Occasional domestic and international business travel to Kestrel offices and/or customer sites, representing up to 10% of working time per year.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. **Job Specs – AI Engineer** **About this role** We are seeking an AI Engineer to build secure, production\-ready AI services and agentic workflows. You will use Python, FastAPI, Apache Airflow, RAG, LLM APIs, LangGraph, LangChain and MongoDB to deliver reliable capabilities from ingestion and retrieval through API deployment, evaluation and operational support. You will bring strong software\-engineering discipline, practical AI judgement and a clear understanding of security, responsible AI and production operations. **In This role you will*** Design and implement production\-grade AI applications, copilots and agentic workflows aligned to measurable business outcomes. * Build maintainable Python services and expose capabilities through secure, versioned FastAPI interfaces. * Design retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines covering ingestion, chunking, metadata, embedding, retrieval, reranking, citation and evaluation. * Integrate and invoke LLMs through provider SDKs or model gateways, applying structured outputs, tool/function calling, retries, rate limits, token controls and fallbacks. * Use LangGraph to implement stateful, controllable workflows and LangChain selectively for model, tool, retriever and prompt integrations. * Hands\-on understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and experience building or integrating MCP servers and MCP clients. * Ability to expose enterprise capabilities through MCP tools, resources and prompts, with appropriate schemas and controls * Create and operate Apache Airflow DAGs for scheduled ingestion, embedding refresh, evaluation, batch processing and data quality controls. * Design MongoDB document models, indexes and access patterns for application state, conversation history, metadata and operational records. * Implement automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure configuration, logging, tracing, monitoring and incident\-ready runbooks. * Partner with product owners, data engineers, security, architecture and subject\-matter experts to translate requirements into safe technical designs. * Document architecture decisions, model limitations, data lineage, controls and support procedures. **Required Qualifications:*** Typically 4\+ years of software, data or machine\-learning engineering experience, including at least 1 year delivering LLM\-enabled applications. Equivalent depth demonstrated through shipped products is acceptable. * Demonstrable ownership of at least one AI solution beyond proof of concept, with production evidence such as monitoring, security controls, evaluation, support and measurable outcomes. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. * For a senior appointment: evidence of technical design leadership, mentoring, architecture decisions and cross\-team delivery * Experience with model gateways and providers such as Azure OpenAI, Anthropic or AWS Bedrock. * Vector\-search platforms or extensions such as MongoDB Vector Search, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch or Milvus. * MLOps/LLMOps tooling for prompt/version management, experiment tracking, evaluation and tracing, for example Galileo. * Cloud\-native delivery using RedHat OpenShift or equivalent infrastructure as code. * Knowledge\-graph, multimodal, fine\-tuning, synthetic\-data or advanced agent\-evaluation experience. * Experience in regulated or control\-focused environments with formal architecture, risk, privacy and change\-management processes. * Essential technical skills: Python, FastAPI \& APIs, Apache, RAG, LLM, LangGraph, LangChain, MongoDB **Kaleidoscope, an Infosys Company, is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, spouse of protected veteran, or disability.**

jobs.title: DMPK
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco; Boston; New York **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- ResearchScience Research **Compensation** ---------------- * $275K – $350K ### **About Us** Edison Scientific builds and deploys AI scientist agents to accelerate science and the development of new medicines. We are an ambitious team run by scientists and engineers from leading institutions across biology, physics, chemistry, and AI. **Role** We’re looking for a DMPK Subject Matter Expert to join our Forward Deployed team, working onsite with pharma and biotech partners alongside our engineers. Your job: ensure our AI agents produce DMPK and PK/PD outputs that are scientifically rigorous, decision ready, and aligned with how drug development teams actually advance compounds. You’ll evaluate agent performance on PK analysis, ADME interpretation, human dose projection, and IND DMPK report sections. You’ll work with our partners’ DMPK, clinical pharmacology, and development teams to identify where AI can streamline their workflows. And you’ll bring real\-world translational experience to everything our platform generates. You’re the person who knows whether an AI\-generated dose projection or DMPK package would hold up to internal governance and regulatory review. This is embedded, partner\-facing work. You’ll build relationships with DMPK and development leaders, understand their program constraints and regulatory requirements, and feed that knowledge back to our AI team. Over time, you’ll define the scientific approaches that train and evolve our agents, shaping how DMPK is practiced across the AI industry. **Responsibilities** * Generate and architect high\-quality DMPK training data spanning the discovery\-to\-IND workflow, in vitro ADME panels, in vivo PK across preclinical species, metabolite identification, NCA outputs, and PBPK/population PK simulations. * Identify optimal data sources, synthetic generation, consortia, licensed datasets, public PK/ADME databases, and beyond. * Evaluate and validate AI\-generated DMPK outputs (PK parameter estimates, model fits, ADME interpretations, dose projections, written report sections) for scientific accuracy and regulatory compliance. * Collaborate with Engineering, Evals, and Science teams to benchmark and improve agent performance against gold\-standard DMPK workflows. * Direct and improve agent logic to refine data quality and agent capabilities. **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of hands\-on DMPK experience supporting programs from discovery through IND, or direct ownership of 10\+ IND\-reaching programs. * Proven ability to translate CRO bioanalytical data, in vitro ADME results, and in vivo PK study reports into FDA\-ready IND DMPK submissions. * Strong proficiency in PK modeling. Experience with at least one PBPK platform (Simcyp, GastroPlus, or PK\-Sim). * End\-to\-end ADME fluency. * Comfortable operating as the sole in\-house DMPK expert with minimal supervision. * Enthusiastic about iterating with LLM tools to identify data sources and improve agent outputs. **Bonus points for** * Experience leading regulatory DDI strategy, including PBPK\-based DDI predictions submitted to FDA/EMA. * PK/PD modeling or quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) experience. * Previous AI/ML work applied to DMPK or ADME property prediction. * Background at big pharma or CROs supporting large pharma IND programs. **Salary** $220k\- $275k ### **Why join us?** We're a fast\-moving, mission\-driven culture where smart people do their best work and actually enjoy doing it. We also offer full\-time employees the following: * Competitive salary and equity * Full healthcare coverage; we pay 100% of premiums for you and your dependents * Support for growing families, including a yearly new parent stipend and fertility coverage through Carrot * Mental health support through Rula, our in\-network therapist and psychiatrist network with fast availability * 12 weeks of paid parental leave for maternity, paternity, and adoption * Pet care support with a yearly employer\-funded stipend for your animal companions * Commuter benefits so you can pay for transit and parking with pre\-tax dollars * 401(k) company matching * $300 health and wellness benefit quarterly * Lunch is on us every day you're in the office, and dinner is on us when you're working late * Regular team off\-sites and company events *Edison Scientific is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.* Compensation Range: $275K \- $350K

placements. * Own the full model lifecycle: problem framing, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, training, offline evaluation, online deployment, monitoring, and retraining, in Python with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or XGBoost/LightGBM. * Design and run rigorous online experiments (A/B tests, multi\-armed bandits, holdouts) with sound statistical methodology, and translate results into clear go/no\-go decisions. * Build the ML platform foundations on GCP — feature pipelines and feature store, training pipelines, model registry, real\-time inference, and model monitoring — using Vertex AI, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Dataflow. * Apply LLMs and agentic workflows where they deliver measurable value, such as AI\-assisted campaign setup, creative and offer generation, content classification, and operator copilots in Moxxi's ad ops platform. * Partner with Data Engineering to ensure event, tracking, and attribution data in BigQuery is accurate, timely, and fit for both billing and model training. **Technical Leadership \& Platform Engineering** * Own the architecture and technical roadmap for Moxxi's ad platform, including ad serving, real\-time decisioning, tracking, and campaign management. * Stay hands\-on in the codebase — designing, building, and reviewing production code in Golang (backend services) and Python (ML and data services), and guiding React work on operator\-facing applications. * Design low\-latency, high\-throughput serving systems that run model inference within strict performance budgets for latency, throughput, and cost, using Redis, Docker, and Kubernetes (GKE). * Build and maintain integrations with advertisers, affiliate networks, publishers, and ad tech partners via APIs, postbacks, and real\-time event pipelines. * Own system and model reliability end to end — observability, alerting, on\-call, incident response, and blameless post\-mortems — using tools like Datadog ough example — coaching engineers on system design, modeling, experimentation, and ownership. **Cross\-Functional Partnership** * Work closely with the CTO, Product, Ad Ops, and Account Management to translate business goals and operator needs into scoped, prioritized technical and ML roadmaps. * Communicate model performance, experiment results, tradeoffs, risks, and timelines clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including leadership. * Stay current on ML research and industry changes (privacy regulation, signal loss, partner platform changes) and their impact on Moxxi's models and platform. **Basic Qualifications** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5\+ years building and deploying machine learning systems in production. * 3\+ years leading engineering teams as an engineering manager or tech lead manager, including hiring, performance management, and leading multiple engineers or teams. * Hands\-on experience building ranking, recommendation, prediction, or optimization models for ads, search, recommendations, or marketplaces — from feature engineering through online deployment. * Production\-level fluency in Python and the ML stack (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or gradient\-boosted trees), plus strong backend development skills in a compiled language (Go, Java, Scala, or similar). * Strong grounding in statistics, experimentation design, and causal measurement, with a track record of using online experiments to drive product and business decisions. * Proven track record designing and operating low\-latency, high\-throughput, highly available distributed systems, including real\-time model serving. * Experience building ML infrastructure: data and feature pipelines, training pipelines, model deployment, and model monitoring. * Strong data skills — advanced SQL, data modeling, and large\-scale data processing on a cloud data warehouse or big data platform. * Experience building and deploying on a major cloud provider (GCP, AWS, or Azure) with containerization and orchestration. * Comfort with ambiguity and a track record of making sound, defensible tradeoffs with incomplete information in a fast\-moving environment. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain models and results to technical and business stakeholders alike. **Nice to Have / Bonus Qualifications** --------------------------------------- * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field. * Direct experience in AdTech or performance marketing, especially ads ranking, real\-time bidding, budget pacing, lookalike targeting, or conversion and attribution modeling. * Familiarity with programmatic concepts (OpenRTB, DSPs/SSPs, auctions) and performance marketing economics (CPA, CPC, EPC, CTR, revenue per impression, ROAS). * Experience with GCP's ML and data stack, including Vertex AI, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, and GKE. * Experience with deep learning for ranking (e.g., deep cross networks, transformers, sequence models) and distributed training. * Experience with mathematical optimization (linear/integer programming), reinforcement learning, or contextual bandits applied to allocation or bidding problems. * Experience building LLM\-powered and agentic product features, including evaluation frameworks, and using AI\-assisted development workflows. * Experience with event streaming technologies (Kafka, Pub/Sub, or equivalent) and real\-time feature computation. * Hands\-on experience with Golang and a modern front\-end framework such as React. * Startup experience — moving quickly, wearing multiple hats, and building teams and ML capabilities from an early stage. * Awareness of privacy regulations and compliance relevant to advertising and consumer data (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, TCPA).

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: #### **Our Mission** Salt AI is building the intelligence layer for the enterprise. In a world where AI is fragmented across models, tools, and data silos, Salt unifies them through a compliance\-first orchestration platform that helps regulated organizations deploy AI securely and at scale. We're building the systems that power real\-world AI workflows in financial services and other regulated industries. Our platform brings models, data, and existing infrastructure together so enterprises can put AI to work within their operational and compliance constraints. #### **The Role \& How We Work** Forward Deployed Engineers build the systems that make Salt real inside our customers' environments. You'll work with enterprises in financial services and other regulated industries—using their actual data, infrastructure, and constraints—to build the custom software and deep integrations a deployment needs and get it running in production. This is hands\-on engineering, not advisory work. You write the code, build the integrations, and own the rollout into the customer’s environment. You'll exercise technical ownership: propose the approach, solve problems independently, and surface risks and trade\-offs to the Deployment Strategist early. You'll build and harden the systems a defined workflow needs, support the agreed deployment and handoff period, and leave the customer able to operate independently. We’re an AI engineering company pushing the edge of what’s possible. **We build our own agent harness, and our engineers use AI agents to design, build, test, and release Salt.** We’re moving from individual output to true systems\-level leverage: engineers break work into pieces agents can own, set the bar, build automated checks and code reviews that catch what tests miss, and remain accountable for what ships. #### **What You’ll Do** * Build \& Harden Integrations: Design and implement integrations to customer infrastructure–enterprise data sources, identity systems, and internal tooling. Respect customer data and infrastructure boundaries by building permission\-aware integrations that protect credentials and sensitive data, and keep telemetry useful without exposing customer content. * Ship to Production: Get your work running in the customer’s environment – SaaS, VPC, or on\-prem – in partnership with Salt Platform engineers on the infrastructure side. Test integrations and design for failure, recovery, and observability from day one. * Navigate Unfamiliar Environments: Debug in unfamiliar environments where you don’t control the stack and documentation may not exist. Work with the account’s Executive Advisor to get the domain context you need. * Technical Ownership: Propose technical approaches and make decisions within the agreed scope. Weigh the customer’s immediate needs against maintainability, delivery effort, and potential value across other accounts; flag scope changes and material trade\-offs to your Deployment Strategist early. Manage and communicate your work clearly so the delivery team can track progress and dependencies. * Enable Customer Independence: Contribute to the agreed workflow evaluation and handoff, working with the customer and delivery team on acceptance criteria, validation, and regression coverage. Pair with customer engineering teams to review and transfer knowledge as you go. Deliver the runbooks, architecture docs, and configuration details they’ll need to operate independently after handoff. * Feed the Core Product: Bring field learnings back to Product and Platform through engagement debriefs, identifying recurring customer needs and evolving suitable integrations into reusable components or extension patterns. **Must\-Have Core Skills and Experience** * Backend \& Systems Engineering: 6\+ years building and shipping production software, with strong Python skills and deep experience in APIs, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)—reasoning about contracts, interfaces, and failure modes, not just calling SDKs. * AI\-First Engineering Habits: Proven ability to use coding agents and AI\-assisted tools effectively—defining clear constraints and verifying, challenging, and improving agent output while retaining full ownership of what ships. * Practical Architecture: Strong judgment to build clear, maintainable integrations and reusable patterns without over\-engineering or losing important customer\-specific requirements. * Customer\-Facing Execution: Comfort sitting directly with customer engineering teams to debug in an unfamiliar environment, ask sharp questions, communicate technical trade\-offs clearly, find the real constraints, and make progress with incomplete information. * Travel: Willingness to travel for onsite deployment work (averaging \~20%). **Nice to Have** * Hands\-on experience with LLM applications, agent frameworks, RAG pipelines, or model deployment. * Experience deploying into customer\-controlled environments (VPC, on\-prem, or air\-gapped) using Kubernetes,Terraform, or other IaC tools. * Background in regulated industries, particularly financial services (life sciences, or government also relevant) and familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, GxP). * Prior forward\-deployed, solutions engineering, or technical consulting experience. #### **Perks \& Benefits** * Competitive salary based on location and experience * Comprehensive medical, dental, and mental health coverage * 401(k) plan * Fully remote role, collaborating primarily within U.S. time zones #### **Join Us** At Salt AI, we're building systems that help enterprises put AI to work in financial services and other regulated industries. If you want to ship code that operates in demanding customer environments and delivers lasting value, we'd love to hear from you. We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

Our Graduate Program is designed as a launchpad, bridging university theory with real\-world impact and helping high\-potential graduates grow into industry leaders. * **Immersive Learning:** Your first three months are a curated mix of immersive workshops, shadow rotations, and learning by doing. Build deep professional and social bonds, ensuring you have a support network of mentors and fellow graduates to grow alongside. * **Technology at your Fingertips:** To do your best work, you need the best tools. You will be equipped with cutting\-edge tech and industry\-leading technology from your first day. Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday are required in\-office in Dallas. * Please note, we do not offer sponsorship for this role. **Rewards \& Benefits at Further** In this role, you will be eligible for our full\-time employee benefits from day 1! Being part of Further means joining a group of incredible people dedicated to delivering value, impact, and innovation through true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve each day. Our total rewards program is designed for your protection, peace of mind, and overall wellbeing. In addition to the basics, we offer a net\-zero cost medical option, company contributions to your HSA, fertility support, fully\-paid parental leave, a monthly stipend for your lifestyle spending account, and much more. The approximate pay range for this position is $68,000 to $70,000 base salary. We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world\-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission. **The role:** ============= You will build and maintain our backend that already handles millions of custom requests daily, and ensure that it’s reliable, performant and exceeds expectations for our customers as we scale. You will also be a steward of our API and ensure that it’s developer\-friendly and easy to integrate with. **About you:** ============== Have deep intuition on distributed systems, databases, maintainable code design, and API design. You like to reason about trade\-offs between speed, scalability, and developer ergonomics. You care about your work powering products and systems that millions rely on, and about APIs that developers *love* to use. **You might be a good fit if you have:** ======================================== * Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience * A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience * Years of experience required will correlated with the internal job level requirements for this position. **Life at Parallel** ==================== We believe in a fully in person work culture 5 days a week. We’re building strong offices in San Francisco, Palo Alto, Austin, and New York. Your office and in office days will depend on your team, and we will walk you through the details during the interview process. We’re a flat, talent\-dense organization dedicated to solving technical and creative problems. We seek like\-minded individuals who share our passion for applying science, creativity, and consistency to big and complex problems with equally big outcomes. These are our values: * **Own customer impact:** It’s on us to ensure real\-world outcomes for our customers. * **Obsess over craft:** Perfect every detail because quality compounds. * **Accelerate change**: Ship fast, adapt faster, and move frontier ideas into production. * **Create win\-wins**: Creatively turn trade\-offs into upside. * **Make high\-conviction bets**: Try and fail. But succeed an unfair amount. **Compensation \& benefits** ============================ * Competitive salary * Generous equity * Visa sponsorships * 401K plans * Daily lunch \& office snacks * Dinner at the office * Unlimited vacation * Caltrain pass reimbursement Compensation Range: $150K \- $300K

jobs.title: Operations Technology Analyst (On-Site)
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** The Operations team at Lakeside Companies is hiring an Operations Technology Analyst to build and run the software, automations, and reporting tools used across Lakeside's portfolio companies. This is an entry\-level, full\-time role for someone early in their career who wants to build real tools for real users. The Analyst works inside Lakeside's custom data and operations platform, using JavaScript, Python, and AI\-assisted development tools to get working tools in front of users quickly, and owns those tools after launch. The role spends real time with the people who use what gets built: in the office, on job sites, and in the field with entity teams. Operations sets priorities and provides direction on scope, and the Analyst is expected to grow into scoping and prioritizing work with increasing independence. **Duties/Responsibilities** ***Build*** * Build and improve applications, dashboards, automated reports, and workflows on Lakeside's platform, from data structure through the user interface. * Use AI\-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude as a core part of daily work, for coding, refactoring, documentation, and analysis. * Prototype quickly and put early versions in front of users before investing in a full build. * Connect and clean data from portfolio company systems such as accounting, CRM, and operations software so it can be trusted in the tools built on top of it. * Follow platform standards for security, data access, and deployment, and coordinate with the Platform team when a build needs new infrastructure or data connections. ***Work in the Field*** * Spend time with entity teams to learn how their work actually happens before building for it. * Deploy tools directly with users, including walkthroughs, collecting feedback in the first weeks of use, and making changes until the tool gets used. * Ask questions early, confirm requirements before building, and raise gaps or conflicting requests to Operations rather than guessing. ***Own It After Launch*** * Own assigned reports, automations, and tools after launch, including fixes when data, processes, or source systems change. * Monitor recurring outputs so problems are caught before users find them. * Document data sources, logic, and assumptions so any tool can be picked up by someone else. ***Learn the Business*** * Build working knowledge of how Lakeside's portfolio companies operate, including homebuilding, land development, agriculture, and senior living, and of the financial and operational metrics behind the data. * Work with Operations to scope projects, set priorities, and define what done looks like, taking on more of that scoping over time. * Communicate status, requests, and decisions through Lakeside's established systems so work stays visible. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, finance, economics, business, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * Zero to two years of professional experience; internships and project work count. * Working knowledge of at least one programming language, with JavaScript or Python preferred. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools. * A project sample, such as a GitHub repository, portfolio, or something you built, submitted with the application. * Comfort working directly with non\-technical people and being on\-site across the portfolio. * Strong attention to detail and a habit of asking questions before assuming.

jobs.title: Product Software Engineer II
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** **Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology** Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. **Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:** * **Building the future of Disney’s media:** Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach, Scale \& Impact:** More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney\+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. * **Innovation:** We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Content Platforms \& Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product \& Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams. Ever wonder how the innovative storytelling from the world’s most beloved brands – Star Wars, Marvel, Pixar, ESPN, 20th Century, National Geographic, FX, Freeform, Disney Channels, ABC, and more \- makes it to viewers around the globe and beyond (yes, we also deliver content to the International Space Station)? Come join our growing team that builds global products, platforms and tools that deliver and monetize our company's unmatched collection of content, power our businesses and reflect the company's innovative spirit. If you: * Enjoy working with teams of talented and passionate people * Have excellent communication skills * Demonstrate determination in finding solutions to complex puzzles * Have the curiosity and interests in how content goes from inception to consumers * Employ positive thinking and can work constructively in a diverse team setting * Enjoy transforming business strategy into innovative products \& platforms * Value learning and being exposed to new experiences * Love working in a startup culture * Find Media \& Entertainment industry fascinating then Content Platforms team is the place for you. **We are growing and investing in innovative technology to deliver a state\-of\-the\-art content pipeline**. Come be a part of the magic that makes The Walt Disney Company one of the **“World’s Most Admired Companies”**. **Job Summary:** We are seeking a highly skilled Product Software Engineer II to join our Content Platform Engineering team, focusing on building and enhancing platform capabilities with a strong emphasis on enhancing and supporting our existing Screening \& Marketing platform and workflows. Our team develops and manages a diverse suite of products and services that power Disney’s media supply chain, enabling content delivery, screening and marketing for iconic brands like Disney\+, ESPN\+, Hulu, ABC, Marvel, and Star Wars. In this role, you will be expected to design, develop backend and frontend solutions in a dynamic, rapidly changing environment using your technical skill sets, working with product managers and team leads to deliver high quality products that are scalable and robust. You will be expected to work closely on solutions with peers in a cross\-functional environment to ensure we are delivering products that align to the larger business initiatives within the digital media supply chain that support Disney’s TV, broadcast, theatrical, and direct –to\-consumer lines of business. **Responsibilities:** * **Write and Maintain Software Solutions**: Design, write, test, and deploy high\-quality code to develop reliable, maintainable software solutions. * **Collaborate with Cross\-Functional Teams**: Work closely with platform engineers, product teams, and stakeholders to ensure technical solutions effectively support business goals and content strategies. * **Production Support**: Monitor and optimize production systems, ensuring platform stability, performance, and uptime. **Minimum Qualifications** * 3\+ years relevant industry experience * Experience building backend services with Kotlin/Java, Spring Boot, C\#, .Net and NodeJS (TypeScript preferred) programming * Experience working with REST APIs for building and consuming web services. * Experience with cloud native technologies such as Azure Web apps, Azure Functions, AWS EC2, Fargate, and CloudFront * Experience with frontend web development technologies and principles such as Angular and React * Experience with a wide range of data store technologies such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, and DynamoDB * Experience with event streaming and messaging systems (e.g., Service Bus, Kafka, SNS/SQS) * Experience with build and deployment technologies such as Docker, Gitlab\-CI, and Cloud formation * Expertise with full lifecycle of application development, including best practices of unit testing, code reviews, documentation, etc * Exposure to building and integrating AI driven solutions into production systems * Solid understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures. * Ability to research, learn, assess, and evangelize new technologies * Experience in Agile/Scrum methodology * Team player with strong communications skills and attention to detail * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Exposure to large scale production systems with complex backends and integrations * Experience with Event based processing for asynchronous workflow management * Exposure to iOS, tvOS and Android mobile application development * Previous work experience in media or entertainment technology, particularly in content distribution and media supply chain. **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Glendale, CA is $119,200\.00 \- $159,800\.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment \& Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Disney Entertainment \& Sports LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. jobs.title: Runtime Lead
jobs.description: Efficient Computer is rethinking computing from the ground up to solve one of AI's biggest challenges: energy. Our Fabric architecture delivers a 10–100x improvement in energy efficiency for general\-purpose computation, including AI, while supporting familiar programming languages and software frameworks—unlocking new possibilities for autonomous machines, intelligent infrastructure, wearables, and space systems. With our first processor, Electron E1, now shipping in volume and more than $97 million in Series B financing recently announced, we're accelerating customer deployments and scaling our architecture to data center performance. Join us to build the hardware and software that bring intelligence wherever it's needed and help shape the next generation of computing. We are looking for a Runtime Lead to architect and design the runtime software stack that brings the Fabric to life, from the Linux kernel\-mode driver through the user\-mode driver and runtime library that sit between the effcc compiler and the Fabric ABI. You will set the overall technical direction, plan the technical work with engineering management, collaborate with partner teams, and provide technical leadership to the engineers who build it, while staying hands\-on in the code. You will take the stack from pre\-silicon environments, involving QEMU, functional simulation, emulation, and FPGAs, through first silicon to ensure applications run on day one. This is a key role for the System Software team. As such, you will represent the runtime team to the compiler, architecture, digital design, verification, and product teams during all phases of development. **Key Responsibilities** ### **Provide Technical Leadership for the Runtime Team** * Provide technical leadership to the engineers who own the kernel\-mode driver and the user\-mode runtime: guide technical priorities and ownership with the engineering manager, mentor engineers, and help interview as the team scales. * Own the runtime technical roadmap: scope, milestones, and estimates. Work with the engineering management on the tradeoffs needed to hit committed dates, and raise technical risks early. * Set the engineering bar for the team: design reviews, code reviews, coding standards, test strategy, and release practices. * Build consensus on technical decisions within the team and with partner teams. * Stay hands\-on, contributing code and design to the most critical parts of the stack. ### **Architect the Runtime Software Stack** * Own the end\-to\-end architecture of the runtime software stack: the kernel\-mode driver, the HAL and Fabric ABI, the user\-mode driver and runtime library, and the interfaces used by ML framework backends (e.g., PyTorch). * Help define the split between kernel and user space: what belongs in the driver, what belongs in the runtime,and how the two share memory, synchronization primitives, and error reporting. * Help define the unified memory model between ARM cores and the Fabric accelerator, including SMMU (IOMMU) integration, tensor pool allocation, shared virtual addressing, and zero\-copy data paths. * Help define, with the compiler team, the in\-memory representations generated by the compiler and consumed by the Fabric, along with binary formats, program loading, and the launch ABI. * Help define, with the help of the firmware and architecture teams: the multi\-island task scheduling policy, microcode loading, and the software stack for the embedded risc core. * Keep the stack layered and portable across device generations, and across QEMU, functional simulation, emulation, FPGA, and silicon backends. ### **Represent the Team Cross\-Functionally** * Represent the runtime team in architecture, digital design, compiler, embedded, verification, and product forums, and bring the software point of view into hardware decisions before tapeout. * Keep engineering leadership and program management informed on technical status, risks, and decisions. * Work with product and application teams to turn SDK, framework, and application requirements into runtime priorities. ### **Drive Pre\-Silicon Bringup and Platform Enablement** * Plan and lead bring\-up across the full stack, from first boot in QEMU and functional simulation through emulation, FPGA prototypes, and first silicon, coordinating kernel and user\-mode work. * Own the runtime quality strategy, including driver and API unit tests, conformance tests, emulation\-based regression suites, performance benchmarks, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop validation. * Serve as the escalation point for the hardest debug problems across kernel and user space. **Required Qualifications** * B.S. in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent; M.S. or PhD preferred. * **10\+ years** of systems software experience, including **significant hands\-on Linux kernel\-mode driver and user\-mode runtime library development** for accelerators (GPUs, NPUs, DSPs, FPGAs, or similar). * **Experience as a technical lead**: planning and estimating technical work, mentoring engineers, and delivering against hardware and silicon schedules. * Experience architecting significant components of a production hw accelerator software stack, including the interfaces between kernel and user space and the public runtime APIs: ABI and HAL design, versioning, error models, device telemetry, thread safety, and synchronization. * Deep understanding of memory management across kernel and user space: cache coherence, IOMMU/SMMU configuration, unified or shared virtual memory, allocators, and zero\-copy data paths. * Experience working with compiler teams on binary formats, loaders, JIT vs AOT compilation, launch ABIs, and kernel metadata. * Strong written and verbal communication; able to represent the team in cross\-functional settings and executive reviews, and to influence decisions across hardware and software teams. * Expert C and C\+\+ and strong Python skills; comfortable working with AI\-assisted development tools for code, analysis, and debugging. **Desired Qualifications** * Experience contributing to or leading development of a runtime stack, e.g., CUDA (cudart), ROCm (HIP, ROCr, HSA), Tenstorrent runtime (TT\-Metalium), oneAPI Level Zero, OpenCL, or similar accelerator runtime software stack. * Experience as a technical lead on a first\-generation silicon product, where the software stack and the hardware mature together. * Familiarity with LLVM or MLIR, and with how compilers for accelerators hand off to runtimes. * Knowledge of dataflow, spatial, or other novel compute architectures, and of how compilers and runtimes target them. * Experience with FPGA prototyping and hardware emulation platforms (Palladium, Zebu, Veloce, or similar). * Experience with pre\-silicon and first\-silicon bring\-up on ARM platforms: QEMU, emulation, or simulation environments; memory\-mapped I/O, interrupt handling, and the Linux boot flow; and the ARM architecture. We offer a competitive base salary for this role, generally ranging from $220,000 to $270,000, plus a 10% annual bonus, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits. Final compensation will depend on experience, level, and location, with flexibility for the right candidate. **Why Join Efficient?** Build what's next. At Efficient, you'll tackle big challenges with room to take ownership and make an impact. We back you with competitive pay, equity, a 401(k) match, company\-paid benefits, paid parental leave, and flexibility—plus opportunities to grow your skills and career as we scale.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer & Product Lead
jobs.description: **Senior AI Engineer \& Product Lead** BroadPeak Investment Group is a private equity and family office firm headquartered in Atlanta building AI\-native platforms across its portfolio — property management, franchise operations, sports and entertainment, and more. We are hiring a Senior AI Engineer and Product Lead to own the design, development, and delivery of these systems from the ground up. This is not a maintenance role. You will be the architect and the builder. You will work directly with the CEO and division leadership to understand what the business needs, translate that into product, and ship it. A junior engineer will support you as your first hire under this role. We use the best tools available. We expect you to know what those tools are, stay ahead of what's coming, and make decisions accordingly. **What you will own:** You are building a property management platform as the first project — a full web application covering tenant management, lease tracking, vendor workflows, maintenance operations, financial reporting, and a public\-facing website with AI\-powered leasing inquiry. Claude AI is embedded throughout as an operational layer: answering inquiries, drafting communications, analyzing financial performance, handling inbound calls via voice AI, and serving each team member as a role\-specific assistant. After Properties, you will replicate and adapt this model across other BroadPeak divisions. * Architect and build full\-stack web applications with clean, scalable, maintainable code * Integrate Claude API and other LLM tools deeply into product workflows — not as a chatbot bolted on, but as a core operating layer * Design the AI behavior — prompts, workflows, guardrails, and output quality — so the system performs like a knowledgeable operator * Manage third\-party integrations including voice AI (Vapi/Bland.ai), payment processing (Stripe), document management, and financial data * Own the product roadmap, translate business requirements into specifications, and communicate clearly with non\-technical stakeholders * Lead and mentor the junior engineer on your team * Evaluate and adopt new tools continuously — if there is a better way to build something, you find it and use it **What we are looking for:** * You have 5 or more years of experience building and shipping production web applications, not prototypes. * You are equally comfortable designing a database schema, writing backend logic, building a clean frontend, and designing the AI workflows that connect everything. * You have shipped something real using Claude, OpenAI, or a comparable LLM API and can walk us through what you built, what broke, and how you fixed it. * You are current. You know what tools exist right now — Cursor, v0, Windsurf, Claude Code, or whatever has emerged since — and you use them to move faster without cutting corners. * You have opinions about the right stack for a given problem and can defend them. * You can sit across from a CEO who does not write code, explain what you are building, take business input, and push back when a requirement does not make sense. **Technical Requirements:** * Full\-stack proficiency — Python or Node.js backend, React or similar frontend * Database design and management — PostgreSQL preferred * LLM API integration in production — Anthropic Claude strongly preferred; include examples in your application * Cloud deployment and infrastructure — AWS or Vercel * Voice AI platform experience — Vapi, Bland.ai, or equivalent (strong plus) * Multi\-tenant application architecture — role\-based access, permissioning, security * API integrations — Stripe, DocuSign, or similar third\-party services * Proficiency with AI\-assisted development environments: Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent **What this is not:** * This is not a corporate IT role. There is no existing system to maintain and no committee to approve your stack choices. * You will make decisions and own them. If you need a large team around you to do your best work, this is not the right fit. **Applications must include a resume, a brief note (no longer than one paragraph) describing the most interesting thing you’ve built, and a link to your GitHub profile or a deployed project to be considered.** *We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer. Applicants for employment are considered without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.*

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Systems
jobs.description: **Arlyn AI – AI\-Powered Insights for Life Science** ---------------------------------------------------- Arlyn AI is a New York based, fast\-growing AI startup expanding patient access to life\-changing medicines while reducing commercial costs for drug innovators. **Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Systems** --------------------------------------- We're unable to sponsor new H\-1B visas. We're looking for a data\-driven problem solver to leverage large language models (LLMs) and transform unstructured data into data ontologies and actionable insights that drive drug launches and access strategies. jobs.description: Description: Fishers, IN, or nearby. Over a decade ago, we started with a pioneering vision and patents for the first smart mailbox for drone delivery. Through systematic research, development, and deep customer collaboration, we've evolved to today, where we deploy Arrive Points: smart lockers and mini\-cross\-docks for frictionless drone, robotic, and courier delivery, from medical supplies to meals to e\-commerce. Arrive AI is now scaling the ALM network and platform of the future for all autonomous delivery providers, services, and customers. We are the intelligent choice for the last inch of the Autonomous Last Mile™. **About Us** We move fast, balancing strategy with opportunity. We are merit\-based, valuing integrity, innovation, and treating others as we want to be treated. At Arrive AI, every employee is an equity holder and a business owner. Our shared vision, ownership, and culture fuel our mission to revolutionize autonomous delivery. **Product Team** You'll be joining Arrive AI's Product Team to revolutionize Autonomous Last Mile (ALM) logistics by transforming over a decade of research, design, and customer collaboration into the world's first autonomous logistics network and platform. Our fast\-paced skunkworks team rapidly iterates, prototypes, and develops next\-generation Arrive Point units, networks, and AI\-powered platforms. By integrating hardware, robotics, IoT, software, data, AI, and manufacturing, we're driving a bold roadmap for ALM innovation. Based in Fishers, IN, we offer a unique opportunity to do your life's best work, shape the future, and share in the success. **The Role** We're seeking a Senior Computer Vision Engineer to own the Arrive Point vision pipeline end\-to\-end: from the camera, through inference on the edge device, to the events that ArriveOS acts on and the data that reaches the cloud. You'll decide which models we run, train and optimize them, deploy them to NVIDIA Jetson hardware, and keep them accurate in the field. This is a hands\-on senior role with a bias toward the edge device. You'll work directly in C\+\+ and Python with NVIDIA's DeepStream, GStreamer, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT, and related frameworks. You'll be familiar with the cloud side and work closely with our platform team, who manages our operating system and cloud services. **What You'll Do** * Own the vision pipeline: Own the Arrive Point vision stack from camera ingress through inference to the events ArriveOS consumes and the data that reaches the cloud. * Build edge pipelines: Develop and maintain C\+\+ pipelines with NVIDIA's DeepStream and GStreamer on Jetson Orin and Thor, using Triton Inference Server and TensorRT. * Select and train models: Evaluate, select, train, and fine\-tune the right model for each task, from binary classifiers and CNNs to vision transformers, object detectors, and vision\-language models. * Optimize for the edge: Export models through ONNX to TensorRT, build per\-platform engines (FP16, INT8\), and verify accuracy, latency, and memory on the device. * Collect data on real hardware: Sample, curate, and label data from deployed cameras, fine\-tune their configurations, and address edge cases. * Run the model lifecycle: Maintain the training and release pipeline, including dataset versioning, CI\-gated evaluation, ONNX and TensorRT parity checks, robustness testing, drift monitoring, and retraining. * Integrate with ArriveOS: Work with the platform team on the gRPC contracts between the vision service and ArriveOS, our Rust\-based edge orchestrator, including event debouncing, health reporting, and inter\-process communication. * Stream video: Maintain live video egress over WebRTC for remote viewing and operations. * Deploy and operate: Containerize and deploy vision services to edge devices with Docker and K3s, including cross\-builds, hardware\-in\-the\-loop tests, and simulated test environments. * Work with the cloud: Collaborate with our cloud and platform team members on object storage, model publishing, and data flows between the edge and the cloud. * Protect camera data: Design with privacy and security in mind for video that can contain personal information (HIPAA familiarity and "on\-prem only" experience are a bonus). * Document and communicate: Write architecture decision records, technical guides, and test reports, and present results and trade\-offs to engineers, leadership, and partners. Requirements: **What We're Looking For** * Education and experience: A master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with 3 to 5 years of industry experience, or a PhD with 3 or more years of industry experience. We weigh hands\-on work with real cameras and edge hardware heavily. * End\-to\-end ownership: A track record of shipping a vision system from camera to production deployment, not only training models. * Model development: Classical and modern computer vision, with experience evaluating, selecting, training, and fine\-tuning classifiers, CNNs, vision transformers, object detectors, and vision\-language models in PyTorch. * Edge inference: TensorRT and ONNX, including engine builds, quantization, and accuracy checks after conversion. * Media pipelines: NVIDIA DeepStream and GStreamer. * Serving and APIs: Triton Inference Server, gRPC, and modern API\-driven development workflows. * Edge hardware: NVIDIA Jetson (Orin, Thor) and other edge compute such as Raspberry Pi. * Programming: Strong C\+\+ (C\+\+17 or later) and Python. * Data on real hardware: Confidence collecting data on edge devices, including sampling, curation, labeling, edge\-case analysis, and adjusting camera and lighting conditions. * Containers and DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes or K3s, CI/CD pipelines, and working familiarity with AWS or Azure and S3\-compatible object storage. * Communication: Clear writing and presenting for technical and non\-technical audiences, and a habit of documenting as you build. * Learning and flexibility: Quick to pick up new tools, platforms, and problems in a fast\-moving startup. **Nice to Have** * Specific models: YOLO, TinyViT, NVIDIA PeopleNet, and the NVIDIA TAO Toolkit. * WebRTC: Live video with WebRTC, including SFUs, WHIP, and TURN and STUN. * Inter\-process communication: Unix domain sockets, shared memory, and message framing with FlatBuffers or Protocol Buffers. * Camera hardware: Image sensors, optics, housings, GigE, MIPI CSI\-2, USB and V4L2, Intel RealSense, and time\-of\-flight sensors. * Other languages: Familiarity with Rust\-based architectures, and Go. * Additional perception: OCR and depth sensing. * MLOps: Dataset versioning, drift monitoring, and label quality analysis. * Video integration: RTSP, ONVIF, and video management systems. * Domain: A background in logistics, delivery, retail, or security video. **Additional** * Expect to travel up to 5 days per month. * Responsibilities include all other duties as assigned. * At this time, we are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position. **Compensation** Salary is market competitive with a high equity incentive. Be an owner and grow with Arrive AI.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, AI Applications
jobs.description: **The opportunity** ------------------- We’re hiring a dedicated technical lead for a growing set of web applications that help people navigate healthcare. Someone might use chat to find a clinic, talk through a financial benefits application while reviewing it on screen, or sign in to reschedule an appointment or view a lab result. You own how that experience looks, feels, and works, from the first interaction to the record the patient relies on. Your engineering team is a fleet of AI agents with a dedicated AI budget. They investigate problems, propose designs, write the code, test it, and carry it through release. You decide what’s worth building, set the architectural and product standards, and give the team the tools and authority to meet them. Our application stack is Rust. **What you’ll own** ------------------- * **The patient experience.** Use the product yourself and decide what needs to improve. When a patient changes an appointment by voice, can they tell at a glance which time they chose, whether it’s confirmed, and what to do next? Direct the team on layout, language, timing, and interaction until the spoken response and the screen feel like one product. * **The engineering across the stack.** Guide the team’s decisions about the database, APIs, model context and tools, and frontend state. Use types to make guarantees hold across those boundaries. If the confirmation screen requires a confirmed booking, code that passes it a pending request should fail to compile. * **What the AI team can own next.** Choose a product outcome the team should own, then identify the decisions that still depend on you. Have the team build the telemetry, replay tools, and simulations it needs to compare what the application told a user, what appeared on screen, and what was actually saved. Once the team can diagnose failures, verify fixes, and catch regressions on its own, give it responsibility for improving that outcome in production. **Required qualifications** --------------------------- * You’ve led a polished, user\-facing web application from an open\-ended need through production. You can show us an interaction you shaped, explain the data and service design behind it, and point to a detail you changed after watching someone use it. * You have deep experience in a strongly typed language and can lead engineering in Rust. You’ve designed a type or interface that eliminated a class of bugs and can explain what still needed to be tested at runtime. * You’ve directed AI coding agents to deliver substantial engineering work. You can describe a design decision you kept, one you delegated, and the evidence that gave you confidence in what the team shipped. **Preferred experience** ------------------------ Production Rust, conversational voice or chat applications, and healthcare workflows are each valuable experience for this role.

Lead root\-cause analysis across upstream and downstream dependencies, including REST APIs, microservices, and third\-party SaaS Platforms, and drive fixes through to deployment. * Suggest architectural direction and author design documents for solutions that meet current requirements and influence future projects. Review architectural designs and solutions proposed by others. * Own the operational health of the systems you work on: drive improvements to monitoring, alerting, performance, and scalability, and strengthen CI/CD and deployment processes rather than only following them. * Lead peer code reviews for epics and larger features, setting and reinforcing team standards for security, efficiency, and maintainability. * Collaborate directly with Product, Design, QA, and dependent engineering teams to align on scope, sequencing, and deliverables. Able to contribute to solution design and code in these areas without ramp\-up or guidance. * Minimum of 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands\-on experience with cloud\-based technologies such as AWS EC2, CloudFront, Lambda, SQS, and S3\. * Demonstrated experience leading the technical design and delivery of medium\-scope features or small projects end to end, including producing high\-level designs and breaking work down for other engineers. * Proven ability to diagnose and resolve high\-complexity production issues across interconnected systems, and to lead others through that investigation. * Strong command of the application development lifecycle—unit and integration testing, CI/CD, code review, documentation, and observability—with a habit of applying team best practices and providing input to improve them. * Communicates effectively, clearly, and concisely in written and verbal form on both technical and non\-technical subjects. Works well across engineering, product, design, and QA, and regularly delivers useful feedback to peers and leaders. * Experience mentoring other engineers and serving as a technical resource for a team. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Proficiency with GraphQL, including experience contributing to or building subgraphs within a federated graph architecture (e.g., Apollo Federation). * Experience using AI coding tools such as Github Copilot, Claude Code, or similar. * Prior work experience in media management or digital media distribution operations * Experience leading a small team or cross\-functional effort to deliver a project, and participating in recruiting and interviewing. * Demonstrated initiative as a change agent: identifies and pursues improvements to team processes, tooling, or service delivery. * Experience working within an Agile environment. **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Glendale, CA is $119,200\.00 \- $159,800\.00 per year.
