jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Ads Integrations & Partner Ecosystem
jobs.description: Reports to: Sr. Director Product Management Department: Product FLSA Category: Exempt Position Type: Full\-Time, Senior level Travel Requirement: 0\-10%, Quarterly for meetings Office Location: Remote, US Based **About the team** Advertising is being rebuilt from first principles \- where people discover products through conversation, agents and generative interfaces rather than search results and banner slots \- where infrastructure connecting buyers, sellers and publishers is being reinvented. Clarvos is building that infrastructure for Small to Medium sized businesses. We’re a collaborative group of Engineers, Product leaders and Marketers. We ship fast, measure rigorously, and hold ourselves to a high bar on user trust: every ad and commerce experience we build must be clearly labeled, genuinely useful, and never compromise the integrity of what our models say. **About the role** We’re looking for a Product Manager who connects Clarvos to the wider advertising and commerce ecosystem: publishers, e\-commerce marketplaces, retail media networks, and other ad platforms (DSPs, SSPs, ad servers and measurement partners). You’ll define the requirements for integration of the APIs and protocols that partners build on, and the commercial and technical terms that make those partnerships work at scale. You’ll sit at the intersection of AI, ad tech and commerce, working directly with our engineering, research, partnerships, policy and legal teams, and with senior counterparts at some of the largest publishers and marketplaces in the world. **In this role, you will** * Work closely with the CRO across publishers, e\-commerce marketplaces and third\-party ad platforms, deciding which partners, data sources and surfaces to prioritize and why. * Design the platform partners build on: ads and commerce APIs, product catalog and inventory feeds, conversion and attribution signals, and agent\-ready protocols that let AI systems discover, compare and transact on behalf of users. * Bring marketplace and retail media inventory into AI\-native experiences, from shoppable answers to agent\-driven checkout, with clear labeling and user control built in from day one. * Build integrations with the programmatic ecosystem (DSPs, SSPs, ad servers, clean rooms and measurement providers) so advertisers can buy, measure and optimize using the tools they already trust. * Partner with publishers to create new models for content licensing, attribution and revenue sharing in a world where answers are generated, not just linked. * Translate partner needs into crisp product requirements, working hand in hand with engineering and research to ship, then iterate based on adoption, revenue and quality metrics. * Champion privacy, safety and trust: work with policy, legal and privacy teams to make sure every integration meets our standards for consent, data minimization and ad transparency. * Represent Clarvos externally in deal reviews, technical deep dives and industry standards conversations (for example, IAB Tech Lab working groups). * Connect to the ad platforms SMBs rely on: build and scale integrations with Meta, TikTok and Amazon, from publishing campaigns to bringing performance reporting back into Clarvos. * Design for self\-serve at SMB scale: create intuitive experiences that let small businesses launch and manage campaigns on their own, without needing an expert. **You might thrive in this role if you** * Have 6\+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years building platform, API or partner integration products in ad tech, retail media, e\-commerce or marketplaces. * Understand the advertising stack deeply: programmatic buying and selling, auctions, ad serving, catalog and shopping ads, attribution and measurement, and the privacy regulations that shape them (GDPR, CCPA and successors). * Have shipped integrations that external partners actually adopted, and can point to the adoption, revenue or performance numbers that prove it. * Are technical enough to design an API with engineers, read a spec critically, and reason about latency, data schemas and reliability trade\-offs. * Are energized by ambiguity and enjoy defining a category, not just optimizing an existing one. * Are curious and thoughtful about AI and can envision how agents, LLMs and generative interfaces will change how people discover and buy things. * Communicate clearly and persuasively, whether you’re writing a strategy memo, negotiating with a partner’s VP, or aligning a room of engineers. * Care about users first, and believe great monetization should make the product better, not worse. **Bonus points if you** * Have worked on a retail media network, a marketplace ads business (Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Instacart, Shopify) or a major publisher’s monetization platform. * Have experience with agentic commerce or emerging protocols for AI\-to\-merchant interaction. * Have built products on clean rooms, privacy\-enhancing technologies or server\-side conversion APIs. * Have founded a company or led a 0\-to\-1 product from concept to meaningful revenue. * Have a technical degree or a background in engineering, data science or machine learning. **Why Clarvos** The last major shift in advertising, from desktop to mobile, created a generation of category\-defining platforms. The shift to AI\-native discovery and agentic commerce is bigger, and it’s happening now. In this role you won’t be adapting yesterday’s playbook; you’ll be writing the one the rest of the industry follows. You’ll work alongside a worldclass team and will shape how millions of people discover products and how publishers and merchants reach them. **Benefits** * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage for you and your family on Day One. * Health Savings Account or Flexible Spending Accounts * Voluntary insurance options * Employee assistance plan and health advocate services * Paid time off and Paid holidays * Employer paid basic life and disability coverage * 401(k) with discretionary company match **Equal opportunity** Clarvos is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. We’re committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities; reach out to hrsupport@clarvos.com if you need one. We believe diverse perspectives make better products, especially products that will be used by everyone. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: At 3Si, our mission is to make your world, safer. As a global leader in innovative security technology, we help businesses and law enforcement prevent and respond to crime through field\-proven solutions and trusted partnerships. With over 100\+ years of combined experience through our merged companies, our expertise drives measurable impact in communities worldwide. We specialize in GPS tracking, video surveillance, and integrated response technologies that deter theft and accelerate criminal apprehension. Designed for retail, financial institutions, law enforcement, and more, our solutions combine cutting\-edge tools with unmatched response capabilities. Through our exclusiveDirectToDispatch™ technology, verified crime alerts are sent directly to law enforcement dispatch centers in real time—bypassing traditional third\-party monitoring delays—to enable rapid, precise response when it matters most. At 3Si, meaningful work makes a difference. We’re a purpose\-driven team that values innovation, trust, and collaboration. From engineering to sales and support, every role contributes to our mission to protect communities and make the world safer. We offer a hybrid, flexible work culture, competitive benefits, and the chance to grow alongside a team of passionate, dedicated professionals. Join us—and be part of something that matters. The DevSecOps Engineer is a crucial part of the engineering team, responsible for maintaining the infrastructure, automating processes, and supporting development environments to ensure seamless integration, security, and delivery. The position includes working with multiple cross\-functional teams, leveraging technologies such as .NET, Blazor, AWS, Gitlab, and Azure DevOps to manage CI/CD pipelines, server infrastructure, and cloud environments. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of DevSecOps practices, continuously improving the software development lifecycle by implementing automation, monitoring, and security measures, and will help ensure that development practices meet compliance and auditing requirements, including NIST SP 800\-218 (Secure Software Development Framework). **Primary Responsibilities** * CI/CD Pipeline Management: Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines, ensuring efficient and reliable software releases across environments using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps, and others. * Automation \& Infrastructure Management: Use infrastructure\-as\-code tools like Terraform and Ansible to automate the provisioning and management of infrastructure across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and data centers. Maintain CentOS physical and virtual servers in multiple data centers. * Collaboration \& Communication: Work closely with product owners, development teams, and stakeholders to gather requirements and provide technical solutions. Participate in Agile environments to ensure smooth collaboration and team efficiency. * Security Integration: Implement and integrate security baselines into CI/CD pipelines, including the use of tools such as SonarQube, Fortify, and SAST/DAST solutions for vulnerability scanning and mitigation. * DevSecOps Compliance \& Auditing (NIST SP 800\-218\): Implement and maintain the practices of the NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) across the software development lifecycle, spanning Prepare the Organization, Protect the Software, Produce Well\-Secured Software, and Respond to Vulnerabilities. Automate the collection of audit evidence from CI/CD pipelines (e.g., scan results, code review records, build provenance, SBOMs, artifact signing, and release archives); support internal and external audits and customer secure\-software attestations; track and remediate compliance gaps; and maintain documentation mapping pipeline controls to SSDF practices and tasks. * Monitoring \& Maintenance: Configure and maintain system monitoring tools like Zabbix or Datadog to track performance, incidents, and system reliability. Conduct server and network maintenance during designated windows. * Release Management: Oversee and manage release cycles, ensuring smooth deployments and troubleshooting issues as they arise. Ensure security and compliance in deployments through continuous monitoring and automation. * Network \& VPN Configuration: Configure and maintain VPN connections and firewalls, ensuring secure and efficient communication between internal and third\-party services. * IT Administration \& Maintenance: Perform basic IT administrator duties, including the administration, maintenance, and support of the Ashburn network, servers, and workstations. * Developer Support: Support local and remote developers with technical issues, troubleshoot development environments, and keep their systems running smoothly to minimize downtime and maintain productivity. * Corporate IT Support: Partner with the corporate IT team to perform tasks that require on\-site presence at the Ashburn facility, such as hands\-on hardware installation and troubleshooting, equipment setup and replacement, and cabling and network connectivity checks. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Experience in Agile environments, preferably SAFe, and supporting multiple development teams. * Familiarity with container management platforms like Kubernetes and orchestration tools such as Docker\-compose. * Experience with continuous monitoring tools like ELK Stack, and Kibana. * Ability to translate compliance requirements, such as SSDF practices and tasks, into automated pipeline controls and clear, auditable documentation. * Knowledge of Cloud Service Platforms such as AWS and Azure, and experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Ansible, Chef, and Puppet. * Strong problem\-solving skills and a passion for improving system efficiency. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team, with an eye for detail and a commitment to quality. * Business acumen: Understanding the business value of technology implementations and aligning DevOps efforts with organizational goals. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Experience in DevSecOps: Minimum of 4 years supporting DevOps/DevSecOps efforts, automating and reengineering the software development process in both cloud and on\-premises environments. * Development Background: 3\-5 years of experience in software development using languages such as.NET, JAVA, C\+\+. * CI/CD Expertise: Experience in developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and integrating various tools such as Gitlab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Git. * Experience with automated testing and release management. * Cloud and Containerization: Proficiency in cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure, with hands\-on experience using containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes for orchestration. * Security \& Compliance: Strong understanding of integrating security systems into DevOps processes and ensuring security compliance in CI/CD pipelines through tools like Nexus Repository, SonarQube, and Fortify. * Secure Software Development Frameworks: Working knowledge of NIST SP 800\-218 (SSDF), including generating and maintaining audit\-ready evidence for its practices; familiarity with software supply chain security (SBOM generation, dependency and provenance tracking, artifact signing) and related frameworks such as NIST SP 800\-53 and EO 14028 attestation requirements. * Monitoring \& Troubleshooting: Hands\-on experience with monitoring tools such as ELK Stack, and Zabbix. Ability to diagnose and resolve performance issues in a multi\-tier environment. **Additional Comments** * Standard business hours for this role are 8:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m. ET. * Less than 10% of travel * Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short\- and long\-term disability starting on your first day * 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Python / JavaScript / ERP)

The focus is Production Data and Inventory Analysis. You will build the pipelines, automation, dashboards, and predictive models that turn network and inventory data into trusted, decision\-ready information for engineering, operations, planning, finance, and executive leadership. **The Main Responsibilities** ----------------------------- ### **Production Data Management and Analysis** * Lead the collection, validation, analysis, and governance of Fiber OLT, Metro, and transport network production datasets. * Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of production network data across operational platforms, inventory systems, and reporting repositories. * Profile data for quality, integrity, accuracy, and completeness, and design repeatable checks that catch problems before they reach reports and downstream systems. * Develop and maintain operational reporting, dashboards, and metrics for network assets, service delivery, and infrastructure deployment using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, and Python or R visualization libraries. * Apply statistical analysis and exploratory data analysis to identify trends, inventory utilization patterns, deployment bottlenecks, data quality issues, and operational risks. * Provide actionable insights and recommendations to engineering, operations, and leadership teams, and present findings in clear, executive\-ready narratives. ### **Network Inventory Management** * Own enterprise governance processes for Fiber and Metro network inventory data. * Ensure synchronization and consistency between network infrastructure, inventory databases, and operational support systems. * Lead inventory reconciliation efforts between production environments and systems such as NetBox, Optius/Odin, and other inventory management platforms. * Identify, investigate, and resolve inventory discrepancies, data quality concerns, and asset record inconsistencies, using root cause analysis to prevent repeat issues. * Lead large\-scale record clean\-up, digitization, and migration efforts, including converting legacy as\-built drawings, route records, and lease information into authoritative inventory systems. * Establish standards and controls for inventory lifecycle management, data maintenance, and audit readiness, including network audit standards and guidelines. ### **Inventory Platform and Systems Management** * Serve as the subject matter expert for network inventory platforms and data management tools. * Partner with IT, engineering, and vendor teams to support enhancements, integrations, and operational improvements within NetBox, Optius/Odin, and related systems. * Define requirements and functional specifications for inventory workflows, data models, reporting structures, and validation processes. * Design and manage data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, APIs, and data warehouse integrations that move network and inventory data reliably between systems. * Support data migration, system integration, and inventory modernization initiatives from concept through production. * Ensure inventory systems accurately reflect deployed network assets and service relationships. ### **Data Governance and Process Improvement** * Establish and enforce standards for network data quality, inventory accuracy, and reporting consistency, including polici  and hypothesis testing, and the ability to explain model results to non\-technical audiences. * Strong understanding of OSS platforms, network inventory architectures, and data integration methodologies. * Advanced analytical, problem\-solving, and root cause investigation skills. * Proven project management, mentoring, and team leadership experience. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities, including with senior leadership. ### **Education** Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Data Analytics, or a related field desired. A master's degree in data science, analytics, or a related discipline is a plus. ### **Experience** **Required:** * 7\+ years of experience in telecommunications network engineering, network operations, inventory management, OSS platforms, production data analysis, or related technical disciplines. **Strongly preferred:** * Experience supporting Fiber Access, OLT, Metro Ethernet, transport networks, and enterprise inventory platforms such as NetBox and Optius/Odin. * Experience in outside plant engineering, network implementation, or fiber planning, including route feasibility, splice and conduit planning, and as\-built records. * Experience leading data quality, data engineering, or business intelligence teams within a telecommunications or broadband provider. * Experience migrating or modernizing large inventory or records datasets (hundreds of thousands of records) from legacy systems. * A record of measurable results, such as reduced data redundancy and errors, faster project rollout, and improved operational KPIs. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Individual pay is based on skills, experience, and other relevant factors. **Base Salary Range:** $132,000 – $165,000 USD This role is also eligible for an annual bonus. Starting pay within this range is based on job\-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, certifications, and work location. Additional growth opportunities exist beyond the starting range through progression and performance. Forged Fiber also offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your physical, mental, emotional, and financial well\-being. **What to Expect Next** ----------------------- ### **Background Screening** If you are selected for a position, there will be a background screen, which may include checks for criminal records and/or motor vehicle reports and/or drug screening, depending on the position requirements. Employers can only use E\-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I\-9\. ### **Equal Employment Opportunities** It is the policy of Forged Fiber to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. jobs.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. This role is critical in ensuring the safety and reliability of our production systems through proactive validation techniques, including production load testing and chaos engineering. **What you'll do** ------------------ ### **Leadership \& Strategy** * Define and drive the vision for resilience engineering at Affirm, with a focus on production load testing and chaos engineering as first\-class engineering practices. * Tech lead and mentor a team of engineers building platforms and tooling for safe production experimentation. * Partner with infrastructure, product, and security leadership to embed resilience validation into the software development lifecycle. * Establish best practices for safely testing system limits and failure scenarios in production. ### **Systems \& Operations** * Own the design and evolution of platforms that enable safe, controlled production load testing and fault injection. * Ensure strong safeguards are in place, including isolation boundaries, approval workflows, and automated rollback mechanisms to protect real users. * Build systems that provide end\-to\-end observability, traceability, and auditability for all resilience experiments. * Drive reliability improvements by systematically identifying weaknesses through load testing and chaos experiments. * Establish monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices tailored to proactive resilience validation. ### **Collaboration \& Enablement** * Work closely with engineering teams to design and execute production load tests and chaos experiments safely. * Partner with infrastructure teams to build guardrails around tests and experimentations. * Enable teams to adopt resilience practices by providing reusable tooling, frameworks, and standardized workflows. * Identify systemic weaknesses and lead cross\-functional efforts to improve reliability and fault tolerance. * Evangelize a culture of "test failure before failure tests you" across the organization. **What we look for** -------------------- * Proven experience leading engineering teams in backend software development or infrastructure development. * Hands\-on experience with production load testing, chaos engineering, or large\-scale system validation (nice to have) * Strong understanding of failure modes in distributed systems, including latency, partial failure, and cascading outages. * Experience building or operating systems with strong safety guarantees (isolation, rate limiting, guardrails, auditability). * Familiarity with cloud\-native environments (AWS, Kubernetes) and observability tooling. * Strong programming background (e.g., Python, Kotlin, Java, or similar). * Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to balance long\-term resilience investments with immediate business needs. * Strong communication and leadership skills, with a track record of influencing engineering practices across teams. * This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field. **Base Pay Grade** \- P **Equity Grade** \- 13 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Some positions may occasionally require in\-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office\-based due to the nature of the work. jobs.title: AI & Automation Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Aldridge is a leading Managed Service Provider (MSP) offering scalable IT and cybersecurity solutions to fast\-growing, small to mid\-market businesses in the US. Founded in 1984, this private equity\-backed company is a technology management consulting, and outsourcing firm that provides best\-fit solutions through a tailored approach and local relationships. With offices in Houston, Dallas, Fort Worth, San Antonio, Austin, Alexandria, Monroe and Seattle, the company’s unwavering dedication, superior technical expertise, and keen understanding of business processes have transformed it into a trusted partner for its clients. With a strong reputation for delivering high\-quality services, Aldridge is committed to helping its clients optimize their technology infrastructure and achieve their business goals. **Position Overview:** The AI \& Automation Solutions Engineer owns the day\-to\-day success of assigned client AI and automation engagements from discovery through operational handoff. The AI \& Automation Solutions Engineer translates client problems into outcome\-oriented technical plans, leads solution scoping, coordinates the Architect and engineering specialists, manages delivery mechanics, drives adoption, and verifies that the client received the intended result. The AI \& Automation Solutions Engineer is accountable for the engagement outcome; the VP of AI retains executive accountability and client satisfaction. The Solution Architect is the Solution Engineer's peer for technical integrity. Neither role automatically overrides the other across that boundary; unresolved material tradeoffs escalate to the VP of AI. **Client Discovery and Outcome Shaping** * Lead discovery with client stakeholders to understand the current process, business problem, desired outcome, users, constraints, environment and readiness risks. * Turn vague client requests into decision\-ready technical engagement definitions with expected outcomes, success criteria, assumptions, dependencies, risks and an initial delivery approach. * Identify when the client problem is primarily adoption, data readiness, process design, platform configuration, custom engineering or some combination rather than defaulting every request to a build. **Solution Scoping and Pre\-Sales Technical Support** * Lead technical solution scoping for AI and automation engagements and provide the delivery perspective required before work is sold. * Pull in the Forward Deployment Architect for consequential design decisions and the AI \& Automation Lead, Developers or Data Engineer for implementation estimates and specialist input. * Make technical assumptions and delivery dependencies explicit so commercial scope is based on a credible implementation plan. * Support sales and account teams with technical explanations and solution demonstrations without becoming the owner of pricing or commercial approval. **Engagement Delivery and Project Management** * Own the day\-to\-day delivery plan for assigned engagements, including milestones, actions, dependencies, risks, client follow\-up, status communication and coordination of Aldridge contributors. * Maintain enough technical depth to recognize when requirements, scope or architecture assumptions are changing and drive the appropriate decision before work drifts. * Coordinate AI \& Automation Developers, the Data Engineer and other Aldridge specialists while respecting their functional reporting lines. * Escalate material scope, client relationship, architecture or delivery\-risk issues to the VP of AI early. **Platform and Environment Deployment** * Coordinate client deployment and readiness for platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude and other AI or automation environments used by the engagement. * Coordinate identity, permissions, connectors, tenant configuration, data\-readiness and specialist engineering activities required to make the solution work in the client environment. * Do not independently act as the final authority on consequential security or architecture design. Work with the Forward Deployment Architect and appropriate Aldridge Security or IT specialists. **Adoption, Enablement and Change Support** * Treat adoption as part of engagement success rather than a post\-project courtesy. Identify low or uneven adoption and make it visible to Aldridge and client leadership. * Build or coordinate corrective adoption plans that may include training, documentation, workflow changes, communications, feedback loops, manager reinforcement and engineering changes. * Create or coordinate training materials, client documentation, demos and enablement sessions needed for successful use. * Partner with client leadership, which remains responsible for reinforcing behavior and holding its own teams accountable for adoption. **Measurement, Acceptance and Value Realization** * Ensure each engagement has an agreed success measure before the solution is treated as complete. * Partner wi oing support once the solution is production\-ready. * Confirm that runbooks, documentation, monitoring, known issues, support ownership, client support path and unresolved enhancement work are clearly documented. * After handoff, routine technical support and remediation move to the AI \& Automation Developers and Lead. Re\-enter when an issue affects adoption, client outcome, scope or relationship management. * Demonstrated experience leading technical client engagements, implementations or consulting work from discovery through deployment and acceptance. * Strong technical fluency across AI/LLM platforms, automation, APIs and integrations, cloud services, identity and data\-readiness concepts sufficient to shape solutions and coordinate specialists. * Ability to translate business problems into technical requirements, delivery plans and measurable success criteria. * Practical project\-management discipline: milestones, dependencies, risk management, status communication, follow\-up and scope control. * Strong client communication and facilitation skills, including working sessions, demos, difficult expectation\-setting and adoption conversations. * Enough hands\-on technical ability to prototype, troubleshoot or validate when useful, without needing to be the primary developer for every engagement. **Preferred Experience** * Managed service provider, professional services, systems integration, consulting or technical customer\-success environment. * Hands\-on deployment or administration experience with Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or comparable enterprise AI platforms. * Microsoft 365, Azure, Power Platform, Microsoft Graph or identity\-and\-permissions experience. * Change enablement, training design or user\-adoption work tied to technology deployments. * Experience scoping fixed\-fee or outcome\-oriented technical work and managing assumptions through delivery. **Hybrid work schedule** * Optional work from home days are Mondays and Fridays * Required in\-office days are Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays **Additional Requirements** * Physical ability to stand, walk or sit for extended periods * Must be comfortable with periodically lifting 25 pounds * Travel will be required up to 50% **Aldridge Core Values:** * Build Trust – We continuously earn the trust of our partners through genuine, transparent communication, and unflinching accountability. * Take Swift, Meaningful Action – When every second matters, we drill to the core question and act decisively. * Create Best\-Fit Solutions – More is not always better – We create the most value for the least added overhead and complexity. * Evolve \& Improve – We know the power of a growth mindset. We do not let fear of failure stop us from finding new, and better ways to do things. **Benefits:** * Competitive Salary and Incentive Plan * Generous Employer Contribution to Health Benefits Package * 401(k) Matching * 4 Weeks Paid Time Off per year, plus additional days for community service * Ongoing Training and Professional Development Opportunities * Free Snacks and Beverages! *Aldridge is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, age, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all our employees. All employment is based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. The Company reserves the right to modify, add, remove, or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time to meet business needs. Nothing in this job description alters the at\-will employment relationship or constitutes a contract of employment.*

jobs.description: Alkami is the digital sales and service platform provider for U.S. banks and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data\-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action. Founded in 2009, we continue to be recognized for our intentional culture and tremendous growth (Best Place to Work in Fintech; Best \& Brightest to Work For Nationally; and Comparably’s Best Company Culture, Best Career Growth, Best Engineering Team, and Best Places to Work in Dallas, among others). We’re building a culture where each Alkamist can perform to their highest potential, and we’re always on the lookout for the best and brightest minds. If you’re ready to experience the power of alchemy \- transforming the ordinary into the extraordinary \- come join one of the fastest growing SaaS companies in the U.S. As a remote\-first company, most of our positions can be remote in the US, except for key roles, which will be indicated in the Job Title. Follow us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn! The Staff AI Platform Engineer builds and operates the infrastructure that enables Alkami’s Elixir agent platform to run safely in Alkami’s cloud environment and prepare for future customer\-approved deployments. The role owns cloud environments, networking, identity, and deployment patterns for the platform, including agent execution environments and connectivity to internal systems. Working with the Principal AI Platform Engineer, InfoSec, and SRE, this engineer turns security and reliability requirements into practical controls. The role leads infrastructure work hands\-on and helps other engineers apply consistent cloud platform standards. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** ---------------------------------------- * Build and operate the cloud infrastructure for Elixir, including its application backend, agent execution sandboxes, and network paths to internal systems. * Create private, inspected connectivity that lets agents reach internal operational services without exposing those services or the platform to the public internet. * Develop isolated, temporary environments for agents to build services, run tests, and execute code, including provisioning, lifecycle management, and teardown. * Write and maintain Terraform infrastructure code with peer review, automated validation, and safe change practices so environments are repeatable and auditable. * Implement secure defaults for identity, secrets, encryption, network segmentation, and tenant isolation, applying single sign\-on, multi\-factor authentication, and least\-privilege access. * Configure logs, metrics, traces, and audit events for security monitoring, and maintain service objectives, alerts, and runbooks. * Partner with InfoSec, SRE, and vendors to implement controls for customer exposure, including ingress restrictions, IP allow\-listing, audit logging, and bank due\-diligence evidence. * Prepare deployment patterns for customer\-approved cloud environments, addressing data residency, customer\-managed encryption keys where required, and isolation between institutions. * Monitor capacity, performance, and cost for agent workloads, including model and sandbox usage, and implement backup, disaster recovery, and continuity plans. * Respond to infrastructure incidents, coordinate resolution with partner teams, and document follow\-up fixes that reduce recurrence. * Review infrastructure designs and code, share cloud platform practices, and support the development of other engineers. **Recommended Experience \& Education** --------------------------------------- ***Minimum Years of Experience*** 5–7 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering, including operating production systems used by other teams. ***Education Level*** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Knowledge, Skills, \& Qualifications** ---------------------------------------- **Required** * Experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or site reliability systems used by other teams. * Hands\-on experience with AWS networking, including VPCs, transit gateways, and private connectivity, as well as IAM, compute, storage, and managed services. * Proficiency with Terraform or a comparable infrastructure\-as\-code tool, including modular design, state management, automated validation, and safe rollout practices. * Experience operating Kubernetes or another container orchestration platform in production. * Experience building automated, self\-service, or temporary environment lifecycle management. * Experience implementing cloud security controls such as single sign\-on, multi\-factor authentication, least privilege, secrets management, encryption, network protections, and audit logging. * Experience translating security or compliance requirements into practical technical controls. * Strong troubleshooting skills across cloud services, networking, containers, CI/CD pipelines, and application dependencies. * Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical partners about infrastructure risks and tradeoffs. **Preferred** * Experience operating infrastructure for AI or LLM applications, such as agent sandboxes, model gateways, MCP servers, or secure data pipelines. * Experience securing AI systems through data governance, tool and model isolation, defenses against prompt injection or data exfiltration, and monitoring. * Experience in fintech, banking, or another regulated industry, including SOC 2, PCI, or bank third\-party risk reviews. * Experience with Convex, Vercel, Cloudflare, or running a vendor\-managed service inside a company’s cloud account. * Experience with zero\-trust networking, policy as code, or SIEM integration. * Experience with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog. The salary range for this position is: $190,000 \- $225,000**Cool Things to Know** ======================= **Not Just Any Company**: Alkami has an awesome diverse and inclusive environment. We have a FUN culture and offer great benefits, including remote\-first environment, unlimited paid time off, 401(k) with employer match, and more. **Work Authorization**: We cannot offer employment sponsorship at this time. jobs.title: Data Engineer II, AWS Marketplace and Partner Services
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Marketplace and Partner Services (AMPS) is a fast\-growing organization that supports Sellers, Partners, Partner Development Managers, and AWS Marketplace customers. The AMPS team is driven by the mission to provide the best partner experience worldwide. Data Engineering is a horizontal layer that supports all foundational data needs for the organization. As a Data Engineer on the AMPS team, you will work directly with Software Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Science, and Product teams to continuously improve and build our data infrastructure, data models, tools, and data pipelines. Your work will directly influence organizational insights, customer\-facing features, and machine learning models. To be successful in this role, you should have strong database design skills, comfort with large data sets, and an eagerness to build with GenAI solutions. You should have a passion for data and analytics with the technical skills needed to build for scale and automation. Key job responsibilities * Design and implement next\-generation data pipelines and business intelligence solutions using AWS services such as Redshift, Kinesis, EMR, Glue, and Lambda * Build and deliver high\-quality data architecture and pipelines to support business analysts, data scientists, and customer reporting needs * Interface with other technology teams to extract, transform, and load data from a wide variety of sources, creating coherent logical data models that drive physical design * Continually improve reporting and analysis processes, automating self\-service support for customers and ensuring data quality across pipelines * Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team planning while mentoring peers on how team data solutions are constructed and operated A day in the life You will collaborate with Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Business Intelligence Engineers to design, plan, and deliver high\-priority data initiatives serving internal stakeholders and AWS customers. You will build automated, fault\-tolerant, and scalable data solutions using technologies such as Spark, EMR, Python, Redshift, Glue, and S3\. You will also evaluate and improve our architecture, tooling, and codebase to maximize performance and scalability. As you deliver projects independently and lead efforts end to end, you will take on increasingly complex scope and grow into broader responsibilities across the team. About the team We are the Data Engineering team in AMPS, powering analytics for the AWS Marketplace Platform. Our data serves external Marketplace sellers and hundreds of internal Finance, Sales, and Partner stakeholders. We are building an enterprise\-grade, AI\-native Data Platform and a unified Canonical Data Model on Redshift and Data Lake — designing ETL frameworks, migrating billions of rows, and treating data quality and security as first\-class concerns. We work across Redshift, Airflow, Glue, S3, and CDK, and we are early adopters of GenAI in our engineering workflow. Come own hard, ambiguous problems end to end. AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Specialist Technology Team (STT) is seeking a Software Development Engineer to join the Specialist AI Tooling engineering team \- the group building AI\-native, agentic solutions that are fundamentally transforming how thousands of AWS technical specialists and field team members develop expertise, get matched to customer engagements, and how AWS service teams consume customer feedback at scale. If you want to build production agentic AI systems that impact thousands of users daily \- not research prototypes, but real AI agents solving real problems \- this is the role for you. You will design, build, and operate core components across four interconnected products that collectively power the intelligence layer of AWS's specialist ecosystem: AWS Learning Agent \- A new generative AI\-powered, agentic learning system that replaces static training paths with personalized, cross\-domain skill development for every builder in the AWS technical field. Powered by a structured skill graph, persistent learner profiles, and the Specialist Knowledge Vault, the Learning Agent delivers adaptive learning journeys via a custom console, in Kiro, Claude, Quick and wherever builders work. Intelligent Routing Agent \- A new AI\-driven routing engine that matches 136K\+ annual specialist requests to verified domain experts using validated skill profiles rather than manually maintained lists \- reducing resolution time (currently 7\.72 days) and enabling precision matching at scale. Technical Field Community (TFC) Hub \- The platform powering 46 Technical Field Communities, managing member engagement, competency tracking, learning path orchestration, and community\-driven content curation across AWS's specialist network. Service 360 \- A GenAI summarization and prioritization engine that aggregates customer feedback signals (PFRs, SpecReqs, SFDC Opportunity data) into categorized, prioritized service recommendations \- automating what was previously a manual closed\-loop feedback process to influence the roadmap for AWS public service teams. This is a high\-impact, AI\-first engineering role where you will build agentic systems, ship production GenAI features, and solve hard problems at the intersection of knowledge graphs, multi\-agent orchestration, LLM\-powered personalization, and retrieval\-augmented generation \- all at AWS scale, using the very AI services AWS builds for its customers. Key job responsibilities Design and implement production agentic AI systems using LLMs, knowledge graphs, RAG, and multi\-agent orchestration \- delivering personalized learning paths and intelligent expert\-matching to thousands of field members daily. Build and optimize GenAI\-powered pipelines including summarization, content ranking, skill assessment, and intelligent routing \- ensuring low latency, high quality, and cost efficiency at scale. Develop and iterate on prompt engineering strategies, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails for production LLM systems \- ensuring quality, safety, and reliability. Implement embedding and retrieval strategies for a knowledge base optimizing how domain expertise is indexed, retrieved, and contextualized for agent consumption. Design and build scalable distributed systems and APIs that power the TFC Hub platform, serving thousands of community members across 46 technical domains. Drive operational excellence for production services \- owning CI/CD, monitoring, alarming, on\-call, and incident response for systems serving thousands of daily users. Contribute to technical strategy and architecture decisions, proactively identifying opportunities to improve system performance, reliability, and developer velocity. Collaborate with Product Management, Science, and field stakeholders to translate ambiguous customer problems into well\-scoped technical solutions. About the team You will be joining a high\-growth engineering organization that is at the forefront of applying generative AI and agentic technologies to transform how AWS field teams operate. The pace of innovation is high, the problems are ambiguous, and the impact is measured across thousands of field team members and the customers they serve. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re\-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re\-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. We are looking for an Applied Scientist to build the science that helps Amazon's advertisers grow — with a focus on Cross Border Sellers who face distinct barriers as they scale across multiple marketplaces, and this role is about understanding those pain points deeply and removing them: building intelligent, autonomous solutions that simplify advertising, act efficiently on the advertiser's behalf, and let advertisers accelerate their growth and success. We expect Scientist to think innovatively about how to reduce the effort and complexity of advertising for these advertisers. Working backwards from their needs — spanning hands\-off sellers and global brands with cross\-marketplace operations — you will take the lead on medium\-to\-large, ambiguous problems where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined, invent new methods, validate them through rigorous experimentation, and deliver customer\-facing products with measurable business impact. jobs.title: Data Engineer, Central InfraOps Analytics Team
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- As a Data Engineer you will enable data\-driven decision making within the Amazon Web Services Data Center Infrastructure Operations organization. The Infrastructure Operations Team is responsible for planning, implementing, monitoring and continuously improving the global Amazon Data Center infrastructure. The team supports all aspects of the Data Center based organizations, including but not limited to : Safety, Security, maintenance, operations, logistics, engineering and equipment management. Key job responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain ETL pipelines to ingest data into the data warehouse and data lake Create and optimize logical data models that drive physical design for the Infrastructure Operations organization Implement data quality measures and ongoing monitoring to ensure data integrity Build scalable, efficient, and maintainable data solutions that support business intelligence needs Optimize data storage and query performance across various data platforms Develop automated processes to replace manual data operations Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand data and reporting requirements Translate business questions into data solutions that drive decision\-making Mentor and develop peers in data engineering best practices Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team planning Improve self\-service access to data for business users Enhance code quality and dependency management Automate manual processes to increase efficiency Identify and resolve root causes of complex data problems A day in the life At AWS, the Data Engineer fully embraces the "You Build It, You Own It" philosophy, taking complete ownership of data solutions from conception through deployment and ongoing maintenance. You design architectures, implement pipelines, and remain responsible for their health and evolution as business needs change. Each day begins with reviewing pipeline alerts and data quality metrics, followed by a 15\-30 minute team stand\-up to align on priorities and discuss blockers. You'll spend time monitoring infrastructure, reviewing logs for ETL pipeline health and data lake performance, then dedicate time to address stakeholder queries and prioritizing incoming requests via email, Slack and intake forms. The majority of your time is spent developing and maintaining ETL pipelines that ingest infrastructure operational data from global data centers, which includes writing code, debugging issues, optimizing queries, and implementing quality checks. The role requires frequent context switching between developing new data models, supporting existing infrastructure, and consulting on data utilization. Key challenges you'll tackle include unifying and understanding fragmented data from diverse data center systems, enabling infrastructure monitoring, supporting analytics for capacity planning, driving optimization through data insights, automating manual processes, creating self\-service access for business users, maintaining quality across massive datasets, ensuring compliance with strict security requirements, designing for scale as AWS expands globally, and modernizing legacy systems to reduce technical debt. About the team Our team builds the data foundation behind AWS's global data center operations. We turn raw operational signals into trusted data products, dashboards, and APIs that technicians, site leaders, and executives use every day to keep infrastructure safe, reliable, and efficient. You'll work closely with fellow engineers, and operations partners around the world to solve real\-world problems at massive scale. We value ownership, curiosity, and learning from each other. We celebrate experimentation, share knowledge openly so everyone can do their best work. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 1\+ years of data engineering experience * Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines * Experience with one or more query language (e.g., SQL, PL/SQL, DDL, MDX, HiveQL, SparkSQL, Scala) * Experience with one or more scripting language (e.g., Python, KornShell) **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR * Experience with any ETL tool like, Informatica, ODI, SSIS, BODI, Datastage, etc. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Senior ML Platform Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description: ### **The Bigger Picture** At Andromeda, we're building the social intelligence layer for humanoid robots \- technology that allows robots to understand people, build relationships and become a meaningful part of everyday life. Our first robot, Abi, is already doing this in aged care and healthcare, where she brings conversation, companionship and engagement to people every day. Now we're scaling from early deployments into a platform that can operate across thousands of real\-world environments. We're looking for individuals who want to tackle hard problems across robotics and AI, and help define what it means for robots to live and interact alongside people. ### **The Role** You'll build the shared workflows behind our ML development: reproducible experiments, trustworthy evaluations, dependable training data, reliable training infrastructure, and models that integrate with the robot software we already run. You'll be the champion for ML developer experience, making the best\-practice workflow the fastest and easiest path for the team. This is a hands\-on engineering role. You'll write the first implementation, help teams use it, and improve it against real workloads. Some days that means making a training job recover cleanly. Others, it means finding why a promising model behaves differently on Abi. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will lead by influence and set technical direction for ML tooling, not manage a team. You'll partner with our existing DevOps, cloud, and robot software platform engineers and extend it for ML workflows.. Our stack includes, AWS, Nix, ROS 2, and NVIDIA Jetson, third party and custom tooling. What we need is strong MLOps judgment, the drive to learn, and an obsession with making your teammates' workflows effortless. This role is on\-site five days a week in SF ### **What you'll own** * Repeatable experimentation. Establish practical patterns for experiment repositories, configuration, code review, and automated checks. Build reusable libraries, scripts, and templates that let engineers start quickly without leaving behind work only its author can run. * Data infrastructure. Build the multimodal data lake and pipelines that clean, annotate, and serve data for model training. Add quality checks and lineage so every dataset traces back to the robot data it came from. * Experimentation and evaluations. Make it cheap to test new ideas against production baselines and challenger models, and clear when a candidate genuinely wins. Define the path a model follows: candidate, qualified against agreed criteria, approved, then deployed to the robot. * Develop patterns for robot integration testing. Test the complete model path inside the existing robot codebase: inputs, preprocessing, inference, interfaces, and downstream behavior. Work with engineers on CI, simulation, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing that catch failures that software only testing will miss * Cloud and training infrastructure. Own the ML\-specific workflows for provisioning compute, scheduling and managing jobsWork with cloud and DevOps engineers on the underlying infrastructure, access, reliability, and cost. * Reproducible environments and deployable models. Build reliable packages and dependency configurations. Learn and apply Nix packaging, the Nix store, and binary caches. Contribute to existing robot build and release workflows so models reach Jetson with compatible dependencies, tested runtime behavior, and a rollback path. Support staged rollouts or shadow deployments, and monitor how deployed models behave on robots in the field. * Product\-linked reporting. Build dashboards that connect model and dataset versions, evaluation results, and deployed performance to agreed product metrics. Help teams distinguish benchmark gains from improvements in Abi's behavior, reliability, and user experience. * Adoption across the engineering team. Work alongside engineers to understand bottlenecks, advise on technical choices, and make shared tools useful in practice. Provide clear examples, documentation, and handoffs. **Requirements** * 5\+ or more years experience in ML infrastructure, developer platforms, and robotics software. You are comfortable working with robots and embedded systems. * You've built systems other engineers rely on and love to use, not just configured tools for your own experiments. You’ve built internal tooling adopted across multiple teams. * Strong engineering, packaging, and dependency\-management skills. You enjoy hardening production systems. You love breaking complex systems into maintainable, tested components and work confidently in an unfamiliar codebase. * Practical experience with reproducible ML workflows, evaluation, experiment tracking, data lineage, and model artifacts. You know where lightweight conventions are enough and where automation earns its keep. * Experience building data pipelines for ML training, including cleaning, annotation, and dataset quality checks, and training and evaluating classifiers. * Experience operating cloud compute and training workloads, with sound judgment about reliability, observability, performance, and cost. * Comfort debugging across model code, runtime environments, and robot interfaces, including hands\-on testing with hardware. * Clear communication and collaborative judgment. You can advise senior engineers, agree ownership with adjacent teams, and support colleagues without becoming a bottleneck. ### **Useful, but not required** * ML model and code optimization for NVIDIA Jetson and cloud deployments, including quantization, mixed precision, inference compilation with TensorRT or comparable runtimes, and performance profiling across CPU, RAM, and GPU. * Management of distributed training infrastructure, including multi\-GPU and multi\-node workloads, scheduling, checkpointing, and failure recovery. * Experience integrating ML workloads with ROS 2\-based robot software. * Experience with Nix/NixOS and AWS. * Willingness to learn Nix packaging, store semantics, and binary caches. Prior Nix expertise is welcome, not required. Experience supporting simulation or on\-robot evaluation systems, * **Benefits** The expected base salary for this role is $150,000 to $220,000 plus benefits and equity. **PLEASE NOTE:** The advertised salary range is intended as a guide. For an exceptional candidate whose experience and capabilities align strongly with this role, we are open to discussing a package that reflects the value they bring. Given the importance of this hire, we are committed to investing appropriately in the person best placed to help us achieve our mission. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. ### **Our Values** * **Empathy** – Kindness and compassion are at the heart of everything we do. * **Play** – Play sharpens focus. It keeps us curious, fast and obsessed with the craft. * **Never Settle** – A relentless ambition, bias toward action, and uncomfortable levels of curiosity. * **Tenacity** – Tenacious under pressure, we assume chaos and stay in motion to adapt and progress. * **Unity** – Different minds. Shared mission. No passengers. Let’s build the future together.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure & Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Apex Clean Energy was founded with a singular focus: to accelerate the shift to clean energy. Through origination, construction, and operation of utility\-scale wind, solar, and storage facilities, distributed energy resources, and green fuel technologies, Apex is expanding the renewable frontier across North America. This is not a break\-fix role. It is a platform ownership role with direct exposure to the highest\-priority workstreams in the company and a mandate to build infrastructure that is resilient, documented, and ready to scale. This role sits within the Integrated Technology Solutions (ITS) department and reports to the ITS Director. You will work with cross\-functional teams including Asset Management, Operations, SCADA, and data analysts. You will collaborate with managed service partners, security consultants, and infrastructure vendors — and you will be expected to lead, not just execute. Success in this role looks like: critical infrastructure that is resilient, documented, and understood; security posture that is continuously improved and verifiably measurable; and a platform foundation that other ITS capabilities — AI/ML, Data Governance, OT Security — can be built on with confidence. Our ideal candidate has done this before at a company navigating real complexity: cloud migration, major platform modernization, scaling inflection points. They bring deep technical judgment and the maturity to work in a collaborative, influence\-based organization where how you work with people matters as much as what you build. Hours/Type: Full Time, Exempt Department: Integrated Technology Solutions Travel: 5% **Primary Responsibilities** * Own and continuously improve Apex's core enterprise infrastructure, with particular depth in Azure, where our environment spans multiple subscriptions, resource groups, virtual networking, and integrated platform services across the organization. Responsibilities extend across the full stack: Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory, Microsoft 365 services, and on\-premises physical and virtual server and network environments at corporate and operational sites. * Partner with ITS leadership and external security partners to continuously improve the organization's security posture, including identity hardening, network segmentation, and SIEM coverage and alert tuning. * Own and mature Apex's infrastructure\-as\-code practice, building on an existing foundation of Terraform and Ansible. Apply IaC principles to automate provisioning, enforce configuration consistency, and reduce reliance on manual processes across cloud and hybrid environments — with the expectation that what is currently nascent becomes a disciplined, version\-controlled standard under your ownership. * Design, implement, and maintain identity governance controls — including privileged access management, conditional access policies, dynamic group logic, and lifecycle automation for joiners, movers, and leavers. * Architect and support zero trust network access (ZTNA). * Support operational technology (OT) connectivity and site infrastructure, coordinating with others to ensure appropriate segmentation and visibility between corporate IT and field environments. * Develop and maintain infrastructure documentation, runbooks, architecture diagrams, and change records. Create the institutional knowledge that makes the team resilient, not dependent on any individual. * Serve as a technical escalation point for ITS Operations Specialists; mentor junior team members and raise the technical baseline across the team. * Communicate clearly and proactively with ITS leadership, stakeholders, and vendors — translating technical findings into business risk language and written briefings when needed. * Contribute to ITS policy compliance by implementing technical controls that align with documented standards and frameworks. * Identify and anticipate infrastructure risks before they become incidents; bring forward prioritized, actio with SIEM tools, ZTNA solutions, network architecture (segmentation, VLANs, firewall policy). Familiarity with IT/OT convergence environments is a differentiator. * **Security orientation:** You think about infrastructure through a security lens by default. You understand defense\-in\-depth principles and can map technical controls to business risk, communicating that clearly to leadership. * **Project and workstream management:** Capable of managing multiple parallel technical workstreams with competing priorities. You can scope work, communicate progress, flag blockers early, and deliver against commitments without constant oversight. * **Communication:** Strong written communication skills: you can produce a clear technical risk briefing, an architecture summary, or a vendor evaluation memo. You engage well with non\-technical stakeholders and know when to escalate versus when to resolve. * **Collaboration and influence:** Apex ITS operates as a collaborative hub – you'll need to build trust across departments, work with managed service partners and external consultants, and influence outcomes without always having direct authority. * **Character:** Self\-directed, intellectually curious, and calm under pressure. You take ownership, ask good questions, and leave things better than you found them. You don't wait to be told there's a problem. * **Location:** Charlottesville, VA preferred; hybrid schedule available. Some remote flexibility for exceptional candidates, but in\-person collaboration with the ITS team is expected regularly. **Additional Information** **Work Environment:** Works primarily traditional office hours in an indoor office environment. Flexible work hours allowed when work duties and business operations permit. **How You’ll Grow** At Apex Clean Energy, our professional development plans focus on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands\-on experience in the dynamic, fast\-paced renewable energy industry. From on\-the\-job learning experiences to a robust multi\-week onboarding experience to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. **What Apex Can Offer You** *At Apex Clean Energy, we know that great people make a great company. We value our people and offer employees a broad, best\-in\-class range of benefits.* * A mission\-driven, energetic environment that supports and encourages our people to do their best work every day. * A respect for and celebration of individuality, differences, and uniqueness * Collaborative and driven professional workforce committed to supporting your ideas and feedback and accelerating your potential * Ongoing support and guidance such as on\-the\-job learning, hands\-on experience, and mentorship * Training, strategies, and tools to support your personal and professional growth * Team atmosphere of diverse professionals committed to making an impact as an organization * Opportunities to volunteer and give back to our local communities * Exceptional benefits such as medical and dental; 401(k) with corporate match * Base and bonus commensurate with experience * Responsible Paid Time Off plus standard company holidays * Benefits Offered: comprehensive high\-deductible health plans, dental and vision insurance plans, short\-term and long\-term disability, group life insurance, 401(k) corporate matching, flexible spending arrangements, company paid parking and cell phone, fitness and wellness corporate discounts ***Apex Clean Energy, Inc.*** *is an Equal Opportunity Employer that recruits and hires qualified candidates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.*

The Quality Assurance team develops the methods, tools, and metrics that help us measure quality, catch issues early, and improve how data is produced and evaluated at scale. We’re looking for a hands\-on software engineer to build the tools and data systems behind that work. You’ll automate QA workflows, build pipelines that turn annotation and review events into reliable metrics, and create dashboards and alerts that help teams act on those metrics. You’ll also analyze quality data to understand where errors occur and whether changes to guidelines, tools, or workflows improve outcomes. Description You’ll own projects from problem definition through deployment and ongoing operation. A project might start with a question such as “Where are annotation errors increasing?” or “Is our audit sample giving us enough coverage?” You’ll work with QA, Data Science, Engineering, and Operations to define the measurement, build the workflow or pipeline, validate the results, and put them in the hands of the people who can act on them. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field. * Experience designing, building, and maintaining production software, internal tools, or data systems used by other teams. * Strong programming skills in Python and strong SQL skills for data transformation, validation, and analysis. * Experience building automated workflows or data pipelines that integrate multiple data sources or services. * Experience presenting data through dashboards, analytical applications, or reporting interfaces that support operational decisions. * Ability to investigate data discrepancies and translate ambiguous quality or operational questions into measurable outcomes. * Ability to work across technical and operational teams and explain findings and tradeoffs clearly. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with data annotation, human evaluation, ML data pipelines, or quality engineering for data\-intensive products. * Familiarity with statistical sampling, confidence intervals, inter\-annotator agreement, or measurement design for subjective tasks. * Experience evaluating rule\-based or model\-assisted QA against human judgments, including precision, recall, and error analysis. * Experience building systems for global operations or workflows with multiple sites and review teams. jobs.description: Summary Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something. The Vision Products Group (VPG) creates the technologies behind Apple Vision Pro and the spatial experiences that reach across Apple's platforms. Our team builds spatial media experiences such as Spatial Scenes, which turn a photo into an immersive 3D scene you can look around in. We work where machine learning meets computer graphics: we train models that generate 3D scenes from photos and videos, and we render them in real time on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro. We are looking for an engineer with a strong machine learning background and a love of graphics who wants to take new ideas from prototype all the way to features used by millions of people. Description We are a team of computer graphics, multimedia, and machine learning experts, and we are looking for an engineer to help build the next generation of spatial media across Apple's platforms. You will design and train models that reconstruct and generate 3D scenes from photos and videos, and develop the rendering techniques that bring these scenes to life on Apple devices within the tight compute and memory budgets. You will work closely with software, hardware, algorithms, and UX teams to take your work from early prototypes to shipping features. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field and 3\+ years of relevant industry or research experience. * Hands\-on experience designing, training, and evaluating deep learning models for computer vision or graphics tasks. * Hands\-on experience with 3D Gaussian splatting, such as per\-scene optimization, feed\-forward prediction, or custom rasterization. * Hands\-on experience training or fine\-tuning diffusion or other generative models for images, video, or 3D content. * Strong understanding of multi\-view geometry and camera models, and of how 3D representations are rendered, including rasterization, alpha compositing, and volume rendering. * Proficiency in Python and PyTorch, JAX, or MLX. * Familiarity with C\+\+, Objective\-C, or Swift * Familiarity with Gen AI coding tools. Demonstrated ability to use them for design, code generation, and debugging. Preferred Qualifications * MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * Experience with novel view synthesis or 3D reconstruction from images or video, such as monocular depth estimation, NeRFs, multiplane images, or dynamic scene reconstruction. * Experience with real\-time rendering or GPU programming (Metal, CUDA, or compute shaders), such as writing custom rendering kernels. * Experience optimizing models for on\-device inference, such as quantization, distillation, and Core ML. * Experience with large\-scale distributed training and building datasets, including rendering synthetic training data. * Familiarity with stereo and spatial media, including metric scale and viewing comfort, or with AR/VR rendering pipelines. * Track record of taking ideas from prototype to a shipped product or widely used project. * Clear communication and the ability to collaborate across ML, graphics, and product teams. jobs.title: Sr Software Quality Engineer (Exp w/ AI in Quality)

What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community. **The Role** ------------ We are seeking a Senior Automation and AI\-Driven Quality Engineer to design, implement, and scale intelligent quality, automation, and performance engineering solutions across enterprise\-grade, AI\-enabled platforms. This role is hands\-on and technically deep, with strong ownership across test automation, performance engineering, AI\-assisted quality workflows, and SAFe\-based delivery pipelines. You will work closely with product engineering, architecture, DevOps, and data/AI teams to embed Built\-In Quality into every stage of the SDLC. **Your Impact** --------------- * Design and implement AI\-driven quality automation solutions to improve test coverage \& defect detection. * Apply ML/LLM\-assisted techniques for test generation, intelligent test selection, prioritization, and regression optimization. * Build automated quality signals that combine test results, telemetry, logs, and metrics to support data\-driven release decisions. * Drive shift\-left and shift\-right quality strategies, integrating automation with both pre\-release pipelines and production monitoring. * Architect and maintain scalable, modular automation frameworks for API, backend, and system\-level testing using Python, Java, or TypeScript. * Implement automation across distributed systems, microservices, and AI\-enabled components. * Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines
