enterprise deployments. * Enable automation reporting and dashboards for engineering, QA, and leadership visibility. * Design and execute performance, load, and stress testing strategies for cloud\-native and distributed systems. * Establish performance baselines, SLAs/SLOs, and continuously validate system behavior under real\-world workloads. * Analyze performance bottlenecks using observability and APM tools (metrics, logs, traces). * Collaborate with architecture and DevOps teams to improve scalability, resilience, and system reliability. * Support production performance validation using telemetry\-driven feedback loops. * Act as a senior technical contributor across Agile Release Trains (ARTs) in a SAFe environment. * Partner with Product Owners, Architects, and RTEs to embed automation, performance, and quality objectives into PI Planning. * Contribute to backlog refinement by defining automation and quality enablers. * Lead root cause analysis for complex understanding of Agile / SAFe delivery models and enterprise\-scale software development. * Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-team collaboration skills. * Familiarity with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling, K6\) and observability stacks. * Experience with containers (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and Infrastructure as Code. * Exposure to DevOps, reliability engineering, or production telemetry analysis. * Prior experience working in AI\-powered or data\-driven product environments. \#LI\-WJ1 The salary range for this role is $92,100\.00 \- jobs.title: Senior Director, AI, Data & Systems Engineering
jobs.description: **Aspire Public Schools NorCal — Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Engineering** **Job Description****About Aspire NorCal** Founded in 1998, Aspire Public Schools has served scholars and communities across California for nearly three decades. With Aspire Los Angeles transitioning into an independent organization, the Bay Area and Central Valley regions are coming together to form Aspire NorCal, operating 22 schools serving approximately 10,000 scholars across Northern California (Oakland, Richmond, East Palo Alto, Sacramento, Stockton, Modesto, and Ceres). This evolution comes at an important moment for Aspire. Changes in California’s funding, policy, enrollment, and operating environment have created an opportunity to rethink how the organization supports its schools and scholars in its next chapter. The formation of Aspire NorCal creates an opportunity to strengthen support for schools across teams previously organized by geography, improve the consistency and effectiveness of school support, and create clear accountability systems for organizational and scholar outcomes. The new model will require the organization to balance greater coherence across Aspire NorCal with responsiveness to the different communities and contexts of its schools. Aspire NorCal enters this transition with a long\-standing mission focused on post\-secondary success and a deep commitment to educational equity, along with decades of institutional knowledge across its schools and teams. Preserving those strengths while building Aspire NorCal as a unified region will be central to the work ahead. **About the AI, Data \& Systems Enablement team** The Data \& Systems team exists to give principals, teachers, and teammates their time back. We are responsible for Aspire NorCal's data and the key software systems that cross departments, and we measure ourselves by the experience of the people we serve: a principal gets a trusted answer in minutes if not seconds, a new hire is entered once, and no one navigates five systems to do one job. We use AI to get there, and we set the policy and training that keep it useful and appropriately safe. The team is made up of an Enablement team that builds the shared foundation, plus pods that each serve a customer group: School Operations \& Principals, Academics \& Teachers, and People \& Resources. Our working principles: go deep with users, one shared foundation, self\-serve first, learning is the job, and nobody works alone. **About the role** Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), the Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Engineering leads the engineering that makes Aspire NorCal's data trustworthy. As the team's technical lead, you are the dedicated owner of the data warehouse, semantic layer, integrations, data governance, and the AI platform. You set and uphold the engineering practices every pod builds on: code control, review, testing, and standard toolkits. You own the integration strategy, set the integration priorities, and write the migration plan, then move the 40\+ legacy integrations onto a governed, version\-controlled platform, and you mentor pod members in AI\-supported data modeling and semantic layer management through pairing and review. This role works closely with the Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Enablement, a peer who also reports to the CTO, and with the Senior Analyst for AI, Data \& Systems (Enablement). It has no direct reports, but mentors pod members. This posting is for one opening. **Key Responsibilities** * Own the data warehouse (in partnership with our vendor, KAE) and ensure it remains useful and relevant to achieve the team’s broader goals. Retire legacy data warehouse. * Own Lightdash administration and the semantic layer, which holds the shared definitions and documentation that let teammates and AI find and trust the data. * Own data governance: the data access rules for Lightdash and the warehouse, data classification, and data quality, so that AI answers come only from governed sources, under the asker’s own access rights. * Own the AI platform: approved AI tools, data rules, and technical guardrails, and the technical review of each AI use case. The Senior Director, AI, Data \& Systems Enablement drafts the AI policy and runs the use\-case pipeline with you. * Create and execute an appropriate strategy for maintaining systems integrations, set integration priorities, write the migration plan, and migrate/retire existing integrations. * In the first six months, serve as technical lead for the implementation of the new HRIS. * Set engineering practices: code control, code review, and standard toolkits, and socialize them throughout the team. * Mentor pod members in AI\-supported data modeling and semantic layer management, through pairing and review. **Qualifications** **Mindsets (required)** * **Intellectual humility:** curious enough to ask the question that shows what you don't know, and secure enough to laugh at yourself. * **Interest in AI that serves Aspire's mission:** has used AI tools on real work, can describe what worked and what did not, and wants to help colleagues use AI to give time back to teachers, principals, and teammates. * **Teaches, coaches, and keeps learning:** leaves people more capable than you found them, and learns from colleagues, customers, and mistakes. * **Service\-minded:** treats principals, teachers, and teammates as customers, with a track record of empathy for the people you serve and curiosity about how schools really work. **Experience (required)** * 15\+ years in data engineering or analytics engineering. * 5\+ years as part of a high performing, mature development team leveraging modern software practices. * Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred), dbt, and data pipelines. * Has created AI workflows and automations that colleagues actually used. * Has written or enforced data governance and access controls. * Has migrated legacy data jobs or integrations onto a governed, version\-controlled platform without losing what users relied on. * Track record of teaching and developing others effectively and treating knowledge\-sharing as part of the job. * Communicates clearly with non\-technical users. * Understands student or employee data privacy obligations (FERPA, California privacy law) and handles sensitive data carefully. **Bonus points for** * K\-12 data experience. * Experience with a semantic layer, Lightdash, or similar AI\-enabled data tool. * A teaching, coaching, or mentoring background. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- The salary range for this role is $168,050 to $215,728 annually in accordance with our salary schedule policy, commensurate with experience. This full\-time, exempt position offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: * Eligible for Aspire health benefits * Retirement through CalSTRS or CalPERS, depending on the role's credential requirements, with a 403(b) option * Paid time off and additional teammate benefits to be determined in accordance with updated employee value proposition to be shared prior to offer. Aspire NorCal is conducting a comprehensive study of our employee value proposition, which could lead to material changes in July 2027\. **Location and work arrangement** --------------------------------- * Preference is given to candidates who reside in a county where Aspire NorCal schools are located (San Mateo, Alameda, Contra Costa, San Joaquin, Stanislaus, or Sacramento) or in an adjacent county. Periodic travel is required across schools, from East Palo Alto to the East Bay and from Sacramento to Modesto. This is a remote or hybrid role; the arrangement will be determined by the Chief Technology Officer. Employment with Aspire is at\-will. **Application Deadline:** December 4, 2026 **Equal opportunity** Aspire Public Schools is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Aspire Public Schools provides reasonable accommodations during the application and interview process. #### **Disclaimer** *We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.*

jobs.title: Principal Cloud Architect
jobs.description: Overview: The Principal Cloud Architect is the senior technical authority for AssistRx's AWS environments. This role designs, builds, and guides the operation of highly available, resilient, and secure AWS architectures, and leads the migration of workloads from on\-premises and other cloud platforms, including Azure, to the cloud solutions that best support the business. The architect brings working knowledge of both AWS and Azure, with demonstrated depth in AWS design, build, and run, and applies FinOps discipline so that cost is a design input, not an afterthought. The Principal Cloud Architect partners with the Director, Cloud \+ Infrastructure Engineering, infrastructure and network engineers, Security, Compliance, DevOps, Operations, and Engineering counterparts (including Product Engineering), IT Service Desk, and external vendors. The architect is expected to set technical direction, mentor engineers, and raise cloud capability across the team through coaching, design reviews, and knowledge sharing. Responsibilities: ***Architecture and Design*** * Design and document AWS reference architectures, landing zones, and standards for compute, storage, network, identity, and data services that are highly available, resilient, scalable, and secure by design. * Define multi\-account structure, governance, guardrails, and policy\-based controls (for example, AWS Organizations, Control Tower, service control policies, and IAM Identity Center). * Design network connectivity and segmentation for cloud and hybrid environments, including VPC design, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPN, and DNS, in partnership with network engineering and Security. * Apply the AWS Well\-Architected Framework across operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability; lead architecture and design reviews. * Design for recovery: define RTO and RPO targets, multi\-AZ and multi\-region patterns, backup, and disaster recovery architectures, and validate them through regular testing. * Maintain working knowledge of Azure services and identity integration (for example, Microsoft Entra ID), and guide interoperability and migration paths between Azure and AWS. * Evaluate emerging cloud services and industry trends, and recommend adoption where they improve resilience, security, efficiency, or cost. ***Cloud Migration*** * Lead workload discovery and assessment, applying migration strategies (rehost, replatform, refactor, retire, retain) with business cases, dependency mapping, and sequencing. * Architect and guide migrations of on\-premises workloads to AWS, and from Azure to AWS where applicable, using tools such as AWS Application Migration Service, Database Migration Service, and Migration Hub. * Design and maintain hybrid solutions where they best serve the business, including data center and colocation exit planning in partnership with infrastructure leadership. * Define cutover, rollback, and validation plans; jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer II
jobs.description: #### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.** At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other. Life at Axon is fast\-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter. **About Axon Vision.** Axon Vision is a new business venture within Axon with one mission: turn any live video feed into a real\-time, AI\-powered sensor. Customers ask a plain\-language question of their cameras and get an alert when the answer is yes. We run AI models against live video at scale, and we hold ourselves to the reliability and trust that public safety demands. We operate like a startup, moving fast and working through ambiguity, with the resources and stability of a larger company behind us. ### **Role Overview** As a Senior Full Stack Engineer (L9\) with an infrastructure core, you will own how Axon Vision's software gets built, shipped, run, and kept healthy, with a focus on the cloud services that process detections and the pipelines that deliver them. You have run real production infrastructure and you still write product code. You are as comfortable tracing a failed deployment through a Kubernetes cluster as you are designing a Terraform module, a queue topology, or an authentication flow between services. You thrive where requirements are sometimes unclear, you do your own research, and you turn what you learn into designs the team can build on. You work AI\-first. You use agentic AI tools every day across design, implementation, testing, debugging, and operations, and you keep the human bar high: you write clear specs and acceptance criteria, have the AI check its work against them, and review what it produces as critically as you would a teammate's code. You build reusable AI workflows for the team and help set the standards that keep AI\-assisted development fast, safe, and reviewable. You will work closely with Product, Design, our AI/ML partners, and Axon platform and security teams. As a senior engineer without direct reports, you will also mentor peers, model strong engineering habits, and set a high bar for quality. **Location:** Seattle (WA), Scottsdale (AZ), Boston (MA), Atlanta (GA) ### **What You'll Do** * Own the cloud infrastructure and delivery architecture for Axon Vision. * Design, build, and operate cloud infrastructure as code (Terraform, Kubernetes, queues and streaming, storage, secrets), with a path to run across more than one cloud. * Build and run the release pipeline for Axon Vision services: container image builds, staged rollouts, rollback, and automated verification. * Strengthen the software supply chain: hardened base images, automated dependency updates, and machine\-to\-machine authentication between services. * Improve the performance, scalability, and cost efficiency of real\-time video and model\-inference services, working with AI/ML partners. * Build observability, alerting, and runbooks so the team can see and fix problems before customers do. * Prove ideas quickly with MVPs while planning for scale, reliability, and security. * Write and review code that sets a high bar for quality and security in mission\-critical, real\-time contexts. * Guide the team through trade\-offs among customer needs, performance, and time to market. * Mentor and coach engineers, and help shape CI/CD, planning, and incident practices. * Work AI\-first: use agentic AI tools across design, coding, testing, debugging, and operations, with clear specs, acceptance criteria, and tests the AI is held to. * Create and share reusable AI workflows, tool configurations, and reference implementations, and measure their impact on delivery and quality. * Set standards, review practices, and quality gates for AI\-assisted work on infrastructure and delivery, including guardrails for changes to production systems. ### **What You Bring** * 10\+ years of professional software engineering (or evidence of performing at a senior level), with a record of owning production infrastructure for a real service, including on\-call. * Deep experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent), Kubernetes and containers, and at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Multi\-cloud or migration experience is a plus. * Experience running production releases safely: staged rollouts, rollback, and change management for services with real uptime expectations. * Strong programming skills in Go or Python, and comfort in TypeScript. Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL data stores and with queues or streaming systems such as Kafka. * Practical knowledge of secure delivery: hardened images, dependency management, secrets, and service\-to\ strated AI\-first engineering practice: daily use of agentic AI tools to build and operate real systems, with sound judgment on correctness, security, and cost. You raise the bar for AI\-assisted work rather than lowering it. **Nice to have** * Experience with ML inference services or real\-time video pipelines. * Experience in video and streaming, scale\-up platform teams, or multi\-tenant SaaS products. **Benefits That Benefit You** * Competitive salary and 401k with employer match * Discretionary time off * Paid parental leave for all * Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Fitness programs * Emotional and development programs * Plenty of snacks in our offices, and a fun, startup\-like culture to enjoy them in Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long\-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Important Notes** *The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.* *Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.* *We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at* ***axongreenhousesupport@axon.com*** *or via our* *Axon Privacy Web Form**. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.* *Axon's mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well\-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon's impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.* *We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We're committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email* *recruitingops@axon.com.* *Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description: Beacon is looking for a Sr. Security Engineer, AI Security to own the safe use of AI at Beacon and across the companies in our portfolio. You will design and operate the security controls, harden the systems that AI tools and agents connect to, and work closely with engineering on identity, authorization, and network protections for AI agents and other non\-human workloads. **Key Responsibilities:** ------------------------- * Give every agent an owner, scoped credentials, least privilege, and approvals where the action calls for it, and track it from creation to offboarding like a user. * Own the security requirements for AI integrations (MCP connections, OAuth grants), memory, and retrieval, and set tenant defaults and approved connectors. * Keep a live view of AI tools and agents, including AI features that vendors turn on inside tools we already use. * Put limits on tool calls, network access, data egress, and resource use. * Threat model and adversarially test our internal AI platform and agents, covering prompt injection, data disclosure, unsafe tool use, and unauthorized actions. Turn findings into regression tests and release gates. * Define the logs AI systems must produce, build detections for risky grants and sensitive data going into AI tools, lead the AI side of incidents, and join the on\-call rotation. * Give a quick yes with conditions on new tools, and keep approved patterns and a pre\-cleared list so most requests need no review. * Add an AI inventory and the same standards to the security baseline for each acquisition. **What we are looking for:** ---------------------------- * About 5 to 7 years in security engineering, application security, or cloud security. * Hands\-on experience securing LLM applications, agents, or AI developer tools, including prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and insecure tool use. * Strong in non\-human identity: OAuth, SSO, SCIM, service accounts, and secrets. * Writes and ships code, building the tooling instead of stopping at a recommendation. * Explains risk clearly to engineers and non\-engineers, and can say yes with conditions. * Works independently, is comfortable in greenfield work, and is willing to join the on\-call rotation. * Uses AI in everyday work and has informed judgment about where it is useful. **Nice to have:** * Experience building evaluations or adversarial tests for AI systems. * Experience with AI gateways, SSPM, CASB, or DLP tools. * Familiarity with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or ISO 42001\. **Our Values at Beacon Holdings:** ---------------------------------- * Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time. * Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant. * Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected. * Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world \- compounding growth. ***How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process:*** *To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI\-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.* ***AI does not make hiring decisions:*** *Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.*

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Rentals)
jobs.description: New York Engineering In office Full\-time **What is Bilt?** Bilt is the membership for where you live. What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants. Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once. We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens. This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here. #### **What's the role?** The Rentals team builds the property platform connecting residents, property managers, and the systems they rely on *across millions of users and billions of dollars* worth of transactions each month. Our work spans rent payments, property\-management integrations, home search and applications, resident experiences, and building access. The work combines visible product development with demanding systems engineering: keeping data accurate across third\-party platforms, making workflows recover safely from failures, and scaling systems that people depend on to manage their homes. You’ll work directly with product, account managers, and property partners, turn real operational problems into software, and own what you ship in production. *You don’t need to arrive knowing every part of our stack* but we value engineers who can navigate ambiguity, make sound trade\-offs, and learn unfamiliar systems. #### **In this role you will:** * **Own projects from customer problem to production**, working directly with product, sales, account managers, and property partners. * **Build reliable rent\-payment workflows** that handle retries, partial failures, and reconciliation across external systems. * **Integrate new property\-management platforms** and keep property, resident, lease, and ledger data accurate as those systems change. * **Ship complete products** across property\-manager tools and resident web/mobile experiences, from home search and applications to building access. * **Scale ingestion and distributed workflows** while improving correctness, observability, and recovery—not just throughput. * **Build AI\-assisted engineering tools** that shorten the path from a customer problem to a safely shipped fix. **Our stack**: Go and Java; Postgres, Redis, and MongoDB; React and Next.js for web; React Native for mobile. #### **In terms of qualifications, we're seeking:** * 6\+ years building and operating software in production, with substantial backend experience * Experience owning ambiguous problems from inception to production, working across engineering, product, and business teams. * Fluency in: + at least one core backend language like Java or Go + Javascript or Typescript along with UI framework like React or Vue * Solid distributed systems fundamentals (async processing, pub/sub, idempotency, retries, caching), and you debug across services with logs, traces, and metrics * Excellent communication skills: you will be talking with executives, property managers, sales and account managers * Experience with at least one cloud provider (like AWS or Google Cloud) * Used AI coding agents effectively and take responsibility for validating the code they produce #### **Bonus:** * Built systems that move real money—such as payment applications or automated trading systems—with safeguards, monitoring, and recovery mechanisms. * Experience with authentication, authorization mechanisms (especially OpenFGA) and identity (OAuth, SAML, etc.) * Built and maintained applications in Google Cloud * Polyglot: you know many different languages and paradigms and you’re learning constantly **Benefits:** * **Compensation** \- We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus program * **Health insurance for you (\& your loved ones) from day one** \- Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one. * **401k plan with a match** \- Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there. * **Commuter FSAs** \- We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive. * **UNLIMITED PTO** \- Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for you as often as you need it. * **Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points** \- We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt. At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations. We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process. Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their individual skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt rewards performance and outcomes \- should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time. The salary range for a **Senior Full Stack Engineer** is **$175,000\-$250,000** and will be eligible for equity and an annual performance\-based bonus. Req ID: R369

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Shield
jobs.description: **WHAT IS BOX?** Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI\-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including AstraZeneca, JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia. By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift. **WHY BOX NEEDS YOU** Box Shield is an add\-on security control that helps you protect the flow of information and reduce content\-centric risks with precision — without slowing down work. It allows classification\-based security controls to automatically prevent data loss, and AI\-powered, context\-aware alerts to detect potential data theft and malicious content. Box Shield enables secure hybrid work from anywhere, anytime, and any device with native tools that help secure content at scale. The Shield team is looking for ML engineers with a passion for building out enterprise security features that are able to handle complex use\-cases in a robust and easy\-to\-use way. Shield's mission is to protect the flow of an enterprise's information while delivering frictionless user experience so that Box is the tool of choice for secure Cloud Content Management. Shield helps customers keep their content secure by detecting malicious software in their content, potentially compromised accounts, and anomalous behavior so that Administrators have the right information to act before a problem occurs. As an engineer on our team, you will join a diverse, fast\-paced, mainly backend/core team that works together to build new capabilities that help Box's customers protect their Box content. Security being a horizontal product, you will work across teams to design and implement capabilities that power high\-demand use\-cases in a future\-proof way. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Build Threat Detection Models: Design, train, and deploy ML models for ransomware detection, suspicious session identification, and user behavior analytics, anomaly detection * Scale Data Pipelines: Own end\-to\-end ML pipelines that process high\-volume security event streams using Apache Spark, GCP Dataflow, GCP Dataproc, BigQuery and Vertex AI * Feature Engineering: Create and maintain feature stores that power real\-time and batch anomaly detection systems * Production ML Systems: Deploy, monitor, and iterate on ML models in production, serving enterprise customers at scale * Cross\-functional Collaboration: Partner with Platform, Application Engineering, and Product teams to translate security requirements into ML solutions * Participate in our on\-call rotation, available at all times while on\-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise. **WHO YOU ARE** We are an AI\-first company. PIEs specialize in building robust, scalable, and highly available systems such as Kubernetes clusters, Kafka ecosystems, and cloud environments. They apply sound engineering principles, operational discipline, and mature automation to ensure a reliable infrastructure foundation for all platform services and applications. Braze operates at a massive scale with over 3\.3 billion monthly active users across our customers, collecting hundreds of billions of data points each month and sending billions of messages to end\-users daily. As a Platform Software Engineer at Braze, you will collaborate with your team and consumer engineering teams to build and continuously improve the infrastructure as a service platform that every other team at Braze depends on. * Design and Manage Infrastructure: * + Build, optimize, and manage foundational systems such as Kubernetes clusters, Kafka ecosystems, and cloud resources (e.g., EC2, S3\) + Performance: * + Implement high\-availability and fault\-tolerant infrastructure strategies + Collaborate with Platform Software Engineers and Product teams to establish and meet Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for infrastructure components + Continuously monitor and optimize infrastructure performance to meet evolving demands * Incident Response and Resilience: * + Be part of a PagerDuty rotation to respond to infrastructure\-related incidents + Implement failover strategies, backups, and disaster recovery plans to mitigate risks + Conduct root cause analyses and retrospectives to improve system resilience * Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing: * + Partner with Platform Software Engineers to integrate infrastructure with service abstractions and APIs + Document processes, tools, and best practices to streamline development and operations + Share expertise and mentor team members to foster a culture of operational excellence * Innovate and Automate: * + Stay ahead of emerging trends in infrastructure technology and integrate innovative solutions + Reduce manual tasks by developing automated solutions for infrastructure provisioning, scaling, and maintenance + technologies + Have an excellent ability to manage multiple tasks and expectations at once * Mindset: * + Focused on building robust, scalable systems that enhance developer productivity + We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work\-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization. To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: **Brewer Science, Inc. is a major innovator of high\-technology solutions for the semiconductor / microelectronics markets. We are currently seeking a purpose\-driven candidate with an ownership mentality to fill an open position as a Software Engineer. This position is remote.** **Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor an employment visa for this position.** **This position will close on 12/01/2026** **Summary:** Software Engineers are responsible for assisting with implementing and maintaining software applications that support and enhance company systems and processes. They are also responsible for supporting systems, database and application infrastructure, and application development tools. **Responsibilities:** ***Software Engineer I*** * Participate in a cross\-functional team to define processes for comprehensive application development, global content management, and continuous process improvement. * Analyze application requirements, provide recommendations, and develop enhancements based on usability principles and best practices. * Offer technical expertise for the maintenance and implementation of business systems, ensuring their alignment with evolving business needs. * Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code based on specifications from senior engineers or team leads. * Assist in creating and executing test cases to ensure software functionality, performance, and stability, and participate in debugging and issue resolution. * Collaborate closely with team members, including senior engineers, quality assurance, and product management, to deliver solutions that meet business needs. * Leverage knowledge of current technology and design standards to identify opportunities for improvement in existing and new systems. * Participate in code reviews to gain feedback, insights, and to learn industry best practices. * Assist in creating and maintaining comprehensive documentation for software features, APIs, and modules, ensuring clarity and completeness. * Provide support and training for applications, responding to user issues and offering education to appropriate personnel or super users. **Education \& Credentials:** **Software Engineer I** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related field or * An equivalent combination of education and experience. **Compensation:** This is a non\-commission based position with compensation and salary will depend on position level, your skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Internal Platform & AI Tooling (TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL)
jobs.description: BusinessRate's product team ships fast. This team builds what the rest of the company runs on: the internal software our staff use every day, and the systems that keep AI\-assisted development safe. Our developers work alongside AI coding agents every day, so both halves matter. You'll report directly to the head of the internal platform team. What you'll do \- Build internal software that customer service, operations and leadership use to run the business every day. \- Build safety controls that decide what AI coding agents can reach, change and send, and what needs a person's approval first. \- Own PostgreSQL databases with large partitioned tables: schema design, migrations, performance and access. \- Improve how we test, release and monitor software, so problems show up before customers notice them. \- Work in TypeScript with Next.js, tRPC and Fastify on PostgreSQL, deployed on Render. What we're looking for \- 3–5 years writing production software in TypeScript or Node.js. \- You've built software other people use to do their jobs, and you've watched them use it. \- You've run PostgreSQL in production: migrations, indexes, query plans on large tables. \- You've owned CI/CD or a release process, not just used one. \- You think about failure modes, and you've built alerts or checks that caught a real problem. \- You use AI coding tools and have opinions about where they need limits. How to apply If you have code you wrote that you can share, include a link to it. You must live in the Phoenix metro area now; we don't offer relocation. Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $135,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Paid time off Application Question(s): * Do you currently live in the Phoenix metro area? If not, where do you live now? * Will you now or in the future require visa sponsorship to work in the United States? Experience: * Software development: 3 years (Preferred) Ability to Commute: * Tempe, AZ 85282 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Self-Built CDN Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Location :** San Jose **Team :** Technology **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A178889 Responsibilities The Global Engineering team builds and operates the global content delivery and multimedia infrastructure behind ByteDance's products, supporting service quality, user experience, and cost efficiency. We run a hybrid platform that combines commercial CDN vendors with ByteDance's own edge network across a large number of points of presence worldwide, supporting edge services including traffic acceleration, CDN caching, and gaming. We also build video transmission networks, multimedia processing platforms, and the data foundation and analysis capabilities behind them, improving product operations while reducing cost and increasing efficiency. You will work where user experience, platform stability, and cost efficiency move together, on infrastructure that carries media for businesses worldwide. ByteDance's Global CDN team is responsible for building and operating a global multi\-cloud CDN platform, providing highly available, high\-performance, and cost\-efficient content delivery capabilities for large\-scale products such as TikTok. The platform combines ByteDance's self\-built CDN infrastructure with commercial CDN providers across multiple regions worldwide, ensuring reliable and consistent content delivery for diverse business needs and global markets. The team owns the onboarding, integration, and ongoing management of CDN solutions and related resources, including commercial CDNs, self\-built CDN infrastructure, and origin services. Its responsibilities span the entire CDN lifecycle, from solution design and architectural evolution to reliability engineering, performance optimization, and cost governance. Operating in a large\-scale, distributed, and complex global environment, we continuously evolve CDN solutions to support the content delivery needs of different business scenarios, while improving platform reliability, performance, cost efficiency, and operational efficiency. Engineers on this team participate in architecture design, software development, and production operations, gaining deep hands\-on experience in large\-scale distributed systems, global traffic management, and multi\-cloud infrastructure. Responsibilities \- Participate in the development, operation, and continuous evolution of ByteDance's self\-built CDN platform in a cloud\-native (Kubernetes) environment, ensuring platform reliability and scalability. \- Collaborate with internal teams to drive platform adoption, providing technical onboarding, configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization support. \- Leverage data analysis and statistical insights to optimize global infrastructure deployment strategies and expand self\-built CDN coverage across regions. \- Analyze, design, and implement system\-level solutions to eliminate performance bottlenecks and improve edge service efficiency and content delivery performance. \- Drive the evolution of CDN operations toward AI\-driven intelligent management, leveraging AI technologies to improve automation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications \- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or related fields. \- Familiar with at least one programming language such as Go, Python, Java, or C/C\+\+. \- Solid foundation in data structures, operating systems, computer networks, and databases. \- Basic understanding of Internet technologies such as HTTP, DNS, TCP/IP, TLS/certificates, caching, or Linux. \- Strong learning ability, problem\-solving skills, and interest in infrastructure platforms. Preferred Qualifications \- Experience in CDN, computer networking, cloud infrastructure or distributed systems is preferred. \- Familiarity with edge computing, traffic management and load balancing, backend software development, or public cloud platforms and related technologies is a strong plus. \- Structured thinking, good communication skills, and collaborative mindset. Job Information 【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually) The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $162000 \- $387600 annually. ​ Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units. ​ Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure). ​ The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice. ​ **For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:** ​ Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: ​ 1\. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues; ​ 2\. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and ​ 3\. Exercising sound judgment. ​ About Us Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content. ​ Why Join ByteDance Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life \- a mission we work towards every day. ​ As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​ Diversity \& Inclusion ​ ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too. ​ Reasonable Accommodation ByteDance is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA\-request

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Vision: Be the best at what we do. Our Mission: Improve lives through technology.** **Summary:** “Customer Inspired” isn’t our slogan — it’s our driving force, and C Spire team members live it. We aim to engage the exceptional and embrace operational excellence to best deliver connectivity and technology solutions that advance our communities and customer’s lives. It’s a challenging goal, but we have a winning team that is looking to grow. You will guide the modernization of a business\-critical operations platform, replacing database\-centered logic with independent Go services. As a hands\-on technical leader, you will shape the migration, build production software, verify that new services preserve legacy behavior, and help teams operate the old and new systems safely side by side.**Responsibilities:** **What You Will Do** In all of your duties, you will have a relentless, obsessive, yet disciplined approach to manage all details to perfection and deliver desired results. * Define the target architecture and sequence the migration of the legacy platform into services with clear boundaries and data ownership. * Move business rules from SQL Server triggers and stored procedures into application code and explicit events while maintaining system performance. * Investigate legacy behavior module by module, compare old and new results, and guide cutovers only after the replacement has demonstrated behavioral parity. * Design resilient, long\-running processes that support retries, compensation, and rollback when work fails or changes course. * Build production Go services, including APIs, data models, tests, and deployment components. * Establish shared standards for service contracts, testing, observability, and security; lead architecture and code reviews and document significant decisions. * Evaluate architectural tradeoffs across performance, reliability, security, and cost, and assess emerging technologies against business and engineering needs. * Mentor senior engineers and technical leads in system design and engineering judgment, including colleagues moving from the existing .NET system. * Partner with product, infrastructure, security, and business stakeholders to develop practical technical solutions. * Troubleshoot complex production issues in both legacy and new systems, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements. This role offers the opportunity to deepen your expertise in large\-scale platform migration while broadening your influence on architecture, engineering standards, and the technical judgment of other engineers. **Qualifications:** **What You Will Bring** As a C Spire team member you will bring a relentless obsession to be the best in our industry and a winning mentality, determined to outsmart and outdo competitors. You will have a single\-minded commitment to unbeatable internal customer and external candidate experience. To support our software engineering team you will have an unapologetic passion for innovation and technology and an uncompromising drive toward continuous improvement. In addition to that, we require: * At least 12 years of hands\-on professional software engineering experience building production services in Go or another compiled, concurrent language, with the ability to become productive in Go quickly. * Experience owning architecture and technical direction across multiple systems or engineering teams. * A record of leading the decomposition of a monolith or legacy system into services while maintaining business operations. * Deep understanding of distributed\-systems challenges, including duplicate and out\-of\-order messages, partial failures, consistent writes across a database and queue, schema evolution, and cutovers without downtime. * Production experience with event\-driven design and messaging, plus strong relational database design and performance skills. * Ability to read SQL Server and .NET systems, including triggers and stored procedures, to extract business rules and verify equivalent behavior in a replacement. * Strong command of automated testing, deployment, and observability, including tests that demonstrate preserved behavior during a migration. * Experience designing secure, reliable systems. * A record of influencing decisions without formal authority, mentoring experienced engineers, and explaining architectural decisions to technical and business audiences. * A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. We will give special consideration to candidates who have: * Experience building or operating long\-running workflow systems, including compensation and rollback of work already in flight. * Experience designing APIs shared across services or teams, such as a federated GraphQL graph. * Experience verifying behavioral parity between old and new code paths during a live cutover. * Experience leading a migration off a proprietary database, particularly one that moved business logic into application code. * Working knowledge of C\# and .NET. * Experience establishing shared engineering standards or reusable application platforms. **What You Will Gain** A great workplace needs more than dental coverage, though we provide that and excellent health insurance. But that’s just the start. We make sure working at C Spire is the best career experience around. And Forbes has named us one of America's Best Midsize Employers multiple times because of it. We also offer: * Competitive Compensation Package * Blue Cross Blue Shield Health Insurance * Tuition Assistance Programs * Complimentary Wireless Service \& Device\* * 401k Match * Teladoc Telemedicine * WellBeacon Wellness Program * Paid Talent Referral Opportunities * Tailored learning paths for every position **Physical Requirements And Working Conditions** This role involves computer\-based design, coding, reviews, and production troubleshooting, as well as collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders. * Complimentary wireless service and device available to team members in our wireless footprint. *If you want to work hard, achieve a lot, and make a difference, then C Spire is the place for you.*

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer I
jobs.description: Overview: Supports the organization’s Development Operations (DevOps) strategy to ensure quality software deployments and help maintain the health, availability, security, reliability, and performance of critical business systems. The DevOps Engineer I is an early\-career role for someone with hands\-on exposure to operating systems, cloud infrastructure, deployment tools, and automation who wants to grow that into deep DevOps expertise. Working alongside senior DevOps engineers, the DevOps Engineer I deploys software, maintains and troubleshoots systems, and helps improve system performance, taking on more complex work as skills and experience grow. This role suits a proactive, curious person who enjoys learning new tools, asks good questions, and takes ownership of their work. Responsibilities: * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for .NET web services and APIs, from build and test through deployment of the services. * Troubleshoot build, packaging (.NET CLI, MSBuild, and NuGet), configuration, and deployment failures with developers. * Write and update Terraform for AWS and on\-premises resources, following team modules and merge\-request reviews, and use Ansible and Octopus Deploy to automate configuration and releases. * Develop scripts and automation tools that remove repetitive manual work. * Prepare and run releases through Octopus Deploy and GitLab CI, following change\-control and approval steps, and coordinate maintenance windows with application owners and stakeholders. * Administer system and application monitoring, logging, and alerting; respond to incidents and take part in a shared on\-call rotation for production support. * Work with developers to keep development, test, and production environments stable and ready for releases, and with cross\-functional teams to turn requirements into technical solutions. * Help support, troubleshoot, and containerize Windows and Linux services with Docker and deploy them to Amazon ECS. * Use MS SQL queries and tools to troubleshoot application issues and validate applications after deployment. * Administer Windows servers and web services for application hosting: sites, app pools, bindings, and certificates. * Troubleshoot routine network hardware and software issues to restore services, and escalate complex or unusual malfunctions to senior engineers. * Troubleshoot IP routing, certificate, Active Directory, VPN access, and DNS issues, with guidance from senior engineers on complex cases. * Apply security patches following the team's patch management process and remediate vulnerabilities identified by the Security team. * Follow PCI DSS, PCI CP, and SOX practices for secrets, access, and change records. * Document system configurations, processes, and runbooks in Confluence and Jira. * Manage assigned tasks and small projects, delivering services and deployments that meet stakeholder requirements, with support from senior team members. Qualifications: * Exposure to supporting .NET (C\#) applications. * Experience with Ansible or another configuration management tool. * Experience using AI tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, or Microsoft 365 Copilot to assist with coding, or building AI skills or agents to automate tasks and workflows. * Exposure to virtualization platforms such as Nutanix, VMware vSphere, or Hyper\-V, and to storage technologies. * Experience configuring or troubleshooting network settings and proxy servers on Windows and Linux. * Experience writing SQL queries against relational databases to troubleshoot issues or gather data. * Exposure to Amazon EKS or Kubernetes. * Experience with Octopus Deploy. * Experience in a highly regulated or highly secure environment (PCI DSS, PCI CP, or SOX). * Experience with Jira and Confluence, or SharePoint. * Exposure to HSM and PGP/RSA key management. * Experience creating network or system diagrams with tools such as Visio or Lucidchart. * AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, or actively working toward one. * Hands\-on experience with a Git\-based CI tool (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins), including Git and merge\-request workflows, from work, coursework, or personal projects. * Working knowledge of Terraform or another infrastructure\-as\-code tool, from work or lab projects. * Experience administering Windows Server and virtual machines, including IIS, and basic Linux skills. * Scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python. * Basic knowledge of relational databases and SQL queries. * Familiarity with core AWS services (EC2, ECS, VPC, IAM, and S3\) and with Docker. * Understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, proxies, load balancing, and TLS, plus basic knowledge of Active Directory and certificates. * Solid troubleshooting skills and a methodical approach to solving problems. * Clear written and verbal communication, including technical documentation. * A proactive, curious attitude and eagerness to learn new tools and take on new challenges. **Requirements:*** B.S. or M.S. degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. * 1\+ years of hands\-on experience in a relevant IT field such as DevOps, systems administration, or software development. Internships, co\-op roles, and substantial lab or home\-lab projects count. **Physical Demands:*** Office Environment: This position primarily operates in a professional office environment and requires the ability to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation. Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer, including extensive use of a keyboard, mouse, and telephone. Frequent viewing of computer monitors and electronic devices requiring close visual attention. Regular verbal communication and active listening during in\-person, virtual, and telephone meetings. Ability to occasionally stand, walk, bend, reach, and move throughout office and meeting spaces. Ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull materials weighing up to 15 pounds, such as laptops, presentation materials, luggage, or office supplies. Ability to travel periodically by automobile and commercial airline, which may include navigating airports, train stations, hotels, and customer or company locations. Ability to transport and manage personal luggage, computer equipment, and work\-related materials during business travel. Ability to work in a variety of environments, including offices, conference facilities, hotels, airports, and manufacturing or operational locations, as applicable. May require occasional early morning, evening, or overnight travel based on business needs. CPI Card Group is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the position. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time **Company Overview:** CPI Card Group® is a payment technology company and leading provider of credit, debit and prepaid solutions delivered physically, digitally and on\-demand. CPI helps our customers foster connections and build their brands through innovative and reliable solutions, including financial payment cards, personalization and fulfillment, and Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) instant issuance. Learn more at www.cpicardgroup.com. **Benefits:** Competitive pay rates and an inclusive, empowering and rewarding culture. Solid benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Short Term Disability, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, FSA, HSA, Vacation and Holiday Pay, Tuition Reimbursement and 401(k) with a competitive company match percentage. jobs.title: Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description: Hi, I'm Cassie Alexander, your Recruiter and guide to joining CSG! We are excited to learn more about you and your unique background. We are seeking a Cloud Security Engineer to support the implementation and maintenance of public cloud security policies, practices, procedures, and technologies to protect networks, systems, applications, and data. In this role, you will work as part of a highly technical team responsible for maintaining and continuously improving CSG's public cloud security framework across multiple cloud providers. You will also serve as a technical resource, providing guidance and expertise to teams across the organization to help address cloud security challenges. Additionally, you will support security operations by participating in the organization's incident response activities and responding to security events as needed. **We are looking for a Cloud Security Engineer who will:** * Identify and define security system requirements to support CSG's public cloud security framework. * Analyze security systems and identify opportunities for improvement through automation and other technical solutions. * Develop, document, and maintain security standards, technical documentation, and standard operating procedures. * Tune, filter, and customize security systems in collaboration with Information Security Analysts. * Participate in audit, compliance, and regulatory activities, including, but not limited to, Payment Card Industry (PCI) Data Security Standard (DSS), Sarbanes\-Oxley (SOX), state and federal privacy laws, and general security audits. * Participate in the organization's incident response plan, including reviewing, analyzing, and responding to security events and incidents as needed. * Organize and coordinate small to medium\-sized security projects, develop basic project plans based on requirements analysis, and communicate project status to leadership and management, including accomplishments, challenges, impediments, and key metrics. * Stay current on cloud security trends and best practices to support the ongoing improvement of CSG's public cloud security framework. * Serve as a subject matter expert in public cloud security, consulting with team members and stakeholders across the organization to provide guidance and help resolve basic to moderately complex cloud security challenges. * Analyze, assess, develop, implement, troubleshoot, and maintain basic to moderately complex commercial, cloud\-native, and open\-source security solutions. * Work outside normal business hours as needed to diagnose issues and implement product releases or changes without disrupting normal business operations. **Is this opportunity right for you? We are looking for candidates who have:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, a related field, or equivalent experience. * 2\+ years of experience working extensively in information security or highly technical IT fields. * Experience with one or more of the following programming or scripting languages: C\+\+, Go, Java, JavaScript, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Python, PowerShell, or Ruby. Python experience preferred. * Strong technical knowledge of AWS and Azure public cloud environments. * Ability to configure, deploy, and maintain a cloud security posture management (CSPM) solution. * Strong knowledge of public cloud infrastructure, security architectures, and industry standards. * Ability to evaluate cloud architectures and identify applicable security requirements and best practices. * Ability to read, interpret, and debug source code to achieve desired code execution. * Understanding of current threats to cloud and IT infrastructure, with the ability to communicate security risks at both technical and management levels. * Experience across the incident response lifecycle, including security system engineering, alert monitoring, triage, incident analysis (host and network forensics, malware analysis, etc.), and incident management. * Knowledge of TCP/IP and the ability to demonstrate a technical understanding of all layers of the TCP/IP stack. Familiarity with major application\-layer protocols, including HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, FTPS, SMTP, and DNS. Ability to read and understand packet traces and interpret network access control lists. * Understanding of network and application attacks, including DoS/DDoS, buffer overflows, SQL injection, reconnaissance scanning, and techniques attackers use to evade detection. Familiarity with well\-known vulnerabilities and exploits. * Working knowledge of IT security, compliance, and regulatory requirements, such as Payment Card Industry (PCI) Data Security Standard (DSS), Sarbanes\-Oxley (SOX), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and state and federal privacy laws. * Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English in a business environment. **CSGer Perks \& Benefits** * Work from Home * Employee Belonging Groups * Healthcare: Dental, Medical, and Vision * Paid Vacation, Volunteer, and Holiday Time Off * And so much more! \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-CA1 Please submit your application at csgi.com/careers. Applications will be accepted for at least 5 days from original posting date. Colorado Residents: In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age\-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. **Position Pay Range:** *This range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to geographical location and experience.* $94,774\.40\-$151,635\.87 This role is eligible for a bonus opportunity. **Location(s):** United States Remote**Accommodation:** If you would like to be considered for employment opportunities with CSG and need special assistance due to a disability or accommodation for a disability throughout any aspect of the application process, please call us at \+1 (402\) 431\-7440 or email us at accommodations@csgi.com. CSG provides accommodations for persons with disabilities in employment, including during the hiring process and any interview and/or testing processes. **Our Guiding Principles:** **Impact:** Always help and empower others, whether they’re colleagues or customers. When our employees set their minds to something, great things happen. **Integrity:** Do what’s right for our customers and our people while being authentic. We treat everyone with trust and respect—that’s just who we are. **Inspiration:** Be bold in the way you think and passionate about the work you do. Test out innovative ideas without the fear of failure. **Our Story:** -------------- CSG empowers companies to build unforgettable experiences, making it easier for people and businesses to connect with, use and pay for the services they value most. For over 40 years, CSG's technologies and people have helped some of the world's most recognizable brands solve their toughest business challenges and evolve to meet the demands of today's digital economy. By channeling the power of all, we make ordinary customer and employee experiences extraordinary. Our people \[CSGers] are fearlessly committed and connected, high on integrity and low on ego, making us the easiest company to do business with and the best place to work. We power a culture of integrity, innovation, and impact across our locations, representing the most authentic version of ourselves to build a better future together. That's just who we are. *Learn more about CSG Inclusion \& Impact here.* *Our culture is award\-winning: CSG has been recognized a US News \& World Report “**Best Companies to Work For**” for 2025\-2026, a Newsweek “**America’s Greatest Workplaces in Tech**” for 2025 and “The Top Company in Technology for Women to Work” for 2025, among many others.*

jobs.title: Principal Search AI Engineer
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. ### **Position Summary** The Principal Search AI Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for defining the technical vision, architecture, and engineering direction for large\-scale **Search and AI platforms**. The role combines deep expertise in information retrieval, distributed systems, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic architectures to build intelligent search capabilities that are scalable, reliable, observable, and production\-ready.
