Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI at scale, and where it matters most. How well our sequential models perform depends on the data they learn from, and on how fast we can turn a question about that data into an answer. We’re hiring a Director of AI Engineering to lead the engineering behind that data. That means building the pipelines and systems that bring new data sources in, turn them into model\-ready representations at scale, and let our scientists test a data hypothesis in days instead of months. . **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Make high judgment build\-vs\-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state\-of\-the\-art in AI. * Translate the enterprise AI strategy into portfolio\-level execution plans across multiple product areas, balancing innovation with delivery discipline * Scale AI engineering practices across teams through shared infrastructure, reusable components, and unified observability and governance frameworks * Establish enterprise standard for Responsible AI, including fairness metrics, model evaluation protocols, documentation requirements, and audit readiness * Partner with research, compliance, and enterprise risk teams to ensure deployed systems meet emerging ethical and regulatory standards **The Ideal Candidate:** * We’re looking for an engineering leader who thrives embedded in science and research teams. You work side by side with scientists, help shape experiments from the start, and turn research ideas into data systems quickly, without waiting for a handoff. * You design infrastructure that is reliable, reproducible, and versioned, so every experiment can be traced back to exactly the data it used. You know when to harden a pipeline and when to keep it fast and disposable. * You’ll lead a team of engineers who work the same way, partnering closely with our science leadership, but your edge is leverage: knowing which engineering investments will speed up the whole research loop, and delivering them. * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good * Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production * You get fulfillment from empowering others to achieve their potential nce building and leading multi\-team AI organization delivering multiple enterprise products or capabilities concurrently * Proven ability to expand and execute long\-term AI platform strategies aligned to enterprise priorities and regulatory frameworks * Experience establishing cross\-functional operating rhythms and review cadences (OKRs, AI governance councils, quarterly reviews) * Experience right\-sizing models, instance counts, and hardware types given requirements (e.g., context length, token inputs, token outputs) ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. jobs.title: Course Instructor- Generative AI for Engineers
jobs.description: The Department of Mechanical Engineering seeks an adjunct Instructor to develop and teach a course on Generative AI for Engineering Applications. The successful candidate will bring expertise in machine learning, computational modeling, or AI\-enabled engineering systems to design and deliver instruction focused on building, adapting, and applying generative models for mechanical engineering problems. This role emphasizes core course development, including curriculum design, technical content creation, and assessment development. Instruction will cover foundational generative architectures such as transformers, diffusion models, and neural operators, with applications in geometry generation, surrogate modeling, materials and microstructure design, and simulation workflows. The instructor will develop hands\-on assignments, guided projects, and assessments using Python and PyTorch and real\-world engineering datasets. The instructor will also be responsible for recording high\-quality asynchronous lecture videos, developing supporting instructional materials, and ensuring alignment between learning objectives, assessments, and course outcomes. In addition, the instructor will facilitate project\-based learning and evaluate student performance through technical assignments and project deliverables. The instructor will teach all scheduled sessions listed on the Mechanical Engineering academic calendar and complete associated instructional and administrative duties. The expected time commitment is approximately 10 hours per week for the duration of the course. Please submit CV and resume as one file uploaded to Interfolio. **Carnegie Mellon University** is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Catch Creation** Catch Creation is a global eCommerce company built for the digital age. We create, grow, and manage online brands that inspire customers and deliver real value through exceptional products and experiences. Our team thrives in a fully remote environment, combining creativity, data\-driven strategy, and innovation to build scalable eCommerce solutions that perform. From concept to conversion, we specialize in developing brands that stand out in competitive markets—driven by a passion for design, storytelling, and customer satisfaction. Every product we launch reflects our commitment to quality, authenticity, and growth. At Catch Creation, we believe great ideas can come from anywhere—and our remote\-first culture allows talented people from around the world to collaborate, innovate, and bring those ideas to life. Catch Creation is looking for an AI Engineer to build the automations that run our company and our creative work. You will turn slow, manual work into workflows that run on their own, and you will build them for real teams who use them every day. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build automations for the business.** Reports that arrive before every meeting, data that moves between tools without copying and pasting, handoffs that no longer depend on someone remembering. * **Build creative workflows.** AI\-assisted pipelines for ad and content work: drafting scripts and ideas, making variations, generating images and video, and passing the results to the people who finish them. * **Connect our tools.** Link the systems each team already uses through APIs and automation platforms. * **Keep it running.** Monitor, fix and improve what you build so the team can rely on it. * **Watch cost and quality.** Track what we spend on AI tools and credits, and recommend cheaper options that give the same or similar results. * **Teach the team.** Tell people when something new is live and show them how to use it. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years building automations or software, with at least 1 year building with large language models (LLMs) and AI tools. * Hands\-on experience with an automation platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier, and at least one programming language such as Python or JavaScript. * At least one automation or AI workflow you built that people used regularly, not only a prototype. * Comfort connecting tools through APIs, and care with company data and access (who can see what). * The ability to explain what you built in plain language to people who are not technical. * You work well on your own and own the result. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience with AI image and video generation tools, and how their pricing works. * Experience on an e\-commerce, consumer brand, marketing or creative team. * Experience building dashboards or automated reports. **Role details** ---------------- * Location: Remote * Full Time

standardize, and support OT network solutions for manufacturing plants, with emphasis on production reliability, controls connectivity, and secure plant\-floor integration. * Partner with plant controls engineers, Manufacturing IT, Enterprise Cyber Security, suppliers, and platform teams to deliver scalable OT connectivity standards and implementation guidance. * Translate manufacturing use cases into practical network requirements for PLCs, CNCs, HMIs, SCADA, industrial PCs, vision systems, robots, safety systems, gateways, sensors, and edge/cloud integrations. * Develop and maintain OT network architecture drawings, standards, test plans, troubleshooting guides, bill\-of\-material guidance, and plant deployment documentation. * Evaluate and validate industrial networking hardware, firmware, software, and monitoring tools through lab proof\-of concepts and plant pilots. * Support plant deployments and escalations involving industrial switches, routers, firewalls, wireless/5G connectivity, and remote access. * Lead technical reviews for new manufacturing solutions to ensure OT network readiness, standards alignment, cyber resiliency, lifecycle supportability, and maintainability. * Drive continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned from deployments, outages, audits, and troubleshooting events, then converting them into reusable standards and training material. **OT Network Architecture Responsibilities** * Define plant\-floor network reference architectures using Purdue Model concepts, zones/conduits, controlled data flows, and appropriate separation between control, supervisory, enterprise, supplier, and cloud\-connected systems. * Establish OT network segmentation and access\-control patterns that reduce lateral movement risk while preserving production uptime and controls\-system functionality. * Specify hardened, supportable connectivity for industrial assets, including fixed and managed IP addressing, VLAN strategy, routing boundaries, firewall rules, certificate/TLS considerations, name resolution, and time services. * Support secure remote access and supplier connectivity with identity, authorization, logging, session control, and change management expectations suitable for manufacturing operations. * Plan monitoring and visibility requirements for OT networks, including asset discovery, traffic baselining, network health, telemetry, logging, alert triage, and incident response handoff. * Ensure OT network designs account for manufacturing constraints such as deterministic traffic, vendor support boundaries, maintenance windows, safety requirements, legacy protocol exposure, and plant skill levels. * Contribute to cyber risk assessments, residual risk documentation, audit readiness, and remediation planning for OT connectivity gaps. * Collaborate with standards and platform owners to support industrial networking governance, documentation accuracy, approved\-product lists, lifecycle planning, and exception handling. **Position Qualifications** **Required:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Controls Engineering, Computer Science, Cyber Security, or equivalent practical manufacturing/controls experience. * 5\+ years of experience supporting manufacturing, controls, automation, plant\-floor networking, or OT infrastructure in production environments. * Strong working knowledge of industrial automation systems and how networks support PLCs, CNCs, HMIs, SCADA/MES interfaces, industrial PCs, robots, drives, safety systems, and plant data collection. * Hands\-on experience with industrial Ethernet, managed switches, routers, firewalls, VLANs, IP subnetting, routing, NAT, ACLs, DNS/DHCP, NTP/PTP, QoS, port security, and network troubleshooting tools. * Ability to read and develop network architecture diagrams, controls connectivity diagrams, rack/elevation details, and implementation standards for plant use. * Understanding of OT network segmentation, Purdue Model concepts, and secure connectivity between OT, IT, suppliers, and cloud/edge platforms. * Experience troubleshooting production\-impacting connectivity issues using packet captures, switch/firewall logs, industrial system diagnostics, and structured root\-cause methods. * Ability to balance cyber security requirements with plant uptime, safety, maintainability, vendor support needs, and manufacturing launch/production schedules. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to simplify complex network topics for plant controls teams, leadership, suppliers, IT, and cyber stakeholders. **Preferred:** * Experience designing OT networks in automotive, discrete manufacturing, process manufacturing, or high\-volume production environments. * Knowledge of industrial protocols such as EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT, CIP, DNP3, BACnet, vendor\-specific fieldbus gateways, and multicast/time\-sensitive traffic considerations. * Familiarity with IEC 62443, NIST CSF, ISA/IEC zones and conduits, Zero Trust principles for OT, risk assessment practices, and audit/compliance expectations. * Experience with industrial wireless, private cellular/5G, edge compute, IIoT gateways, secure data brokers, certificate/TLS deployment, and cloud\-connected manufacturing use cases. * Relevant certifications or training such as CCNA/CCNP, Cisco Industrial Networking, Fortinet/Palo Alto, ISA/IEC 62443, GICSP, GRID, or vendor OT\-networking credentials. * Experience with Windows and Linux administration, virtualization, backup/restore concepts, endpoint hardening, and secure lifecycle management for plant\-floor compute platforms. * Coding Capabilities: Python, Bash Scripting, Go (Golang), JavaScript, PowerShell, C / C\+\+, YAML / JSON, VB, Visual Studio **Other Information** * Role is manufacturing\-floor focused and should be positioned as an OT/controls network architect or engineer, not a traditional corporate IT network role. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills across Manufacturing, Controls Engineering, IT, Cyber Security, suppliers, and operations leadership. * Highly motivated self\-starter who can work independently, lead technical alignment, and make practical decisions under production constraints. * Ability to travel to manufacturing plants as required for assessments, deployments, pilots, troubleshooting, audits, and training. * Expected to create clear, reusable documentation that supports scalable deployment across multiple plants and regions Pay: $60\.00 \- $65\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Lifecycle Engineer
jobs.description: Remote, Miami, United States ### **About the Role** You'll be the engineer responsible for what AI\-MSL delivers into a customer's production system. AI\-MSL, CloudGeometry's AI Managed Software Lifecycle platform, takes a change request written in plain language and carries it through requirements, specs, code, tests, and documentation, delivered as a branch that's ready for production. AI agents do the work, and a senior engineer oversees every step. That's you. You won't write every line yourself. You'll guide agent work on real customer codebases, decide whether the results are correct, and own what happens once they reach production. On a typical day you might turn a vague request into a clear spec, review a 400\-line change you didn't write, spot an issue that looks fine in review but would fail under load, and then add a check so it doesn't happen again. You'll work across several customer systems with unfamiliar code, past decisions you weren't part of, and business rules nobody wrote down. Getting up to speed quickly in new code is a big part of the job. The title is still new in our industry, but the work is clear: someone has to be responsible for AI\-built software that real businesses rely on. ### **What You'll Do** * Turn requests into clear specs. Work out what a customer or product owner is really asking for and write a spec the agents can follow. Most bad output starts with an unclear spec. * Guide agent work and review it. Run changes through each step, step in when something goes off track, and decide at each checkpoint whether the work moves forward or goes back. You approve what ships. * Review a lot of code you didn't write. Read changes, specs, and test results closely enough to catch what looks right but isn't, like a missed edge case, a test that passes for the wrong reason, or a change that works on its own but breaks this codebase. * Learn new systems quickly. Understand each customer's codebase, including its conventions, usage patterns, and unwritten rules, and keep AppGraph (our live model of the system) accurate as things change. * Turn mistakes into safeguards. When something slips through, add a rule, test, or check so the system catches it next time. * Own production results. Handle deployment, monitoring, incident response, and the cost and speed of agent runs. Once you approve a change, it's yours. * Share feedback with the platform team. You'll see where AI\-MSL falls short before anyone else. Report it clearly and help shape what gets built next. * Work directly with customers. Explain decisions and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical people, and push back when a request needs to change before it can run. * Join a daily standup with the team in Europe and South America (between 07:00 and 11:00 MT) and stay reachable on Slack during your working hours. ### **Must\-Haves** * 5\+ years building and running production software, including fixing things when they break * Strong backend fundamentals. Our stack is TypeScript, NestJS, and PostgreSQL, but fluency in any typed language matters more than knowing ours already * Strong code review skills. You can read unfamiliar code and find what's wrong with it, and this is the most important skill for the role * 1\+ years of daily hands\-on use of an AI coding assistant such as Claude Code, with clear opinions on where it struggles and how you work around it * Good testing instincts. You know the difference between a test that passes and a test that proves something * Experience working in codebases you didn't write, ideally several, and a reliable way of getting up to speed * Experience debugging in production with logs and traces, and handling live incidents * Some cloud experience, ideally AWS * Knowing when to stop and ask. We value people who raise questions early over people who guess * Strong written and spoken English, and comfort working asynchronously across time zones ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Built something with agents beyond a simple chat tool, such as a skill, hook, harness, or agent that runs on its own * Testing frameworks or automated checks for generated code * Legacy modernization or large refactoring projects * Consulting, agency, or managed services experience, switching between customers in the same week * On\-call or site reliability experience * TypeScript, Next.js, and React, for work on the review interface * Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, and event\-driven architecture * Writing or open\-source contributions about AI\-assisted development * Spanish, or experience working with teams in Latin America ### **Why CloudGeometry** CloudGeometry is a Silicon Valley engineering company. We're an Anthropic Claude Partner, an AWS Advanced Consulting Partner, and a CNCF Kubernetes Certified Service Provider, and we help companies move from scattered AI chat tools to a reliable, well\-governed way of building software. Most engineers using AI today do it on their own, inside processes that weren't built for it. Here you'll work in one that was, on real production systems, with the tools and authority to do it well. * Competitive pay and benefits * Access to Claude Code and the latest AI models * Training budget for courses and certifications * Fully remote, with flexible hours outside one daily standup (07:00 to 11:00 MT) * Experience across many codebases and architectures, which helps your career grow faster Submit Resume Send us an application to jobs@cloudgeometry.com, and we’ll contact you in shortly.

jobs.description: The Mass DOT software quality assurance (QA) team is responsible for ensuring the integrity of applications across the entire Mass DOT agency which includes the Registry of Motor Vehicles, The Highway, Aeronautics Divisions, and Shared Services. QA testers analyze the testing objectives, the scope of the testing effort and the testing approach as that fits within the Project methodology; QA Analysts identify gaps in the business test requirements coverage by reviewing the documented business processes. QA Analysts can write detailed QA Test Plans and test scenarios as well as create the test data required for positive and negative testing and track key Project milestone dates. The Quality Assurance team is responsible for testing Functional/Business Requirements within multiple applications to ensure the full and correct linkage and integrity of data and functionality QA Analysts create and maintain Defect/Issues Logs, suggest improvements, re\-test fixes and provide test progress reports. QA analysts perform regression testing to prevent adverse effects on existing functionality; execute Stress and Performance testing, evaluate the application for usability and accessibility, participate in User Acceptance testing, and assist the Training Department if needed. Post implementation, the Quality Assurance department is expected to support any project in any way needed. The primary work location for this role will be at **10 Park Plaza, Boston, 02116\.**The work schedule for this position is **Monday through Friday, 8:00AM\-4:00PM EST**. This position is expected to follow a **hybrid** work model that combines in\-office and remote work as needed. **Duties and Responsibilities** * Incumbents in this functional area are responsible for assisting in managing the testing activities for the eligibility mainframe system and supporting integrated services. Incumbents will design and develop test cases and execute by both manual and automated methods. * The Quality Assurance Analyst II performs and leads tests to ensure all systems meet minimum standards and requirements. Incumbents may also instruct, direct, and review IT Quality Assurance work of others (including the Quality Assurance Analyst I) and act as an internal consultant to business partners and management on more complex application projects, software, work methods, and/or procedures. * Review and appropriately interpret business requirement documentation for eligibility applications residing on mainframe and web enterprise systems. * Work with the project team to design, develop and deliver on test plans for new and existing functionality. * Design and execute regression test plans on an ongoing basis — support frequent and rapid changes. A reliable source for early feedback on new functionality and feature changes. * Provide immediate feedback to the project team to address gaps in testing coverage. * Collaborate with the application manager to identify improvements to enhance application quality. * Analyze and triage defects and be prepared to define issues. * Manage defects and issues using enterprise tracking tool. * Become the voice of Quality for the product team and function as team lead back\-up when required. * Develop and distribute test summary reports after each cycle. * Deliver projects with high quality, within the agreed timeframe and upon budgetary and time constraints. * Contribute to efforts to implement, monitor, and control security privileges compliance. * Perform timely audits, ensure policy compliance, and take corrective actions as necessary, on non\-compliant matters. * Develop and distribute audit summary reports after each cycle. * Perform and lead test projects in accordance with written business and functional design documentation, following established standards. * Perform workflow analysis and recommend improvements. * Devise improvements to current procedures and develop models of possible future configurations. * Efficiently and effectively communicate status of assigned tasks to the developers, engineers, architects, projects managers, project teams, and other personnel. * Prioritize tasks and adhere to deadlines to meet department objectives and individual performance metrics under the guidance of quality assurance leadership within the project. * Support defect management with creation of defects, providing information to application development teams on expected outcome and retesting when assigned; participate in defect triage meetings. * Update and maintain traceability matrices to ensure test coverage with the approval of quality assurance leadership. * Pro\-actively follow up with quality assurance leadership on issues and escalations and provide suggestions for possible resolutions. * Assist in all phases of code deployments; including, but not limited to, off\-hours support and occasional weekend hours. * May be required to be on call based on department needs. **Preferred Qualifications** * Two (2\) to five (5\) communities. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home, and their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright." We built a phone that works out of the box, AI check\-in calls that surface how she's really doing, and a family app that replaces daily dread with peace of mind. Families tell us they used to wake up with a knot in their stomach. They don't anymore. It is working, with tens of thousands of active customers, a strong financial position, and investors including the YC Continuity Fund behind us. We are looking for a hands\-on owner of finance and operations: a do\-er who makes finance a real partner to every leader in the company and runs the operations that keep it moving. You will put the numbers at the center of how we make decisions including telling us when we should be investing more, not just less. This is not a role for someone who wants to hire a team and manage from above. You will build the model, sit in the budget reviews and negotiate the contracts yourself. If building the financial and operational backbone of the company that brings peace of mind to millions of seniors and their families is how you want to spend the next few years, we'd love to talk. **What you will own** --------------------- * **Own and evolve our data foundation.** Today, our data stack and analytics infrastructure are maintained by backend engineers who have taken on data work alongside their primary responsibilities. You will become the first person dedicated to this area: owning the reliability, structure, and evolution of the systems that bring together data from our product, billing, CRM, marketing, and other platforms. * **Turn raw data into a trustworthy, usable data layer.** Build and maintain pipelines, models, views, and shared definitions that make important business concepts easy to understand and analyze. Reduce duplicated logic across dashboards and queries, establish clear definitions for core metrics, and make it easier for others to answer questions without rebuilding the same logic every time. * **Enable self\-service analytics across the company.** Make it possible for non\-data specialists to answer recurring questions through dashboards, well\-designed data abstractions, documentation, and AI\-assisted tools. * **Own recurring reporting and business visibility.** Maintain and improve the dashboards and reporting used to understand growth, revenue, retention, churn, customer behavior, product adoption, and operational performance. * **Investigate questions, not just fulfill data requests.** When someone asks why churn increased, which customers adopt a feature, where a funnel is breaking, why a marketing channel is performing differently, or whether an experiment worked, you should be able to take an ambiguous question, find the relevant data, explore it, and come back with a clear answer\-or explain what the data can and cannot tell us. * **Partner closely with product, engineering, growth, marketing, and leadership.** Data here is not a separate reporting function. You will work directly with people making product and business decisions, helping them define what should be measured, challenge assumptions, design useful analyses, and interpret results. * **Build the foundations of our data function.** You will have significant influence over how we structure analytics as the company grows: what belongs in the data layer, how metrics are defined and documented, how we monitor data quality, what should be automated, and eventually where additional data specialization or headcount would create leverage. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * **Strong SQL and relational data skills.** You should be extremely comfortable exploring complex production datasets, joining information across systems, understanding imperfect schemas, and turning messy business logic into clear, maintainable queries and models. * **Production data engineering depth.** You understand data pipelines, ETL/ELT, APIs, databases, data modeling, scheduling, monitoring, and failure modes. You do not need a backend engineer to diagnose every pipeline issue or build every new integration for you. * **Cloud warehouse experience.** Hands\-on experience with BigQuery or a comparable analytical warehouse, including performance, cost, and maintainability tradeoffs. * **Strong analytical judgment.** You understand funnels, cohorts, retention, conversion, segmentation, experimentation, and the difference between an interesting correlation and something we should actually make a decision around. You know when a dataset is too small or biased to support the conclusion someone wants to draw. * **Business curiosity.** You want to understand why a metric changed, not just calculate it. You ask follow\-up questions, inspect unexpected results, notice when two numbers that should reconcile do not, and keep digging until you understand what is happening. * **The ability to communi ime, you will start taking ownership of existing analytics and data work. Fix a broken report. Investigate a real business question. Trace a metric back to its source. Identify places where duplicated or fragile logic is creating risk. By the end of the first month, you should understand both the shape of our data environment and the major areas where improving it would create leverage.### **Days 31 to 60: Take ownership** You are now the primary owner of our day\-to\-day data and analytics work. Recurring reporting and pipelines are reliable and understood. Important metrics have clear definitions. When something looks wrong, you know where to start investigating it. You are independently handling analytical questions from product, growth, engineering, and leadership, and you are beginning to replace one\-off or duplicated analysis with reusable data models and shared logic. You have also developed a point of view on the highest\-leverage improvements to our data foundation. Not a theoretical architecture roadmap, but a prioritized list grounded in the problems you have actually encountered.### **Days 61 to 90: Build leverage** By month three, the goal is not simply for you to be doing the data work that engineers were doing before. The goal is for the company to be better at using data because you are here. Common questions are easier to answer. Core metrics are trustworthy and documented. Repeated manual work is becoming automated. Engineers spend less time maintaining analytics infrastructure and answering ad hoc data questions. Marketing and growth have better visibility into acquisition, conversion, and customer behavior. Product and business teams can make decisions with better information and less friction. Our CRM, billing, marketing, and product data are becoming easier to reason about as a connected customer and revenue lifecycle, even without a dedicated RevOps function. You have a clear roadmap for what comes next: where our data architecture needs to mature, what analytical capabilities we are missing, and which investments will create the most leverage as the company grows.**The team and structure** -------------------------- You will be our first dedicated data hire and work closely with engineering, product, marketing, growth, and company leadership. You will inherit a functioning data environment built largely by backend engineers with strong interest and experience in data and analytics. That means you are not starting from zero: there are existing pipelines, dashboards, reporting, and significant institutional knowledge to build from. But data has historically been one responsibility among many rather than anyone's primary focus. Your role is to change that. You will have significant autonomy over how the data function evolves, while working closely with engineers who know the systems and business logic deeply. This is a hands\-on role: particularly early on, you will move regularly between data engineering, analytics engineering, and analysis depending on where the highest\-value problem is.**Why now** ----------- As the company has grown, data has become essential to understanding who our customers are, how they find us, whether they adopt our products, where they struggle, why they leave, how our revenue changes, and whether the things we build actually improve those outcomes. Until now, engineers have owned much of this work alongside their other responsibilities. That has taken us surprisingly far, but it also means valuable engineering capacity is spent maintaining pipelines, building reports, and answering analytical questions, and there is no single person whose primary responsibility is making our data more reliable, accessible, and useful. We are ready for that to be someone's job. If you like moving between engineering and analysis, digging into messy questions until they make sense, and building the foundations of a data function rather than inheriting a large established team, this is the role.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Silver Spring, MD \| Full\-time Competitive Power Ventures, Inc. (“CPV”), with headquarters in Silver Spring, MD, and offices in Braintree, MA and Sugar Land, TX, is uniquely positioned to leverage global technology and financial partnerships to help modernize America’s power generation. We are driven to improve our energy infrastructure by developing and operating power generation facilities using cutting edge, domestically available natural gas, and renewable power technology. CPV is owned by OPC Energy, the first privately held electric company in Israel. OPC Energy became a public company in August 2017 and is traded on the Tel\-Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE: OPCE). CPV is seeking an AI Solutions Engineer to join our Information Technology Department in our Silver Spring, MD office. The AI Solutions Engineer helps CPV design, build, test, and improve practical AI solutions using ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Databricks. Working with business teams, and vendors, this role turns real work problems into useful prototypes and production\-ready capabilities, with appropriate security, data governance, human review, and measurable outcomes. This is a hands\-on, mid\-level role for someone with 3–5 years of relevant experience who can contribute directly to solution development and explain new AI capabilities in clear, usable terms. The person will continually track changes in AI tools and practices, assess what matters to CPV, and help colleagues learn through demonstrations, guidance, and training. **Key Responsibilities**: **Build and improve AI solutions** * Partner with business users to understand processes, pain points, and success measures, then help shape practical AI use cases. * Develop and configure solutions using ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, and Databricks capabilities, including assistants, agents, workflow support, data analysis, and document\-based experiences. * Create prototypes and proofs of concept; gather user feedback; refine, test, document, and support solutions as they move toward broader use. * Connect AI solutions to approved enterprise data and services using available connectors, APIs, and Databricks data products, working with data and security teams as needed. * Apply sound practices for prompt and context design, retrieval, tool use, evaluation, access control, privacy, and human review. * Monitor solution quality and user feedback; help troubleshoot issues and recommend improvements to reliability, usability, and cost. **Enable responsible adoption** * Work with business stakeholders to identify where AI can help and where a simpler non\-AI approach is more appropriate. * Follow CPV security, privacy, records, data governance, and responsible AI requirements; raise risks and involve the right reviewers early. * Prepare clear solution documentation, user instructions, support notes, and reusable examples so successful work can be maintained and extended. * Collaborate with IT, data engineering, cybersecurity, business teams, and implementation partners to deliver solutions that fit CPV’s environment. **Keep CPV current and build capability** * Keep abreast of product releases, new features, and broader trends across ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Databricks, and the AI field. * Test relevant capabilities in a controlled way and summarize their potential value, limitations, costs, and readiness for CPV. * Share timely updates and practical recommendations with business and technology teams. * Deliver demonstrations, office hours, short training sessions, and learning materials that help employees use approved AI tools effectively and responsibly. * Capture lessons learned and contribute reusable patterns, standards, and examples for CPV’s AI community. **Requirements**: * 3–5 years of professional experience in software development, data and analytics, business systems, automation, AI solution development, or a closely related field. * Hands\-on experience building or configuring solutions with one or more of ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or Databricks; ability and interest to develop across all three. * Experience translating user needs into working technical solutions, prototypes, or process improvements. * Working knowledge of APIs, data concepts, access controls, and software or analytics delivery practices. * Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to nontechnical audiences and lead practical training. * Curiosity and disciplined learning habits; ability to assess new features and distinguish useful capabilities from hype. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience with Python, SQL, notebooks, workflow automation, or low\-code application development is preferred. * Familiarity with Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, Mosaic AI, MLflow, Vector Search, or model serving is preferred. * Experience with Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, Azure, or enterprise knowledge sources is preferred. * Familiarity with generative AI concepts such as prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, agents, and model evaluation are preferred. * Experience supporting adoption through user enablement, change management, documentation, or training is preferred. * Must pass a pre\-employment background and financial credit check **Compensation**: The base annual salary range for this position is $165,000 – $195,000 in the Company’s good faith estimate. jobs.title: Lead Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Position Summary** As the Lead Engineer, AI Security, you will secure the digital fabric enabling our company’s rapid AI transformation. You will focus entirely on discovering, managing, and securing machine identities, service accounts, API keys, and automated tokens. A primary objective in this role is mapping and restricting data access rights for non\-human actors—both independent automated systems and AI agents operating on behalf of human users. You will act as the critical bridge between core identity security operations and our AI enablement initiatives, ensuring that tools like Microsoft Copilot and emerging LLM technologies operate under strict least\-privilege principles. **Core Responsibilities** * NHI Governance \& Lifecycle: Discover, inventory, and classify all non\-human identities, including Azure/Entra Enterprise Applications, AWS IAM Roles, service accounts, and API keys. * Data Rights \& Privilege Mapping: Analyze, map, and audit the data rights/permissions held by NHIs to understand what sensitive data they can access, either independently or through inheritance from their human owners. * AI \& Copilot Guardrails: Partner with the AI Enablement team to define and enforce access controls for Microsoft Copilot and future AI models, ensuring AI agents cannot access or expose restricted corporate data. * Least\-Privilege Enforcement: Design and implement automated policies to remediate over\-privileged service accounts and eliminate "privilege creep" within AWS and Microsoft environments. * Blast Radius Reduction: Formulate strategies to untangle complex human\-to\-machine permission chains, ensuring a compromised human account does not inadvertently grant an AI or machine identity elevated data rights. Monitoring \& Incident Response: Establish continuous monitoring for anomalous NHI behavior and integrate machine identity alerts that facilitate the AI Observability and Runtime monitoring requirements of the security operations pipeline. * **Required Technical Experience** * Cloud Identity Infrastructure: Deep, hands\-on experience managing identity frameworks in AWS IAM and Azure AD / Entra ID (specifically Workload Identities, App Registrations, and Managed Identities). * Data Security \& Governance: Proven experience auditing data access paths, file\-share permissions, or cloud data store policies (S3, Azure Blob, SharePoint/OneDrive permission structures) and utilizing tools such as Microsoft Purview or Cyera (or equivalent DSPM platforms). * AI Security Context: Familiarity with the security implications of AI deployment, data ingestion pipelines, and how tools like Microsoft Copilot inherit user\-level permissions. Automation \& Scripting: Proficiency in scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell) or using API\-driven tools to automate the discovery and rotation of machine credentials. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience deploying dedicated Non\-Human Identity Management (NHIM) or Secrets Management platforms. * Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security, Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator, or CISSP. Excellent cross\-functional communication skills * \#LI\-JV1 **Location** Canandaigua, New York **Additional Locations** Chicago, Illinois, Rochester, New York, San Antonio, Texas **Job Type** Full time **Job Area** Information Technology **The salary range for this role is:** $98,800\.00 \- $177,600\.00 This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. Our compensation is based on cost of labor. For remote locations or positions open to multiple locations, the pay range may reflect several US geographic markets, including the lowest geographic market minimum to the highest geographic market maximum. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, the prevailing minimum wage for the location, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue\-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), and any other benefits to eligible employees. Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law. **Equal Opportunity** Constellation Brands is committed to a continuing program of equal employment opportunity. jobs.title: Senior Software Quality Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **Location:** Remote **Work anywhere in the US, must live in the US** **Level:** Senior **ABOUT CONTINUED** A leader in EdTech, Continu**ed** is a team of passionate individuals dedicated to empowering professionals and enhancing careers. We are fast\-paced, nimble, and we laugh a lot. We are proud to be certified as a great workplace (https://www.greatplacetowork.com/certified\-company/7010396\), ranked \#4 in Fortune's 2026 Best Workplaces in Education \& Training (https://www.greatplacetowork.com/best\-workplaces/education\-training/2026?category\=small\-and\-medium), ranked \#23 in Fortune's 2026 Best Workplaces for Women (https://www.greatplacetowork.com/best\-workplaces/women/2026?category\=small\-and\-medium), and ranked \#27 in Fortune's 2026 Best Workplaces for Parents (https://www.greatplacetowork.com/best\-workplaces/parents/2026?category\=small\-and\-medium) by the independent analysts at Great Place to Work®. We are 100% virtual, scattered across the country, but we maintain a tight\-knit culture driven by curiosity, a love of learning, and a desire to solve complex problems. Learn more about us at continued.com (http://www.continued.com/). **THE MISSION: Quality Engineering in the AI Era** We are seeking a Senior Software Quality Engineer to drive quality practices **in an AI\-augmented engineering environment.** **This role goes beyond traditional test automation. You will help design and build quality intelligence frameworks and testing agents, validate AI\-powered features, and help embed continuous quality practices across the SDLC.** You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Data, and TechOps teams to ensure our systems are reliable, scalable, observable, and responsible. **WHAT YOU'LL DO (The Impact)** * **Release Quality:** Drive end\-to\-end quality assurance for web and mobile releases, partnering with engineering and product teams to define acceptance criteria and release readiness. * **AI\-Assisted Test Automation:** Build and maintain Cypress and Playwright test suites for application teams, using AI tools like Claude and Cursor to speed up test creation and maintenance, and evaluate emerging tools worth adopting. Pair with frontend developers and complement automation with exploratory testing. * **Own API Quality:** Design and build test architecture for microservices and AI\-integrated platforms, with a focus on GraphQL and Apollo Studio. * **Agentic Testing:** Design, build, and refine AI agents that automate testing work such as test generation, regression analysis, failure triage, and defect investigation. Keep humans in the loop on the output, and share what works with the team. * **Continuous Quality (CI/CD):** Establish and maintain quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions). * **Observability \& Telemetry:** Leverage tools like Honeycomb and defect trend analysis to identify systemic risks and contribute to predictive incident feedback loops. * **Engineering Partnership:** Author pull requests for bug fixes and participate in architecture reviews to advocate for testability and reliability at the design phase. * **Mentorship:** Mentor Quality Engineering team members on modern, AI\-driven, and agentic quality practices. * **Security:** Incorporate security and performance testing into the development lifecycle. * **Test Planning \& Regression Strategy:** As needed, define and maintain comprehensive test plans for feature releases and platform changes. Own regression strategy for your product area, recommending what to automate vs. test manually and keeping suites lean. **WHO YOU ARE** * **Automation Engineer:** You have strong hands\-on experience building UI and API test automation frameworks, whether from scratch or by significantly extending existing ones. You're proficient in Cypress and Playwright, and have integrated suites into CI/CD pipelines. * **GraphQL Proficiency:** You have strong hands\-on experience with schema validation and query/mutation testing, ideally in Apollo Studio. * **AI \& Agentic Testing:** You've used or built AI agents and workflows to automate testing tasks, or you're eager to learn, and you review AI output with a critical eye. * **Coder \& Debugger:** You are comfortable reading, debugging, and writing code (PHP/Laravel and JavaScript) to contribute to platform stability. * **Systems Thinker:** You connect defects and test signals to underlying risks, and you're comfortable with ambiguity and driven by data. * **Security \& Accessibility:** You are passionate about system security and accessibility. * **Culture Fit:** You are reliable, trustworthy, and a genuine team player. You must be able to comprehend (and contribute to) highly advanced forms of sarcasm. * **Coach and Mentor:** You enjoy teaching other team members about the latest tools and practices. * **Ethics:** You believe in responsible and ethical AI practices. With the additional requirements of: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred. * Excellent communication skills — able to clearly explain technical issues to non\-technical stakeholders and do so in a way that builds confidence rather than confusion (we live in Slack). * Reliable, trustworthy, and consistent — the team will depend on you. * There is direct oversight, but you are expected to take ownership of your work, to establish deadlines, and to communicate progress proactively. * Must have the ability to fulfill the job requirements with or without reasonable accommodations. * Must be located in the United States and be legally eligible to work for us. * Travel is required for an all\-company meeting and may be required once or twice per year for team or project meetings. **WHY JOIN US?** * Full\-time W2 position, work core business hours in your time zone. * Work from home with a company\-provided MacBook and internet stipend. * 21 days of flexible PTO \+ your birthday \+ holidays (with flexible substitution). * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision group health insurance, flexible spending accounts, and more. * 401k match, professional development budget, robust wellness programs, pet insurance and many more perks and benefits. **THE EVOLUTION OF THIS ROLE** This is not a traditional QA position focused solely on regression cycles. This role shifts from: “Testing what was built.” to “Engineering quality into intelligent, evolving systems.” **TO APPLY** To apply, **please submit a cover letter with your application.** In your cover letter, we'd love to hear about: 1\) why you would make a great addition to our team; and 2\) a project achievement you are particularly proud of and why AND/OR something you've learned recently, etc.

jobs.title: Sr FW Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature\-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today! **Key Responsibilities** * **Firmware Design \& Implementation:** Architect, write, and maintain clean, highly optimized embedded code (C/C\+\+) for resource\-constrained microcontrollers, SoCs, and RTOS or bare\-metal environments. * **Board Bring\-Up \& Validation:** Partner with electrical and hardware engineering teams to bring up new prototypes, configure I/O peripherals, validate schematics, and troubleshoot complex board\-level issues using lab equipment. * **Connectivity \& Protocols:** Implement and optimize wireless and wired communication stacks (e.g., Wi\-Fi, BLE, Cellular/LTE\-M, MQTT, TCP/IP, SPI, I2C, UART). * **Security \& Lifecycle Management:** Build and maintain secure bootloaders, Over\-The\-Air (OTA) firmware update mechanisms, and robust cryptographic routines (encryption, secure key storage, certificate management). * **Power Optimization:** Profile and minimize power consumption for battery\-operated IoT edge devices to maximize field life. * **Technical Leadership:** Serve as a mentor to junior and mid\-level engineers, drive rigorous code and design reviews, and establish architectural best practices across the engineering organization. **Qualifications \& Requirements** * **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * **Experience:** 5\+ years of professional experience in embedded systems and firmware development, specifically targeting connected/IoT devices. * **Programming Languages:** Expert\-level proficiency in Embedded C and C\+\+; familiarity with Python or scripting languages for test automation and tooling. * **OS \& Architecture:** Substantial hands\-on experience with Real\-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) like FreeRTOS or Zephyr, as well as bare\-metal development. * **Hardware \& Tooling:** Deep familiarity with common microcontroller architectures (e.g., ARM Cortex\-M, ESP32, nRF5x, STM32\) and proficient use of lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and debuggers (JTAG/SWD). * **IoT \& Cloud Integration:** Demonstrated experience connecting edge devices to cloud platforms (e.g., AWS IoT, Azure IoT) using lightweight messaging protocols like MQTT or HTTP. * **Soft Skills:** Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, technical writing abilities for design documentation, and a proactive approach to troubleshooting ambiguous problems. * **Copeland Experience:** Prior experience supporting Copeland products is strongly preferred. Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship \- sponsorship will not be provided for this role. * **Our Commitment to Our People** Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial. Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team! **Our Commitment to Inclusion \& Belonging** At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland. **Work Authorization** Copeland will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F\-1 with OPT or CPT, H\-1, H\-2, L\-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud\-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real\-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi\-site visibility. You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast\-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected. **About the role** ------------------ Coram is hiring an AI Native GTM Engineer to make our sales organization faster, sharper and more efficient through AI, automation and the tools we already own. You will sit on the Strategy \& Operations team and treat the go\-to\-market motion as a system to be engineered. The role sits where GTM systems architecture meets field execution: you are both a builder and the person who unblocks others. This is a builder role, not an admin role. You will ship agents, workflows and internal tools that reps and managers use every day, and you will measure whether they move pipeline, productivity and data quality. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build AI agents and workflows for sales.** Design and deploy agents and automations to make the sales organization more efficient and productive. * **Turn signals into action.** Connect signals from all our data sources so reps know whom to engage, why, when and how. * **Automate the manual work.** Map how AEs, managers, channel and CS teams spend their time, then remove repetitive steps with automations across HubSpot, Salesloft, Nooks, Clay, Slack and Zapier. * **Get more out of the existing stack.** Before buying anything new, push the tools we already pay for to their limits: integrations, APIs, webhooks, custom objects and native AI features. * **Build internal tools.** Extend our internal tools and GTM connectors to optimize all our GTM motions. * **Make AI workflows reliable.** Prototype quickly, put tools in front of users, then harden what works with validation, guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, monitoring and error handling. * **Unblock the field.** Unblock sellers who are stuck, then fix the root cause of the issue. * **Measure everything.** Define a baseline before each build, instrument it, and report on hours saved, adoption, meetings booked, pipeline created and data quality. * **Document and enable.** Write clear documentation, set up new hires on their tools, train the field on what you ship, and iterate weekly on feedback. * **Scout what's next.** Test new models, agent frameworks and AI\-native GTM tools, and recommend what Coram should adopt, replace or retire. **What you bring** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a closely related technical field. * 1 to 3 years of experience in software engineering, GTM engineering, revenue operations, growth engineering, solutions engineering or a similar technical role. * A systems thinker: you see how data, tools, processes and people connect, and you fix root causes instead of symptoms. * AI native: you use tools like Claude, Cursor or Codex daily as a builder, and you have personally built LLM\-powered workflows or agents, not just prompts in a chat window. * A track record of automations, integrations, internal tools or data workflows you built yourself, not only administered. * An understanding of, or strong curiosity about, B2B revenue workflows: lead management, routing, enrichment, qualification, account prioritization, prospecting and pipeline generation. * Strong analytical skills: you can define a metric, pull the data and tell whether your build worked. * A driver, not a passenger: you operate autonomously, ship a first version in days, then iterate based on usage. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience with HubSpot or Salesforce administration, including workflows, custom objects and APIs. * Exposure to sales engagement and dialer tools such as Salesloft, Outreach or Nooks. * Experience building with agent frameworks, MCP servers or retrieval over internal data. * Time spent at a high\-growth B2B startup, or working directly with a sales team. * Familiarity with channel or partner\-led sales models. * A portfolio of side projects, internal tools or automations you can walk us through. **Tools, location and logistics** --------------------------------- **Our stack:** HubSpot (CRM), Salesloft (sales engagement), Nooks (dialer), Clay (enrichment), Fireflies (call recording), Slack, Zapier, Claude and our internal sales app. **Location:** Onsite 5 days a week in Sunnyvale, CA. **Team:** Reports to the Senior Director of Strategy \& Operations, working alongside Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and Sales leadership. **Why join:** You get direct access to a fast\-growing sales team as your users, a leadership team that wants AI in every workflow, and the room to build the GTM system rather than maintain someone else's. **What we offer:** ------------------ * 100% Employer\-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance * Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays * 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options * Early\-stage equity in a rapidly growing company * Referral bonuses * Daily team breakfast and dinner, and regular team off\-sites * The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude Cowork, Perplexity Computer, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.) We're on a mission to transform a $50B\+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting\-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real\-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI\-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness. Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex\-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex\-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission\-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.
