jobs.title: Senior Director, Organizational Engineering
jobs.description: At Credit Acceptance, we are building on the foundation of a successful business while investing in the future through technology, data, AI, and continuous improvement. As we continue to evolve, our Team Members play an active role in improving experiences, driving meaningful change, and shaping the future of our business. We foster an environment where people are empowered to contribute ideas, develop their careers, make an impact, and help lead our continued transformation. Our Enterprise teams provide the expertise, insights, and partnership that help our business and people succeed. Team Members collaborate across the organization to solve challenges, support informed decision\-making, and enable the strategies and initiatives that move our business forward. We value curiosity, continuous learning, and diverse perspectives from people who are passionate about making a meaningful impact on our customers, Team Members, and business. What AI makes possible has changed dramatically in the past 18 months. How most organizations develop and lead people has changed far less. We are looking for a technical product leader to help close that gap. Organizational Engineering is a greenfield opportunity to reinvent how we develop and lead people, so that leaders, teams, and the enterprise work together as one healthy, high\-performing organization. The team will apply first principles to talent management practices: ask why each exists and what it is meant to achieve, then reimagine how to achieve it. There is no established playbook for this role. We are looking for an innovator who understands what has come before and uses every tool and resource available to find what works. Some answers will feel familiar. Others will make us ask why we never thought of them. The goal is an environment where the path to great leadership is easier. Leaders spend their time on what builds high\-performing, highly motivated teams, and every employee can do their best work. As the founding leader, reporting to the CHRO, you will build and lead a multidisciplinary team of six, carry a senior leadership mandate, and work directly with the executive leadership team, HR leadership, and leaders across the organization to imagine what is possible. **Outcomes and Activities** **Build the team and the operating model** * Recruit and develop a multidisciplinary team within an approved investment envelope, validating the capabilities and sequence of hires as the work informs needs. * Establish how the team works, including its delivery approach and standards for evidence, and own the budget, vendors, and technology partnerships. Create an environment where scientists, engineers, product leaders, and talent practitioners do their best work together. * **Define problems from first principles** * Begin with durable enterprise needs rather than inherited processes. Examine the underlying problems and constraints, and determine what practices, information, technology, and human judgment best achieves them. * Translate ambiguous organizational challenges into clear problem statements and hypotheses. Lead the inaugural challenge: design a talent feedback system that gives managers and employees the information they need, when they need it. Start with discovery across employee populations and recommend where experimentation will create the greatest learning and business value. * **Design, build, and deploy the talent cycle** * Serve as the architect of the talent cycle, in partnership with HR and business leaders: paint the product vision and roadmap for how we develop and lead people, spanning feedback loops such as reviews, succession planning and bench strength identification, and talent\-to\-strategy planning. * Deploy in minimally lovable increments and at speed: ship the smallest version leaders and employees would value, keep sprinting, and iterate as we learn. Build with AI\-enabled tools, data, and measurement systems within enterprise\-approved technology, standards, and governance, in partnership with Engineering, including enterprise architecture and AI platform teams, and measure what ships: deployment frequency, adoption by leaders and employees, and impact on decisions and outcomes against baselines set in advance. * **Test, learn, and improve** * Establish baselines, hypotheses, and success measures, including potential unintended effects, before each deployment. * Apply scientifically rigorous analysis and experimentation, using phased rollouts or comparison groups where practical, with safeguards appropriate to work that affects people. Report results against the measures defined at the start, adapt what works, and discontinue what does not, bringing evidence\-based findings, including those that challenge established practices, to senior leaders while accountability for people decisions stays with managers and their leaders. * **Competencies** **Thinks from First Principles:** Questions why existing standards, policies, and process duct, engineering, data or applied science, and economics, including hiring, developing, and setting direction. * Ownership of AI\-enabled products in production (such as LLM\-based or agentic systems, machine learning, or intelligent automation), with accountability for data governance and evaluation. * Experience designing and running experiments in production, using baselines, comparison groups or phased rollouts, and statistical or causal analysis. * Demonstrated ownership of a roadmap, budget, and vendor or technology partnerships, including build\-versus\-buy decisions. Evidence of influence without authority across organizational boundaries, including work that changed direction at the executive level, and the ability to communicate complex information clearly to C\-level leaders. * Preferred Qualifications * Advanced degree in a quantitative, behavioral, or organizational science (for example economics, industrial\-organizational psychology, data science, or human\-computer interaction). * Experience building a new team or capability from the ground up, including founding\-team or early\-stage experience. * Experience applying data science, behavioral science, or experimentation to how people and organizations perform, such as people analytics, talent management, organizational design, or consumer behavior. * Experience designing or delivering solutions involving sensitive or regulated data, with accountability for privacy, security, or data governance, or working closely with security, audit, and compliance functions. * Experience in financial services, consumer lending, credit operations, or other regulated, complex operating environments. Experience scaling new products, technologies, or organizational capabilities across large organizations. * **Targeted Compensation:** $288,800 \- $336,900 base salary \+ annual bonus plan **Benefits** Excellent benefits package that includes 401(K) match, adoption assistance, parental leave, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive medical/ dental/vision and many nonstandard benefits that make us a Great Place to Work * **Our Company Values:** To be successful in this role, Team Members need to be: * Positive by maintaining resiliency and focusing on solutions * Respectful by collaborating and actively listening * Insightful by cultivating innovation, accumulating business and role specific knowledge, demonstrating self\-awareness and making quality decisions * Direct by effectively communicating and conveying courage Earnest by taking accountability, applying feedback and effectively planning and priority setting * **Expectations:** * Remain compliant with our policies processes and legal guidelines * All other duties as assigned Attendance as required by department * **Advice** ! We understand that your career search may look different than others. Our hiring team wants to make sure that this would be a fit not just for us, but for you long term. If you are actively looking or starting to explore new opportunities, send us your application! **P.S** . We have great details around our stats, success, history and more. We’re proud of our culture and are happy to share why – let’s talk! Required degrees must have been earned at institutions of Higher Education which are accredited by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation or equivalent. Credit Acceptance is dedicated to providing an inclusive environment for all. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and value a culturally diverse workforce. We believe in ensuring all team members demonstrate mutual respect for one another. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected characteristics like age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. California Residents: Please click here for the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) notice regarding the personal information Credit Acceptance may collect from you.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Tools
jobs.description: Join the company that's building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world's biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what's next. We're one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we're remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd. **Why You'll Love This Role** You will help build Cribl Engineering's AI platform and productivity rails: the shared systems, runtimes, and workflows that let engineers use autonomous AI across the software delivery lifecycle. Instead of one\-off prompts or single\-feature AI experiments, you will focus on intent engineering, orchestration and harnesses, and production agent infrastructure that other teams can trust and extend. You will work with a small, high\-impact team alongside tech leads, principals, and partner engineering groups. You will ship systems that plan, implement, review, test, and operate work with strong guardrails, then drive adoption until those tools become part of how Cribl builds software. You will also bring a builder mentality: use the product yourself to solve real team and Engineering problems, then turn that lived experience into better systems. Cribl strives to be a great place to work for everyone. **As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…** * Design, build, and operate production agentic workflows and the platform harnesses they run on (orchestration, tool integrations, shared context, extension points for other teams) * Practice intent engineering: turn goals into clear specifications, rules, constraints, and acceptance criteria that AI systems can execute reliably * Stay current on AI tooling and practices, and evangelize what works across Engineering so partners adopt proven patterns * Engage hard in design discussions and healthy debate while the direction is open, then pivot with equal energy into implementation once the team decides * Build observability and guardrails: tracing, regression detection, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, safe rollout, and operability for agentic systems others depend on * Own critical pieces of agent runtime: job isolation, scheduling, execution environments, secrets and access, and production operations in the cloud * Design and operate event\-driven architectures where it fits (queues, streams, webhooks, async job fan\-out) so agentic systems stay scalable and loosely coupled * Ship safely and often: keep agentic systems on automated CI/CD paths with progressive delivery and clear rollback * Bring a builder mentality: dogfood what we ship. Use the platform to unblock yourself and the team, surface sharp edges, and turn real usage into product and platform improvements * Compress software delivery loops by improving how AI helps engineers write, test, review, debug, and validate changes in real repositories and pipelines * Partner across Engineering to understand workflows, ship tools that fit how people work, and drive adoption through playbooks, examples, demos, and enablement * Evaluate build vs. buy; stay current on models, agent frameworks, MCP\-style tool protocols, and the broader AI tooling ecosystem * Define and track success metrics for adoption, quality, reliability, and satisfaction; use feedback and data to decide where to invest * Partner on security and data access so tools are useful while respecting permissions and company policy * Take designed projects from zero to production: own the path from agreed design through implementation, rollout, and day\-two operability * This position may include stand\-by, on\-call, or off\-hours duties for systems you own **If You've Got It \- We Want It** * Staff\-level (or equivalent) professional software engineering experience building and operating production distributed systems * Strong TypeScript (and modern JavaScript) plus Node.js experience shipping production services; polyglot comfort is welcome, TypeScript is the primary stack for this team * Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to ship quickly: design, testing, debugging, APIs/services, and code quality * You have lived (or thrived in) a continuous deployment culture: automated pipelines, progressive delivery or safe rollout, monitoring and rollback, and a bias toward frequent, reversible production changes rather than infrequent manual releases * Hands\-on fluency with modern LLM and agentic coding workflows in production or serious internal platforms (not curiosity\-only) * Experience building backend services, integrations, automation, and internal tools; comfort across product surfaces when needed * Professional experience with agent orchestration, tool\-calling systems, evaluation or guardrail techniques, and connecting agents to reliable backend systems * Familiarity with agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and integrating external tools and data sources into LLM\-based systems (MCP or equivalent experience is a plus) * Experience with event\-driven systems: queues, streams, pub/sub, webhooks, or similar async patterns in production * Observability fluency: metrics, logs, traces, and using them to operate and improve production systems * Clear communication, documentation, and teaching ability; comfort driving adoption, not only writing code * Good judgment around security, permissions, data access, and safe tool rollout * Ability to problem\-solve from first principles, make sound trade\-offs, and drive work independently through ambiguity * **Nice to have** * + Hands\-on Kubernetes in production + Terraform or similar infrastructure\-as\-code for cloud provisioning + Temporal or other workflow\-platform experience + Deeper AWS / cloud\-native ops fluency (IAM, networking, running production workloads end to end) \#LI\-JB1 \#LI\-Remote **Bring Your Whole Self** Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We're building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you'll ever meet at cribl.io/about\-us.

jobs.description: **About Critical Loop** Critical Loop is shaping the next generation of energy systems by building the integrated edge grid of the future. Specializing in advanced energy management and battery control systems, Critical Loop empowers businesses and communities to seamlessly unite distributed energy resources for faster, more reliable, and affordable grid access. jobs.title: Sr. Data Scientist - Applied Machine Learning and Optimization
jobs.description: Serve as an experienced individual contributor responsible for framing business problems as analytical, statistical, predictive, and optimization solutions; developing and validating models; and partnering with engineering teams to move approved models into governed production use. Use Python, SQL, Snowflake, Azure, and appropriate modeling methods to create explainable, reproducible, and measurable solutions while applying responsible AI, data governance, privacy, security, and MLOps standards throughout the model lifecycle. **Job Duties and Responsibilities:** ==================================== * Partner with business owners, analysts, and subject\-matter experts to translate operational problems into testable hypotheses, objective functions, constraints, target variables, evaluation criteria, and measurable business outcomes. * Explore and profile enterprise data; identify data limitations, bias, leakage, missingness, quality concerns, and suitability for statistical, predictive, optimization, or AI/ML methods. * Design and develop statistical analyses, forecasting models, predictive models, machine\-learning solutions, and mathematical optimization approaches appropriate to the business problem. * Perform feature engineering in partnership with data engineers and analytics engineers, using governed and reproducible data inputs rather than unmanaged one\-off datasets. * Build baselines, select methods, conduct experiments, tune models, and evaluate results using appropriate holdout, cross\-validation, back\-testing, scenario, sensitivity, and error\-analysis techniques. * Document model assumptions, intended use, limitations, training data, features, evaluation results, fairness or risk considerations, explainability, thresholds, and human\-oversight requirements. * Validate model outputs with business SMEs, compare recommendations with historical and scenario\-based outcomes, and incorporate approved feedback without obscuring model limitations. * Collaborate with data engineering and MLOps resources to package, register, deploy, monitor, retrain, version, and retire models through controlled environments and release processes. * Define and monitor model\-performance, drift, data\-quality, business\-outcome, and operational metrics; investigate degradation and recommend corrective action. * Create clear visualizations, analytical narratives, model cards, experiment records, and decision\-support materials for technical and nontechnical audiences. * Apply enterprise AI governance, responsible AI, privacy, security, architecture, SDLC, and regulatory requirements; surface residual risks and obtain required approvals before production use. * Advance reusable modeling practices, peer review, testing standards, and knowledge sharing across the team; provide technical guidance on complex analytical work. * The requirements herein describe the general nature and level of work performed by the employee but are not a complete list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Other duties may be assigned as needed. Requirements: **Minimum Requirements:** ========================= **Education and Experience** ============================ * Undergraduate degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field; graduate degree preferred for roles with advanced optimization or research responsibilities. * 6\+ years of experience in data science, applied statistics, operations research, machine learning, optimization, or a related quantitative discipline. * Advanced proficiency with Python and SQL and experience using common data\-science, statistics, machine\-learning, and optimization libraries. * Experience developing models using Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms and working with Azure\-based data, application, or ML services. * Experience with problem formulation, feature engineering, experiment design, model selection, model evaluation, explainability, and communication of uncertainty and limitations. * Experience moving models beyond notebooks into versioned, testable, monitored, and supportable production workflows in partnership with engineering teams. * Experience with forecasting, predictive modeling, mathematical optimization, or decision science; operations research and constraint\-based optimization experience strongly preferred when supporting planning and scheduling use cases. * Knowledge of responsible AI, model risk, data privacy, security, governance, and documentation practices. * Relevant Azure, Snowflake, data science, ML, or analytics certification preferred. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** ----------------------------------- * Deep knowledge of statistical reasoning, machine learning, model evaluation, experimentation, and the appropriate use and limitations of quantitative methods. * Able to frame ambiguous business problems, distinguish predictive questions from optimization or rules\-based problems, and select methods based on evidence rather than novelty. * Able to evaluate model performance using technically sound and business\-relevant measures and clearly explain tradeoffs, uncertainty, limitations, and residual risk. * Strong Python, SQL, data exploration, feature engineering, visualization, and reproducible research skills. * Strong understanding of data leakage, bias, drift, explainability, human oversight, privacy, security, responsible AI, and model governance. * Able to collaborate with data engineers, analytics engineers, MLOps engineers, application teams, analysts, product owners, and business SMEs across the full model lifecycle. * Able to independently lead complex analytical work, review the work of peers, maintain rigorous documentation, and influence decisions through evidence and clear communication. * Able to balance model accuracy with interpretability, operational constraints, reliability, cost, maintainability, and business adoption. * Must be able to read, write, and speak English. Compensation: $135000\-$145000/Annually

jobs.title: IntelligentOps - Lead Architect_Products & Platforms
jobs.description: **The Team** **Innovation \& Delivery Transformation (I\&DT) Team** The I\&DT team exists to build what Deloitte's next decade demands. We don't optimize the past. We place deliberate bets on the technologies and markets that will define the future of industry, and we build the platforms, products, and commercial engines to win there. IntelligentOps is one of those bets: a decision intelligence product purpose\-built for the complexity of large\-scale operations, and a cornerstone of how Deloitte delivers durable, scaled value to operations\-intensive clients. The core focus of this role is IntelligentOps, Deloitte's decision intelligence and execution product for supply chain and manufacturing operations. IntelligentOps connects data, existing enterprise systems (ERP, MES, PLM, OT), and AI agents on a unified common core, enabling operations leaders to move faster, act with greater precision, and scale operational outcomes without adding systems or complexity. Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026\. **Work you'll do** The Lead Architect owns the technical vision for IntelligentOps solutions and is accountable for architectures that scale across clients, solutions, and industries. IntelligentOps solutions are made up of modules, which call on engines, the pre\-built agentic actions that do the underlying work. All of it connects to client systems and builds on shared foundations. You will guide how these pieces fit together and how they are built, reused, and delivered to clients, with a focus on moving forward the solutions we sell and deliver. **Technical Direction** * Set the technical direction and multi\-year architecture roadmap for IntelligentOps solutions, modules, and engines, and for how they build on shared foundations. * Translate product and client requirements into a scalable technical architecture that holds up across multiple solutions, modules, and client environments. * Make and document key architecture decisions, including technology selection, build versus buy, and integration approach, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to leadership. **Patterns, Standards, and Guardrails** * Define reusable architectural patterns, reference architectures, and engineering guardrails that help teams build new modules and engines faster and more consistently. * Set standards for scalability, performance, security and access control, data modeling, reliability, operability, and observability, including how IntelligentOps integrates with client ERP, MES, PLM, QMS, and OT/IoT systems and with AI agents. * Work with Product, Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), and leadership to make sure implementations adhere to the architecture, and resolve exceptions and gaps. * Design engines as reusable, standardized capabilities that modules can call on, so a capability is built once and reused across modules, solutions, and clients. * Define the architecture for AI agent orchestration and agent\-to\-agent interoperability, including model validation, governance, and human oversight controls. * Set the approach for automated deployment and release of solutions, modules, and engines into client environments across cloud providers. * Build resiliency, high availability, and scalability patterns, such as failover and graceful degradation, into reference architectures so reliability is designed in rather than added after incidents. **Innovation and Proofs of Concept** * Identify, scope, execute, and document proofs of concept that test new technologies and approaches, building reference implementations hands\-on. * Decide which proofs of concept graduate into the product, and partner with Engineering to turn them into production\-ready patterns. **Team Leadership** * Lead, coach, and develop a team of architects and engineers, raising the bar on technical quality and on how efficiently the team builds and ships. * Capture implementation lessons from FDEs and client engagements and feed them back into the architecture and the product roadmap. The successful candidate possesses these skills: * Ability to set technical direction and bring engineers, product leaders, and executives along with it, including when you do not have formal authority. * Pragmatic judgment with a bias toward simple designs that scale. * Clear communication that explains complex technical tradeoffs to both engineering and executive audiences. * Ability to build credibility with engineers by building and coding, not only by designing. **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience defined as an additional 4\+ years of relevant work experience in lieu of a degree. * 10\+ years of experience designing and building enterprise software at scale and serving as an architect or technical lead long enough to have lived with the consequences of your own decisions. * 3\+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing other architects and engineers, and raising the bar for the whole team. * 5\+ years of experience architecting cloud\-native systems on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including containerized deployment (Kubernetes), infrastructure as code, and CI/CD automation. * 2\+ years of experience using or evaluating agentic systems in production, including harness design, tool\-use interfaces, sandboxed execution, and evaluation approaches that test against real execution. * 2\+ years of experience using agentic coding tools daily on real production work; having a considered view of where they help, where they fail, and how to verify what they produce. * Hands\-on proficiency writing code, building proofs of concept or reference implementations, and earning credibility with engineer by showing the work. * Demonstrated experience defining when to standardize and when to leave room for speed, and being able to explain that tradeoff to both engineers and executives. * Experience establishing set patterns or standards that multiple teams adopt without being forced to, including security, access control, and integration with enterprise systems. * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. Preferred: * Experience with agent interoperability standards, such as Agent2Agent (A2A), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and with event\-driven architecture patterns. * Experience designing ontologies, knowledge graphs, or semantic data models for enterprise or operational data. * Experience integrating with ERP (SAP, Oracle), MES, PLM, or OT/IoT systems in manufacturing or supply chain environments. * Cloud architect certification, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $141,200\-$278,300\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Product Engineering Delivery Manager, Applied AI
jobs.description: Product Engineering Organization **Overview** As a Delivery Manager, you hold program\-level execution accountable on a day\-to\-day basis within Deloitte's Product Engineering organization, one or more product teams operating against a shared set of intents. Delivery in this organization operates inside an intent\-driven development model with three concurrent layers \- governance, execution, and learning \- that run simultaneously. Execution advances in evidence\-gated dashes, not sprints. The activities that used to define this role \- status compilation, schedule maintenance, risk\-log upkeep, and ceremony documentation \- are increasingly AI\-assisted. What remains, and grows, is the judgment work: cross\-team coordination on initiatives larger than a single product team can self\-coordinate, stakeholder alignment, dependency management, and the operational discipline that keeps evidence\-gated delivery. **Work you'll do:** * Program\-level coordination for one significant initiative or a set of related programs. Ensure dashes start when slices are ready and end when deployed evidence confirms the intended behavior shifted. * Day\-to\-day stakeholder orchestration with internal Deloitte stakeholders at the program level, including reconciliation of AI\-drafted artifacts when stakeholders arrive with their own briefs. * Drive cost\-efficient adoption of LLM, agentic AI, and cloud platforms through effective governance, FinOps practices, and consumption optimization. * Operational integrity of the evidence\-gated cycle in your scope: proof signals being read, harm watches honored and exit gates respected before slices expand. **Core Responsibilities** * **Outcome\-Driven Leadership:** Deliver the right customer and business outcomes by engaging product teams on structure, skills, leverage models, and measurement. Scope dashes against ready slices and observable evidence, so work advances when deployed evidence confirms the behavior shifted \- not at a sprint boundary. * **Delivery Leadership and Advocacy:** Champion fit\-for\-context delivery methodologies and work with Product Managers to drive priorities and execution. Form skilled teams, remove roadblocks, and set cadence to the rhythm the program needs. Surface coordination friction before it becomes a blocker, escalating to the Delivery Leader when it exceeds your authority. * **Craft Mastery:** Foster delivery excellence through quality processes, program value delivery, and team growth \- coaching junior professionals via pairing, observation, and feedback. Experiment with new tools like GenAI and support the AI Workflow Orchestrator on your program, knowing which workflows are AI\-driven and how exceptions route. Spread knowledge through community sessions. * **Communication:** Inspire and influence stakeholders, serving as the contact for value achievement across product engineering teams. Communicate status accurately on the cadence the program needs. Hold the room when stakeholders disagree: surface trade\-offs, recommend a path, drive to decision. Facilitate co\-creation workshops. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work as a connected member of the program alongside the triad ensemble (Product, Engineering and Experience) and cross functional groups. Maintain a live picture of dependencies across the product teams and platform services you touch. Manage conflict, foster collaboration, and enable cross\-skilling. * **Discovery \& Delivery Proficiency:** Apply deep SDLC expertise with continuous planning and refinement. Watch for drift between intent and execution and raise it early. Hold evidence\-gate discipline \- proof signals read, harm watches honored, exits and expansions respected. Identify risks, adapt scope, and embed continuous improvement. * **Customer\-Centric Delivery:** Drive lean solutions through rapid experimentation, engaging customers before, during, and after delivery to land the right solution effectively. * **Operational Excellence:** Build inclusive, engaged teams; remove obstacles and coach; improve satisfaction and reduce attrition. Govern the intake of AI\-drafted artifacts so they become productive inputs, not noise. Report on financials, innovation, and engagement, and drive efficiency and productivity. * **Engagement and Collaborative Co\-Creation:** Engage stakeholders at all levels and foster a culture of co\-creation. Hold the relationship with program sponsors and affected stakeholders, informing them in proportion to their stake, and reconcile conflicting AI\-generated artifacts on the same initiative. Align diverse perspectives to deliver quality solutions. * **Domain Expertise:** Rapidly acquire domain\-specific knowledge and navigate enterprise functions to drive product value and organizational alignment. **The Team** US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost\-effective model that focuses on value and outcomes. It leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure across a four\-capability matrix: Product, Experience, Engineering, and Delivery. As Deloitte's primary product development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom\-line results. jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Merkle is dentsu’s global leadership brand for business and technology consulting, differentiated by an approach to enterprise transformation that’s data\-driven, experience\-led, and outcomes\-obsessed.** **With a heritage in data and marketing performance, Merkle has evolved into a transformation consultancy recognized for excellence in CRM, loyalty, digital commerce, technology, engineering, experience design, business advisory, market research, and analytics.** Merkle is seeking an AI Innovation Manager to help us scale how we use AI across our delivery work. Our delivery teams have already built a strong base of AI pilots and tools, and the next step is scaling that work so more of what we deliver gets done efficiently with AI. This individual will run AI pilots day to day, measure results, report progress to leadership, and scale knowledge sharing so what works on one account reaches the next. You will be part of the DDM AI Hub, a small central team that points all AI work at four goals: margin, revenue generation, scaling pilots and quality controls. Results go to an AI Steering Committee of DDM senior leadership every month, so this role has direct visibility with the people setting priorities and funding. We are looking for someone who is genuinely excited by AI tooling and builds with it, not just talks about it. You understand how tools like Claude fit into real business processes, and you can lead busy delivery teams toward a common goal without managing them directly. AI tools and best practices change month to month, so we want someone adaptable who learns quickly and shifts their approach as the technology evolves. There are no direct reports for this role. You will direct teams during sprints and partner with practice leads and account leadership, carrying full ownership of the program's cadence, measurement and reporting. **Key** **Responsibilities** The responsibilities below cover how we run, measure, report on and scale AI across our delivery work. * **Run AI pilots day to day.** Work with delivery teams to find and prioritize AI opportunities, map current\-state workflows, and lead each pilot through build, measurement, and a scale, hold or stop recommendation. * **Measure results.** Set baselines before each pilot for hours saved, cycle jobs.title: Sr. Lead Data Scientist
jobs.description: At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting\-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses. Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment. Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship. The Sr. Lead Data Scientist is a senior individual contributor and technical leader within the data science organization, responsible for designing, developing, and delivering advanced machine learning and statistical solutions in a complex, high\-volume, high\-throughput data environment. This role plays a critical leadership function by owning end\-to\-end modeling initiatives, guiding analytical direction for major business problems, and mentoring data scientists across multiple projects. This position is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence modeling standards and best practices, and partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to translate strategic objectives into scalable, production\-ready analytics solutions. ### **Essential Functions** **Advanced Modeling \& Technical Leadership** * Leads the design, experimentation, and implementation of advanced machine learning, statistical, and optimization models to solve complex, high\-impact business problems. * Serves as the technical owner for large\-scale, business\-critical models, including model selection, feature engineering, training strategy, validation, and performance monitoring. * Drives development of complex consumer or entity profiles used for both offline model training and real\-time scoring. * Assesses and ensures long\-term performance, stability, scalability, and interpretability of analytically derived models in production environments. * Establishes modeling standards, evaluation frameworks, and best practices adopted across the data science team. **Project \& Cross\-Functional Leadership** * Takes a lead role in the development and delivery of product\-prototype and production models, coordinating across multiple data science and engineering contributors. * Partners with software engineers and MLOps teams to define statistical components, data requirements, unit testing, acceptance testing, and deployment strategies. * Translates ambiguous, high\-level business goals into clearly defined analytical problems, roadmaps, and measurable success criteria. * Identifies and recommends new modeling, analytics, and data opportunities aligned with business strategy. **Mentorship \& Knowledge Sharing** * Acts as a senior mentor and subject matter expert, coaching junior and mid\-level data scientists on modeling techniques, analytical thinking, and technical execution. * Reviews analytical work, model designs, and code for quality, rigor, and alignment with best practices. * Shares knowledge of emerging technologies, tools, and methodologies through documentation, presentations, and informal leadership. **Communication \& Documentation** * Clearly documents model design, assumptions, workflows, and performance results for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Presents analytical findings, model outcomes, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership with clarity and confidence. **Data Stewardship \& Compliance** * Supports the company’s commitment to protecting the integrity, confidentiality, and appropriate use of systems and data. * Ensures models and analytical solutions adhere to governance, regulatory, and ethical standards. ### **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field. * Typically 10\+ years of professional experience in predictive modeling, machine learning, statistical analysis, or equivalent advanced education and experience. * Extensive hands\-on experience working with large, complex datasets in high\-volume environments. * Advanced proficiency in data science and machine learning tools and technologies such as Python, R, SQL, Spark, Hadoop, Hive, Java, or equivalent. * Deep experience with a broad range of machine learning methods, including classification, regression, tree\-based models, SVMs, ensemble methods, and optimization techniques. * Proven ability to translate business requirements into robust analytical designs and production\-ready models. * Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating data scientists on complex projects. * Successful completion of background and drug screening. ### **Preferred Qualifications** g and maintaining data science pipelines and workflows in Python, R, or similar languages. * Experience working with financial or regulated data environments. * Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments while balancing multiple priorities. * Track record of discovering non\-obvious insights and patterns in complex datasets. ### **Physical Requirements** Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling, and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. jobs.title: Process Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Join EarthOptics as a Process Quality Engineer!** At EarthOptics, we are combining cutting\-edge genomic analysis, data science, microbiology, and remote sensing to revolutionize agriculture. We are creating a future where traditional sampling methods are obsolete. Our mission is to be the leading soil information company, delivering maps that growers, farmers, ranchers, and other stakeholders use to cost\-effectively increase yields, improve soil health and the climate and feed the growing world through all things soil. We are a growing company with a passion for soil health, innovative technologies, and supporting all within the food value chain. We currently have \~100 individuals spread across 20 states and 2 countries, and they come from all walks of life, industries, and experiences. We are deeply focused on building the future of AgTech and sustainability and helping the world see soil differently. Our Process Quality Engineer will join our Data Science \& Data Engineering team as an individual contributor reporting to the Chief Technology Officer. You will own quality controls across the journey from field sample collection and laboratory processing through data pipelines and customer delivery. You will investigate problems, build reliable checks, and work across disciplines to make quality part of everyday operations. **The digs:** * **Job Type:** Full\-time, salaried, exempt (not eligible for overtime) * **Work Location:** This is a remote position open to candidates who are authorized to work in the US and reside in the contiguous 48 states. * **Travel:** Up to 25% of the time, including visits to our Emeryville and Raleigh laboratories and field operations. * **Compensation:** $100,000\-$125,000 annual base salary, plus eligibility for our bonus program and an equity option grant (see below). * *This range covers all US locations where this remote role can be performed. The low end reflects our geographic pay adjustment for lower\-cost labor markets (75% of the market rate), and the high end reflects our highest\-cost markets, such as the San Francisco Bay Area and New York City (100% of the market rate). Your offer will reflect the pay zone for your location and your job\-related skills and experience, assessed consistently for every candidate. We do not ask about current or past pay.* **What you’ll cultivate as a Process Quality Engineer:** * **Own quality controls across the sample lifecycle.** Identify gaps in field soil sampling, hardware, sample shipping and intake, laboratory processing, data pipelines, and customer delivery. Maintain an inventory of QC checks and their coverage across products and workflows. While this is not a software role, the candidate is expected to be code\-competent. * **Build quality controls that work consistently.** Translate gaps into clear requirements and tickets for the software engineering team, such as automated ingest gates, acceptance thresholds, chain\-of\-custody and completeness checks, and delivery holds when checks fail. Use AI tools, along with working knowledge of Python and SQL, to analyze data, prototype checks, and document them so they’re reproducible, logged, and auditable. * **Investigate failures and prevent recurrence.** Trace field and laboratory QC flags and customer\-reported issues to their causes, then implement process changes, SOP updates, or tooling. Review gate performance monthly, documenting false positives, missed issues, and problems that reached customers. * **Partner across disciplines.** Work directly with field crews, laboratory operations, software engineering, and data science. Contribute to sampling protocols, SOPs, and field tool and hardware selection; translate observations into concrete requirements; and track the quality initiatives you own through completion. * **Support traceability and accreditation readiness.** Contribute to the data\-integrity workstream supporting the ISO 17025 accreditation effort, led by laboratory and Technology leadership, including audit trails, chain of custody, and traceability. Report quality metrics to the CTO. **Within your first 90 days, you can expect to:** * Visit at least one laboratory and one field sampling operation, document the highest quality risks by customer impact, and take ownership of the existing QC inventory, including automatic, manual, and missing checks. * Ship or strengthen at least two automated pipeline QC gates with logging and a delivery hold on failure. * Lead the first monthly QC gate review and manage the quality issue queue using the AI program manager. * Identify the data\-integrity gaps most relevant to ISO 17025 and share them with laboratory leadership. **Are you our soil\-mate? You’ll bloom in this role if you have experience in:** * A quantitative or applied science discipline through a bachelor’s or master’s degree \- or equivalent experience \- in engineering, soil or environmental science, chemistry, statistics, data science, or a related fie  role requires willingness to travel up to 25% of the time and participate directly in field and laboratory observations. **We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor or transfer visas at this time.** **Although not required, we’d love to see roots in:** * Agricultural, soil, or environmental testing. * ISO 17025 or similar accreditation efforts. * Cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery and pipeline orchestration. * AI\-assisted program management or issue\-tracking systems. * Running cross\-functional programs without direct reports. * A fast\-paced, start\-up environment. **Aside from “the green”, we can offer you:** * Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance \- 90% funded by EarthOptics for benefit\-eligible employees and 55% for dependents * Company\-paid LTD, STD, and Life Insurance * Meaningful equity option grants * 401k Plan \+ Employer Match up to 4% * 17 days of paid time off, plus 11 additional company holidays * Dependent Care FSA * Paid Parental Leave * Professional Development Stipend * Employee Referral Bonus Program * Above and Beyond Bonus Program * Flexible Schedule * Regular opportunities to give feedback on our benefits offerings **How we stay grounded:** Although we have teammates working in the field, in\-office, and at home, we aim to create a cohesive, diverse, and enriching environment for all of our employees. We embrace different tools to enhance our workflows and communicate intentionally, both live and asynchronously. A few quick facts you should know: * We rely on Slack to communicate. Although there are a variety of team\-specific systems to facilitate your work, this is our primary! * We love both food and emojis at EarthOptics. If hired, you’ll come to love (and use many) taco and donut emojis. * Our core business hours are Monday through Friday, 11am–4pm ET. We have teammates in every time zone, and some teams operate outside of that timeframe. As a remote employee, you are asked to honor those hours to ensure enough time to overlap with key cross\-functional teams. * In order to maximize our remote culture, we host company\-wide opportunities to connect (virtually and in\-person) and create space for focus work. For example, we have a weekly all\-hands stand\-up meeting on Monday and reserve Fridays as a regular “No Meeting” day. * Instead of values, we believe in actionable “cultural concepts”. Collectively, we hold one another to act and give feedback with these concepts in mind. Ours are *autonomy, accountability, collaboration, customer centricity, grit and grace*. **Equal Opportunity and Inclusion at EarthOptics:** EarthOptics is an equal opportunity employer, and we stand against any form of discrimination or harassment. We base all hiring and promotion decisions on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, marital or family status,physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We are deeply committed to welcoming and including every qualified individual. As part of this commitment, we provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, for pregnancy, childbirth, and related conditions, and for sincerely held religious beliefs. If you require assistance during the job application or interview process, need support to perform essential job functions, or seek other benefits and privileges of employment, please reach out to us at accommodations@earthoptics.com. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local fair chance laws.

jobs.description: **Data Architect / Integration Engineer** ========================================= **Program:** VA Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) SISS **Location:** Remote **About Emerging Tech** ----------------------- Emerging Tech LLC is a Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), 8(a), and HUBZone\-certified federal contractor delivering innovative technology solutions to government agencies. We specialize in Healthcare IT, cybersecurity, systems engineering, and digital modernization, supporting critical federal programs and helping our clients solve complex technical challenges. At Emerging Tech, we value our people and are committed to creating opportunities for professional growth, collaboration, and career development. **Position Overview** --------------------- Emerging Tech is seeking a Data Architect / Integration Engineer to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM) SISS program. This individual will provide technical leadership and hands\-on integration architecture expertise across a complex healthcare IT environment. The role requires the ability to establish integration strategy and architecture while working closely with architects, engineers, clinical teams, functional specialists, and other technical stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with healthcare interoperability standards, interface architecture, data exchange, multi\-vendor integration, and enterprise healthcare systems. This person must be adaptable, comfortable learning complex environments, and able to support evolving priorities based on government direction. **Important:** This position does not require hands\-on database administration or the creation of logical or physical data models. The primary focus is healthcare data integration, interoperability, and integration architecture. **Priority consideration will be given to candidates with existing VA access.** **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Provide strategic direction and hands\-on technical leadership for healthcare data integration and interoperability. * Develop integration architecture strategies, blueprints, interface control documents (ICDs), data flow diagrams, and technical recommendations. * Define and support integration patterns across enterprise systems, interfaces, vendors, and clinical applications. * Support API management, interface engines, push/pull architectures, and data exchange workflows. * Collaborate with clinical, functional, and technical teams to support integration across pharmacy, laboratory, imaging/radiology, scheduling, and other ancillary systems. * Establish multi\-vendor integration governance, including service\-level expectations, data contracts, payload completeness, system availability, and delivery performance. * Evaluate authoritative data sources, data migration approaches, integration dependencies, and technical challenges. * Develop integration assessments, mappings, engineering courses of action, and current\- and future\-state architecture recommendations. * Support enterprise analytics, dashboards, and reporting that provide visibility into system interfaces, data exchange pathways, message types, and routing patterns. * Develop metrics related to interface volumes, clinical and operational data dependencies, integration performance, and capacity planning. * Translate market activation plans into executable interface and data migration runbooks. * Support cutover readiness activities, including mock conversions, dress rehearsals, and deployment preparation. * Troubleshoot integration defects and coordinate root cause analysis and remediation across EHR vendors, middleware, and downstream systems. * Support the program's Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) migration by developing integration architecture patterns and supporting the transition of workloads, interfaces, and clinical data flows from on\-premises or legacy middleware environments to OCI\-based services. **Required Qualifications \& Experience** ----------------------------------------- **Healthcare Interoperability \& Interface Design** * Experience with healthcare interoperability and semantic standards, including HL7, CCD, FHIR, and DICOM. * Knowledge of medical ontologies and clinical vocabularies such as ICD\-10, LOINC, and SNOMED\-CT. * Understanding of healthcare data exchange, clinical messaging, and interface design. **Integration Architecture \& Data Movement** * Experience with API management and interface engines. * Knowledge of push/pull architecture and enterprise data exchange patterns. * Understanding of clinical information exchange, including patient demographics, orders, results, and other clinical data sets. * Experience integrating healthcare applications, ancillary systems, and third\-party vendor platforms. **Clinical Systems \& Healthcare Applications** * Experience supporting integrations across clinical domains and ancillary systems, including: + Pharmacy + Laboratory + Imaging and radiology + Scheduling + Other clinical and operational applications * Understanding of interface patterns required for commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) EHR deployments across multiple markets. **Multi\-Vendor Integration \& Governance** * Experience supporting integration governance across multiple vendors and platforms. * Understanding of service\-level agreements (SLAs), data contracts, payload completeness, uptime, and data delivery performance. * Ability to establish and evaluate interoperability standards for vendor solutions, system connectivity, medical devices, and mobile applications. **Healthcare Security, Compliance \& Privacy** * Knowledge of HIPAA, PII, and PHI requirements. * Understanding of data encryption in transit and at rest. * Familiarity with identity and access management standards, including SMART on FHIR and OAuth 2\.0\. **Enterprise Architecture** * Ability to understand complex enterprise architecture environments, system boundaries, foundational components, and end\-to\-end data flows. * Knowledge of authoritative data sources, data migration approaches, timelines, and implementation challenges. * Experience developing architecture assessments, data mappings, integration blueprints, hybrid designs, and engineering recommendations. **Analytics \& Reporting** * Experience supporting enterprise analytics and dashboards that provide visibility into system integrations, interfaces, data types, and vendor\-specific implementations. * Ability to develop reporting and metrics related to interface volumes, clinical data dependencies, integration pathways, and capacity planning. **Delivery \& Site Activation** * Experience translating deployment and market activation plans into executable integration and data migration runbooks. * Familiarity with cutover readiness, mock conversions, and dress rehearsals. * Ability to troubleshoot integration defects and coordinate root cause analysis and remediation. **Cloud \& Migration Support** * Experience supporting on\-premises and cloud migration initiatives. * Understanding of integration architecture and data flow transitions to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or comparable cloud environments. * Ability to support continuity of routing, data quality, performance, and compliance during migration. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Existing VA access. * Experience supporting VA EHRM or other large\-scale federal healthcare IT modernization programs. * Experience with Oracle Health/Cerner environments. * Experience supporting multi\-site or enterprise\-wide EHR deployments. * Experience working within complex, multi\-vendor healthcare integration environments. * Experience supporting OCI migration initiatives. **Why Join Emerging Tech?** --------------------------- * Competitive compensation * Benefits effective Day 1 * 401(k) retirement plan * Federal holidays and PTO * Opportunities for professional growth and career development * Collaborative team environment supporting meaningful federal platform and its anti\-spam, anti\-phishing, email encryption, and threat response policies to protect the organization's email infrastructure * Enforce network security standards, perform regular audits, and respond to security incidents in coordination with the IT security team * Support the BitSight security ratings platform to track and improve the organization's external security posture SYSTEMS AND PLATFORM ADMINISTRATION: * Administer and support identity and access management through OKTA, with responsibility for SSO integrations, MFA enforcement, and user lifecycle management * virtualization environments, with responsibility for vSphere infrastructure, virtual networking, and server resource management * Oversee the AvePoint platform for Microsoft 365 data governance, backup, and compliance management * Manage physical server infrastructure, rack equipment installation, and data center operations, with attention to cabling, power, and cooling requirements CCNA certifications are a plus ### **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds at times ### **WHAT YOU CAN jobs.title: EverHealth - AI Automation Analyst (Remote, US)
jobs.description: **Job Description** **EverHealth AI Analyst** EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically\-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service\-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end\-to\-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. **Responsibilities** **Build AI Products \& Automation** * Build automations and AI agents from early prototype to something a team runs every day. * Apply AI models where they improve speed, accuracy, or quality, and test their output against real data until quality is consistent. * Write, test, and version the prompts that production workflows depend on. * Flag where a model is unreliable for a task and recommend a different approach instead of forcing it. **Connect Systems** * Connect the systems a team depends on so data and actions move automatically instead of by hand. * Build connections that hold up in production: authentication, error handling, and edge cases, not just the happy path. * Partner with our platform engineer on anything that should become part of shared infrastructure rather than a one off connection. **Maintain Agents \& Products** * Own what you build once it is live. Monitor runs, catch problems early, and fix them quickly when an upstream system or a data change breaks something. * Keep credentials, connections, and access organized and secure, following team governance practices. * Track how automations and agents perform, and look for ways to make them more reliable or extend them. **Discover \& Analyze Processes** * Sit with teams to map how a process works today, step by step, and identify the manual, repetitive, or error prone parts. * Recommend which processes are good automation candidates and which need to be fixed first, since automating a broken process only makes it break faster. * Gather the inputs, systems, and rules an automation needs before the build starts. **Partner, Document \& Hand Off** * Work with function leaders and their teams to gather requirements and confirm that what you built does what they actually need. * Partner with the platform engineer and forward deployed engineers on larger builds, owning the pieces suited to your level. * Document every automation: what it does, what it touches, who owns it, and how to troubleshoot it. Hand it off with clear instructions so the owning team can run it day to day. * Help shape how this team works as it grows, from build standards to how we engage a function, since you are one of the first people on it. **Skills and Experience Needed for Success in This Role** * 2\+ years in automation, operations, revenue operations, analytics, IT, or a related role where you built or maintained workflows or tooling. * Hands on experience with a no code or low code automation tool such as Zapier, n8n, or Power Automate. * Comfort working with APIs and JSON and reading or lightly editing code. Candidates elsewhere in the U.S. will work remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America. **Benefits and Perks:** * Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in\-office, remote, or hybrid * Continued investment in your professional development * Day 1 access to robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend * 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting * Flexible and generous (FTO) time\-off * Employee Stock Purchase Program **Compensation:** The target base compensation for this position is $65,000 to $80,000 USD per year in most US locations. EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators. **Position Summary** The Senior Director, AI Deployment is a hands\-on delivery leader accountable for putting AI into production and generating measurable business results. This leader will build and run the AI Deployment Team: 3 to 5 forward\-deployed AI practitioners who embed with business units, uncover real workflow problems, build and deploy solutions, and leave each team more capable and self\-sufficient. Think forward\-deployed engineers, built internally. The core job is to re\-engineer how work gets done and deploy AI and autonomous agents into production workflows. Success is measured by workflows redesigned, agents and applications running in production, and business impact validated with Finance and business owners, not by roadmaps, training hours, or pilots. The Senior Director sets deployment priorities enterprise\-wide, partners with IT, engineering, data, cybersecurity, legal, and enterprise architecture to deploy safely and at pace, and advises executives on where AI will and won't create value. Governance, platforms, and adoption programs matter, and this leader makes them serve deployment rather than replace it. **Key Responsibilities** 1\. Build and Lead the AI Deployment Team * Recruit and lead 3 to 5 forward\-deployed AI practitioners: builders with real engineering depth, business fluency, and credibility with operators and executives. * Set the standard for craft: technical practices, code and design review, evaluation discipline, and delivery cadence. * Define the engagement model: how business units are selected, how embeds are scoped and run, what success looks like, and how work is handed off. * Stay hands\-on: scope problems, shape architecture, review work, and build alongside the team when it matters. * Allocate the team to the highest\-value opportunities, make explicit tradeoffs, and decline work that won't move a business outcome. * Develop team members into the next generation of technical and business leaders. 2\. Embed, Re\-engineer Workflows, and Deploy to Production * Embed with business units to see how work is actually done and identify where AI can change cost, speed, quality, or revenue. * Redesign workflows end to end rather than layering AI onto broken processes, deciding what to automate, augment, or eliminate. * Build and deploy LLM\-based applications, autonomous agents, and workflow automation into production, integrated with systems of record, enterprise data, and APIs. * Favor working software over decks and pilots, moving quickly from problem to prototype to production. * Operate what ships: own monitoring, evaluation, cost, incident response, and iteration until ownership transfers to the business. * Turn each engagement into reusable patterns, components, and playbooks so every deployment is faster than the last. 3\. Deliver and Prove Measurable Business Impact * Agree on baselines and success metrics with the business owner before building anything. * Measure realized outcomes (cycle time, cost to serve, throughput, error rates, revenue impact), validate them with Finance, and distinguish measured results from estimated productivity gains. * Red artnership and Prioritization * Prioritize deployments with executive leadership by value, feasibility, and risk, maintaining a living portfolio rather than an annual roadmap. * Advise on investment, build\-versus\-buy decisions, and where AI should and shouldn't be applied. * Represent the AI deployment mandate and results to senior executives and, as needed, the board. What Success Looks Like * The AI Deployment Team is hired, operating, and sought out by business leaders. * Multiple AI solutions and agents are live in production across business units, with impact validated by Finance and business owners. * Business units that worked with the team run and extend their solutions independently. * Reusable patterns and standard guardrails are shortening the path from problem to production. * Deployments are monitored, owned, and auditable, and governance is seen as speeding work up. **Qualifications** Required Experience * 12\+ years in software engineering, ML or AI engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or technology delivery, with increasing scope and leadership responsibility. * Deep, hands\-on experience deploying LLM\-based applications, agentic systems, and workflow automation into enterprise production, including systems you personally built or directly led. * A record of measurable business outcomes from production deployments, with specific results, baselines, and how impact was validated. * Strong technical depth: able to write and review code, design architecture, and integrate with enterprise systems and APIs. Working knowledge of RAG, tool use and agent orchestration, prompt and context engineering, evaluation, observability, and guardrails. * Experience hiring, coaching, and leading small, high\-caliber technical teams with a high bar for quality. * Experience working directly with business stakeholders and operators to diagnose workflows and redesign how work gets done. * Experience deploying AI within enterprise security, privacy, and risk requirements, including human\-in\-the\-loop controls and auditability. * Executive presence: earns the trust of engineers and front\-line operators and communicates credibly with senior leadership. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent practical experience considered. Preferred Experience * Background in forward\-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or embedded technical consulting. * Experience re\-engineering workflows in finance, supply chain, manufacturing, operations, customer service, or software engineering. * Experience with major cloud AI ecosystems and enterprise AI platforms (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, Google Cloud). * Experience with MLOps and LLMOps: model evaluation, observability, cost management, and lifecycle management. * Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks, data privacy requirements, and enterprise AI governance. * Experience standing up a new delivery function or building a technical team from the ground up inside a large organization. * Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline. *Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at* *www.fanaticsinc.com/careers* By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. *Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it* *here**.*
