jobs.title: Senior AI Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: The Senior AI Analytics Engineer is responsible for developing and supporting the company’s AI\-enabled analytics capabilities, enabling Commercial, Finance, and Operations leaders to ask business questions in plain language and receive accurate, governed answers. Working closely with Commercial, Finance, Operations, and IT Data Engineering, this position designs, develops, and deploys large language model (LLM)\-powered analytics solutions on Microsoft Azure data platforms and maintains the Power BI semantic models and dashboards that serve as their trusted foundation. The Senior AI Analytics Engineer focuses on delivering reliable AI\-driven insights, standardizing KPIs, and supporting the organization’s shift toward centralized, governed analytics. #### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and deploy an AI analytics engine that answers commercial, financial, and operational questions in natural language. * Build LLM\-powered applications and agents in Python using Azure OpenAI or similar services, including prompt design, tool calling, and orchestration. * Develop natural\-language query capabilities, such as text\-to\-SQL or text\-to\-DAX, over curated datasets in Azure Data Lake Gen2 and Databricks SQL. * Connect AI solutions to Power BI semantic models and governed metric definitions to ensure answers align with standardized KPIs. * Create evaluation datasets and automated tests to measure answer accuracy, detect errors, and monitor quality over time. * Deploy, monitor, and support AI services in production, managing reliability, performance, and cost. * Maintain and optimize Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, and dashboards that support commercial and operational reporting. * Improve dashboard performance, refresh reliability, and usability. * Reduce manual reporting workflows by enabling self\-service, AI\-assisted analytics. * Document AI solutions and support user adoption, training, and trust in AI\-generated insights. #### **Qualification Guidelines** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. #### **Education/Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data science, statistics, business analytics, or a related field required. * Five or more years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role required, including at least one year of experience building LLM\-based or AI applications. * Experience developing Power BI solutions in an enterprise environment required. * Experience in multi\-unit retail or restaurant environments preferred. #### **Language Ability** Excellent verbal and written communication skills are necessary. This position requires strong written, verbal, and group communication skills. The ability to read, write, and comprehend complex instructions and correspondence is necessary. This position also requires the ability to read, analyze, create, and interpret financial reports, business requirements, technical documentation, and data models, and to explain AI\-generated results and technical trade\-offs clearly to non\-technical stakeholders. This position requires advanced business math skills. #### **Reasoning Ability** This position requires strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities and the exercise of independent technical judgment in designing AI solutions, evaluating system performance, investigating discrepancies between AI\-generated answers and reported figures, and supporting data validation efforts. #### **Computer Skills** Exceptional computer skills are required, including proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite and other appropriate software. Strong proficiency in Python and LLM APIs, such as Azure OpenAI, is required for building production AI applications. Proficiency in Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service is required, including semantic model development, publishing, and performance optimization. Experience with Microsoft Azure\-based data platforms is required. #### **Supervisory Responsibilities** This position has no supervisory responsibilities. #### **Physical Demands** This position primarily involves sustained computer and technology use and may be performed from a seated or standing position. Occasional movement throughout the work environment and lifting or moving items weighing less than 20 pounds may be required. Occasional travel of less than 20% may be required based on business needs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. #### **Special Requirements/Certification** * Hands\-on experience building LLM applications, including prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool or function calling, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Experience evaluating and testing AI output for accuracy, reliability, and security. * Strong expertise in DAX and data modeling, including star schema design, semantic model optimization, and Row\-Level Security (RLS). * Advanced SQL skills for querying, validating, and transforming data across enterprise datasets. * Experience working within Microsoft Azure data environments, including Azure Data Lake Gen2, Azure Data Factory pipelines, and Databricks SQL or similar cloud data warehouse platforms. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI services, or Databricks AI/ML tools preferred; relevant Microsoft or Databricks certifications are a plus. #### **Additional Information** The above job description is not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions and perform any other related duties as assigned by their supervisor, policy, and company management. Work location and onsite attendance requirements will be determined by the company in accordance with company practice and business needs.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Security Engineer
jobs.description: US \- Remote Security Remote Full\-time ### **About Us:** **Company Overview:** Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond reactive care and enabling proactive, data\-driven insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture\-backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). Hundreds of thousands of members have joined Function to take control of their health. Through advanced diagnostics, deep biomarker testing, longitudinal data, and AI\-enabled insights, Function equips members with actionable intelligence to take control of both the quality and length of their lives. Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent. We are growing our team and seeking out world\-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. Function fosters a collaborative and dynamic environment where every day we build the future. ### **The Role** Function Health is re\-platforming our services onto Kubernetes. Our new platform moves us from Cloud Run onto GKE \- about 220 workloads are already running in a new cluster, infrastructure is managed through Kubernetes (Config Connector), an Istio mesh enforces strict mTLS, and Temporal runs our identity and agentic workflows. As a Senior Platform Security Engineer, you'll own security for that platform. You'll report to our CISO and be embedded in the platform team \- working in its repos and reviews, co\-authoring ADRs, and building security into the paved road so every domain, and later every company we acquire, lands on a secure baseline by default. The platform is built to be agentic\-centric, and so is this role: agents do the building, and you design the guardrails and access controls that keep them safe. We're looking for someone who is fully AI\-pilled. You don't write code by hand \- you work through agents and think at the systems level about how to configure guardrails for them and enforce access controls on them. You get controls into the project plan through ADRs and into agents.md so future PRs follow them by default, and you contribute checks to Pulse, our AI PR reviewer. You see the big picture, avoid adding security controls that don't meaningfully reduce risk, and treat security as a business enabler. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Own security for our Kubernetes platform (GKE) and GCP, with Azure and AWS as needed. * Embed with the platform team: work in its repos and reviews, co\-author ADRs, and build security into the paved road. * Define a secure platform baseline that every domain gets by default as it migrates, and that acquired companies adopt as they move onto our infrastructure. * Move GCP org constraints into enforcement and eliminate long\-lived credentials by moving service account keys to workload identity. * Replace standing human access to production with break\-glass access. * Harden the software supply chain: image digest pinning, vulnerability scanning, SBOMs, signing, and admission control. * Roll out default\-deny network policies alongside our Istio mesh (strict mTLS and peer identity). * Secure Temporal and workload identity: scoped namespaces, service accounts, and keys per domain. * Design least\-privilege access for autonomous agents working in our environments, with clear guardrails and a full audit trail. * Turn on the audit logging that matters (e.g. pgaudit, Data Access logs) and partner with detection engineering on what to alert on. * Review internet exposure \- WAF, rate limiting, and public routes \- and keep it tight as domains migrate. * Build a scheduled drift check that catches hand\-made grants and changes made outside of GitOps. * Encode controls in ADRs and agents.md, and contribute checks to Pulse, our AI PR reviewer, so every future PR follows them. * Define and track platform security KPIs, and communicate risk and progress to engineering and business leaders. ### **Qualifications** * 8\+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or security engineering, with at least 4 years securing Kubernetes in production. * Deep Kubernetes security experience, ideally GKE: RBAC, workload identity, network policy, admission control, and pod security. * Strong grasp of GCP IAM: service accounts, workload identity, org policies, and eliminating long\-lived credentials. * Experience with service mesh security (Istio preferred): mTLS, peer identity, and authorization policy. * Hands\-on software supply chain security: image provenance, SBOMs, signing, and admission control. * Experience managing infrastructure as code through GitOps (Config Connector, Terraform, Argo CD, or similar). * Fully AI\-centric workflow: you build through agents rather than writing code by hand, and you think at the systems level about guardrails and access controls for agents. * Experience securing autonomous agents or other non\-human identities with least privilege, or a strong point of view on how it should be done. * Experience embedding with a platform team and shaping architecture through design reviews or ADRs. * Pragmatic, big\-picture judgment: able to prioritize the risks that matter, avoid extraneous controls, and balance speed and control in support of business goals. * Excellent communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Bonus: Temporal or other workflow\-engine identity; Config Connector; Azure or AWS; experience with HIPAA/HITRUST environments, SOC 2 Type II audits, or healthcare data protection. **Why You'll Love Working With Us:** We value our team at Function and offer a competitive salary and benefits package, flexible working hours, and a dynamic work environment where creativity and innovation are encouraged. If you are a highly motivated and experienced individual who is passionate about using technology to improve people’s lives, we would love to hear from you. At Function, we celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workforce. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, ancestry, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Join the Function Health team and become a part of our mission to revolutionize healthcare. Work with us to make a difference in the lives of thousands, ensuring a healthier future for all. Discover more about us and how we're changing the face of healthcare at Function Health. ***Important Notice:*** *Legitimate communication from the Function Health team will always come from an email address ending in* *@functionhealth.com**.* *Function Health will never request personal information such as banking details or payment during the hiring process. Please be cautious of communications or job offers that come from other email domains, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls. If you ever have doubts about the legitimacy of a communication, please reach out to us directly at* *talent@functionhealth.com*.

jobs.title: AI Development Engineer
jobs.description: **Introduction** Welcome to Gallagher \- a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client\-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way. **Overview** The Senior AI Engineering Developer owns the technical delivery of enterprise AI solutions at AJ Gallagher. Reporting to the Director of AI, you will lead the design, build, and deployment of production AI systems \- RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and Copilot integrations \- on our Azure and .NET/Python stack. You will set engineering standards for a growing AI team, mentor developers, and partner directly with business units to turn ambiguous problems into shipped, governed, production\-grade AI products in a regulated insurance environment. **How you'll make an impact** * **Translate Business Problems into Technical Solutions:** Work side\-by\-side with business leaders and subject\-matter experts to unpack ambiguous, unstructured challenges and shape them into well\-scoped, buildable AI solutions with a clear delivery path. * **Own AI Solution Architecture:** Design and defend end\-to\-end architectures for GenAI and agentic systems on Microsoft Foundry \- spanning Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Foundry Tools, and Copilot Studio \- that meet enterprise security, scalability, and data\-residency requirements. * **Lead Hands\-On Delivery:** Write and review production code (C\#/.NET and Python) for RAG pipelines, AI agent orchestration, and API integrations; remain a strong individual contributor while leading the team. * **Set Engineering Standards:** Establish patterns for agentic development, evaluation, testing, CI/CD (Azure DevOps), and observability so AI solutions are repeatable and maintainable \- not one\-off prototypes. * **Mentor and Grow Engineers:** Coach AI developers through design reviews, pairing, and career development; raise the technical bar across the team. * **Ship to Enterprise Surfaces:** Deliver AI capabilities into internal applications, Microsoft Teams, and M365 Copilot, integrating through Foundry agents, Service Bus, Azure Functions, and other cloud\-native services. * **Build Governance In:** Implement responsible\-AI controls \- Entra ID/RBAC, IaC Policy, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, audit logging \- aligned to Gallagher compliance expectations from day one, not as an afterthought. * **Drive Evaluation and Reliability:** Define measurable quality bars (groundedness, accuracy, latency, cost) and build the evaluation harnesses to enforce them before and after release. * **Communicate Up and Across:** Translate technical trade\-offs into clear recommendations for the Director of AI and business stakeholders; manage delivery risks and dependencies proactively. **About You** **Required** ============ * **Experience:** 7 or more years in software engineering, including experience in building LLM/GenAI systems in production and 2\+ years leading engineers or owning technical direction. * **Azure Depth:** Hands\-on production experience with Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, and Azure compute (Functions, Container Apps, or App Service). * **Languages:** Strong .NET/C\# plus working proficiency in Python; able to review and contribute in both. * **GenAI Engineering:** Proven delivery of RAG architectures, agent orchestration (Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, or LangChain), and prompt/evaluation pipelines. * **API and Integration Skills:** Designing secure REST APIs and event\-driven integrations (Azure API Management, Service Bus) within an enterprise identity model (Entra ID, RBAC). * **Delivery Discipline:** Agile experience with Azure DevOps (or equivalent) \- backlogs, CI/CD, automated testing, and release management. * **Leadership:** Track record of mentoring engineers, running design reviews, and owning technical decisions across multiple concurrent initiatives. **Preferred Differentiators** ============================= * **Regulated Industry Experience:** Prior AI/ML delivery in insurance, financial services, or healthcare, with familiarity with model risk management or responsible AI guidance. * **Familiarity with AI\-enabled and spec\-driven development:** Using AI\-assisted tooling and agent workflows across the SDLC to quickly deliver production\-grade systems. * **Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code:** Building applications tightly aligned to Terraform\-deployed, optimized infrastructure. * **Evaluation and MLOps Maturity:** Built LLMOps tooling \- automated evals, red\-teaming, drift/cost monitoring \- at enterprise scale. * **Architecture Credentials:** Azure certifications (AZ\-305, AI\-103\) or equivalent demonstrated architecture ownership. **Professional Qualities** ========================== * **Bias for Shipped Outcomes:** Measures success by working software in users' hands, not demos or decks; cuts scope intelligently to ship. * **Calm Technical Authority:** Makes and defends decisions under ambiguity, and changes course quickly when evidence demands it. * **Force Multiplier:** Gets more from the team than from their own keyboard \- through mentoring, standards, and unblocking others. * **Governance as a Feature:** Treats compliance, security, and auditability as design inputs that build trust, not friction to route around. * **Clear Communicator:** Explains complex systems simply to executives and precisely to engineers; writes things down. * **Pragmatic Curiosity:** Tracks the fast\-moving AI landscape but adopts new tools only when they solve a real AJ Gallagher problem. **Compensation and benefits** At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation * Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being * Career development opportunities and ongoing learning * A collaborative, people\-first culture with accessible leadership * The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact **At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will design and build scalable, AI\-powered solutions that accelerate early clinical development. You will work alongside data scientists, product managers, and clinical experts in an environment that champions curiosity, continuous learning, and purposeful innovation. **The Opportunity** * **Build scalable software:** Design, develop, test, and deploy reliable backend services, APIs, and cloud\-native applications that power medical data review and clinical trial operations. * **Drive Generative AI innovation:** Integrate large language models (LLMs), retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and intelligent workflow automation into enterprise platforms. * **Architect modern data pipelines:** Connect and transform complex clinical and enterprise data across relational, non\-relational, and cloud data platforms (such as AWS, Snowflake, or PostgreSQL). * **Champion engineering excellence:** Lead by example through automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, observability, and security best practices for sensitive clinical data. * **Collaborate across disciplines:** Partner closely with data scientists, clinical researchers, and fellow engineers to translate complex healthcare challenges into user\-friendly technical solutions. * **Shape technical direction:** Contribute to architectural decisions, evaluate emerging AI frameworks, and foster a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing. **Who You Are** You are a curious, hands\-on builder who thrives on solving meaningful technical problems and exploring emerging technologies. jobs.title: Senior/Principal AI Engineer, Agentic Systems, AI for Drug Discovery
jobs.description: ### **The Position** A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R\&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide. **The Opportunity** ------------------- Within AI for Drug Discovery, our team builds platforms that bring AI agents, machine learning models, scientific tools, and data into the hands of drug discovery scientists. We are seeking a Senior / Principal AI Engineer to own the backend architecture of our agentic molecule design platform and help turn emerging AI and scientific capabilities into robust, production\-quality systems. At the Senior level, you will lead delivery of major platform workstreams. At the Principal level, you will also own the platform's technical direction and outcomes, and lead across teams. This is a hands\-on engineering role at the intersection of backend systems, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and computational drug discovery. You will work closely with software engineers, machine learning engineers, computational scientists, and experimental scientists to build reliable foundations for agentic scientific workflows. **In this role, you will:** --------------------------- * Own and evolve the backend architecture of the agentic molecule design platform, including service boundaries, APIs, persistence, workflow state, asynchronous execution, and integration patterns. * Scale the platform for its projected user base: stateless services, session and workflow state, load and capacity testing, running multiple replicas reliably. * Design reliable infrastructure for long\-running scientific and agentic workflows, including retries, checkpointing, idempotency, failure recovery, and human\-in\-the\-loop interactions. * Build backend services that integrate AI agents, scientific tools, machine learning models, databases, and internal services into end\-to\-end workflows. * Evaluate new AI agents using our agentic evaluation framework, decide with scientists which are worth deploying, and bring them into production safely via sandboxing, scoped permissions, monitoring, and rollback. * Establish strong engineering practices around testing, observability, reliability, performance, deployment, and operational ownership. Lead delivery of major platform workstreams: translate project goals into concrete outcomes, and manage dependencies, risks, and stakeholder alignment with ML, data, and scientific teams. * * **For the Principal AI Engineer level:** + Own technical direction and outcomes for the platform as a whole: scope, priorities, trade\-offs and risks. Be the group's go\-to decision maker on architecture and delivery. + Lead across team boundaries (including ML, data, foundation models, and scientific teams) to align shared infrastructure, including the job\-execution layers and agentic platforms our applications depend on. + Set engineering standards and reusable components that other teams adopt, and mentor senior engineers. **Who You Are** --------------- * You have significant experience building and owning production backend, platform, or distributed systems, with a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (typically BS \+ 4\-7 years, MS \+ 3\-5 years, or PhD \+ 0\-2 years of relevant experience). * You are a strong Python engineer with deep software engineering fundamentals, including system design, APIs, distributed systems, data modeling, testing, and maintainable architecture. * You have experience designing systems with asynchronous workflows, persistent state, failure handling, and clear service boundaries. * You have migrated a production system to a new framework or backend while minimizing downtime. * You have scaled a service horizontally and have navigated failure modes around in\-memory state, sticky sessions, background workers, DB connections. * You understand the practical requirements of production AI\-enabled applications, including observability, evaluation, deployment, reliability, and iteration. * You can translate ambiguous product or scientific requirements into pragmatic technical architectures and implementation plans. You have led delivery of complex workstreams and can coach other engineers. * * **For the Principal AI Engineer level:** + Typically BS \+ 7\-12 years, MS \+ 5\-10 years, or PhD \+ 2\-7 years of relevant experience. + A track record of owning architecture and outcomes for a complex, multi\-team platform, and of being the person others go to for technical decisions. + You have strong working knowledge of LLMs and agentic frameworks, including evaluation and model validation practices, and the guardrails needed to run autonomous agents safely. + Influence beyond your own team: shaping shared standards, guiding architectural decisions, and mentoring senior engineers. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience building AI\- or ML\-enabled applications, agentic systems, or platforms that integrate models, tools, and data. * Experience with agent orchestration, tool calling, state management, human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, retrieval, tracing, and Model Context Protocol. * Experience with model serving, scientific computing workloads, workflow engines, event\-driven architectures, queues, or distributed job\-execution systems. * Experience designing data platforms that combine raw data, derived features, model outputs, metadata, provenance, and large computational artifacts. * Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, Helm, load testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and production observability. * Experience in computational biology, bioinformatics, cheminformatics, computational chemistry, protein engineering, drug discovery, or another scientific computing domain. * Experience running untrusted or model\-generated code safely (sandboxing, container isolation, least\-privilege service accounts). * Deep experience with multi\-agent orchestration, including evaluation frameworks and guardrails. Relocation benefits are **NOT** available for this job posting The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of California, is $168,100 \- 312,300 for the Senior AI Engineer and $201,300 \- 373,800 for the Principal AI Engineer. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job\-related factors permitted by law. jobs.title: Engineer I - Engine Code Engineer
jobs.description: **We believe power is a promise \- a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.** ===================================================================================================== For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future. Ready to Power a Smarter World with us? The **Engine Code Engineer** supports the design and performance of internal combustion engines (ICE), through code creation, embedded software, and code validation under the guidance of senior engineers. This position leverages CAN, ATI Vision, and Matlab/Simulink tools to learn and contribute to optimizing system behavior, improving engine control, and increasing engine performance across a range of gaseous fueled applications. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Assist in creating system\-level engine code using Matlab/Simulink to support engine and generator design and development. * Assist with simulated and functional analyses to evaluate engine performance of mechanical and energy systems. * Support system evaluation and testing to aid in optimizing an engine’s steady state and transient performance. * Help interpret testing results and collaborate with cross\-functional teams through code design reviews and technical discussions to guide product development. * Learn and contribute to software and code analysis best practices to improve efficiency and accuracy. * Document code objectives, methods, and results using standardized reporting formats, with guidance from senior team members. * Apply data analysis techniques, including Matlab/Simulink modeling and Python\-based scripting, to support code performance forecasting; exposure to machine learning is a plus. * Stay informed on relevant technologies, tools, and industry trends to support continuous learning and improvement. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or related discipline * Minimum of 3 months of relevant experience **Knowledge Skills and Abilities:** * Working knowledge of applying Matlab/Simulink to internal combustion engine related systems, including steady state, transient, fault codes, SPNs, SAE J1939 CAN networks, sensor integration, and embedded systems; coursework or project experience is acceptable. * Familiarity with automotive standards. * Exposure to co\-simulation environments, including Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SiL) and Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HiL). * Familiarity with machine learning and predictive analytics techniques applied to engine performance and emissions modeling. * Familiarity with generator design. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a foundational understanding of internal combustion engine design, operation, and testing. * Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly present simulation results to technical and non\-technical audiences. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field of study. * Advanced engine and engine system code writing in Matlab/Simulink. * Advanced experience applying MATLAB/Simulink and Python to internal combustion engine design. * Advanced experience using ATI Vision to set calibrations in internal combustion engines. * Advanced experience in applying MATLAB/Simulink and Python in engineering analysis and simulation. * Advanced proficiency in applying Matlab/Simulink code to complex propulsion systems, with demonstrated success in optimizing transients, steady state, and overall performance. * Deep expertise in internal combustion engine control code, operational dynamics, and advanced testing methodologies. * Extensive experience designing and executing co\-simulation workflows, including SiL and HiL integration for real\-time system validation. * Exceptional ability to synthesize and present complex code insights to diverse technical and non\-technical stakeholders, influencing design decisions. * Proficient in applying machine learning and advanced predictive analytics to optimize engine performance with experience developing custom code. * Superior analytical acumen and strategic problem\-solving capabilities, with a track record of delivering high\-impact engineering solutions. ***Physical Demands:*** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear; and use hands to manipulate objects or controls. The employee is regularly required to stand and walk. On occasion, the incumbent may be required to stoop, bend, or reach above the shoulders. The employee must occasionally lift up to 25 pounds. jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote in the USA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Strategy \& Operations **We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse** ================================================= Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI\-ready APIs alongside traditional real\-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission\-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer\-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest\-growing SaaS vendors. Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more. To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- We are looking for an experienced GTM Systems Engineer to join our go\-to\-market organization to help us build the systems and processes we need to 10X. This role is critical to helping our sales team land new logos, enabling our account management team to drive more adoption, and for our RevOps systems to operate with minimal toil. You will pair technical expertise with business acumen to design and implement systems that improve data quality, accelerate deal velocity, and provide visibility into the health of our business. You’ll also own the context layer behind our AI\-powered GTM motion, making sure our LLM workflows get the right customer, product, and pipeline data at the right time. You’ll join a small team that works across sales, account management, operations, analytics, and engineering. If you’re a builder who thrives in ambiguity and loves to see the direct impact of your work, this is a job for you. ### **What you'll do** * Build and refine the agents and models that decide which accounts we sell to and who owns them, rooted in a deep understanding of our ideal customer profile and full revenue lifecycle. * Leverage coding agents to build internal software tooling for sales on a platform our engineers maintain. Turn sales prototypes into tools the whole team can depend on, then keep improving them with the people who use them. * Use agents and data to build, measure, and continuously improve automation for lead routing, deal stage progression, renewal tracking, and post\-sales engagement. * Implement and optimize integrations between HubSpot, systems of record, enrichment tools, and analytics platforms to ensure accurate, timely, and complete revenue data to drive pre\- and post\-sales growth. * Create automation for data hygiene, enrichment, and deduplication to maintain a single source of truth for customer, deal, and revenue records. * Partner with GTM leadership to translate process requirements into scalable workflows that serve sales, marketing, and customer support teams. * Design and maintain context pipelines for AI\-powered GTM workflows such as account research, lead scoring, outbound personalization, and deal briefs. Decide what CRM, enrichment, call transcript, and product data goes to LLMs, how it’s retrieved and structured, and how output quality is measured. ### **Who you are** * **You are agent\-first**. You direct agents with clear, specific instructions to get work done, and you put systems in place to check that the work was done correctly. You know HubSpot deeply, including workflows, reporting, and the API. * **You are a B2B SaaS growth expert.** You have experience in growth, marketing, sales operations, BizOps, or related roles. You know the best tools, systems, and strategies to build a scalable growth engine for a B2B SaaS company. * **You are a context engineer for GTM.** You’ve built production LLM workflows for sales or marketing, not just used AI tools. You know how to assemble the right context (ICP definitions, account data, call notes, product knowledge) through retrieval, structured prompts, and tool and agent design. You evaluate outputs rigorously and know when to use an LLM and when to write a rule. * **You are technical.** You work in GitHub every day through coding agents. You're at home with APIs, serverless infrastructure on AWS, and enrichment providers. * **You are data\-driven.** You think in terms of revenue metrics, pipeline health, and data integrity, and you can design systems that measure and optimize them automatically. * **You do what it takes to get the job done.** You are resourceful, self\-motivated, curious, self\-disciplined, and don’t wait to be told what to do. You put in the hours. * **You move fast.** We move fast at Stedi. This requires an ability to match our pace and not get lost when managing competing priorities. You communicate what you are working on, and proactively ask for help or feedback when you need it. **We’ve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team.** Please note: * All official communication about roles at Stedi will **only come from an @****stedi.com** **email address**, or from our official identification verification partner, Persona, @frompersona.com. * If you’re unsure whether a message is legitimate or have any concerns, feel free to **contact us directly at** **careers@stedi.com****.** We appreciate your attention to this and your interest in joining Stedi. *At Stedi, we're looking for people who are deeply curious and aligned to our ways of working. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.*

jobs.description: **About Glean:** Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time\-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long\-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. \#LI\-HYBRID **AI\-First Mindset at Glean:** At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI\-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:** Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. jobs.description: **YOUR IMPACT** As a Vice President and Technology Risk Engineer for \*\*Global Banking \& Markets (GBM)\*\*, you will lead the Dallas Technology Risk team and partner technically with GBM application owners to remediate security vulnerabilities. The central Technology Risk team identifies vulnerabilities and defines risk programs. Our team works alongside application owners and their engineers to resolve those issues quickly, durably, and at scale. This is a hands\-on, engineering\-focused role. We are looking for a software engineer by background who has built modern applications at scale. You should be comfortable working in application owners' code, architecture, and platforms as a technical peer who helps solve problems and delivers lasting fixes. You will also lead an AI\- and technology\-first approach to how the team works. That means using AI to speed up remediation and automating our reporting and remediation workflows so the team moves off email and spreadsheets. You will advise GBM engineering and business leadership on the division's risk profile, and you will build, develop, and lead a high\-performing team in Dallas. **HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL** **Technical Partnership with Application Owners** * Partner technically with GBM application owners to remediate security vulnerabilities and meet risk program requirements from the central Technology Risk team, and drive them to closure. * Work with application teams on root causes and practical fixes through code and architecture reviews, design input, and improvements to CI/CD, cloud, and infrastructure configuration. * Turn recurring vulnerabilities into systemic, reusable solutions, such as shared libraries, guardrails, and automated controls, so the same problems do not return. * Help application owners prioritize remediation by business risk and engineering effort, and build plans that fit how their teams deliver. * Build credibility with application owners and engineers as a peer who understands their systems, constraints, and trade\-offs. **AI\-Enabled Remediation** * Design, build, and champion AI\-enabled tools that help application teams remediate faster. jobs.title: Data Center Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: This position requires onsite client\-facing work 5 days a week.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering, related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 10 years of experience in mission\-critical facility design, construction environments, and their mechanical infrastructure. * 5 years of experience in design, construction, and commissioning of either chilled water cooling systems, air handling systems, fire suppression systems, plumbing systems, or underground dry/wet utilities. * 5 years of experience with data center operations and working with mechanical contractors and cross\-functional project teams. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Engineering, Business or other relevant field or a professional engineering license. * Experience in designing complex modular building scale assemblies, with an understanding of mechanical tolerances and tolerance analysis. * Experience with electro/mechanical assembly and mechanical testing procedures including resolution and comprehensive documentation maintenance for mechanical designs. * Knowledge of mechanical engineering and design principles with a focus in the areas of design for medium\-scale production, structural beams/elements, and international building codes. **About the job** ----------------- Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department \- cutting\-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements \- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior\-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians. With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical). As a Data Center Services Mechanical Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the field\-level implementation and operational support of Google’s rapidly expanding data centers. You'll be responsible for overseeing the design, construction, and commissioning of complex Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) and mechanical distribution systems, ensuring projects are delivered safely, swiftly, and with high quality. Your role involves managing site\-level mechanical engineering issues, ensuring compliance with design standards and local regulations, supporting quality assurance, and providing technical guidance to vendor teams. You will be a strong communicator and collaborator who thrives on construction sites and has experience with complex mechanical systems, ideally within mission\-critical facilities, heavy industrial, oil and gas, or semiconductor industries.The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We're behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. jobs.title: Senior Ads ML Engineer
jobs.description: **About Gravity** ----------------- Gravity is the ad network for AI. We place relevant, sponsored suggestions inside AI platforms, right when someone is deciding what to do or buy. Everyone at Gravity believes three things: * AI should be free for everyone. * Most people will never pay for an AI subscription. * Someone has to pay for the compute, and advertising is the answer. If you believe these too, you'll probably fit right in. We built our ad engine from the ground up for AI interactions. Any AI platform can plug in with one integration, and we're already live on 50\+ of them, reaching millions of conversations every day. You can read more about us at trygravity.com. We've raised $38\.5M from investors like Lightspeed, Committed Capital, Basis Set and Caffeinated Capital. We work in person in San Francisco, 6 days a week. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a **Senior Ads ML Engineer** to own Gravity's entire ad engine. This is a senior IC role. You'll set the roadmap, working with our engineering team and our CEO, Zach. * **Conversation understanding.** Build semantic analysis of conversations from scratch, so the engine knows what each moment is about. * **Identity and audiences.** Build our identity graph and lookalike products. * **Attribution.** Build the attribution products that prove what's working for advertisers. * **Auto\-scaling.** Build the auto\-scaling that controls spend across different performance objectives. * **Data.** Decide what data to buy. * **Training and deployment.** Train the system and deploy it on live traffic. * **Continual learning.** Build an engine that keeps learning, and run RL on the best\-performing ad formats. * **Roadmap.** Own the roadmap for all of it. We're not tuning an old ad engine. We're rethinking how one should work: built for many performance objectives, and creating ads that fit the conversation and the person's history. **Job Requirements** -------------------- * **Experience.** 5\+ years in ML, most of it on ads, ranking or recommendations. * **End to end.** You've built or scaled an ad engine and shipped models on live traffic that moved revenue. * **Range.** You've worked across several of identity, lookalikes, attribution, RL and continual learning. * **AI\-native.** You're ahead of the curve on AI. You build your own workflows and systems with it, and most of your routine work already runs without you. * **Ownership.** You don't need to be told what to do. You take responsibility, you follow through, and you don't drop the ball. * **No bullshit.** You say what you think and you do what you said. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * LLM\-based ad matching. Very few people have done it. **Compensation** ---------------- * $260K – $520K base * $625K – $1\.25M equity * Health benefits * Unlimited PTO Compensation Range: $260K \- $520K

With our historic growth, it is an exciting time to join our team of employee\-owners. This opportunity entails being responsible for managing assigned project(s) throughout their full lifecycle including developing the scope and technical sections of proposal and procurement documents to participating in contract negotiations and overseeing the delivery of the project plan to successfully accomplish HNTB’s 4 for 4 performance: delivery of quality work, on time, on budget and to the client’s satisfaction on every project. Provides high level technical tasks while managing and reviewing design related specifications, calculations, reports and plans. jobs.description: If you are currently an employee of Herc Rentals, please apply using this link: ***Herc Employee Career Portal*** Founded in 1965, Herc Rentals is one of the leading equipment rental suppliers in North America with 2025 total revenues reaching approximately $4\.4 billion. Herc Rentals’ parent company, known as Herc Holdings Inc., listed on the New York Stock Exchange on July 1, 2016, under the symbol “HRI.” Herc Rentals serves customers through approximately 607 locations and has about 10,000 employees in North America as of June 30, 2026\. **Job Purpose** --------------- Herc Rentals is one of the largest equipment rental suppliers in North America, supporting construction, industrial, and infrastructure customers nationwide. Our Cybersecurity team protects the people, customers, systems, and data that keep that business running. Joining us means working with a modern, cloud\-first security stack, an emphasis on AI and automation, a collaborative team, and real opportunities to grow your career in cloud security engineering. Short Description Herc Rentals is seeking a skilled and forward\-thinking Cloud \& AI Security Engineer to join our Cybersecurity team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure cloud infrastructure across our enterprise environment, with a strong emphasis on leveraging artificial intelligence and automation to enhance our security posture and protecting against advanced threats. You will serve as a key technical contributor in protecting Herc Rentals' cloud\-hosted systems, data, and applications from evolving cyber threats while ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and industry best practices. **What you will do...** ----------------------- **Cloud Security Architecture and Engineering** * Design and implement security controls, policies, and guardrails across cloud environments, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and related platforms. * Develop and maintain secure cloud architecture patterns for infrastructure, applications, and data pipelines. * Configure and manage cloud\-native security services including identity and access management (IAM), encryption, network segmentation, and logging. * Conduct regular security assessments, architecture reviews, and threat modeling for cloud workloads. **AI and Automation Integration** * Implement data governance and data loss prevention (DLP) controls for AI systems to prevent sensitive data — including customer PII, contracts, and financial information — from leaking into prompts, model training data, or third\-party model APIs. * Discover, assess, and govern the use of unsanctioned AI and SaaS tools ("shadow AI") across the organization, establishing approval, monitoring, and offboarding processes to reduce data exposure and compliance risk. * Define and enforce safe data\-handling standards for prompt and model\-response content across internally built and vendor\-provided AI services. * Leverage AI and machine learning tools to enhance threat detection, anomaly detection, and automated incident response capabilities. * Build and maintain security automation workflows to reduce manual effort and accelerate response times across the security operations lifecycle. * Evaluate and implement AI\-powered security platforms and tools, ensuring they are deployed securely and aligned with Herc Rentals' standards. * Identify opportunities to apply AI\-driven insights to improve vulnerability management, access governance, and cloud compliance monitoring. **Security Operations and Incident Response** * Monitor cloud environments for security events, misconfigurations, and anomalous activity using SIEM and cloud\-native monitoring tools. * Participate in incident response activities, including investigation, containment, remediation, and post\-incident review for cloud\-related security events. * Collaborate with the broader Cybersecurity team to develop and refine playbooks, runbooks, and response procedures. **Compliance and Risk Management** * Ensure cloud environments comply with applicable regulatory frameworks and standards, including NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, and PCI DSS. * Conduct risk assessments and vulnerability analyses for cloud\-hosted systems and AI workloads. * Partner with IT, DevOps, and application teams to integrate security into the software development lifecycle and cloud deployment pipelines (DevSecOps). * Maintain documentation of security configurations, controls, and audit evidence. **Collaboration and Continuous Improvement** * Work cross\-functionally with infrastructure, application development, and operations teams to embed security into cloud initiatives from inception. * Stay current on emerging cloud security threats, AI security risks, and industry developments, including OWASP LLM Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS frameworks. * Contribute to security awareness efforts and provide guidance to internal teams on cloud security best practices. **Requirements** ---------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3 to 5 years of experience in cloud security engineering or a closely related cybersecurity discipline. * Hands\-on experience securing cloud environments in AWS, with working knowledge of Azure. * Proficiency with cloud security tools and services such as AWS Security Hub, AWS GuardDuty, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and related platforms. * Knowledge of adversarial machine learning concepts and AI\-specific attack vectors. * Strong understanding of IAM, network security, encryption, and cloud security architecture principles. * Experience with security automation, infrastructure as code (IaC), and DevSecOps practices. * Familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts as they apply to security use cases, including anomaly detection and automated threat response. * Experience with AI security tooling, including tools designed to secure LLM integrations, model endpoints, and AI\-driven workflows. * Knowledge of compliance frameworks including NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, and PCI DSS. **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with SIEM platforms such as Splunk or Microsoft Sentinel. * Experience with container security and Kubernetes environments. * Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), CompTIA Security\+, Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate, or an AI security/governance credential such as ISACA AAISM or AAIA. Equivalent certifications or practical experience may also be considered. * Experience working in a regulated industry environment. **Skills** ---------- * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a security\-first mindset. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Self\-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Collaborative team player with a commitment to continuous learning and professional development. * High attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating risk. **Req \#:** 70394 **Pay Range:** Based on qualifications. Please be advised that the actual salary offered for any position is subject to the company's sole discretion and may be influenced by various factors, including but not limited to the candidate's qualifications, experience, location, and overall fit for the role. jobs.title: 2027 Hearst AI Newsroom Developer Fellowship Program
jobs.description: **Role Overview** ----------------- The **Hearst Fellowship for Newsroom AI Development** is a one\-year program focused on building tools for journalists and experiences for readers with cutting\-edge technology. The successful candidate will embed on the **DevHub** , Hearst’s San Francisco\-based editorial innovation team, and will work on AI\-assisted projects, tools and news products with our core product and engineering teams and our top metro newsrooms: San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, Dallas Morning News, Austin American\-Statesman, San Antonio Express\-News, (Albany) Times Union and our Hearst Connecticut newsrooms. Fellows will receive training, mentorship and real\-world experience alongside top journalist\-programmers who build interactive experiences and automation tools focused on building connections to the local communities we cover. Hearst Fellows are full\-time employees with competitive salary and benefits, including health insurance, relocation allowance and a housing stipend. **What the DevHub Does** ------------------------ The Hearst DevHub is a team of editorial engineers, AI developers, data journalists, interactive designers and content strategists who collaborate with local newsrooms to create best\-in\-class digital experiences. We make things like election results pages, AI tools, searchable databases, severe weather trackers, elegantly designed alternative story forms and whatever else you can dream up. You can learn more about the DevHub here . **What This Fellowship Could Mean for Your Future** --------------------------------------------------- Our goal for the program is for Fellows to earn full\-time employment at the end of the yearlong term. We want to train our next builders, and then continue supporting them as they grow into our future leaders. While participation in the program is not a guarantee of future employment, our goal is to recruit candidates who eventually will join our full\-time professional staff. All of us here have an investment in your future and in the future of Hearst Newspapers. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ The successful candidate will do the following on the DevHub: * Create AI tools for newsrooms and experiences for readers that adhere to our strict editorial standards and company policies. * Work with newsrooms on best practices for AI usage. * Enrich existing tools and interactives with fresh approaches to workflows, data analysis and visualization. * Innovate with new technology to benefit journalists and the communities we cover. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- The experience you gain as a Hearst Fellow is the start of a strong foundation for your journalism career. Our objective is to recruit, train and retain journalists who have experience with AI, data journalism and programming. Candidates should be college graduates with interest, experience or background in journalism and AI. **How Fellows Are Selected** ---------------------------- Hearst DevHub team members will conduct multiple interviews and test the top candidates. If you are offered and accept a position, you will be assigned a mentor, and we’ll help you develop relationships with seasoned professionals throughout Hearst Newspapers and beyond. **Requirements and Information** -------------------------------- Please see our Fellowship website . In addition, candidates must be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area and work a hybrid in\-office schedule. To be considered you must submit all required documents in PDF format: * One\-page resume that includes past journalistic experience, academic major and minor, date or expected date of graduation, permanent and current addresses, email, website, and social media addresses (if applicable). * Reference page that includes three work references including titles, email addresses and phone numbers. * Page with links to portfolio or digital work samples. **Deadline to apply for the Fellowship program is Jan. 4, 2027\.** **Additional Information** -------------------------- * **Sponsorship:** This position does not provide immigration sponsorship. Applicants must have the right to work in the U.S. without immigration sponsorship. * **Accommodations:** We are committed to an accessible application process. jobs.title: Chief Engineering, Technology, and AI Officer
jobs.description: CDS Global is undertaking a significant transformation of its platforms, engineering practices, operating model and use of artificial intelligence. CDS Global seeks an exceptional executive to lead Engineering, Architecture, Technology Modernization and Applied AI while serving as a strategic partner to Product, Commercial and Client leaders. The successful executive will combine deep software and platform credibility with enterprise transformation experience. This person will determine how CDS Global stabilizes, modernizes, integrates, re\-platforms, replaces or retires capabilities while protecting service continuity, client commitments, security and trust. This is a builder mandate. The executive must create the engineering system, leadership depth, partner ecosystem and AI\-enabled practices required to turn product direction and client needs into scalable, reliable and economically responsible outcomes. **Engineering Organization \& Delivery** ---------------------------------------- * Builds a high\-performing engineering organization with clear ownership, standards and measurable outcomes. * Transforms Engineering from a capacity\- and project\-oriented delivery model toward an increasingly platform\-oriented operating model characterized by durable ownership, reusable capabilities, measurable engineering effectiveness and clear accountability for production outcomes. * Improves delivery predictability, engineering capacity transparency, quality, reliability, security and developer effectiveness. * Balances client commitments, roadmap delivery, platform investment, maintenance, technical debt, modernization and innovation. * Reduces dependence on individual knowledge holders through architecture, documentation, leadership development and succession. **Architecture \& Modernization** --------------------------------- * Sets coherent architectural direction across platforms, cloud, APIs, integration, data, event\-driven systems and observability. * Creates a sequenced modernization roadmap for business\-critical legacy platforms. * Uses pilots and proofs of concept to answer explicit investment questions with entry, exit, scale and stop criteria. * Protects continuity, controls and client trust while reducing fragility, complexity, technical debt and scarce\-skill dependency. **Applied AI \& AI\-Augmented Engineering** ------------------------------------------- * Defines a focused applied\-AI portfolio tied to product, engineering and operating outcomes. * Establishes measurable AI value criteria, including adoption, quality, productivity, revenue enablement, cost\-to\-serve, client value and operating capacity, and recommends when initiatives should scale, change direction or stop. * Moves selected use cases from discovery to pilot, production and scaled adoption. * Uses AI responsibly across code understanding, development, testing, documentation, migration, workflow automation and client\-facing capabilities. * Establishes evaluation, monitoring, security, data, privacy, human\-review and accountability practices with appropriate enterprise partners. **Product, Client \& Commercial Partnership** --------------------------------------------- * Partners with Product to translate market and client needs into scalable capabilities, coherent roadmaps and sound technical choices. * Engages strategic clients and partners where architecture, integrations, modernization, data or AI are material. * Ensures commitments are technically supportable, economically responsible and aligned with platform direction. * Brings engineering evidence, capacity, risk and economics into product lifecycle and portfolio decisions. **Investment, Partners \& Governance** -------------------------------------- * Owns Engineering and Technology budgets, workforce planning, material vendors and strategic investment recommendations. * Creates transparent governance across engineering, modernization and AI investments, and provides executive oversight of the technology responsibilities within the enterprise compliance and assurance program, including Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) compliance and applicable System and Organization Controls (SOC 1 and SOC 2\) examinations. In partnership with Security, Compliance, Finance, Legal and control owners, establishes clear responsibilities, a coordinated assessment calendar, ongoing control monitoring, evidence readiness and timely remediation of findings. Escalates material gaps, overdue actions and resource needs to the President. * Leads build\-buy\-partner\-integrate\-orchestrate decisions and manages dependency risk. * Measures progress through enterprise outcomes rather than activity or pilot volume. **Talent \& Transformation** ---------------------------- * Assesses and evolves the organization, leadership structure, skills, decision rights and ways of working. * Recruits and develops Engineering, Architecture, Platform and AI leaders. * Builds technical caree bilities, roadmap choices and technical investment decisions. Has partnered with Product, Finance and business leaders to develop return on investment (ROI) business cases addressing expected benefits, development and ongoing operating costs, assumptions, risks and investment trade\-offs. Has then stewarded approved initiatives through Engineering, aligning architecture, capacity, delivery sequencing, quality and production readiness with the agreed requirements and business case. Must distinguish reusable product value from one\-off customization and demonstrate how feedback and delivery results informed subsequent decisions. Company\-wide Product leadership is not required; Product strategy and product\-management accountability remain distinct from this role. * Commercial and financial acumen: Understands recurring\-revenue economics and how engineering and technology choices affect revenue, margin, retention, implementation effort, cost to serve and enterprise value. Has managed meaningful budgets, workforce plans, partners and investment trade\-offs. * Build\-buy\-partner judgment: Has demonstrated judgment to build, buy, partner, integrate, orchestrate, encapsulate or retire capabilities and understands the strategic and economic consequences of vendor and platform dependency. * Risk, security and responsible technology leadership: Has operated where cybersecurity, privacy, data stewardship, operational resilience, regulatory obligations and responsible AI materially influenced technology decisions. * Has led Engineering and Technology participation in material security, compliance and assurance programs, preferably including PCI DSS and SOC 1/SOC 2 Type 2 examinations, including scope management, control implementation and operation, evidence collection, assessor and auditor engagement and remediation of findings. Can demonstrate sustained control effectiveness between assessments and explain personal accountability, cross\-functional governance and how modernization preserved compliance and assurance coverage. * Client and external credibility: Can engage enterprise clients, prospects, strategic partners and senior operators; translate technology into differentiated and supportable value; and prevent technically or economically unsound commitments. * People and leadership builder: Has recruited, developed and retained senior Engineering, Architecture, Platform and AI leaders; built succession depth; and created an accountable, collaborative and low\-ego culture across distributed teams. *The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be a complete list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel assigned to this job.* **Benefits** ------------ CDS Global offers a competitive benefits package to eligible employees, including: * **Health coverage:** Two medical plan options—High Deductible and Traditional—plus comprehensive dental and vision plans. * **Time off and protection:** Generous PTO, holiday pay, basic and voluntary life insurance, AD\&D insurance, and short\-term and long\-term disability coverage. * **Retirement:** A 401(k) retirement savings plan that allows employees to begin contributing immediately and includes a company match based on a percentage of employee contributions. * **Wellness and development:** Wellness and tuition reimbursement programs. * **Family support:** Paid parental leave for new parents. * **Child and dependent care:** Up to $750 per month in reimbursement for qualified child and dependent care expenses. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Post\-offer, pre\-employment background checks are conducted on qualified candidates. Pre\-employment drug and/or health screenings may be required for some positions. **If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be just the right fit.**
