jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: **The Opportunity** ------------------- **Homecare Homebase (HCHB)** is the software platform behind home health and hospice care across the United States, supporting scheduling, clinical documentation, coding, compliance and revenue cycle for agencies serving millions of patient visits each year. We are seeking a **Principal AI Platform Engineer** to build our AI software factory. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role. You will write code every day, ship the first working version of our agent platform yourself, and then teach engineering teams to build on it. You will have no direct reports at the start. The platform will run agents against our production codebase, with people writing specifications and validating results and agents doing most of the implementation. You will also serve as the senior technical authority on AI built into our products. Our primary stack is .NET and Azure, with Azure DevOps, Kubernetes, Azure AI Foundry and MCP\-based tooling, alongside other languages and frameworks. The agent platform must work across all of them. This is a greenfield effort, so you will set the standards rather than inherit them. **Is This Role for You?** ------------------------- This role is for someone who builds. You’ll set standards, shape how teams use AI and influence the roadmap, but you’ll do it through working code and reference implementations, not decks, review boards or org charts. If your recent work has mostly been leading teams, advising executives or designing solutions that others implement, this probably isn’t the right match. Expect to spend most of your time coding, especially in your first few months. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ **AI Platform Architecture and Development** * Design, write and operate the agent platform that runs autonomously against our production codebase, taking work from specification to pull request with human review. * Implement agentic patterns, orchestration and tool integration for real\-world engineering workflows. * Make the platform effective across our full technology stack, not only one language or framework. * Define the agent templates and shared framework that every team uses. * Own the AI lifecycle from concept through deployment, operation and iteration on Azure and Azure AI Foundry. * Shape how work is handed to agents and review the results, from concept to specification through pull request. **Developer Experience and Integration** * Partner with application teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing products and workflows. * Build the APIs, SDKs, MCP servers and extension points that engineering teams build on. * Establish how MCP servers, tools and agent skills are packaged, versioned, discovered and distributed to teams, such as through an internal registry or catalog with access controls. * Design tool access with per\-tenant data scoping, so that an agent acting for one agency can reach only that agency’s data. **Context and Knowledge Engineering** * Design the context, skills and retrieval patterns that make AI agents effective in large codebases, including an application\-level knowledge map that tells an agent which module a ticket belongs to and what it affects. * Decide when retrieval is the right tool and when curated context is better. * Establish versioning, review and governance for shared AI assets. **Evaluation, Safety and Operational Quality** * Build evaluation frameworks that measure AI output quality and detect regressions. * Define guardrails, failure handling and human\-in\-the\-loop controls for regulated environments, including keeping PHI out of agent context, prompts and logs. * Monitor and optimize AI systems for reliability, accuracy and cost efficiency, with token budgets, rate limits, retry caps and step limits. * Establish observability best practices across supervised and autonomous AI usage. **Enablement and Technical Leadership** * Mentor engineers across the organization and raise AI engineering capability at scale, by building working examples in their own codebases. * Define engineering standards and shape the AI technical roadmap with the CTO. **Innovation and Applied Research** * Evaluate emerging capabilities in LLMs, agentic AI, RAG and MCP, and bring what proves out into production. * Advise on build, buy and partner decisions across the AI toolchain. * Maintain a working view of commercial and open\-weight models, and match model tiers to tasks by cost, latency, quality and data\-handling terms. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Within your first 90 days, a working agent template and shared framework that engineering teams can adopt, with at least one team using it on real tickets. * Telemetry in place for token spend, agent launch frequency and traceable tool calls. * A baseline for measuring the impact on our development process: time saved, delivery velocity and cost. * One common standard across teams such as clinical, revenue cycle and integration, so that each team owns its knowledge but no team builds its own agents, models or tiers. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 10\+ years in software engineering, with recent hands\-on coding. You write code today, not only review it. * 3\+ years building and operating production AI systems in which agents call tools or change code. RAG or machine learning products alone do not meet this bar. * Proficiency in Python and modern AI tooling (for example LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs). * Hands\-on experience building MCP servers or equivalent tool interfaces, including authentication and per\-tenant access control. * Ability to make agents effective across multiple languages and technology stacks, not only one. * Hands\-on experience deploying and operating AI workloads in cloud environments (Azure preferred). * Solid grasp of LLMs, generative AI, agentic patterns and context engineering. * Proven RAG experience, and judgment on when retrieval beats curated context. * Experience with AI evaluation and observability, including quality measurement, cost and token management. * Working knowledge of handling regulated data such as PHI in AI systems. * Demonstrated record of mentoring engineers and raising technical capability across teams. * Evidence of your own work: a repository, code sample or demo of agent or MCP work that you personally built. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience integrating AI into C\# and .NET applications. * Experience using AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code on large codebases. * Familiarity with vector databases and retrieval tooling (for example pgvector, Pinecone, Azure AI Search). * Exposure to LLMOps and evaluation tooling (for example Azure AI Foundry, MLflow, LangSmith, CI/CD). * Familiarity with agent\-to\-agent communication standards such as A2A, and judgment on when a multi\-agent design is warranted over a single agent with tools. * Experience with large legacy codebases and incremental modernization. * Interest in healthcare, EHR or revenue cycle applications. **Additional Information** -------------------------- **Sponsorship:** This position does not provide immigration sponsorship. Applicants must have the right to work in the U.S. without immigration sponsorship. **What You Can Expect From Us** ------------------------------- **We don't just help our clients succeed; we help our employees succeed.** Competitive pay, robust benefits and professional development opportunities are a few of the many reasons Homecare Homebase is a great place to build your career. * **Meaningful work.** Make a difference in the lives of clinicians and home\-based care teams—and ultimately the patients they serve. * **Leaders who care.** Work in a culture where leaders value, support and invest in their people. * **Flexibility.** We value work\-life balance and offer career opportunities designed to support life’s changing demands. * **A company that gives back.** Each year, Homecare Homebase supports charitable initiatives that align with our mission of empowering exceptional care and helping others in need. **Sound like a good fit? We’d love to hear from you.**

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **The Opportunity** ------------------- Help modernize the data platform behind the automotive aftermarket. As **Senior Data Engineer** at **MOTOR Information Systems** , you’ll take a leading role in architecting, designing, building and evolving our AWS\-based data platform, supporting the next generation of products and AI\-driven capabilities. This is not a maintenance role. You’ll have meaningful technical ownership and influence over how data is architected, processed and delivered across our systems and product suite. You’ll tackle large\-scale, complex data challenges while driving architectural decisions, establishing engineering best practices and designing for scalability, reliability, performance and cost efficiency. As a senior member of the team, you’ll collaborate across engineering and product, provide technical guidance and mentorship, and help shape our platform toward a more modern, scalable and intelligent data architecture. **Hybrid:** This hybrid role is based in our **Troy, Michigan** office and requires working in the office **3 days per week.** *No visa sponsorship is available at this time.* **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Analyze large and complex data sets. * Design, develop and coordinate the generation of data pipelines. * Work collaboratively with the team to plan and solve complex problems. * Design for, or optimize existing pipelines for, performance and cost. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * Expert Python and SQL developer. * Strong AWS experience (Lambda, Glue, State Machines, Fargate, CloudFormation, Redshift). * Strong experience with semi\-structured data (XML, CSV, JSON, Parquet). * Strong automation experience. * Experience with Databricks (Delta Lake, Notebooks, SQL Analytics). * Experience with Kubernetes (cluster orchestration, container networking, pod management). * Experience with DevOps, CI/CD and deployment orchestration (Octopus Deploy). * Experience with agentic AI (LangGraph, MCP servers, agent frameworks). * Experience with data handling (Pandas/NumPy, Apache Spark, Ray). ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with LLMs, machine learning and deep learning libraries, AI application frameworks and vector databases. * Experience with automotive data or the automotive industry. * Experience with Agile/Scrum. **Benefits** ------------ As part of Hearst, MOTOR employees have access to modern, flexible benefits designed to support you and your family. Benefits include: * Medical, dental and vision coverage * 401(k) matching * Emotional wellness support * Paid time off * Paid parental leave * LGBTQ\+ health services * Additional benefits to meet you and your family’s needs

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ Hearst Corporate GenAI, within the Office of the CTO, helps our diversified businesses develop AI fluency and transform how work gets done. We test frontier capabilities, build useful systems, develop reusable methods, and help business teams adopt them. Our remit spans workflow transformation, product development, AI software factory practices, and AI\-assisted cybersecurity. **About the role** ------------------ As Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will build AI systems and engineering approaches that advance transformation across Hearst businesses. You will combine product judgment, strong engineering, and frontier experimentation to move from an ambiguous problem to reliable use. As a senior individual contributor, you will make architectural decisions, mentor others, and create capabilities that extend beyond one engagement. Your work spans agent systems, multimodal applications, automation, and AI software factory practices across OpenAI, Anthropic's Claude, and other relevant systems. You will evaluate emerging capabilities, establish reusable engineering approaches, and partner with security teams on AI\-assisted defense. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Discover real workflow needs with business teams, challenge existing assumptions, and prototype solutions that test both business value and the potential for reuse. * Create, use, test, and maintain reusable agent skills: modular instruction sets for key workflows, packaged with reference material and supporting code. Define when each skill applies, its dependencies, and permissions. Version and evaluate skills, adapt them across systems where useful, and help colleagues apply them reliably. * Build, review, and test software using AI coding systems. Compare models and tools on task quality, cost, latency, and operating needs. Verify delegated work and generated code, and remain accountable for system behavior. * Design agent workflows using APIs, tool calls, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). Engineer context, retrieval, memory, and state. Use orchestration and multi\-agent approaches when evaluations show a benefit. * Build representative evaluations and regression tests for task outcomes, tool actions, and failure cases. Inspect traces, validate changes, and monitor quality and cost after release. * Implement least\-privilege access, isolated execution, secrets management, audit logs, and human approval for consequential actions. Test prompt injection and data leakage risks at model, tool, and workflow boundaries. * Ship maintainable systems with testing, monitoring, recovery, and rollback. Publish reusable components and coach corporate and business engineers to adopt and support them. * Partner with security teams on authorized vulnerability discovery, triage, patch validation, and defensive automation. Help strengthen systems against increasingly capable AI\-enabled attackers, including coordinated multi\-agent attacks. **How you will work** --------------------- You own technical design and quality for corporate systems and shared components. Product Owners guide priorities; Project Managers coordinate delivery; Product Ops supports measurement. Partner with local technology owners on integration and support, and make your methods usable by others across the portfolio. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * Typically 5\+ years building software or technical products, or equivalent depth, including independent architectural decisions and responsibility for production systems. * Strong engineering fundamentals across APIs, data stores, authentication, cloud environments, testing, and production debugging. Ability to inspect and correct generated code. * Hands\-on experience shipping generative AI workflows or agent systems, including creating and using modular agent skills. Ability to work across AI development tools and verify results as part of everyday engineering. * Practical judgment about evaluations, reliability, context and data quality, tool permissions, and human oversight. With over 100 years of experience and colleagues in over 30 countries, Fitch Group's culture of credibility, independence, and transparency is embedded throughout its structure, which includes Fitch Ratings, one of the world's top three credit ratings agencies, and Fitch Solutions, a leading provider of insights, data and analytics. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst. Fitch's Technology \& Data Team is a dynamic department where innovation meets impact. Our team includes the Chief Data Office, Chief Software Office, Chief Technology Office, Emerging Technology, Shared Technology Services, Technology, Risk and the Executive Program Management Office (EPMO). Driven by our investment in cutting\-edge technologies like AI and cloud solutions, we're home to a diverse range of roles and backgrounds united by a shared passion for leveraging modern technology to drive projects that matter to our organization and clients. We are also proud to be recognized by Built In as a "Best Place to Work in Technology" 3 years in a row. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, we offer an exciting and supportive environment where you can grow, innovate, and make a difference. Want to learn more about a career in technology and data at Fitch? Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/content/Technology\-and\-Data/ **How You'll Make an Impact:*** Contribute as a member of a high\-performing data engineering team, by implementing modern scalable data solutions aligned with business priorities. * Partner with the CDO team and data product leaders to implement the vision for an AWS\-based data platform that enables enterprise\-wide self\-service, unlocking data for AI, analytics, and innovation. * Implement architectural decisions and establish best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and distribution frameworks that accelerate time\-to\-insight for data producers and consumers. * Champion adoption of emerging technologies such as Agentic AI and Generative AI, integrating advanced capabilities into data workflows to enhance user experience and position the organization as "AI\-Ready." * Ensure operational excellence and reliability by proactively addressing complex data engineering challenges, implementing robust quality controls, and preventing production incidents. **You May be a Good Fit if:*** Hands\-on Solution Archtiect with 8\+ years of experience in Data Management, expertise in designing, building, and governing enterprise\-scale data management solutions that enable high\-quality, trusted, and accessible data across the organization. This role combines strategic architecture leadership with hands\-on technical implementation across Master Data Management (MDM e.g. Informatica), Data Governance, Data Integration, Data Quality, APIs, Cloud Data Platforms, and Analytics ecosystems. * Proven AWS expertise (S3, EKS, Lambda, Glue, EMR, Redshift, S3, RDS/Aurora, Valkey/Redis, Step Functions, MSK/Kafka, Event Bridge), AWS Certification strongly preferred * Experience applying AI/ML to boost engineering productivity (GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q). * In\-depth experience in Python for data engineering (Pandas, Spark/PySpark) and API Development (FastAPI or similar). * Lead the design and development of mission\-critical backend services leveraging Java, Micoservice architecture, Spring Boot, REST APIs, GraphQL, and cloud\-native architectures, while promoting coding standards, performance optimization, and best practices. * Experience in optimized query patterns, pagination, caching, and schema design to ensure low\-latency, performant reads at scale. * Experince in in\-memory database e.g. Valkey, Elastic Search, Redis, OpenSearch * Expericen is CI/CD,GitHub, Git/GitHub workflows, ArgoCD. * Ability to solve complex data\-driven requirements and triage towards defects and production bugs **What Would Make You Stand Out:*** Hands\-on experience building AI agents (e.g., using LangChain or LlamaIndex), implementing RAG over enterprise data, and enforcing robust guardrails through rigorous testing and evaluation. * Applying AI/ML to boost engineering productivity (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q) and using agentic AI to automate workflows such as code reviews, test generation, data quality checks, and runbook execution. * Experience working with AI connection protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A) that ensure secure, interoperable, observable, and vendor\-agnostic communication with authenticated, auditable messaging and robust error handling * Caching with Valkey/Redis: TTL strategies, invalidation, key design. * Experience with forming strong partnerships with stakeholders and product teams * Great interpersonal and collaboration skills * Ability to translate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. **Why Choose Fitch:*** **Work\-Life Balance First:** 40% in\-office monthly stay connected while keeping flexibility. * **A Culture of Learning \& Mobility:** Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity * **Investing in Your Future:** Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long\-term goals * **Promoting Health \& Wellbeing:** Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing * **Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family\-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively * **Inclusive Work Environment** : A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe * **Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward\-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch's credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work. Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law. **FOR NEW YORK ROLES ONLY:** Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $135,000 and $145,000per year. Actual salaries will be determined on an individualized basis and may vary based on factors including but not limited to education, training, experience, past performance, and other job\-related factors. Base pay is one part of Fitch's total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, discretionary bonuses, long\-term incentives, and other benefits sponsored by Fitch. **Nearest Major Market:** Manhattan **Nearest Secondary Market:** New York City

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Fitch Group is currently seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack based out of our NYC office.** Fitch Group Technology has a number of agile teams that deliver world\-class innovative solutions to Fitch Group internal and external customers. This position will be within one of our agile teams delivering software products for our BMI business. **What We Offer:** In this position, you will have the opportunity to be a part of an exceptionally talented, bright and driven team, and apply your skills in novel ways. And you will have fun doing it! Our technology stack is modern \- cloud based, containerized, serverless and microservices oriented. You will play a key role in implementing tools and processes that aim to improve the quality of our end\-to\-end code while creating a more efficient and sustainable workflow for our customers. You will work in a hybrid (in\-office / Work from Home) arrangement, in a collaborative and supportive work environment where your ideas and contributions are valued with a focus on achievable improvements that get used every day. **We'll Count on You To:*** Design, develop and deploy cloud native container based financial applications * Developing new user experiences using React JS * Design, develop REST based API Services using NodeJS/Python * Define and document best practices and strategies regarding application deployment and infrastructure maintenance * Optimize components to work seamlessly across different browsers and devices **What You Need to Have:*** 7\+ years of experience designing and developing distributed application architecture of moderate\-to\-high complexity. * 5\+ years in Nest JS, React JS, Open Search experience, c\#, Docker * In\-depth knowledge of Typescript, SCSS, HTML, and front\-end languages. * Knowledge of REACT tools including React.js, React Hooks, Redux/MobX/Recoil or other state management frameworks * Experience with relational databases, particularly PostgresSql and MSSQL * Experience in working with scrum, keeping track of your sprint item in JIRA and completing everything on time. * Knowledge of performance testing frameworks including Mocha and Jest * Ability to troubleshoot distributed systems. * Ability to lead offshore team * Experience working with multicultural global technology teams in the financial industry * Exceptionally self\-motivated, self\-directed, and detail\-oriented * Excellent communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills * Experience with AWS Dynamo DB, AWS Neptune, lambda, S3, document DB * Familiarity with modern data architecture and engineering technologies * Excellent communication skills with ability to articulate ideas clearly and concisely. **Why Fitch?** At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone. Every team member is essential to our business and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority. We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey. In an uncertain macroeconomic environment, BMI's systematic, independent and data\-driven market insights, analysis and forecasts enable customers to recognize and assess risks and opportunities across markets and industries. For almost 40 years, we have provided impartial views to support our customers' strategic plans and investment decisions. Learn more: fitchsolutions.com/bmi Fitch Group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Wholly owned by the Hearst Corporation, we are comprised of three main businesses: Fitch Ratings \| Fitch Solutions \| Fitch Learning. For more information please visit our websites: www.fitchratings.com \| www.fitchsolutions.com \| www.fitchlearning.com Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward\-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch's credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interests or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work. Fitch Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law. **FOR NEW YORK ROLES ONLY:** Ex  websites: www.fitchratings.com \| www.fitchsolutions.com \| www.fitchlearning.com Fitch Ratings is a leading provider of credit ratings, commentary and research. Dedicated to providing value beyond the rating through independent and prospective credit opinions, Fitch ratings offers global perspectives shaped by strong local market experience and credit market expertise. The additional context, perspective and insights we provide have helped fund a century of growth and enables our clients to make important credit judgements with confidence. Fitch Solutions provides data, research and analytics to support informed decisions. We help clients excel at managing their credit risk, offer deep insight into the debt investment market, and provide comprehensive intelligence about the macroeconomic environment. Fitch Learning is a leader in financial services training. With unrivaled breadth and depth of training, the company delivers learning solutions for apprentices and graduates, to those with 10\+ years' experience in Financial Services. Our learning solutions encompass expert faculty, e\-learning, coaching and blended candidate assessments, improving individual contribution and collective business performance. CreditSights, Covenant Review and LevFin Insights are becoming one, bringing together best in class research, covenant analysis and news on a new platform, with a unified interface and login. Now more than ever before, we give our clients the ability to KNOW MORE, RISK BETTER. CreditSights was founded over 20 years ago with the goal of producing insightful, impartial research that would allow our clients to make prudent, profitable investment decisions in the global credit markets. CreditSights is a Fitch Solutions Company. Our global institutional client base includes banks, investment advisors, mutual funds, pension managers, insurance companies, hedge funds, private equity investors and corporations. The independent research we provide is a leading voice in global credit markets, with our experts contributing to market news in Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, Forbes, Financial Times, Business Insider, Barron's and many more. In an uncertain macroeconomic environment, BMI's systematic, independent and data\-driven market insights, analysis and forecasts enable customers to recognize and assess risks and opportunities across markets and industries. For almost 40 years, we have provided impartial views to support our customers' strategic plans and investment decisions. Learn more: fitchsolutions.com/bmi GeoQuant uses advances in political and computer science to create high\-frequency, systematic country risk data and analytics that are transparent and can be validated. Our geopolitical forecasts are highly accurate because they are built on robust models. When they're wrong, you'll know that, too. We let the data speak. Fitch (China) Bohua Credit Ratings Ltd. Is licensed by the People's Bank of China (PBOC) and the National Association of Financial Market Institutional Investors (NAFMII) to provide ratings services for China's onshore bond market. The rating agency offers independent analysis, transparent methodologies and a rigorous ratings process in line with international best practice. Fitch Bohua provides forward\-looking ratings, in\-depth research, valuable data tools and insightful commentary. It is committed to supporting the development and internationalisation of China's capital markets. Fitch Bohua is wholly owned by Fitch Ratings. Powered by the human insight that has differentiated Fitch for over 100 years, Sustainable Fitch combines experience and heritage with the best ESG information available in the market today. Our suite of solutions provide a much\-anticipated, single source for the ESG focused financial community with tools, data, research and insights under one holistic, modular, user\-friendly ESG investing umbrella. **Nearest Major Market:** Manhattan **Nearest Secondary Market:** New York City

It informs investment strategies, strengthens risk management capabilities and helps identify strategic opportunities. Its analysts, lawyers, journalists and economists offer in\-depth views on credit markets/risk and individual credits, ESG, developed and emerging markets, and industry sectors. Fitch Solutions is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in over 30 countries. Fitch Group is owned by Hearst. By becoming a part of the Fitch Solutions team, you will join a group of colleagues driving high\-impact AI initiatives and identifying cross\-product synergies across our external product portfolio. We advance innovation by uncovering strategic opportunities and delivering scalable, enterprise\-grade solutions. You'll work in a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and collaboration is key to developing solutions that address the evolving needs of global markets. tackle frontier AI challenges witnessing your innovations reshape products in real\-time. * **Leverage cutting\-edge AI innovation** \- Experiment with cutting\-edge LLMs and foundation models, architect RAG implementations, design sophisticated agentic systems, and develop Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for Fitch Solutions; stay at the bleeding edge of AI technology with access to the latest tools, frameworks, and platforms. * **Lead enterprise\-wide AI standardization initiatives** \- Build GenAI solutions across multiple business units while creating unified patterns, reusable components, and standardization frameworks that enable AI at enterprise scale across Fitch Solutions. * **Address complex, cross\-functional challenges** \- Work at the intersection of engineering and product development, building systems that leverage GenAI agentic workflows and production\-scale deployment; jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Owner
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ Hearst Corporate GenAI, within the Office of the CTO, helps our diversified businesses develop AI fluency and transform how work gets done. We test frontier capabilities, build useful systems, develop reusable methods, and help business teams adopt them. Our remit spans workflow transformation, product development, AI software factory practices, and AI\-assisted cybersecurity. **About the role** ------------------ As Senior Technical Product Owner, you will identify valuable AI opportunities, decide what to build, and personally implement solutions. You will combine product ownership with hands\-on building to take AI\-enabled products and workflows from discovery into use. This senior individual contributor role requires independent product judgment, technical problem solving, and accountability for adoption and results. You will work across OpenAI, Anthropic's Claude, and other relevant AI systems on workflow transformation, AI fluency, product development, and software factory capabilities. Your implementation work will inform product decisions and produce approaches businesses can reuse, including defensive AI work with security partners. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Discover problems with business teams, challenge inherited workflows, and set priorities based on business value, technical feasibility, and opportunities for reuse. * Create, use, test, and maintain reusable agent skills: modular instruction sets for product work and key business workflows, with reference material and scripts as needed. Define when each skill applies and its acceptance criteria, gather user feedback, and adapt skills across systems where useful. * Build and maintain AI\-enabled applications, automations, and integrations using suitable models, APIs, platforms, and AI coding tools. Connect tools and data, inspect generated code, debug failures, and verify complete workflows. * Own smaller solutions through release and improvement using team engineering standards. Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers on complex integrations, shared infrastructure, and architectural decisions. * Turn implementation findings into roadmap decisions. Identify missing data, tool actions, or product capabilities; decide what to configure, build, reuse, or stop, with clear acceptance criteria. * Evaluate capabilities from OpenAI, Anthropic, and emerging providers against real tasks. Test quality and failure cases, and account for cost, permissions, data handling, and human review. * Own adoption and outcomes with business sponsors. Use feedback and Product Ops analysis to improve what you ship, and agree ongoing support and ownership. **How you will work** --------------------- You own product priorities, acceptance, and the quality of what you implement. Hands\-on building is a continuing part of the role. Forward Deployed Engineers provide deeper engineering and shared standards; the Technical AI Project Manager also implements workflow improvements while coordinating delivery. Product Ops supports measurement; business and security owners retain their operating and risk decisions. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * Typically 5\+ years in technical product ownership, software delivery, solutions engineering, or equivalent depth, including independent product decisions and work with senior stakeholders. * Demonstrated hands\-on delivery of AI\-enabled workflows or applications, including creating, adapting, and using modular agent skills. Be able to show what you built, how you tested it, and how it improved after feedback. * Ability to use AI coding tools to implement and debug working solutions. Practical understanding of APIs, authentication, structured data, and code review; ability to explain and verify generated code. * Product judgment across discovery, prioritization, acceptance, and adoption, including when a platform configuration is sufficient and when deeper engineering is needed. * Evidence of resolving ambiguous problems, making consequential tradeoffs, influencing business and technical leaders, and helping colleagues develop their capabilities. **How you will grow** --------------------- Bring strong professional judgment and a willingness to rethink established methods. We look for people who question inherited workflows, test what AI can now do, change course when evidence warrants it, and teach others. You will deepen this practice through real delivery, experimentation, and feedback. We assess learning behavior and demonstrated work; we do not expect a finished transformation playbook on day one. **Useful additional experience** -------------------------------- Experience with computer\-use agents that operate browser or desktop interfaces, or always\-on agents that retain context and perform scheduled or event\-driven work, is desired but not required. Relevant engineering experience includes reliable tool execution, monitoring, and recovery from failures. Experience with Python or TypeScript, agent SDKs or managed runtimes, MCP integrations, multimodal systems, and AI\-assisted security is useful. We value demonstrated problem solving and the ability to learn as the field changes; no single framework or model version defines this role. **What success looks like** --------------------------- Agree initial milestones with your manager and partners based on the work and its readiness. **Timeframe** **Expected progress** First 30 days Identify a valuable workflow and build a working prototype using suitable AI systems, tools, or data, with clear evaluation criteria. By 60 days Take a small solution into user testing or controlled use; resolve implementation issues and use the evidence to refine priorities. By 90 days Show an adopted improvement with clear support ownership. Publish a tested agent skill that another business can use or adapt. Hearst provides a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, 401(k), paid holidays and paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more. **Compensation** The base salary range below is the Company's good\-faith estimate for this position in the posted work location at the time of posting. Final starting salary will be based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, training, certifications, education, location and market considerations. Base Salary Range: $180,000 — $210,000 USD

jobs.description: **The Opportunity** ------------------- MHK is hiring for a technically savvy Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) who will help ensure the reliability, availability, scalability, and performance of our healthcare technology platforms. This role is expected to change and improve our reliability, availability, scalability, and performance – not just maintain existing systems and processes. Additionally, you'll focus on keeping production systems healthy and resilient, monitor and improve system reliability, establish and maintain service\-level objectives, respond to and lead production incidents, identify systemic causes of failures, and build automation that eliminates repetitive operational work. The ideal candidate will improve the reliability, availability, scalability, and performance of our systems while solving complex production challenges through expertise in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, automation, observability, and data\-driven analysis. **Hybrid:** This hybrid role is based in **Tampa, FL** and requires working in the office **3** **days per week** . **Position Responsibilities** ----------------------------- * Reliability \& Production Engineering: Own and improve the reliability, availability, scalability, and performance of MHK production applications and infrastructure; establish and continuously improve SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, and reliability metrics. * Observability \& Monitoring: Design, implement, and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and observability solutions; improve visibility into application and infrastructure health. * Incident Response \& Problem Management: Lead and participate in production incident response; diagnose complex issues; coordinate recovery; conduct root\-cause analysis and drive corrective actions through completion. * Automation \& Toil Reduction: Identify repetitive and error\-prone operational work and develop automation using Python, Bash, or similar tools to reduce manual intervention and operational toil. * Capacity, Performance \& Scalability: Analyze system performance, capacity, latency, error rates, resource utilization, and scaling requirements; identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and reliability risks. * Reliability \& Resilience Engineering: Identify single points of failure, evaluate system dependencies and failure modes, and develop strategies to improve high availability, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and system resilience. * Cloud \& Infrastructure Reliability: Support and improve the reliability of AWS production environments, including networking, storage, IAM, DNS, load balancing, databases, and related cloud services. * Release \& Change Reliability: Partner with Engineering and QA to establish production\-readiness standards, deployment safeguards, health checks, rollback strategies, and operational validation for production changes. * Documentation \& Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, service documentation, escalation procedures, and incident response processes. * Cross\-Functional Reliability Partnership: Partner with Software Engineering, QA, Infrastructure, Security, Product, and other technical teams to identify reliability risks and implement sustainable solutions. **Position Requirements** ------------------------- * Five (5\) or more years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, Systems Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. * Strong understanding of SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, reliability metrics, service ownership, resilience engineering, and disaster recovery. * Demonstrated experience supporting production applications and infrastructure in high\-availability environments. * Hands\-on experience supporting, troubleshooting, and improving AWS cloud environments, including compute, networking, storage, IAM, DNS, load balancing, databases, and related services. * Experience leading production incident response, troubleshooting issues across applications, infrastructure, databases, networking, and cloud services, and completing root\-cause analyses, post\-incident reviews, and corrective actions. * Strong knowledge of observability practices, including monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, application performance monitoring, distributed tracing, and service health analysis. * Strong Linux systems administration, networking, performance optimization, capacity planning, and reliability troubleshooting skills, including TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, firewalls, and VPC networking. * Ability to develop automation using Python, Bash, or similar tools; reduce operational toil; communicate complex technical issues clearly; and collaborate effectively with Engineering, QA, Infrastructure, Security, Product, and technical leadership. ### **Education/Certification Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * Relevant professional experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, Systems Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or a closely related discipline including supporting high volume java applications. * Professional certifications related to AWS, cloud engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or related technical disciplines preferred. **Additional Information** -------------------------- **Pre\-Employment Requirements:** All prospective employees must pass a background check and drug screening. **Benefits** ------------ At MHK, we support employees with meaningful work, opportunities to grow and benefits designed to promote health, financial security and overall wellbeing. Highlights include: * **Health coverage:** Medical, dental and vision plans for full\-time employees. * **Retirement:** 401(k) with a generous company match. * **Time off:** Generous paid time off and holiday policy. * **Benefits eligibility:** Benefits begin on the first day of the month following employment. * **Health and wellness:** Exercise and health club reimbursement opportunities. * **Dependent care:** Monthly dependent care reimbursement opportunities. * **Income protection:** Short\- and long\-term disability coverage. * **Life insurance:** Basic term life and AD\&D insurance.

jobs.title: Data Architect / Principal Data Engineer III
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced **Data Architect / Principal Data Engineer III** to design, develop, and support modern, scalable data solutions for enterprise applications. **Location:** Farmington Hills, MI **Work Arrangement:** Onsite – 4 days per week **Experience:** 8\+ Years **Employment Type:** Full\-Time (W2\) **Industry:** Financial Services – Wealth \& Asset Management **Position Overview** The Data Architect / Principal Data Engineer III will play a key role in designing, developing, and supporting secure, scalable, and high\-performance data platforms and integration solutions within an AWS environment. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on expertise in Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, Amazon RDS, DynamoDB, Amazon S3, and ETL/ELT engineering, along with the architectural capabilities required to deliver enterprise\-grade data solutions. This role involves working with structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data, developing reusable ingestion and transformation frameworks, implementing data governance controls, and enabling vector\-based information retrieval using PostgreSQL and pgvector. **Key Responsibilities** * **Data Architecture \& Engineering** * Design and implement scalable, secure, and reliable data architectures. * Develop and maintain high\-performance data ingestion, transformation, and ETL/ELT workflows. * Build reusable Python and SQL components for enterprise data processing and integration. * Design solutions supporting structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data. * Evaluate architectural approaches and recommend appropriate data technologies. **2\. AWS Data Platform Development** * Design, develop, and support solutions using Amazon RDS, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and Amazon S3\. * Develop and optimize relational and NoSQL data models. * Build integrations with internal and external applications through REST APIs. * Implement efficient JSON and Parquet processing workflows. * Optimize database queries, storage strategies, and data pipelines. **3\. AI\-Enabled Data Solutions** * Support data ingestion, transformation, and preparation for AI\-enabled applications. * Implement document\-processing workflows involving structured and unstructured information. * Support document ingestion and text extraction using Amazon Textract. * Develop PostgreSQL/pgvector integrations for embedding storage, similarity search, and vector retrieval. * Collaborate with AI and application engineering teams to support intelligent search and retrieval applications. **4\. Data Quality, Security \& Governance** * Implement data quality controls, validation, completeness checks, duplicate detection, and reconciliation. * Establish data lineage, metadata management, retention, and governance practices. * Protect sensitive financial and customer information. * Implement secure data access, encryption, and access\-control mechanisms. * Support enterprise auditability, traceability, and data integrity requirements. **5\. Production Engineering \& Operational Excellence** * Monitor data pipelines, databases, and integration processes. * Diagnose and resolve complex production and database performance issues. * Improve processing efficiency, scalability, and operational resilience. * Establish logging, monitoring, error handling, and recovery mechanisms. * Participate in engineering standards, design reviews, and documentation. **6\. Collaboration \& Technical Leadership** * Collaborate with application developers, AI engineers, DevOps teams, enterprise architects, cybersecurity professionals, and business stakeholders. * Translate business and technical requirements into scalable data solutions. * Provide technical guidance on data architecture and engineering practices. * Participate in architectural reviews and technology selection. * Communicate technical decisions and trade\-offs effectively. **Preferred Qualifications** **The following experience will be an advantage:** * Financial services, banking, Wealth Management, or Asset Management experience. * Amazon Textract and document extraction workflows. * Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and AI\-powered enterprise search. * AWS IAM, KMS, CloudWatch, and secure cloud infrastructure. * Data pipeline orchestration, event\-driven architectures, and workflow automation. * CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for AWS data platforms. * High\-volume financial transaction processing or regulatory data management. * Experience mentoring engineers or leading enterprise data engineering initiatives. **What Success Looks Like** **The successful candidate will be able to:** * Independently design and deliver production\-ready AWS data engineering solutions. * Demonstrate advanced hands\-on expertise in Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS database services. * Develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines with strong data\-quality and recovery capabilities. * Make sound architectural decisions involving relational databases, NoSQL, object storage, and vector retrieval. * Support AI\-enabled data processing while maintaining enterprise security and governance. * Take ownership of complex technical challenges from architecture through implementation and production support. * Collaborate effectively with business and technology stakeholders. **Work Location \& Requirements** * **Location:** Farmington Hills, Michigan. * **Work Arrangement:** Onsite 4 days per week. * Local candidates are strongly preferred. * Candidates outside the area must be willing and able to meet the onsite requirement. **Required Skills \& Qualifications** * 8\+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Data Integration, or related disciplines. * Strong hands\-on proficiency in Python for production\-grade data processing, automation, and transformation. * Advanced SQL development skills, including complex queries, joins, window functions, query optimization, and performance tuning. * Extensive experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, database optimization, and production support. * Hands\-on experience with Amazon RDS and AWS\-managed relational databases. * Experience with Amazon DynamoDB, including NoSQL data modeling, partition/sort key design, indexing, and query optimization. * Experience building cloud\-based data ingestion, storage, and processing solutions using Amazon S3\. * Strong ETL/ELT engineering experience, including designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines. * Solid understanding of relational and NoSQL data modeling, normalization, and data architecture principles. * Experience integrating REST APIs and processing JSON and Parquet data. * Experience with PostgreSQL pgvector, vector embeddings, similarity search, and vector\-based retrieval. * Strong understanding of data validation, reconciliation, metadata, lineage, governance, and data quality. * Experience designing secure data\-processing solutions involving sensitive or regulated information. * Knowledge of encryption, access controls, database security, and operational monitoring. * Experience supporting document\-processing and AI\-enabled data applications. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Decision Intelligence
jobs.description: **Become a part of our caring community** ========================================= As a Senior MLOps Engineer on the Next Best Action (NBA) team, you will build, deploy, and operate the machine learning infrastructure and decisioning workflows that power our NBA platform. The NBA platform uses reinforcement learning to deliver personalized recommendations that improve healthcare experiences and outcomes for millions of members. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on production ML systems. You will build scalable pipelines and deployment workflows that move models and decision policies from development through testing, simulation, production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines strong MLOps and software engineering experience with an understanding of how production decisioning systems work. You should be comfortable working with model\-training pipelines, feature engineering, batch and online inference, model registries, automated testing, observability, and production reliability.**Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **MLOps and Model Lifecycle** * Design and maintain end\-to\-end ML workflows covering model training, validation, deployment, batch and online scoring, monitoring, and retraining. * Develop MLflow\-based workflows for experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry management, and production promotion. * Implement CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, deployment, rollback, and release management. * Build automated validation and quality gates to ensure models, features, and scoring workflows are production ready. ### **ML Platform and Pipeline Engineering** * Develop scalable ML and feature\-engineering pipelines using Python, Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, and related technologies. * Build reliable batch and online inference workflows supporting NBA decisioning use cases. * Improve the performance, scalability, reliability, and resource efficiency of ML pipelines and scoring services. * Support data quality, lineage, feature consistency, and reproducibility through Databricks Unity Catalog or equivalent technologies. ### **Decisioning System Integration** * Integrate models and reinforcement learning policies with decision engines, business rules, and downstream systems. * Build reliable interfaces and data contracts between feature pipelines, scoring services, Redis, event streams, and decisioning components. policies, and decisioning strategies. ### **Monitoring and Production Reliability** * Implement monitoring and observability for data quality, features, model inference, scoring, and decision\-system performance. * Detect and investigate data drift, model degradation, pipeline failures, latency issues, and scoring inconsistencies. * Build feedback loops using event\-driven systems such as Kafka to capture member interactions and outcomes for future training and evaluation. * Support troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement of production ML systems. **Use your skills to make an impact** ===================================== **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, feature\-engineering, batch\-scoring, or online\-inference workflows. * Experience implementing monitoring, data\-quality validation, or observability for production ML systems. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, automated testing, version control, troubleshooting, and production reliability. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Decision Processes, policy evaluation, or simulation\-based testing. * Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Ray RLlib, or related ML frameworks. * Experience with Kafka, Redis, event\-driven architectures, APIs, or rules\-based decision engines. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud\-native deployment technologies. * Familiarity with OpenTelemetry or equivalent observability platforms. * Experience with model\-performance monitoring, drift detection, and automated model validation. * Experience operating production ML systems in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or other regulated industries. jobs.title: Principal Firmware Engineer - AI System/OpenBMC
jobs.description: **Hyve Company Overview** ------------------------- Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US\-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through dep technical partnerships and co\-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve’s integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time\-to\-market with single\-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co\-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure. Platform management firmware is essential to the reliability, serviceability, and manageability of hyperscale AI servers. This Principal\-level role owns BMC firmware architecture and development—built on OpenBMC—for Hyve's next\-generation AI and compute server platforms, spanning manageability, telemetry, power/thermal control, security, and manufacturing enablement in close partnership with hardware and Hyperscaler customers. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- * **BMC firmware architecture.** Define and own the OpenBMC\-based firmware architecture for AI/GPU server platforms, including manageability stack, Redfish interfaces, IPMI, and platform telemetry. * **Platform control and monitoring.** Develop and integrate power, thermal, fan\-control, and sensor monitoring firmware in close collaboration with power delivery and thermal teams. * **Security and reliability.** Implement secure boot, firmware update/recovery, RoT integration, and robust error handling to meet hyperscaler security and reliability requirements. * **Bring\-up and debug.** Lead firmware bring\-up across EVT/DVT/PVT, debug at board and system level, and drive root\-cause analysis and permanent fixes across firmware, hardware, and system\-integration domains. * **Manufacturing and deployment enablement.** Deliver firmware tooling and features for factory provisioning, diagnostics, and fleet deployment, and support field issue resolution at scale. * **Technical leadership.** Set firmware development methodology, review code, and mentor engineers; represent firmware architecture to customers and internal executives. **Required Qualifications \& Skills** ------------------------------------- * **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * **Experience:** 10\+ years of embedded/firmware development experience, including significant BMC/platform management firmware work and hands\-on OpenBMC development. Proven delivery of server\-class firmware into production; hyperscale experience preferred. * **Technical expertise:** Strong C/C\+\+ and embedded Linux skills; deep knowledge of OpenBMC, Redfish, IPMI, I2C/I3C, PMBus, SPI, and platform management interfaces; experience with secure boot, firmware update, and RoT. * **Systems knowledge:** Solid understanding of server hardware, power/thermal control loops, and the interaction of firmware with BIOS, hardware, and manufacturing flows. * **Communication:** Able to lead cross\-functional debug, drive architecture decisions, and communicate effectively with hardware teams, customers, and executives. Compensation: $214,000 to $290,000 **What’s in it for you** ------------------------ Benefit Insurance * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Health Savings Account (HSA) * Mental Health Care * 401K with match * Paid Holidays, Vacation \& Sick Days * Tuition Reimbursement * Perks at Work * LEAP Program * MyFlexPay ***We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The SDET II builds the automation infrastructure, frameworks, developer tools, and CI/CD pipeline integrations that Quality Engineers and development teams depend on. This is a code\-first, engineering\-heavy role – the SDET II writes production\-grade software to solve quality problems at scale, enabling teams to test faster, more reliably, and with less manual overhead. Working independently, the SDET II exerts technical influence across multiple teams by delivering reusable tooling that raises the automation capability of the entire engineering organization. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Architect, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks and shared libraries (Playwright, Selenium, REST Assured, TestNG) that serve as the jobs.description: **Job Type:** Contract **Location:** Austin, TX (Hybrid) — This role requires an initial 3\-month commitment to the Austin area, with a strong likelihood of an extended or permanent presence. **About InMarket** Since 2010, InMarket has been the leader in 360\-degree consumer intelligence and real\-time activation for thousands of today's top brands. Through InMarket's data\-driven marketing platform, brands can build targeted audiences, activate media in real time, and measure success in driving return on ad spend. InMarket's proprietary Moments offering outperforms traditional mobile advertising by 6x.\* Our LCI attribution platform, which won the MarTech Breakthrough Award for Best Advertising Measurement Platform, was validated by Forrester to drive an average of $40 ROAS for our clients. * + Source: Wordstream US Google Display Benchmarks for Mobile Media **About the role** As a Product Builder at InMarket, you will design and build internal AI\-powered software that simplifies, automates, and scales workflows across the entire organization. You'll work close to the business, embedding with teams across operations, data, product, and engineering to turn messy, manual processes into clean, reliable systems. This is a high\-velocity, hands\-on role for a pragmatic builder with direct exposure to founder\-level leadership who sets priorities and grades impact. You'll start by securing quick wins on well\-scoped internal problems, then progress toward larger\-scale, higher\-impact initiatives leading AI deployment for a key area of the business. At InMarket, AI is the default way of working, and we care less about where you come from than about what you've built with it. Strong candidates come from a software engineering background or from a business domain (finance, marketing, operations), where they've rebuilt a real workflow around AI. This role is a great fit if you're looking at AI transformation and figuring out how it actually drives business value, playing with the latest tools, building things for fun, and are hungry to show what you can do at the highest levels of a fast\-growing company. **Core Areas of Responsibility** * ***Full\-Lifecycle Engineering*** + Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of internal tools, from initial discovery, design, and rapid prototyping through launch, iteration, and transition to steady\-state ownership. + Design and build scalable, AI\-enabled systems and services that automate repetitive tasks and optimize complex workflows. + Modernize technical debt by converting ad\-hoc scripts and notebook\-driven processes into robust, maintainable, well\-documented production software. + Harden and validate solutions to ensure they meet rigorous standards for reliability, security, and scalability. * ***Strategic Collaboration*** + Embed with internal teams to identify friction points and translate business requirements into technical designs that reduce operational risk. + Partner with Product, Data, and Engineering to ensure internal solutions align with the broader company roadmap and architectural standards. + Manage stakeholders by setting clear expectations, communicating progress, and facilitating tight feedback loops that drive continuous improvement. * ***Enablement \& Operational Excellence*** + Drive adoption through hands\-on enablement for new system rollouts. + Standardize documentation — system architectures, operational playbooks, and handoff plans — to ensure long\-term stability and ease of use. + Share incremental wins transparently with the broader team to build momentum and surface what's working. **Impact and Success Indicators** * ***Where you'll make an impact in the first 90 days:*** + Demonstrate the judgment to know when AI provides genuine leverage and when traditional, deterministic software is the right call. + Independently write, test, and ship functional solutions and prototypes with agile practices. + Turn vague, amorphous stakeholder requests into clear requirements and working MVPs, validated directly with the people who'll use them. + Identify and automate repetitive, process\-heavy workflows, surfacing risks and blockers early with a proposed resolution rather than waiting. + Identify and build relationships with key cross\-functional partners so you can unblock yourself independently. * ***Where you'll make an impact in the first year:*** + Move from quick wins to larger\-scale internal pain points and proofs of concept for client\-facing products, delivering production\-grade solutions with high technical rigor. + Convert ad hoc scripts and notebooks into maintainable, thoroughly documented software that the team can own over the long term. + Build the velocity, ownership, and product instinct to lead AI initiatives under an executive leader. **What we're looking for** * A self\-starting, entrepreneurial builder's instinct. You ship things for fun, unprompted, and outside of work, with a high level of ownership and minimal need for micromanagement. * AI is your default way of working with proven fluency with AI\-native IDEs (e.g., Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code) and LLMs to accelerate development and automate complex workflows, whether your background is engineering or a business domain you've rebuilt around AI. You move fluently between tools and have a clear sense of where to deploy AI and how to manage and verify its output. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, or a demonstrated ability to ship production\-grade software through AI\-augmented tooling. Ideally, you've built both with and without AI. * A solid understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases, data modeling, and structured data management. * A "progress over perfection" mindset, you ship fast, identify patterns, evaluate trade\-offs, and prioritize high\-impact solutions; 80% awesome and shipped beats perfect and late. * The ability to make progress on under\-specified problems; you ask the right clarifying questions, make your assumptions explicit, and ship a first version rather than stalling for a perfect brief, with strong analytical debugging skills to reason through complex system failures. * An obstacle\-navigator's approach. When you encounter a skill gap, you start searching for a solution rather than making an excuse. * Strong stakeholder management: you set clear expectations, communicate progress without prompting, and can work with a non\-technical stakeholder who can't yet articulate what they want, translating ambiguity into structure. * The courage to speak up; you voice constructive feedback directly * Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders, and experience working in fast\-moving teams where iterative feedback and flexibility are key. * Low ego and a team\-first attitude; genuine curiosity and a desire to understand things deeply before and after building. *Preferred* * Hands\-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or similar). * Experience in Node.js and/or Python and SQL, with a track record of building internal tools, services, and robust automations. * Experience building internal platforms or operational tooling with AI. * Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **Compensation \& Benefits** The Targeted Base Salary Range for this role is $90,000 \- $100,000\. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI at scale, and where it matters most. How well our sequential models perform depends on the data they learn from, and on how fast we can turn a question about that data into an answer. We’re hiring a Director of AI Engineering to lead the engineering behind that data. That means building the pipelines and systems that bring new data sources in, turn them into model\-ready representations at scale, and let our scientists test a data hypothesis in days instead of months. . **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Make high judgment build\-vs\-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team.
