jobs.title: Sr. AI Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: The Sr. AI Software Engineer reports to the Sr. Director, AI Center of Excellence, in the Technology Department, and has no direct reports. Be a part of a growing team that is directly impacting the way our business operates. In this role you embed with business teams across Health \& Benefits, Retirement \& Wealth, operations, contact center, finance, HR, marketing, sales, and engineering. You are a consultant at the edge of our internal teams, helping to identify AI opportunities, define requirements, build prototypes, and ship governed, measurable AI agents into production. The primary duties include finding and scoping AI\-suited business problems; building and shipping production agents and automations on approved enterprise platforms; baselining processes and measuring and reporting ROI before and after deployment; applying AI governance and compliance controls to every build; and converting repeat work into reusable patterns while raising AI fluency across the business teams this role supports. You bring information back to the CoE and deliver value to our business partners. If you love finding new challenges, showing people new was to solve problems, and to build and tinker while delivering critical business value continuously, this role is a perfect fit. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Embed within business teams across Health \& Benefits, Retirement \& Wealth, operations, contact center, finance, HR, marketing, sales, and engineering to identify work that is repetitive, automatable, or bottlenecked. * Translate and communicate a business need into a written solution statement, success criteria, data requirements, and a documented recommendation on whether AI is the appropriate solution. * Build working prototypes to validate feasibility before committing to a full build. * Scope each opportunity appropriately, determining whether the right solution is a single\-purpose agent, an automated workflow, a multi\-tier agent system, or an existing approved vendor capability. * Build production agents and automations on approved enterprise platforms, including assistant and agent frameworks, low\-code workflow automation, document intelligence, conversational and agent\-assist capabilities, and natural language analytics. * Design multi\-tier agent systems where an orchestration layer routes to specialized agents with scoped tools, defined boundaries, and a clean handoff to a human. * Integrate with business systems through approved connectors and MCP servers and support the approval process for new connectors when a use case requires one. * Hand off completed builds with documentation, a runbook, a named owner, and a business user able to operate the solution independently. * Baseline process performance prior to each build, capturing cycle time, volume, error and rework rates, handle time, and cost per unit as applicable. * Instrument deployed agents so that value is measured continuously rather than asserted once at launch. * Report outcomes honestly, including builds that did not deliver value and the resulting lessons learned. * Apply an ISO/IEC 42001 governance mindset to every build, including defined purpose, risk classification, data handling, human oversight, and evidence that controls operated as intended. * Define and implement governance, security, and compliance telemetry for each agent, covering tool calls, scope adherence, escalation and override rates, data access, output quality, and cost. * Build monitoring and alerting so drift, boundary violations, and unexpected spend are surfaced to an owner. * Operate within the AI Governance Committee process and the AI Acceptable Use Policy. * Report business team needs, governance friction points, recurring patterns, and tooling gaps back to the AI Center of Excellence. * Convert repeat builds into reusable patterns, templates, and starter kits for use by other consultants and delivery teams. * Run enablement sessions and working labs to raise AI fluency within the business teams this role supports. * Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Education \& Experience:** Minimum required: * Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering or Computer Science * AI Continuous learning certifications are a plus * 3\-6 six years of software engineering experience shipping and supporting production systems. * 2 \+years of hands\-on experience building AI solutions across assistants, agents, workflow automation, retrieval, and document processing. **Skills \& Abilities:** * Demonstrated end\-to\-end ownership, taking a business idea from initial concept through requirements, prototype, and production use. * Ability to define and measure business value, including constructing a baseline, defending a measurement method, and communicating cost and benefit independently. * Working knowledge of at least one AI governance or management framework, such as ISO/IEC 42001 or NIST AI RMF, and the ability to convert it into implemented controls. * Experience instrumenting telemetry as part of the build process rather than after an incident. * Ability to work effectively within unfamiliar business functions, build credibility quickly, and influence stakeholders while building relationships. * Ability to learn and adapt to a changing AI platform and tooling landscape. * Financial services, healthcare, benefits administration, or other regulated industry experience preferred, particularly environments handling PII, PHI, or fiduciary data. * Process improvement experience preferred, such as Lean, Six Sigma, or process mining. * Fluency in low\-code automation platforms alongside code\-first development preferred. * Experience with contact center, claims, or back\-office operations technology preferred. * Experience developing internal enablement materials, documentation, or practitioner communities preferred. **Other Requirements:** * Ability to occasionally work outside normal business hours to meet project deadlines as needed. * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Req Benefits: The compensation for this position will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. The compensation package may also include incentive and bonus opportunities. Inspira provides industry\-leading benefits including, but not limited to: healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, paid time off, parental leave and an employee assistance program. Compensation: $100,200\-$140,000 per year Additional Details : **Take the next step in your journey at Inspira Financial.** Guided by our mission to enable better health and greater wealth, we help businesses and individuals thrive today, tomorrow, and into retirement by strengthening and simplifying the health and wealth journey. Serving more than 7 million clients and representing over $62 billion in assets, Inspira partners with thousands of employers, plan sponsors, recordkeepers, TPAs, and other institutional partners to help the people they support plan, save, and invest for a brighter future. Through solutions including automatic rollover services, health savings accounts, emergency savings, and custody services, Inspira is focused on delivering better outcomes for all. Learn more at inspirafinancial.com. Our values shape how we show up every day. We **Lead with Heart** by acting with compassion, empathy, and doing what's right; **Cultivate Trust** through integrity, transparency, and accountability; **Aim Higher** by never settling for what's expected and continually raising the standard; and **Win Together** by collaborating inclusively to achieve the best outcomes. Our growth and culture haven't gone unnoticed; we've been recognized on Crain's Fast 50 and Inc. 5000 for remarkable growth, and named to Built In's 2025 Best Places to Work and Gallagher's 2022 Best\-In\-Class Employer for our workplace culture and benefits. Don't meet every single requirement? That's okay. We know growth comes from people who are willing to learn and challenge themselves, not just check every box. If you're energized and inspired by meaningful work, continuous development, and being part of a team that turns collective effort into real impact, we want to hear from you. We look forward to receiving your application. *Our office locations are designed to bring people together, foster collaboration, and build meaningful connections. While some roles are aligned to a specific office location, work arrangements and role locations may change over time to support business and team needs. Relocation assistance is not provided, whether for the initial move or for future changes in work location or role.* **Remote Eligibility:** At the time of hire, candidates for remote positions must reside in one of the following states: AL, AZ, CT, DE, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, KY, MA, MI, MN, MO, NC, NE, NJ, NV, OH, OK, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA, WI, WV.

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description: We're looking for a hands\-on Customer Success Engineer who owns customer relationships, drives customer outcomes, and enjoys solving complex data problems. We're taking a different approach to Customer Success. Rather than primarily coaching customers on how to use Insycle, our team works directly in their environments to investigate problems, build solutions, and deliver results. Think of it as Customer Success with a Forward Deployed Engineer mindset. With our secure Support Access, you'll be able to configure and test solutions directly in customers' Insycle environments. Customers retain control over approving and executing changes to their CRM data. You'll own a portfolio of customers across onboarding, ongoing adoption, renewals, and expansion. You'll build relationships, understand customers' business challenges, and help them get lasting value from Insycle. This role combines hands\-on technical problem\-solving with customer relationships and business understanding. You'll have the autonomy to investigate challenges, design practical solutions, and see your work make a difference. **Location:** Remote, United States. We're looking for candidates based in the Eastern or Central time zones who can collaborate effectively with our team and customers during U.S. business hours. Requirements: * **Customer account ownership:** You have experience directly managing ongoing customer relationships or a portfolio of accounts, taking responsibility for customer outcomes, adoption, and retention—not solely responding to technical support requests. * **Technical problem\-solving:** You enjoy investigating complex problems, working with data, asking thoughtful questions, and finding practical solutions. * **CRM and data experience:** You're comfortable with HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar platforms, including data management, business rules, workflows, and automation. * **Ownership and initiative:** You work independently, take responsibility for outcomes, and follow through without needing constant direction. * **Customer communication:** You can explain technical concepts clearly, understand business needs, and build strong customer relationships. * **Judgment and attention to detail:** You think through consequences, validate your work, and favor simple, reliable solutions. * **Teamwork and growth:** You enjoy collaborating, sharing knowledge, learning from feedback, and helping the team improve. Ideally, you'll have 3\+ years of experience in technical Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, Implementation, RevOps, or a similar customer\-facing B2B SaaS role. Experience with CRM data quality, deduplication, data transformation, record matching, or integrations is a plus. Software development experience is not required. What you’ll do: #### **Solve customer data challenges** * Understand customers' business goals and translate their requirements into practical data solutions. * Investigate CRM records, fields, workflows, and existing configurations to understand problems and identify root causes. * Configure Blueprints, templates, matching rules, transformations, associations, assignments, and other Insycle capabilities on customers' behalf. * Test solutions against real customer data, review previews, investigate edge cases, and refine configurations until they produce the expected results. * Choose simple, reliable solutions that customers can understand and maintain, and follow through to ensure the original problem is resolved. #### **Drive adoption and customer outcomes** * Lead customer onboarding, configuring initial use cases and helping customers achieve results quickly. * Help customers move from one\-time cleanup to continuous data integrity using Blueprints, Data Logic, and Observability. * Proactively review customer usage, identify opportunities to improve workflows, and recommend additional use cases. * Monitor adoption, address challenges early, and help customers get sustained value from Insycle. #### **Build relationships and grow accounts** * Own customer relationships across onboarding, ongoing use, renewals, and expansion. * Become a trusted partner by understanding customers' priorities, offering practical recommendations, and following through. * Identify opportunities to expand Insycle usage across teams, CRM objects, and business processes. * Communicate business value through measurable results, including time saved, data quality improvements, and reduced operational risk. * Proactively manage customer relationships, identify adoption and retention risks, initiate outreach when intervention is needed, and help customers achieve the outcomes that support renewal and growth. #### **Improve how we work** * Share knowledge, document reusable solutions, and collaborate with teammates to solve challenging problems. * Identify recurring customer issues and contribute ideas to improve the product, onboarding, and customer experience. * Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to investigate problems, explore solutions, and improve workflows, while validating the results. * Take initiative to improve processes, learn from feedback, and help the team become more effective. Why join Insycle: You'll work on real data challenges across a wide range of customers and industries, with the tools and autonomy to investigate problems and build solutions yourself. You'll see the results of your work directly and build strong relationships with the people you help. We're a small team with an established product and ambitious plans. You'll have the opportunity to influence how we serve customers, improve our product, and help shape the next stage of Insycle's growth. How we work: Our values shape how we work together, make decisions, and develop as a team: * **Care deeply:** Understand customers' needs and take initiative to help them succeed. * **Everyone builds:** Look for opportunities to improve how we work and contribute practical solutions. * **Better together:** Share knowledge, support teammates, and work toward shared success. * **Quality counts:** Think through the details, validate your work, and deliver reliable results. * **Positive energy:** Bring kindness, constructive communication, and a willingness to tackle challenges. * **Own the outcome:** Take responsibility, follow through, and deliver results. * **Choose simplicity:** Favor practical, reliable solutions over unnecessary complexity. * **Raise the bar:** Seek feedback, keep learning, and help others improve. Compensation and benefits: * $80K \- $100K Total Compensation * 0\.05% \- 0\.1% Equity * Medical, dental, and vision insurance. * 401K with a 4% company contribution. * PTO, sick and unplanned time off, holidays. Company Overview: Insycle builds data integrity infrastructure for the agentic CRM. More than 700 customers trust our tools to resolve duplicates, standardize data, manage imports, and connect related records in platforms such as HubSpot and Salesforce. Those tools fix what’s wrong today. But clean data is a moment. Data integrity is a system. Our platform helps businesses define what right looks like in Blueprints, continuously apply those standards through Data Logic, and use Observability to understand where data conforms, where it drifts, and whether it stays aligned over time. As AI agents increasingly use CRM data to make decisions and write changes back, that foundation becomes essential. Businesses need reliable inputs and a system that detects when people, integrations, workflows, or agents move data away from their standards. We’re a B2B SaaS company with an established customer base and a much larger ambition: to make data integrity foundational to how businesses operate with AI.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer

Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end\-to\-end across every channel, with minimal set\-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system. Together with Salesforce, the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI. Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. **What's the opportunity?** --------------------------- As Fin becomes mission\-critical for our most strategic customers, we’re growing our team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help bridge the gap between customer needs and product innovation. Experience building a SaaS product is a plus, but not a requirement. * Interest in AI and machine learning, and the ability to quickly build an understanding of novel problems, capabilities and architectures \- including their trade\-offs and limitations. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate organisational boundaries and bring people together to achieve the best outcomes for our customers. * Deep knowledge of at least one high\-level programming language, such as JavaScript, Python or Ruby. You can comfortably discuss the same topics with engineers and non\-technical audiences, adapting the depth and detail as needed. * Willingness to travel and work on\-site with customers to build strong relationships and deeply understand their needs. * Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required. jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ We're hiring an AI Engineer who can build a fraud model and also build the production system that runs it. build reproducible training pipelines with scheduled retraining and recalibration. * Serving: deploy models to real\-time and batch serving with online/offline parity, latency budgets and safe fallbacks. * Decisioning: integrate scores into the rules engine with policy partners, so each decision records whether a rule, a model or a fallback made it. * Monitoring: own dashboards, drift and data\-quality alerts, decision logs, and on\-call for your model's decision path. **Do the science** * Frame fraud problems with policy: patterns, label definitions, label maturity and the cost of each action. * Build calibrated models (gradient\-boosted trees, deep and sequence models) whose probabilities a decision can price. * Design shadow\-mode, champion/challenger and holdout experiments, for model risk management, fairness review and bank\-partner validation. **Raise the engineering bar** * Write production\-quality code with tests, code review, CI/CD and versioned artifacts. * Turn what you build once into reusable patterns other AI scientists can self\-serve. **Qualifications** * MS or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Math, Operations Research or a related field, or a BS with equivalent experience. * 2\+ years of industry experience building ML models, including at least one you deployed and operated in production. * Strong Python and SQL, plus Spark or a similar distributed framework. * Supervised learning on tabular data: gradient\-boosted trees, logistic regression, evaluation and calibration. * Experience building data or feature pipelines on event streams (for example Kafka) or a workflow orchestrator (for example Airflow). * Software engineering fundamentals: Git, testing, code review, CI/CD and containers. * Clear communication with non\-technical partners such as policy and product. Kipp \& Zonen, a Veralto company, provides class\-leading instruments for measuring solar radiation and atmospheric properties in Meteorology, Climatology, Hydrology, Industry, Renewable Energy, Agriculture and Public Health. Kipp \& Zonen is the specialist in the measurement of solar and sky radiation, from the ultraviolet to the far infrared. We offer a complete range of high\-quality instrumentation and accessories, from reliable cost\-effective products to the best performance available. Our pyranometers, for example, are used in meteorological networks around the world. Furthermore, our expertise and close links with the scientific community have led to high\-end solutions for the measurement of atmospheric properties such as stratospheric Ozone, UV Spectra and evapo\-transpiration. Our mission is to satisfy the fundamental need to monitor atmospheric properties related to climate change, classical meteorology, agriculture, renewable energy and the available water budget. **The opportunity:** Reporting into the Senior Manager, R\&D, you will **lead the firmware engineering aspect of product development and maintenance initiatives** at the Austin site and support a global organization. **This is a full\-time, onsite position (40 hours per week, Monday to Friday) based in Austin, Texas (North Central, near the Domain)**, where our factory and production operations are located. In this role, you will: * **Lead** the concept and implementation of new features for our solar sensing products. You turn requirements into a firmware architecture, make the key design decisions together with electrical and systems engineers, and implement robust, production\-ready C firmware for MCU\-based sensors and controllers. You own each product’s firmware independently from specification through final design, and set the technical direction and quality bar for the team through code and design reviews. * **Think** beyond the firmware. Weigh electronics, communications, manufacturability, reliability, and cybersecurity in every decision, and choose solutions that work for the whole product, not just the code. * **Champion** hardware bring\-up at system level: analyze schematics, review component selections, validate hardware\-software interfaces, and define integration strategies for sensors, ADCs, communications interfaces, memory, power systems, and peripherals. jobs.title: Release Strategist, Professional Services
jobs.description: #### **About the Job:** Most companies don't have a "release problem" so much as a way\-of\-working problem. Shipping live functionality to their customers takes too long, depends on a few heroes, or happens with fingers crossed, and AI\-assisted development is raising the stakes. LaunchDarkly Professional Services is helping our most strategic customers change that, and we're hiring a Release Strategist to lead those engagements. As a Release Strategist on LaunchDarkly's Professional Services team, you are the "product manager" for each customer engagement, responsible for defining how that customer achieves release excellence by evolving their software and agentic release processes. You join the sales cycle early to define the problem and quantify what it's costing them, then own the engagement through delivery and adoption until the change sticks. You own the "why" and the "what"; our Solutions Architects, who serve as our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), own the "how." Day to day, you'll partner with a Solutions Architect on each engagement, combining their technical judgment with your view of the commercial context, customer priorities, and relationship dynamics. Neither of you can do the job alone. You own the problem, the value, the scope, and the success criteria; your Solutions Architect owns the technical approach and its quality. You'll also work closely with Account Executives and Customer Success Managers, and you'll lead without direct authority, so influence, clarity, and trust matter more than title. This is a new role, and its shape will flex and adapt as the business grows. Early on, expect to lean into scoping, delivery, and change leadership on both the pre\-sales and post\-sales side of the business. As we establish a feedback loop through customer delivery, you'll extend that product mindset from individual engagements to our offerings themselves, and help write the playbook for how we package engagements, measure success, and bring on the next Release Strategist. #### **Responsibilities:** * **Product \& Value** + Scope the problem and the value if solved: join sales cycles from early discovery, map the customer's organization and decision landscape, and quantify the business value of their release and delivery problem. + Define the customer engagement like a product: identify the business challenges and, with your Solutions Architect, the technical ones behind them; set the MVP or first phase, success criteria, and timeline; write the engagement plan (the outcomes, deliverables, and acceptance criteria the team delivers against); and shape the SOW with PS leadership so what we sell is what we can deliver. + Own scope and prioritization: decide what we do first and what we defer, manage scope as the engagement evolves, and continuously assess whether it still serves both the customer's outcomes and LaunchDarkly's interests, reshaping the plan when they diverge. + Own the outcome from go\-live, the point where the customer starts working the new way, through adoption: capture feedback, iterate, and prove the business value defined at the start. * **Change \& Adoption** + Facilitate discovery and design sessions mapping release processes and visualizing "who should get a feature and when" without the technology or process on how to accomplish it. Adapt or invent new collaborative practices when a customer's situation doesn't fit one we already use, to turn ambiguous goals into clear, owned success plans. + Lead and grow our change management practices: align customer teams on new ways of working, address resistance, and drive adoption so changes stick after the engagement ends. Scope the ongoing support plan and create the documentation and enablement the customer needs to sustain it. * **Executive \& Growth** + Act as a trusted advisor to VP and C\-level stakeholders: set expectations, present progress, risks, recommend data\-driven decisions, and drive decisions quickly. + Monitor account health and surface expansion or renewal signals; scope the next engagement as a natural outcome of delivered value. * **Offerings \& Playbook (grows as our FDE engagement volume does)** + Turn what you learn across engagements into a feedback loop for our offerings: capture patterns, help shape how we package engagements and measure success, and help write the playbook, including how we bring on future hires. * **Delivery \& Execution** + Run the delivery rhythm: status calls and reporting, accountability to tasks and deadlines across the engagement team, and escalation of technical or political blockers. + Keep a running view of budget/burn against SOW and flag over/under\-projection early; partner with PM\-type support (where it exists on an account) for detailed tracking and change\-order mechanics. * **Customer Landscape** + Our customers struggle with long lead times, risky deployments, feature flag sprawl, unclear ownership of releases, and a gap between what engineering ships and what the bu /renewal signals to Sales or AM; comfort with a role that may take on commercial ownership over time. + (Bonus) Experience operating in a scaling PS org where role boundaries are still being defined. **Travel** * Travel roughly once per quarter for customer workshops and team onsites; more frequent travel may be needed around specific engagements. **Pay:** *Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones\* for Level P4:* * Zone 1: *San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle* \- *$171,200**\- $235,400*\*\* * Zone 2: *Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago \- $154,100* *\- $211,860*\*\* * Zone 3: *All other US locations \- $145,500* *\- $200,090\**\* *LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.* * *Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.* *\*\*Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.* #### **About LaunchDarkly:** Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big\-bang" technology migrations. The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by: * Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages * Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts * Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize * Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types * Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at hr@launchdarkly.com. **Do you need a disability accommodation?** Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @LaunchDarkly.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts.Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to careers@launchdarkly.com.

set clear goals and give timely, specific feedback. * Build an individual development plan with each person and support their growth through stretch assignments, mentoring, training and promotion readiness. * Run performance and talent reviews, compensation input and promotion cases with clear evidence. * Hire and onboard new team members; build a team that people want to stay on. * Notice and address workload, morale and collaboration issues early. **Plan and deliver** * Turn team priorities into clear workstreams with owners, milestones and success measures. * Track progress, surface risks early and remove blockers. * Balance commitments against capacity, including compute resources. * Work with program managers on planning, status and delivery. **Guide the technical work** * Review experiment designs, results and readiness of the team's work. * Help the team make sound technical choices, and know when to bring in deeper expertise. * Raise the bar on rigor: reproducible experiments, consistent tracking, fair evaluation and documented results. * Keep up with developments in the field and help the team judge what is worth adopting. **Collaborate globally** * Work day to day with colleagues and technical leads in other regions: align priorities, share work and keep joint projects moving across time zones. * Build strong working relationships across cultures and locations, and help the US team do the same. * Work with product and partner teams to deliver what they need. * Represent the team's work clearly to leadership and partner teams. **Minimum qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 6\+ years in machine learning engineering or applied AI research, including hands\-on development of deep learning models. * 2\+ years leading people, as a people manager or as a technical lead with clear mentoring and coaching responsibilities. * Solid working knowledge of modern AI models, including large language models: how they are trained, adapted and evaluated. * Proficiency in Python and a major deep learning framework; able to read and review code and experiment results. * Clear written and spoken communication, including difficult performance and career conversations. * Flexibility to join occasional early\-morning or evening meetings with colleagues in other regions. **Preferred qualifications** * Master's or PhD in a relevant field. * Experience taking AI models from research to products. * Hands\-on experience in one or more areas of model development, such as training and fine\-tuning, model optimization and efficiency, generative models, data, or evaluation. * Experience with large\-scale training on shared compute. * Experience managing a mix of researchers and engineers, including early\-career engineers. * A track record of growing people into more senior roles. * Experience working with globally distributed teams across time zones and cultures. \#LATC *We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.* **Additional Locations**: * United States of America \- North Carolina \- Morrisville * United States of America * United States of America \- North Carolina * United States of America \- North Carolina \- Morrisville

orchestration systems. * Drive improvements to infrastructure provisioning, validation, monitoring, and lifecycle management through scalable software solutions. * Establish standards for software Managed Services to support integrations between underlying infrastructure systems and customer\-facing Kubernetes and Slurm services. * Establish clear technical interfaces and ownership across teams to improve infrastructure operations and reduce manual work. * Communicate engineering priorities, project progress, and technical tradeoffs to stakeholders and leadership. **Who You Are** engineering background building production backend services, APIs, or distributed systems. * Proficiency in Python, Go, or similar backend programming languages, with the ability to guide technical design and architectural decisions. * Experience leading infrastructure software, platform engineering, or automation projects. * Working knowledge of Linux, infrastructure automation, and production jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **Staff Backend Engineer** LiteLLM is the world’s most popular open\-source AI Gateway, used by Adobe, Netflix, NASA, NVIDIA and much of the Fortune 500\. Every LLM call these companies make runs through our code, so when we break, they break. We’re a team of about 20, and we’re hiring senior and staff backend engineers to own the core of the gateway and keep it fast and reliable as traffic grows. **About the role** You’ll own critical parts of the LiteLLM proxy: routing, auth, caching, spend tracking, guardrails and observability. The job is to make these systems correct, fast and dependable at 1B\+ requests a month. That means hunting down silent failures, fixing the root cause in code rather than adding another dashboard, and refactoring components that keep breaking without changing how they behave. You’ll set the bar for how our mostly early\-career team writes, tests and ships backend code. **What you’ll do** * Own core proxy components end to end, from design through production, including the incidents * Find and remove whole classes of bugs, like race conditions, stale cache state across replicas, and errors that get silently swallowed instead of shown to users * Make sure every guardrail and policy check (e.g. apply\_guardrail) is logged, traceable and fails loudly when it should * Build guardrails that run inside the gateway and block common attacks on LLM APIs, MCP servers and agents * Keep our observability integrations (Datadog, Splunk, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry) accurate at 1B\+ requests a month, with minimal latency overhead and no memory leaks (e.g. from Prometheus jobs.title: AI Composer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Position Summary:** The AI Composer is responsible for developing, implementing, and supporting AI\-powered solutions that help Litera build and ship software faster and with higher quality. This is a hands\-on technical role focused on building the agentic product and software development lifecycle (idea, spec, build, test, release) on Argo, Litera's internal agent orchestration platform. The AI Composer will partner closely with software engineering and product teams to roll out this lifecycle across 20\+ Litera products, with the goal of going from idea to shipped product with minimal human touchpoints. Product teams are the AI Composer's internal customers. Success is measured by adoption and by measurable improvements in delivery speed and quality. The ideal candidate is a software engineer who builds with agentic AI tools every day. **Key Responsibilities:** * Develop, configure, and support agent\-driven software development across the product and software development lifecycle. * Build and improve agents, skills, and orchestrated multi\-step workflows on our internal agent platform. * Develop and maintain AI\-enabled applications, integrations, APIs, and services utilizing approved cloud platforms and tools. * Collaborate with product and development teams to understand their software development process and translate it into an agentic development process. * Integrate agents into existing engineering systems and workflows, such as source control, CI, and issue tracking. * Use AI evaluations (evals) as a core method for measuring agent output quality, alongside testing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization of agents and workflows. * Follow established AI governance, security, and data privacy standards. * Research emerging AI technologies and recommend tools, features, and capabilities that can improve developer productivity and delivery outcomes. * Use delivery data to find where teams are getting stuck and drive adoption. * Troubleshoot technical issues related to agents, integrations, and our agent platform. * Create and maintain documentation for solutions, integrations, processes, and user guidance. Frontend experience with React and the Microsoft Fluent Design System. * \#LI\-Hybrid Litera is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior AI-Native Software Engineer, Product R&D
jobs.description: #### **About the Role** We partner with global enterprises to design and build the products and platforms at the center of their business. This engagement is a new research and development (R\&D) team inside a major US healthcare organization. It runs like a set of small startups: intentionally small, hands\-on, and accountable for shipping real products that real customers use, with access to customers, data, and scale already in place. We are looking for senior\-level engineers who are, above all, strong problem solvers. You will take loosely defined problems, figure out what is worth building, and build it end to end, from first prototype to production. This is an AI\-native team: engineers build with AI coding agents by default, and technology choices are guided by what large language models (LLMs) handle best. We want software engineers first, with deep fundamentals and broad range, who will raise the level of the team around them. #### **What You'll Do** * Take ambiguous problems from idea to production, deciding what to build, prototyping quickly, and shipping what proves its value. * Build customer\-facing products end to end: front end, back end, data, and deployment. * Partner directly with product leaders to understand the problem, the users, and the reasoning behind each product decision, and make sound prioritization decisions without a dedicated product manager. * Use AI coding agents such as Codex or Claude Code to move faster, and help your teammates get more out of them. * Build LLM\-powered features where they add real value, and measure how well they perform in production. * Make pragmatic technical decisions that balance speed, learning, and durability. * Build platform components the whole team can reuse to deliver the next product faster. * Own what you build in production: deploy it through CI/CD (continuous integration and delivery), monitor it, and keep it reliable for the people who use it. * Help shape how the team works as it grows, from engineering practices to the hiring bar. #### **What We're Looking For** * 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including senior\-level ownership of products in production. * An exceptional problem solver who can break down vague, open\-ended problems and find a practical path to a working product. * A full\-stack generalist who has worked across front end, back end, and data, and has moved comfortably between languages, frameworks, and problem domains. Breadth matters more to us than deep specialization in a single stack. * A fast learner who picks up new languages and tools as the work requires. We are not hiring for a specific tech stack; adaptability matters more. * A track record of building products that reached real users, especially new applications where you personally owned the outcome. * A daily user of AI coding agents, with sound judgment about their strengths and limitations. * Solid engineering fundamentals: you can solve the problem yourself, which is what lets you direct AI agents and judge what they produce. * Product judgment: you can weigh business value, user need, and engineering cost, and decide what to build first. * Production experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), Docker, CI/CD, and monitoring, including work on large\-scale systems. * A collaborator who works well with people outside engineering and has shaped technical direction beyond your own team. * At home in a small, startup\-style team where everyone owns outcomes end to end. * Fluent English, both written and spoken. * Healthcare experience is not required. #### **Nice to Have** * Experience shipping LLM\-powered or agentic features in a production product. * Experience building products in an R\&D, innovation, or startup environment. * Flexibility to travel occasionally if needed. #### **Why Lumenalta is an amazing place to work at** At Lumenalta, you can expect that you will: * Be 100% dedicated to one project at a time so that you can innovate and grow. * Be a part of a team of talented and friendly senior\-level engineers. * Work on projects that allow you to use leading tech. #### **Location** This role is remote within the United States only. Candidates must reside in the United States while assigned to our client and be physically located within the United States when performing project work or accessing project systems or data. Availability to work overlapping Pacific, Central, or Eastern U.S. time zones. Travel is not required, but flexibility for occasional travel is a plus. #### **Application Deadline** Applications will be accepted until **December 6th, 2026**. Candidates can expect feedback by **December 14th, 2026**.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Your Team Responsibilities: Private capital index calculation is a demanding engineering problem. Inputs are irregular, sparse and often revised. The measures are non\-linear and solver\-based, and the published output is a number that clients rely on for a decade. Every run must reproduce bit\-for\-bit against the validated code. You will build the calculation library itself, including the plugin contract, the solver, the aggregation logic and the test harness that confirms results have not changed. Your Key Responsibilities: * Design and build the measure library: money\-weighted (IRR, pooled, neutrally weighted), multiples, time\-weighted (Modified Dietz, unitised, index\-level chaining), public\-market equivalents (Direct Alpha, KS\-PME, Long\-Nickels) and real\-asset measures, each exposed through a stable, versioned, conformance\-tested interface. * Implement numerically sound logic: exact decimal arithmetic throughout, no floating\-point types for money or IRR solves, a safeguarded solver that brackets before iterating, and a canonical flow order for summation. * Make every calculation reproducible: pin each run to a data snapshot, engine version, measure version and input hash, so replays produce identical output and any mismatch is flagged. * Build and maintain the conformance harness: golden vectors from the methodology documents run on every build, with invariant tests for date\-shift, netting, weight sums and monotonicity. * Optimise batch performance across roughly 15,000 funds and roughly 150 definitions in a single pass rather than 150 separate passes, with caching keyed on the data snapshot so re\-ingested extracts invalidate stale results. * Work with methodology, data and product teams to turn methodology documents into tested code, and review changes to numerical code. Your skills and experience that will help you excel: * Strong software engineering experience in a typed language, with linting and tests that enforce numerical rules and act as the specification. * Working knowledge of fixed\-precision and floating\-point arithmetic, and a clear sense of where the two must never mix. * Root\-finding and numerical methods, including bracketing, convergence, ill\-conditioning, and recognising when a converged result is still meaningless. * A disciplined testing habit: test claims rather than asserting them, since plausible but wrong numbers are the main failure risk in this domain. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with performance measurement or financial calculation libraries, ideally for private markets. * Experience building versioned, reproducible computation pipelines. About MSCI: **What we offer you** * Salary range: $133,000 \- $173,000 / year plus eligible for annual bonus * Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing. * Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces. * A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results. * A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients. * Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development. * Multi\-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles. * We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride \& Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum. At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry\-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry. MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research\-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private\-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates. MSCI Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. It is the policy of the firm to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy (including unlawful discrimination on the basis of a legally protected parental leave), veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. MSCI is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. jobs.title: Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** **Cloud \& Data Platform Security** * Serve as the security engineering point of contact for the Azure cloud environment — reviewing architecture, integrations, and configurations for security posture (network segmentation, private endpoints, Key Vault, managed identities, RBAC, Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy). * Partner with the data engineering team to secure the data platform stack — Snowflake, Databricks, and Microsoft Dynamics — from an infrastructure and access\-control perspective: authentication, network access, encryption at rest and in transit, key management, audit logging, and secrets management. (This role supports the security of these platforms; it does not own data engineering or pipeline development.) * Review and validate security configurations for new Azure and data\-platform integrations before go\-live, in partnership with data engineering and application owners. * Support identity governance and least\-privilege access reviews across Azure resources and connected data platforms (service principals, managed identities, OAuth/API integrations). * Contribute to cloud security monitoring and alerting using Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud, and Purview, and help extend existing security tooling (DLP, DGE) into cloud and data\-platform contexts. * Support use of Infrastructure\-as\-Code (ARM templates, Bicep, or Terraform) to enforce consistent, reviewable security configurations across Azure resources. * **Security Operations \& Incident Response** * Monitor, investigate, and respond to security alerts across endpoint, email, identity, cloud, vulnerability management, data loss prevention (DLP), and managed detection platforms. * Analyze suspected security incidents and determine appropriate containment, remediation, and recovery actions. * Coordinate incident response activities with internal teams, managed service providers, and business stakeholders. * Maintain accurate incident documentation, evidence collection, root cause analysis, and remediation records. * Support ongoing improvements to incident response processes, automation, and user communications. * Participate in on\-call or after\-hours incident response activities as needed. * **Vulnerability \& Patch Management** * Administer and continuously improve vulnerability management processes and reporting, including cloud resource and container/workload scanning. * Identify, prioritize, and track remediation of security vulnerabilities and configuration issues across on\-premises and Azure\-hosted assets. * Coordinate operating system and application patching activities across enterprise systems. * Maintain accurate asset inventories — including cloud resources and data platform integrations — and ensure * proper lifecycle management of technology assets. * **Endpoint, Identity \& Mobile Security** * Manage and support endpoint security technologies and investigations. * Administer and enhance operations for Windows, iOS, and device management. * Support Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, security groups, and identity governance processes across on\-premises and cloud. * Ensure endpoint security controls align with operational and business requirements. **Email Security \& Data Protection** * Support email security operations, including phishing investigations, message analysis, and user\-facing communications. * Review and respond to security events related to sensitive data handling and policy violations, including within cloud data platforms. * Collaborate with IT, security, and data engineering teams to test, validate, and deploy security policy changes. **Security Assessments \& Third\-Party Risk** * Support security assessments, penetration tests, and due diligence reviews — including assessments of cloud and data platform vendors. * Develop and maintain vendor information security review questionnaires and assessment procedures for high\- risk vendors and service providers. * Perform internal and vendor risk assessments to validate control effectiveness and recommend risk mitigation actions. * Partner with third\-party security vendors and managed service providers to establish monitoring, escalation plans, and workflows — and to investigate issues and implement corrective actions. * Review security documentation, vendor responses, and assessment findings, escalating identified risks where appropriate. * Support the overall third\-party/vendor risk management program and due\-diligence process. **Governance, Risk \& Compliance** * Maintain a risk register for identification, evaluation, and monitoring of risk findings, reported to executive stakeholders. * Develop dashboards, reports, and alerts providing real\-time visibility into the state of security controls and policies. * Establish data classification and information protection policies and controls across email, chat, and sensitive file repositories. * Partner with other departments to establish consistent review and approval workflows for exceptions to security policies and controls. * Contribute to the continuous improvement of security program goals, objectives, policies, standards, and procedures. * Support internal and external audit and regulatory processes relevant to applicable compliance frameworks (e.g., CIS, SOC 2, PCI, NIST, CCPA, GLBA). * Participate in business impact analysis, business continuity, and disaster recovery planning and testing. * Work with business units to ensure security controls are adequate, appropriate, and effective. * Stay current on developing regulatory requirements and evolving IT and information security trends. * **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of experience in information security, security operations, systems engineering, systems administration, or a related field. * Substantial hands\-on experience securing Microsoft Azure environments — including identity (Entra ID, conditional access, managed identities), network security (VNets, NSGs, private endpoints), Key Vault, Defender for Cloud, and Azure Policy — from an integration and architecture perspective, not just administration. * Experience securing or supporting cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and/or Microsoft Dynamics from an infrastructure and security standpoint (access control, network security, encryption, audit logging, secrets management). Direct data engineering experience is not required, but the ability to work fluently alongside a data engineering team is. * Hands\-on experience investigating endpoint, email, identity, cloud, or data security events. * Experience with vulnerability management, patch management, asset inventory, and remediation tracking. * Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows administration, and PowerShell. * Familiarity with common security and compliance frameworks (CIS, SOC 2, PCI, NIST, CCPA, GLBA) and with business impact analysis, BC/DR planning, and DR testing. * Experience administering endpoint management or mobile device management (MDM) platforms. * Experience working with managed security providers, technology vendors, or outsourced IT partners. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across technical and business teams, including engineering. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail. * Ability to work on\-site in Santa Monica, CA on a hybrid schedule for the duration of the engagement. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Sentinel, and the broader Defender suite (Defender for Cloud, Defender for Cloud Apps). * Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (ARM/Bicep, Terraform) for enforcing security configuration at scale. * Experience with technologies such as CrowdStrike Falcon, eSentire, Proofpoint, and Fortra Digital Guardian. * Experience supporting financial services, investment management, or other highly regulated environments. * Experience coordinating penetration tests, security assessments, and vendor risk reviews — particularly for cloud/SaaS and data platform vendors. * Familiarity with hybrid infrastructure and modern endpoint management solutions. * Knowledge of incident response planning, business continuity, disaster recovery, and audit support processes. * Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, Security\+, GIAC, or Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\- 500\) — preferred but not required. Prior consulting or contract engagement experience within an embedded client team. \* Pay: $131,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) Work Location: In person

jobs.description: What part will you play? If you’re looking for a place where you can make a meaningful difference, you’ve found it. This role goes beyond servicing the platforms. The Sr. Infrastructure Engineer builds and maintains the platform configurations, automations and solutions that enable Markel associates to use AI safely and productively. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technologist who pairs strong platform administration with practical engineering skills: configuration management, scripting, workflow automation, integrations and reusable solution components. This is not a full\-time software development role; it suits someone who builds to make the platforms, and the people who use them, more effective. The Sr. Infrastructure Engineer partners closely with AI engineers and architects, the Cloud Infrastructure team, Global Security Services, Audit, IT Global Risk \& Compliance, Identity, Architecture, End User Computing, Microsoft and other AI vendors, and the U.S. and International AI Centers of Enablement. This role reports to the IT Manager, AI Platforms \& Enablement and resides within the Global Employee Experience department in Core Technology Services. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Platform Engineering \& Configuration** ----------------------------------------- * Design, build and maintain configurations for AI and automation platforms, including tenant and admin settings, Copilot Control System, Copilot Studio and agent settings, Power Platform environments, Managed Environments, Environment Groups, and DLP and connector policies. * Manage platform configurations as repeatable, documented and version\-controlled builds wherever possible, with configuration baselines that make drift easy to detect and correct. * Engineer and maintain the Power Platform environment strategy (Green / Yellow / Red zones), application lifecycle management (ALM) pipelines, solution deployment and environment provisioning. * Build and maintain the integrations, custom connectors and identity configuration (Entra ID app registrations, service principals, security groups) that AI platforms and agents depend on, in partnership with Identity, Security and Architecture. * Evaluate, pilot and implement new AI platform features and services, defining the configuration, controls and support model needed for production readiness. * Support and govern the use of Azure AI Foundry in partnership with AI engineers and architects and the Cloud Infrastructure team, including access and onboarding, approved models and deployment guardrails, responsible AI and content safety settings, and cost and usage visibility. **Automation \& Solution Enablement** ------------------------------------- * Automate platform administration and governance tasks such as provisioning, licensing and AI credit allocation, inventory, clean\-up of inactive and orphaned resources, and access reviews, using PowerShell, Power Platform CLI, Microsoft Graph and Power Automate. * Build reusable solutions, templates, agents and starter kits that help makers and business teams adopt AI quickly and within established guardrails. * Partner with business stakeholders and the AI Centers of Enablement to turn use cases into well\-architected platform solutions, and advise makers on design, performance and supportability. * Build the data feeds and reporting automation that surface utilization, platform health, compliance, cost and value. **Service Delivery \& Operations** ---------------------------------- * Support multiple AI and automation products and services so they stay reliable, available and responsive for the business; own complex incidents, problems and changes in ServiceNow, perform root cause analysis and drive permanent fixes. * Drive internal and third\-party service reviews with Microsoft and other AI vendors, covering platform performance and KPIs, service improvements, customer satisfaction, quality and processes. * Maintain platform capacity, licensing, consumption and release readiness, including changes a future. **Pay information:** The salary range for this position is $87,100\-$145,100\. The posted salary range reflects the lowest and highest base salary applicable to this role across our U.S. locations. Individual offers are determined based on geographic location, experience, qualifications, internal equity, and other job\-related factors. As a result, the salary offered for a specific location will fall within a narrower range than the overall range displayed in this posting. This position may also be eligible to participate in the Company's annual incentive plan.**Who we are:** Markel Group (NYSE – MKL) a fortune 500 company with over 60 offices in 20\+ countries, is a holding company for insurance, reinsurance, specialist advisory and investment operations around the world. **We’re** **all about people \| We win together \| We strive for better** **We enjoy the everyday \| We think further** **What’s** **in it for you:** In keeping with the values of the Markel Style, we strive to support our employees in living their lives to the fullest at home and at work. * We offer competitive benefit programs that help meet our diverse and changing environment as well as support our employees’ needs at all stages of life. * All full\-time employees have the option to select from multiple health, dental and vision insurance plan options and optional life, disability, and AD\&D insurance. * We also offer a 401(k) with employer match contributions, an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, PTO, corporate holidays and floating holidays, parental leave. **Are you ready to play your part?** Choose **‘Apply Now’** to fill out our short application, so that we can find out more about you. **Caution: Employment** **scams** Markel is aware of employment\-related scams where scammers will impersonate recruiters by sending fake job offers to those actively seeking employment in order to steal personal information. Frequently, the scammer will reach out to individuals who have posted their resume online. jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer – Full-Stack TypeScript & LLM Consumer Products
jobs.description: **Founding Product Engineer – Full\-Stack TypeScript \& LLM Consumer Products** =============================================================================== **San Francisco, CA · New York, NY · London, UK \| On\-site \| Full Time \| Direct Hire \| Mid to Senior Level \| ASAP Start** **MaxIT Consulting – Max Corporate Group** is looking for a **Founding Product Engineer** to join a seed\-stage consumer AI company that has become one of the fastest\-growing consumer AI products of the year. The company builds a personal AI assistant that people use inside the messaging apps they already have. It does not just answer questions: it carries tasks out for the user, from bookings and purchases to email, calls and content, and nothing irreversible happens without the user's approval. The team is still very small, so every engineer owns whole products and has a direct impact on what millions of users experience. **THE CHALLENGE** ----------------- You will build what people actually touch: the conversation itself across messaging apps and group chats, the moments where the assistant asks before it spends money or sends something on the user's behalf, onboarding, payments and the web surfaces around them. On a team this size you take a product from the first sketch to production and to the numbers after launch, working side by side with the agent and infrastructure engineers so that new capabilities ship as product, not as demos. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** ------------------------ * Own user\-facing features end to end, from idea to production to the next iteration, across messaging and the web. * Design the moments of trust: approvals, receipts, confirmations and recovery when a task goes wrong. * Build onboarding, subscriptions and billing as the product moves from waitlist to paid. * Work closely with agent and infrastructure engineers so new capabilities reach users as polished product. * Read conversations, talk to users and turn what you learn into what ships that week. **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** --------------------------- * At least **3 years** of software engineering experience, with a record of **shipping polished consumer products end to end**, ideally as an early engineer or a founder. * Strong **full\-stack** skills in **TypeScript** and a modern web stack, and the judgment to choose the simplest thing that works. * Experience building on **large language models (LLMs)** in a product people use every day. * Real product taste: you notice latency, wording and edge cases, and fix them without being asked. * Speed: you ship in days, measure and ship again. * Based in, or willing to relocate at your own cost to, **San Francisco, New York or London**, to work on\-site. * Fluent English, as you will work daily with the founders and users. **NICE TO HAVE** ---------------- * Experience at a fast\-growing consumer or AI\-first product company. * Experience with messaging platforms, payments or subscription billing (not required). A particular framework, prior messaging experience or a degree are not required. **POSITION DETAILS** -------------------- Work arrangement: On\-site Schedule: Full Time Employment type: Direct Hire (permanent) Seniority: Mid to Senior (3\+ years) Start date: ASAP Location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; or London, UK Meaningful founding equity, comprehensive benefits and the tools you need to do your best work. The hiring process is short: a conversation with a founder, a working session on a real problem and a decision within days. **WORK AUTHORIZATION** ---------------------- You must already hold the right to work in the United States (San Francisco and New York) or in the United Kingdom (London). Visa sponsorship is not available; H\-1B transfers and TN status may be considered. **HOW TO APPLY** ---------------- If you want to build a consumer AI product that people use every day, with real ownership from day one, we want to hear from you. Apply through this platform with your updated CV, your expected gross annual salary in USD, the hub you would work from and your availability to start.
