jobs.title: Distribution Center IT Engineer
jobs.description: McKesson is an impact\-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well\-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. **Position Summary:** McKesson is seeking a Distribution Center IT Engineer to support reliable technology solutions used across distribution center operations. In this role, you will help configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and improve systems and hardware that support warehouse productivity, accuracy, and service continuity. You will work closely with operations, engineering, infrastructure, and support teams to resolve issues, improve processes, and ensure technology used in distribution centers performs reliably. This role is ideal for someone who brings hands\-on experience with Windows environments, distribution center hardware, and a customer\-focused approach to technical problem solving. What You’ll Do * Provide advanced technical escalation support for complex incidents, including P1/P2 incident resolution, root cause analysis, and participation in change requests, and recommend sustainable fixes that improve reliability. * Deliver hands\-on break/fix and operational support at one or more distribution centers, including configuring, supporting, and troubleshooting RF devices, scanners, scales, printers, and related automation peripherals. * Support and maintain Windows\-based servers, workstations, thin clients, and print environments, including hardware replacement, imaging, deployment, and lifecycle activities. * Monitor systems proactively, perform health checks and maintenance, and troubleshoot network connectivity in coordination with network teams to minimize unplanned downtime. * Partner with operations, infrastructure, and vendor teams (such as automation, printer, and WCS partners) to support system availability, device readiness, scheduled maintenance, and issue resolution. * Support enterprise and regional projects, such as onboarding new technologies, platform migrations, compliance\-driven device configuration, and infrastructure enhancements, translating business and operational needs into practical technical solutions. * Maintain tooling and platform systems, including mobile device management, monitoring, vulnerability management, and system health validation. * Develop and maintain support procedures, configuration standards, SOPs, and lessons learned, informed by incident outcomes and compliance requirements. * Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, scripting, automation, and process standardization, and participate in planning and change management forums to align with enterprise priorities. * Provide responsive, professional support to warehouse and office users and stakeholders, including on\-call and after\-hours coverage to maintain distribution center uptime. Basic Requirements * Degree or equivalent and typically requires 4\+ years of relevant professional experience in systems engineering, systems support, infrastructure support, or distribution center technology. * Experience configuring, supporting, and troubleshooting hardware used in distribution centers or warehouse environments, such as RF devices, scanners, scales, printers, and automation peripherals. * Experience working in a Windows environment, including servers, workstations, thin clients, and printers. * Experience responding to production incidents, performing break/fix support and root cause analysis, and documenting resolution steps. * Working knowledge of Incident, Problem, Change, and Knowledge Management practices. * Experience supporting internal customers, operational users, or business stakeholders and coordinating with cross\-functional teams and vendors in a technical support or engineering role. * Ability to provide on\-call and after\-hours support as needed to maintain distribution center operation. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Preferred Skills/Experience * Experience supporting warehouse management, logistics, supply chain, or distribution center systems. * Familiarity with software development lifecycle, Agile delivery, release management, or change management practices. * Experience with incident management, service desk workflows, monitoring tools, or operational support processes. * Knowledge of networking fundamentals, device connectivity, peripheral configuration, or environment readiness. * Familiarity with CI/CD, automation, scripting, or DevOps practices. * Experience improving technical processes, reducing recurring issues, or standardizing support procedures. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical information clearly. * Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on quality, reliability, and customer experience. Travel, work environment and physical requirements * Work model, travel expectations, and on\-site distribution center support will be based on business and team needs. * May require occasional support outside standard business hours for operational issues, deployments, or incident response. * May require working at a computer for extended periods and interacting with distribution center hardware or peripherals. We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long\-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson, **Our Base Pay Range for this position** $84,100 \- $140,100 McKesson has become aware of online recruiting\-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind: McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application. McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting\-related communications with candidates. McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: careers.mckesson.com. **McKesson is an Equal Opportunity Employer** McKesson provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other legally protected category. For additional information on McKesson’s full Equal Employment Opportunity policies, visit our Equal Employment Opportunity page. McKesson is committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers including job seekers with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, please contact us by sending an email to (United States) Disability\_Accommodation@McKesson.com or (Canada) Accessibility@mckesson.ca. Resumes or CVs submitted to this email box will not be accepted. **Join us at McKesson!** **Benefits** ------------ * ### **Coverage you can rely on** + Medical, Dental, and Vision + Health Spending Accounts + Flexible Spending Accounts * ### **Benefits that go beyond your base pay** + 401(k) (U.S.) + Pension (Canada) + Employee Stock Purchase Plan * ### **Support for total well\-being** + Mental Health Programs + Flexible Schedules + Paid Time Off + Wellness Program + Education Reimbursement + Volunteer Opportunities + Flexible Work Environment * ### **A culture powered by belonging** By fostering a culture of belonging, we advance our goal of being the best place to work in healthcare—connecting the right talent to the right roles to solve our most critical challenges.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
jobs.description: Job ID: 114810 * Atlanta * Boston * Chicago * Denver * New Jersey * New York City \+ 1 More Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Are you a creative problem\-solver who is energized by challenges? **You’ve come to the right place.** **YOUR IMPACT** --------------- You will be the technical lead your team and clients rely on to tackle the hardest engineering challenges, make sound architectural decisions, and ensure the delivery of complex, high\-quality solutions that create lasting impact. You will own the technical direction for your team, designing and delivering complex software systems while setting the engineering standards that define how great software gets built. You will mentor engineers at all levels, help clients make smart technology decisions, and bring the kind of judgment and depth that turns a good team into a great one. Your work will help solve some of the most complex and high\-impact challenges facing clients across industries. Collaborating across McKinsey's QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you'll help develop innovative software capabilities and scalable enterprise solutions. You'll help build robust technical foundations for production\-ready, AI\-enabled systems. Your contributions will directly support the firm's ability to accelerate AI adoption, solve complex business problems at scale, and enable clients to achieve meaningful, lasting impact. You'll be based in one of our NA offices as part of our global Software Engineering community. Working in cross\-functional teams, you'll collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and industry experts to deliver software solutions. By partnering with clients from technical teams to C\-level executives, you'll help solve complex problems that drive tangible business value and continue to grow your skills as a client\-facing technologist. Your work offers a unique opportunity to grow at the forefront of AI and software engineering. You'll develop expertise at the intersection of technology and business by tackling diverse challenges in the evolving AI landscape. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you'll gain a holistic understanding of how software engineering enables advanced AI while collaborating with some of the leading technologists and AI practitioners in the industry. There is flexibility to hire at different Software / Senior Software Engineer levels, depending on your experience. **YOUR GROWTH** --------------- Driving lasting impact and building long\-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture \- doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else. When you join us, you will have: * **Continuous learning:** Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey. * **A voice that matters:** From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. * **Global community:** With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. * **World\-class benefits:** On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family. **YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS** ---------------------------------- * Undergraduate or master’s degree; or equivalent experience * 8\+ years of experience developing full\-stack applications, with expert\-level proficiency across frontend and backend frameworks such as JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Angular, Next.js, Vue.js, Java, Spring, C\#, or Node.js; SQL and NoSQL databases; cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP); and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, Docker, CircleCI, or similar); able to evaluate third\-party dependencies, build custom solutions, and deliver robust, scalable systems across the full stack * Proven ability to lead the design of complex API ecosystems — including REST and GraphQL — with a focus on consistency, scalability, and long\-term maintainability; deep knowledge of API lifecycle management, software design patterns, and distributed systems architecture, with experience managing technical debt and building reusable components adopted across teams * Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering complex cloud solutions independently, including multi\-tier cloud migrations, scalable and fault\-tolerant infrastructure, and cost\-effective cloud\-native architectures on platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP * Experience establishing agentic engineering standards, reusable workflows, and tooling that measurably improve engineering productivity and delivery quality across teams * Experience driving AI capabilities that teams build upon, owning evaluation frameworks, self\-learning loops, and security controls that improve release quality over time * A security\-first mindset — able to engage as an expert on standards, compliance, and regulation, architect complex authentication solutions, and lead testing strategies that establish the code quality bar for the team * Experience leading collaborative, cross\-functional engineering teams and fostering a strong engineering culture * Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment * Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and the local office language(s), with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels Please review the additional requirements regarding essential job functions of McKinsey colleagues. Our unwavering commitment to integrity drives everything we do, guiding us to always act in the best interests of our clients, our people, and the communities we serve.

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer (Irvine, Roseville, or Walnut Creek, CA)
jobs.description: Mechanics Bank is currently searching for an AI Platform Engineer to join our team. Here at Mechanics Bank, we value connection, partnership, long term relationships and working together in person. This role will be working on\-site. The Senior Kubernetes, OpenShift \& AI Platform Engineer architects, engineers, secures, automates, and supports the Bank's enterprise Kubernetes and artificial intelligence platform on Red Hat OpenShift, OpenShift Virtualization, and OpenShift AI. The role supports containerized and virtualized workloads, enterprise model serving, large language model inference, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, agentic AI services, and GPU\-enabled workloads. The engineer establishes resilient, observable, governed, and cost\-aware platform patterns and partners with Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Data Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Application Development, Risk Management, and Service Management to operationalize AI capabilities in a regulated banking environment. **What you will do:** * Architect, configure, maintain, patch, upgrade, and optimize production Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift clusters. * Administer OpenShift Virtualization and shared platform services, including compute, storage, network, identity, backup, recovery, services, vector stores, retrieval controls, reranking, model endpoints, and source traceability. * Support retrieval relevance, grounding, authorization, data freshness, lineage, retention, and quality controls. * Design and support MCP server and agentic AI integration patterns, including authentication, authorization, tool registration, network segmentation, secrets, logging, action Infrastructure\-as\-Code, GitOps, CI/CD, MLOps, and operational automation using approved tools. * Create reusable templates, pipelines, operators, validation controls, and self\-service capabilities. * Implement platform and AI security controls, vulnerability remediation, audit logging, monitoring, incident response, risk documentation, control testing, and regulatory evidence. * Participate in on\-call support, root\-cause analysis, problem management, disaster recovery testing, and continuous improvement. * Perform other job duties as assigned by supervisor. * Travel Required: 0\-10% **Who you are:** * 4 Year /Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related discipline preferred. Additional relevant experience may be considered in lieu of degree. * 5 years minimum progressive enterprise infrastructure, platform engineering, systems engineering, AI engineering, or closely related technical experience required. * 5 years minimum hands\-on Kubernetes engineering in production environments required. * 3 years minimum Hands\-on Red Hat OpenShift engineering and administration required. * 2 years minimum Deploying or operating AI/ML, generative AI, or model\-serving workloads in containerized environments required. * Experience supporting highly available, mission\-critical platforms. * Experience in financial services or another regulated environment is preferred. * Experience integrating platform services with enterprise storage, networking, identity, backup, monitoring, SIEM, CMDB, vulnerability management, and service management solutions. * Red Hat Certified OpenShift Administrator or Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration preferred. * Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS) preferred. * Relevant Red Hat OpenShift AI, NVIDIA, cloud AI, machine learning, security, Linux, automation, or infrastructure certification preferred. * Working knowledge of ITIL practices preferred. * Advanced Kubernetes engineering: cluster architecture, control plane operations, scheduling, networking, storage, RBAC, Operators, Helm, autoscaling, policy, and troubleshooting. * Advanced Red Hat OpenShift experience, including OpenShift Container Platform, OpenShift Virtualization, OpenShift AI, OpenShift GitOps, Routes, Operators, Security Context Constraints, and cluster lifecycle management. * AI platform engineering experience with model serving, LLM inferenc ferably Red Hat Enterprise Linux, and strong knowledge of DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, storage, virtualization, certificates, and network troubleshooting. * Automation and software engineering using Ansible, security, vulnerability management, prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery. * Ability to communicate complex platform and AI concepts to engineers, jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps & Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** Healthcare quality is complex. Medisolv helps make it manageable \- and actionable. We partner with hospitals, health systems, ACOs, and payers to bring clarity to quality data, connecting clinical and claims information into a single, reliable view. More than 1,800 organizations and 130M\+ patient records rely on Medisolv to measure, report, and improve performance across 500\+ measures tied to CMS, The Joint Commission, and other programs. With support from Bessemer Venture Partners Forge, we're continuing to grow our platform and expand our impact \- investing in advanced analytics, AI, and new capabilities that help healthcare organizations stay ahead of change and improve outcomes with confidence. **About the Role** We are looking for a hands\-on Senior DevSecOps \& Cloud Platform Engineer to build, secure, and operate the cloud foundation behind Medisolv's Lilac healthcare analytics platform. This role combines cloud infrastructure engineering, security operations, developer enablement, and production reliability. You will own automation across AWS, infrastructure as code, secure delivery workflows, identity and access, Snowflake platform controls, observability, disaster recovery, and compliance evidence. You will also help evolve the platform from customer\-specific infrastructure toward reusable, parameterized, and versioned capabilities that can be deployed consistently across clients. Success means faster and safer delivery, less manual provisioning and configuration drift, lower support and infrastructure burden, stronger auditability, and a scalable foundation for a multi\-client SaaS product. **What You'll Do** * Build and operate secure, resilient AWS infrastructure using Terraform and disciplined infrastructure\-as\-code practices; maintain clear environment and state boundaries, reusable modules, tested changes, and controlled promotion paths. * Own and improve GitHub\-based engineering workflows, including GitHub Actions, Atlantis plan/apply processes, branch protections, approvals, runners, secrets, release controls, and automated validation for application, data, and infrastructure changes. * Embed security into delivery through least\-privilege IAM and RBAC, federated identity, SAML/OIDC and Cognito patterns, user provisioning and offboarding, access reviews, network controls, secrets and key management, and auditable change management. * Administer and secure Snowflake platform access, including users, service identities, key\-pair or federated authentication, roles and grants, network policies, PrivateLink/VPN connectivity, customer isolation, data\-sharing controls, and behavior\-change readiness. * Improve cloud and application observability through centralized logging, metrics, alerting, audit trails, operational dashboards, runbooks, jobs.title: Senior Platform Enigneer
jobs.description: **About Megaport** We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia\-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun. **Our Team Culture** We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do. We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. ### **The Role** Megaport is building a serverless edge compute platform that runs customer workloads as isolated microVMs on bare metal in our own facilities, directly inside the customer's private network. This role owns the runtime: everything between Kubernetes and the guest kernel. You will be the engineer who makes a container image boot as a secure microVM, with its own private network, in under a second. ### **What You’ll Be Doing** * Designing and building the Go service that converts container images into bootable microVMs and runs them under Firecracker on Kubernetes nodes. * Building the guest init and kernel configuration so standard container images run unchanged. * Building the per\-customer private network: WireGuard overlay, tenant isolation, remote peers, and integration with existing Megaport networking products. * Attaching persistent block storage to microVMs, building fast snapshot and restore. * Owning host security: VM jailing, seccomp, cgroups and least privilege for untrusted customer code on shared hardware. ### **What We Are Looking For** * Deep Linux systems knowledge: KVM and virtio, namespaces and cgroups, block devices and filesystems, boot and init. * Hands\-on experience with a microVM or hypervisor such as Firecracker, Cloud Hypervisor, QEMU or Kata. * Packet\-level Linux networking: tap and bridge devices, routing, nftables, VLANs, WireGuard or IPsec. * Strong Go, or strong C or Rust and the willingness to write Go daily. * Kubernetes from the node's point of view: CNI, device plugins, what a privileged pod actually does. * Experience building or operating a serverless, PaaS, sandbox or cloud compute platform. * You have excellent written and verbal communication skills * You can work collaboratively in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment ### **What We Offer** * Flexible working environments * Birthday Leave * Generous study and training allowance \+ 5 days paid study leave * Creative, fun, and contemporary workspaces * Motivated team of industry experts and new talent * Celebrated success with ‘Legend’ and ‘Kudos’ Awards * Health and wellness program * Opportunities for career growth and potential for global intra\-company transfers for interested candidates \#LI\-DNI If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at Careers@megaport.com **NOTE:** ***All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team careers@megaport.com directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".*** *All applications will be treated in confidence.* *Please see Part 2 of our Privacy Policy to see what information Megaport collects from job applicants, why, and how we store and use it. Note that you’re entitled to know what personal data of yours Megaport holds, to request updates, rectification, and in some circumstances restriction or deletion thereof if you object (you being entitled to withdraw your consent to our holding your information at any time). Please see Part 5 of our Privacy Policy for more details on this and how to contact Megaport's data protection officer if you have any further privacy\-related questions. Candidates who meet the selection criteria will be invited to attend an interview. Strictly no Recruitment Agencies.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: AI Trainer
jobs.description: **About Metis Strategy** Metis Strategy, a management and strategy consulting firm, focused on the intersection of business and technology, continues to grow and is looking for highly motivated individuals to join our San Francisco Bay Area team. We are trusted advisors to Fortune 500 and Global 1000 companies, helping them meet their most critical business objectives through tailored engagements and deep professional relationships. We work across industries on topics related to business \& digital strategy and navigating organizational change. We are an entrepreneurial, fast\-growing firm headquartered in the Washington, D.C. area with offices in the San Francisco Bay Area and Dallas, Texas. The firm’s presence from coast to coast allows us to serve clients throughout the United States and internationally. In our 20\+ year history, we have established a track record of making lasting impacts on organizational performance and helping executives improve business outcomes. In a career with Metis Strategy you will experience high growth as you encounter new challenges with each client engagement; have a high degree of autonomy to craft the direction of your work; and become empowered to work directly with thought\-leaders, C\-level clients, and other decision\-makers. ### **What We Look For** ### **Role summary** You will design and deliver hands\-on AI training for enterprise clients. Sessions are mostly virtual and run in 3–4 hour blocks across global time zones. Audiences range from executives to software engineers. Builder cohorts work in the labs themselves: skills, agents, MCP servers, coding agents, code review. Leader and enabler cohorts work on everyday workflows. You co\-facilitate with other Metis trainers and tailor the content to each client’s industry, tools and security requirements. You own keeping content current. Models, tools and pricing change quarterly, so you update materials before each cohort. ### **Must\-have** ### **Technical depth** * You have shipped LLM or agentic systems to production, not just prototyped them. You can show examples. * You are fluent in how agentic coding harnesses work: context files (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md), skills, subagents, hooks, MCP and plugins. You have built a custom MCP server and an agent end to end. * You know the main ways to extend a model (prompting, RAG, fine\-tuning, self\-hosting) and can explain when to use each. * You understand agent security: prompt injection, least\-privilege tools, human\-in\-the\-loop and guardrails outside the model. * You can explain Tokenomics and cost control to both engineers and finance audiences. **Ecosystem breadth** * Hands\-on with Anthropic (Claude, Claude Code, Cowork), OpenAI (ChatGPT, Codex, SDKs), Microsoft (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Copilot Cowork, GitHub Copilot) and open\-weight models. * Working familiarity with Google (Gemini, Vertex), AWS (Bedrock), Cursor and the major agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, MS Agent Framework). **Teaching and facilitation** * You have taught live, technical, hands\-on sessions to groups, in person or virtual. * You pace a 4\-hour virtual session well: polls, breakouts, chat, energy management and a clean break structure. * You troubleshoot setup problems in locked\-down enterprise environments (Windows, WSL2, proxies, restricted installs, SSO and licensing) without losing the room. * You can explain complex concepts plainly to different audiences, and you stay calm when a live demo misbehaves. Models are non\-deterministic, so demos will sometimes fail. **People skills (observable)** * You read a remote room and adjust. You can tell who is lost, who is bored and who is already ahead. * You handle skepticism and job\-displacement anxiety directly, without dismissing it. * You are comfortable saying “I don’t know, let’s test it.” **Experience** * 10\+ years in software development, data/ML engineering, architecture or technical product work, with recent, practical experience building with LLMs. ### **Strong plus** * Consulting or client\-facing delivery experience, including working under a partner brand and co\-facilitating. * Governance and compliance fluency: responsible AI, data classification, and regional requirements such as the EU AI Act and data residency. * Evals and observability experience: building test sets, guardrails and monitoring for LLM applications. * Instructional design: building labs, measuring learning with pre/post assessments, and reinforcing it afterward (office hours, 30/60/90\-day follow\-through). * Change management or AI adoption experience, including connecting training to business outcomes and ROI. * Domain experience in a regulated or industrial sector (manufacturing, IT/OT, healthcare, financial services). * Experience authoring skills, plugins or reusable templates that a client team can maintain. ### **Nice to have** * Experience teaching across cultures and non\-native English audiences (for example India, EMEA and North America in the same program). * Public thought leadership: writing, talks or open\-source work. * Self\-hosted inference and fine\-tuning experience (vLLM, Ollama, LoRA/QLoRA). ### **What Metis Strategy Has to Offer** Successful candidates will be motivated by the desire to make a difference by helping our clients achieve and maintain strategic and operational excellence while continuously improving their own skill set and embracing emerging intellectual challenges. This position is also eligible for bonus compensation. Additional benefits include but are not limited to: * comprehensive medical insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance; * parental leave, and family benefits; * retirement contributions; * stipend for continued learning; * paid time off, and more. Compensation and benefits are competitive and will be commensurate with each candidate’s qualifications and relevant work experience. If you are driven by the desire to help some of the world’s most renowned companies solve complex business problems and excited by the intersection of business strategy and technological innovation, you will enjoy being a part of our team. The pay range for this role is: 140,000 \- 220,000 USD per year (Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Senior AI Infrastructure & Data Center Architect
jobs.description: **Position Overview** --------------------- MetroSys is seeking an experienced **Senior AI Infrastructure \& Data Center Architect** to design, deploy, and optimize enterprise infrastructure environments supporting GPU\-accelerated computing, artificial intelligence platforms, and high\-performance workloads. application development, data science, or machine learning engineering position.** The focus is on building and supporting the underlying IT infrastructure required to operate enterprise AI environments. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ ### **Enterprise Infrastructure \& Data Center Architecture** * Design and architect enterprise data center infrastructure supporting GPU\-accelerated computing and high\-performance workloads. * Develop end\-to\-end infrastructure solutions integrating compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and management platforms. * Assess existing customer environments and identify infrastructure requirements for deploying NVIDIA AI computing solutions. * Create high\-level and low\-level infrastructure designs, technical diagrams, bills of materials (BOMs), and implementation plans. * Lead infrastructure discovery sessions, technical assessments, and architecture workshops with enterprise customers. * Evaluate hardware platforms, infrastructure dependencies, scalability requirements, and operational considerations. * Design highly available, resilient, and scalable infrastructure environments. * Provide technical guidance on data center modernization, infrastructure consolidation, and emerging accelerated computing technologies. ### **NVIDIA GPU \& Accelerated Computing Infrastructure** * Design infrastructure solutions utilizing NVIDIA DGX, HGX, MGX, and enterprise GPU computing platforms. * Architect GPU compute environments incorporating NVIDIA Hopper, Blackwell, and other accelerated computing technologies. * Evaluate GPU server platforms, compute density, hardware compatibility, and infrastructure sizing requirements. * Design and support GPU cluster infrastructure for enterprise AI and high\-performance computing environments. * Provide architectural guidance on NVIDIA Base Command Manager, NVIDIA Mission Control, and related infrastructure management technologies. * Support infrastructure deployment, configuration, validation, and operational readiness for NVIDIA\-based computing environments. * Evaluate GPU resource allocation, cluster performance, capacity requirements, and infrastructure utilization. * Work with hardware manufacturers and infrastructure vendors to develop integrated computing solutions. ### **High\-Performance Networking** * Design high\-bandwidth, low\-latency networking environments supporting GPU clusters and distributed computing. * Architect NVIDIA InfiniBand and high\-speed Ethernet networking solutions. * Design network fabrics utilizing RoCE, RDMA, and other high\-performance interconnect technologies. * Evaluate NVIDIA Spectrum Ethernet and Quantum InfiniBand switching technologies. * Develop network architectures supporting east\-west traffic, high\-throughput data movement, and distributed GPU workloads. * Integrate accelerated computing environments with existing enterprise networking infrastructure. * Evaluate network performance, redundancy, scalability, and resiliency requirements. * Troubleshoot complex network connectivity and performance issues affecting GPU infrastructure. ### **Enterprise Storage \& Data Center Systems** * Architect high\-performance storage environments supporting GPU\-intensive computing workloads. * Evaluate enterprise SAN, NAS, NVMe, NVMe\-oF, and parallel file system technologies. * Design storage connectivity and data access architectures for large\-scale compute clusters. * Integrate enterprise storage platforms with NVIDIA GPU computing environments. * Evaluate storage performance, throughput, latency, and scalability requirements. * Support infrastructure solutions involving Linux, virtualization platforms, and containerized infrastructure environments. * Assess data center requirements including rack architecture, power distribution, cooling, and hardware density. * Collaborate er infrastructure teams, IT directors, and technology leadership. * Translate technical requirements into infrastructure designs and implementation strategies. * Develop architecture documentation, technical proposals, and infrastructure equipment specifications. * Collaborate with technical sales teams and engineering resources during solution development. * Evaluate infrastructure technologies from NVIDIA, Cisco, Dell, HPE, Lenovo, AMD, and other enterprise technology providers. * Provide technical leadership and mentoring to infrastructure engineers and architects. * Present infrastructure recommendations and solution designs to technical and executive stakeholders. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 10\+ years of experience in enterprise IT infrastructure engineering, data center architecture, or solutions architecture. * Extensive experience designing and implementing complex enterprise infrastructure environments. * Strong technical understanding of NVIDIA GPU computing infrastructure and accelerated computing platforms. * Experience with enterprise server architecture, compute platforms, and large\-scale infrastructure deployments. * Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking, including high\-speed Ethernet, InfiniBand, RoCE, or RDMA technologies. * Strong understanding of enterprise storage technologies, including SAN, NAS, NVMe, and high\-performance storage architectures. * Experience with Linux\-based infrastructure environments and enterprise virtualization technologies. * Knowledge of GPU cluster architecture, infrastructure management, and compute resource allocation. * Experience developing infrastructure architecture documentation, high\-level designs, low\-level designs, and bills of materials. * Understanding of data center hardware requirements, including rack density, power, cooling, and physical infrastructure considerations. * Experience integrating compute, networking, and storage platforms into enterprise environments. * Strong troubleshooting, infrastructure assessment, and technical problem\-solving skills. * Ability to lead customer\-facing architecture discussions and provide technical recommendations. **NVIDIA Certifications** ------------------------- Candidates holding one or more of the following NVIDIA professional certifications are strongly preferred: * **NVIDIA\-Certified Professional: AI Infrastructure (NCP\-AII)** – Demonstrates expertise in NVIDIA AI infrastructure architecture, deployment, and enterprise computing environments. * **NVIDIA\-Certified Professional: AI Networking (NCP\-AIN)** – Demonstrates expertise in high\-performance networking technologies supporting accelerated computing infrastructure. * **NVIDIA\-Certified Professional: AI Operations (NCP\-AIO)** – Demonstrates expertise in operating, administering, monitoring, and maintaining NVIDIA AI infrastructure environments. Candidates with multiple NVIDIA certifications will receive additional consideration. Equivalent hands\-on experience designing and deploying NVIDIA accelerated computing infrastructure will also be considered. **Preferred Technical Experience** ---------------------------------- * NVIDIA DGX, HGX, MGX, and accelerated computing platforms. * NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPU architectures. * NVIDIA Spectrum Ethernet and Quantum InfiniBand networking. * NVIDIA Base Command Manager and Mission Control. * GPU cluster design, deployment, and administration. * InfiniBand, RoCE, RDMA, and high\-performance Ethernet networking. * Enterprise storage solutions and parallel file systems. * Linux infrastructure administration and cluster management. * Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift infrastructure. * VMware or other enterprise virtualization technologies. * Enterprise data center infrastructure and hardware integration. * Infrastructure automation and configuration management. * High\-performance computing (HPC) architecture. * NVIDIA AI Factory infrastructure design and deployment. iMuT0HDC9y

Our team partners closely with People leaders and functional teams to identify high\-value opportunities, simplify and redesign workflows, and rapidly translate business challenges into scalable solutions. The Applied AI Engineer is a business\-facing technologist who works directly with People teams to identify opportunities, redesign processes, rapidly build AI\-enabled solutions, and own delivery from business problem through deployed outcome. This is not a traditional software engineering role and not a consulting role that stops at recommendations. The Applied AI Engineer combines business acumen, process engineering, AI solution design, hands\-on coding, and delivery ownership to turn workforce challenges into working solutions. jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer - Security Data, Risk Reduction & Response
jobs.description: **Overview** **Team overview:** IAM Protect, part of Microsoft's CISO organization, protects the production environments that run Microsoft's cloud, including the identities, tenants, applications and critical services that everything else depends on. We keep attackers out of production through tenant, application and access policies and company\-wide risk\-reduction campaigns. We build the security data and graph platforms that power our operations, risk reduction and incident response. And when an incident happens, we lead the work to evict the attacker and keep them out. Data is the backbone of all of it. Every policy we enforce, every campaign we run and every eviction we execute depends on knowing exactly which identities, applications, credentials and permissions exist, who owns them and what they can reach. **Role overview:** We are looking for a **Senior Security Operations Engineer – Security Data, Risk Reduction \& Response**who is as effective in a Kusto query window as in a risk\-reduction review or a live incident. You will turn troves of raw identity, configuration and telemetry data into insight that drives decisions; model attack paths and risk; help build and scale our security data, graph and eviction capabilities; support incident response; and lead campaigns that measurably reduce exposure across Microsoft's production cloud. This is a deliberately broad role on a team that values range. You will start on the team that builds our data platform and eviction capabilities and drives risk reduction, and as priorities evolve you will have opportunities to apply your skills across IAM Protect's mission. If you love data, learn new domains quickly and want your work to show up as measurable risk reduction, we want to talk to you. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day. **Responsibilities** * Turn raw data into decisions. * Write and optimize KQL across large, heterogeneous datasets (directory and tenant data, application and credential inventories, role assignments, configuration and telemetry) to find exposure, answer leadership questions quickly and prove when risk has gone down. * Help build our security data platform with engineering: define sources, schemas, data quality checks and pipelines, and turn ad hoc analysis into durable datasets, dashboards and self\-service views that operations, risk\-reduction and incident response teams rely on. * Model risk with graph\-based attack\-path analysis to understand blast radius and identify the paths worth removing first. * Lead risk\-reduction campaigns end to end: size the problem with data, find the owners, set targets, drive burn\-down across service teams, manage exceptions and report measurable progress. * Support incident response. Rapidly scope affected identities, applications, credentials and resources using our data platforms, help responders plan and execute evictions, and feed lessons learned back into controls and campaigns. * Strengthen our eviction capabilities by contributing requirements, data enrichment and validation, and by testing new features with responders before a real incident needs them. * Automate the toil, using scripting and AI\-assisted tools and agents to remove manual effort from analysis, campaign tracking and response. * Write concise analyses and status updates for engineering leaders and senior leadership. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** * Doctorate in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field + OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field AND 3\+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large\-scale computing, threat modeling, cyber security, anomaly detection, Security Operations Center (SOC) detection, threat analytics, security incident and event management (SIEM), information technology (IT), or operations incident response + OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field AND 4\+ years experience in software development lifecycle, large\-scale computing, threat modeling, cyber security, anomaly detection, Security Operations Center (SOC) detection, threat analytics, security incident and event management (SIEM), information technology (IT), or operations incident response - OR equivalent experience. **Other Requirements:** Candidates must be able to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. code. * Establish checks for data quality, freshness, schema changes, and training\-serving consistency. * Build workflows for labeling, enrichment, deduplication, and dataset curation with our clinical experts. * Explore data to identify quality issues, coverage gaps, and opportunities to improve model performance. * Own well\-scoped projects and communicate data assumptions, limitations, infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK) plus at least one database or warehouse. * Strong experience processing and manipulating datasets with inconsistent schemas, and imbalanced or handling sensitive health data. * Good software engineering practice: testing, version control and code review. **Helpful additional experience** * Workflow orchestration and distributed processing tools, such as Airflow, Dagster, or Spark. * Docker and CI/CD. * Dataset versioning, lineage, and reproducibility. * Annotation platforms, active learning, or human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * verbal. * Startups and cross\-functional teams.

and automated regression tests that measure safety, empathy, and risk. * Select appropriate metrics, analyze performance across meaningful data segments, and investigate failure modes. * Design experiments and use statistical methods to judge whether an improvement is real. * Connect offline evaluation results with what customers see in production. * Develop tools that make evaluation repeatable and useful throughout development and release workflows. * Communicate findings, limitations, and recommendations clearly to clinicians, product leads, and customers. **What you’ll bring** * Practical experience developing and shipping ML systems, typically 2–5 years of relevant work or equivalent. * Strong Python skills and familiarity with common ML frameworks. * Solid ML fundamentals, including training, validation, generalization, and common sources of model error. * Experience with evaluation metrics, benchmark design, and systematic error analysis. * An jobs.title: Early Software Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description: **About Multiply** Multiply is building the AI\-native media agency for B2B companies, combining AI agents with expert strategists to transform how businesses run and optimize paid advertising. Our platform connects to advertising channels, CRMs, and customer data to continuously create, manage, and optimize campaigns. We're building autonomous AI agents that make decisions, execute workflows, learn from results, and improve performance over time. We're also building a Marketing Intelligence platform that learns from thousands of campaigns and ads to uncover insights about buyers, creative performance, and channels, making every campaign and Ad smarter than the last. We're a fast\-growing, venture\-backed startup tackling complex technical challenges at the intersection of AI, automation, and large\-scale marketing data. Our goal is to fundamentally change how marketing gets done. **Role Description** We're looking for an exceptional AI\-native engineer who loves building products, solving hard problems, and shipping fast. As an early engineer at Multiply, you'll work directly with the founders to build and scale our AI\-powered platform. You'll have significant ownership over product features, technical architecture, and engineering decisions. This isn't a role where you'll be handed detailed specifications. You'll take ambiguous problems, figure out what matters, and ship solutions to customers. You'll work across the stack, from intuitive product experiences to sophisticated AI agents and backend systems. You'll join a small, ambitious team in San Francisco where your work will have an immediate impact on our product, customers, and company. **What you’ll do** * **Build AI\-powered products**: Own and ship end\-to\-end features that customers use every day, from intuitive interfaces to complex backend systems. * **Develop autonomous AI agents**: Build agents that reason, plan, execute actions, and continuously improve marketing workflows. * **Engineer reliable AI systems**: Design agent orchestration, tool integrations, evaluations, observability, and feedback loops to make AI systems dependable in production. * **Integrate data and build intelligence:** Connect advertising platforms, CRMs, and other data sources to power intelligent automation, uncover insights, and improve decision\-making. * **Move fast with AI**: Leverage AI coding tools and modern development workflows to prototype, build, and ship at exceptional speed without compromising quality. * **Own problems end\-to\-end**: Work directly with founders and customers to turn ambiguous ideas into working products, from initial design through production. * **Shape our engineering foundation**: Influence architecture, tooling, technical decisions, and engineering culture as the team grows. **What We Mean by "AI\-Native"** AI isn't just a feature we're building — it's fundamental to how we build software. We expect engineers to actively use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other AI\-powered development tools to accelerate development, testing, and experimentation. We're looking for engineers who constantly explore new AI capabilities, rethink traditional development workflows, and combine AI\-driven speed with strong engineering judgment. **Qualifications** * Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building and shipping production applications across the stack. * Hands\-on experience with modern AI development tools and a demonstrated ability to use them effectively. * Experience building AI\-powered applications or workflows, ideally using LLMs or agents. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to independently take ambiguous problems from idea to production. * Product\-minded engineering approach — you care about the user experience and business impact, not just the code. * Comfortable moving quickly, learning new technologies, and making pragmatic technical trade\-offs. * High ownership, curiosity, and a bias toward action. **Bonus Points** * Experience with agent frameworks, orchestration, tool calling, or evaluation systems. * Experience building integrations with third\-party APIs or complex data systems. * Previous experience at an early\-stage startup or building your own products.

jobs.title: Senior Automation Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Every CPU, GPU, and Tegra SoC NVIDIA has shipped in the past decade has passed through our toolchain on its way to production. That toolchain grew up alongside the chips: powerful, battle\-tested, and built for a smaller, slower world! Chip complexity is outpacing the infrastructure that develops it. When a workflow breaks, engineers lose days. When the system scales badly, schedules slip. We’re rebuilding this toolchain into a modern, distributed automation platform, without ever stopping the chips that depend on it! **What you’ll be doing:** * The architecture. You’ll set the technical direction for Python services, production APIs, and Kubernetes\-hosted systems that thousands of hardware engineers rely on daily. * The full lifecycle. You’ll take a design from whiteboard to production and keep it healthy once it’s there: reliability, observability, and failure recovery. * The migration. You’ll decide what gets rebuilt, what gets wrapped, and what gets retired, and you’ll prove it works under real load. * The standards. You’ll lead design reviews and raise the bar for how engineering teams across the group build and ship. The AI layer. You’ll bring AI\-assisted capabilities into production workflows where they measurably help, and leave them out where they don’t. * **What we need to see:** * BS, MS, or PhD (or equivalent experience) in CS, CE, EE, or a related field, with 10\+ years of relevant experience. We care more about what you’ve shipped than how you got there. * You have developed backend systems that other specialists depend on, and you’ve been on call for them. * Proficiency in Python and building APIs people enjoy using. You know what breaks in distributed systems (async processing, partial failures, data consistency) because you’ve fixed it. * Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation, and you lead by example and judgment, not title. You’ve designed and built AI/LLM\-powered systems that automate workflows, strengthen design verification, and improve engineering efficiency. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Built an automation platform for a large engineering organization and watched real users adopt it. * Run Kubernetes at scale with Helm and Terraform. * Worked with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, Airflow, Argo Workflows, Celery, or Temporal, and have opinions on when each is the wrong choice. * You’ve modernized a legacy system without a rewrite\-and\-pray cutover. Understand silicon development, validation, or large\-scale compute infrastructure. * You’ll join the Silicon Co\-Design Group, working directly with the chip architects and verification engineers who use what you build. Your feedback loop is days, not quarters, and your work shows up in the next chip. \#LI\-Hybrid Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job\-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 187,500 USD – 364,000 USD for Level 4; and 232,500 USD – 442,000 USD for Level 5\. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . jobs.title: Open Source Software Engineer
jobs.description: At NetApp, our High Achievement Principles shape how we work: we innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel as a team. We have a history of helping customers turn challenges into business opportunities. That’s because we bring new thinking to age\-old problems, like how to use data most effectively in the most efficient possible way. As an Engineer with NetApp, you’ll have the opportunity to work with modern cloud and container orchestration technologies in a production setting. You’ll play an important role in scaling systems sustainably through automation and evolving them by pushing for changes to improve reliability and velocity. **Success profile** ------------------- Ready to be an engineer at NetApp? Explore the traits that can help you thrive. * Analytical * Adaptable * Communicator * Detail\-oriented * Quick\-thinking * Problem solver **Responsibilities** -------------------- United States; Remote **Job category:** Software Engineering **Job ID:** 137109\-en\_US **Own Every Moment at NetApp** At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud. Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real\-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function. **Job Summary** --------------- Are you an Apache Kafka committer or contributor who wants to operate at the highest level of technical and community influence? This role connects deep upstream work, including binding committer authority, KIP\-level design, and protocol\-aware engineering, directly to production\-scale outcomes in enterprise Kafka deployments. NetApp Instaclustr runs one of the industry's largest managed open source data platform portfolios, including Apache Kafka services for enterprise customers across financial services, retail, and technology sectors. Our open source engineering team contributes to projects that matter to production operators at scale, and this role strengthens our ability to influence Apache Kafka upstream in areas that affect reliability, performance, operability, and customer delivery. You will work at both levels \- upstream influence and customer impact \- with meaningful autonomy, strong peer collaboration, and direct access to the product and field relationships that turn technical work into commercial outcomes. Postion location: **US San Jose, CA** **Job Requirements** -------------------- **Job Requirements** * A minimum of 8\+ years of applicable professional software engineering experience is required. * Current Apache Kafka committer status with a sustained and publicly verifiable upstream track record across patches, reviews, KIPs, and community standing in Kafka core or a closely related area such as Streams, Connect, clients, or release engineering. * Expert Java engineering capability in performance\-sensitive, concurrent, and production\-grade distributed systems, with the ability to write, review, and reason about complex Kafka internals at depth. * Deep mastery of Apache Kafka internals in at least one major domain: broker storage and log replication, KRaft and metadata management, consumer group coordination and rebalancing, protocol and client compatibility, Kafka Streams, Kafka Connect, observability, performance, or release management and CI. * Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical work through the Apache open source governance model: KIP authoring or co\-sponsorship, design consensus, mailing\-list engagement, and Jira\-driven delivery from proposal through merge. * Strong written communication for asynchronous, global, public technical collaboration \- mailing lists, design documents, code reviews, and Jira threads. * Proven senior\-level technical judgment that resolves most blockers independently, determines approach on novel or ambiguous assignments, surfaces systemic risks proactively, and produces work that is consistent with project and team objectives. **Preferred qualifications** * PMC membership in Apache Kafka or a related Apache project. * Track record of work in current Kafka feature and maintenance areas such as KRaft maturity, controller and metadata reliability, consumer rebalance protocol improvements, exactly\-once semantics, tiered storage, Kafka Connect security and operability, Streams APIs, client metrics, or release stabilization. * Experience connecting upstream technical leadership to enterprise customer and operator outcomes \- translating production pain points into accepted community improvements. * History of mentoring contributors toward reviewer or committer standing in an open governance project. * Familiarity with the Kafka ecosystem: Kafka Streams, Kafka Connect, MirrorMaker 2, Kafka clients, schema and serialization patterns, Kubernetes\-based Kafka operations, or adjacent open source projects such as Strimzi. **Education** ------------- Bachelor's degree in engineering or technical related field of study Or additional equivalent experience. At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in\-office and/or in\-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification. **Why You'll Thrive at NetApp** At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure. NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise\-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security. **Our culture** We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do. If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment \- make your next move your best one. Apply now. **Submitting an Application** To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application. **AI Disclosure** For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision\-making. **Our values** -------------- Put the customer at the center. Care for each other and our communities. Think and act like owners. Build belonging every day. Embrace a growth mindset. **Benefits** ------------ ### **Volunteer time off** 40 hours of paid volunteer time each year. ### **Well\-being** Employee Assistance Program, fitness, and mental health resources to help employees be their best. ### **Time away** Paid time off for vacation and to recharge.

jobs.title: Software Engineer 5, AI Observability
jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. **The Opportunity** ------------------- The AI Observability team makes AI, ML, and Agentic systems transparent, reliable, and production\-ready at scale. We build end\-to\-end observability for ML and GenAI workloads, capturing model inputs, features, predictions, outcomes, and behavior across online and batch systems. Our platform enables teams to monitor model performance, data quality, drift, latency, and failures, turning the ML system from a black box into an explainable, debuggable system. We provide developer\-friendly libraries, dashboards, and alerts so teams can debug issues, respond to incidents, and ship AI\-powered products with confidence. We're looking for a hands\-on senior engineer to build the frameworks behind Netflix's AI Observability platform, model performance, evaluation, and vendor integration surfaces. You will design reusable infrastructure that enables ML/AI practitioners across domains to monitor model quality in production, evaluate LLM and agentic systems, and adopt vendor tooling through a consistent, self\-serve platform. AIP owns the generic, reusable infrastructure; domain teams own their domain\-specific evals and remediation. You will partner closely with engineering, product, machine learning, and data teams to turn their needs into reusable platform capabilities. To succeed, you will bring a strong background in AI or ML infrastructure and a passion for building scalable, robust systems. **In this role, you will:** --------------------------- * Build the observability framework and platform capabilities that give ML and GenAI systems metrics, logs, and distributed traces across online inference, batch scoring, feature pipelines, and agent orchestration, so teams can instrument their systems consistently. * Build the primitives that let teams monitor model performance (accuracy, calibration, error rates), data quality, drift, and degradation on their own systems, rather than monitoring individual models yourself. * Build and extend evaluation frameworks for LLM and agentic systems that support response quality, grounding and hallucination, task success, tool\-use and trajectory correctness, and LLM\-as\-a\-judge and human\-in\-the\-loop scoring, giving teams reusable building blocks to define and run their own evals. * Lead build\-vs\-buy evaluations for observability and eval tooling, and own the SDKs, connectors, and APIs that integrate vendor platforms into a consistent, well\-supported interface, so ML and product teams can onboard models and agents with minimal friction. * Build reusable libraries, SDKs, and templates that make observability and evaluation the default for new systems ("observability\-by\-default"), lowering the barrier for teams to instrument and evaluate their work. * Provide the dashboarding, alerting, and SLO/SLI building blocks (plus sensible out\-of\-the\-box templates) that teams use to track model performance, latency, cost, and reliability. **To succeed in this role, you will need:** ------------------------------------------- * Experience in software, AI/ML, or platform engineering, with hands\-on time in production observability, monitoring, or ML/LLM evaluation * Proven track record of designing standards, libraries, SDKs, or frameworks that other teams build on and adopt, reflecting a platform and enablement mindset rather than shipping features for a single use case. * Strong coding skills in Python and at least one of Java, Go, or Scala, with experience building production services * Practical experience operating ML models in production (online serving and/or batch), including drift, model performance, and data quality. * Hands\-on experience with modern observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus/Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, ELK/OpenSearch, Jaeger/Tempo, or similar). * Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Ability to work cross\-functionally with ML, data, infra, and product teams, and to communicate clearly about system behavior, quality, and risk. * Experience with vendor integration and VPC deployment. * An AI\-Native Engineering Mindset who uses AI tools as a core part of their own workflow to accelerate design, development, testing, and code review. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Hands\-on experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation tools (e.g., Arize, Braintrust, LangFuse, Weights \& Biases, Galileo, Vertex AI Model Monitoring, SageMaker Model Monitor). * Experience building or shipping LLM/GenAI applications and evaluating them: prompt/result logging, evaluation metrics, LLM\-as\-a\-judge, and human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Experience evaluating agentic systems: tool use, multi\-step reasoning, and trajectory/task\-success measurement. To learn more about our AI Platform, you can review the relevant talks/blog posts on the Netflix AI Platform Research website . Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $500,000\.00 \- $860,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Netic is the AI revenue engine for essential services who are the backbone of the American economy. **With $43M in funding from Founders Fund, Greylock, Hanabi, and Dylan Field who led our Series B, we helped our customers book hundreds of thousands of jobs across services industries in North America.** There are now companies operating entirely AI\-first on Netic. You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible. As an Applied AI Engineer, you’ll dive deep into cutting\-edge research, understand the business functions we put on autopilot inside\-out, and execute targeted ML projects that deliver pure magic. **What You'll Do:** * **Study the frontier:** Track frontier work in traditional ML, LLMs, multimodal models, retrieval, and agentic systems—then distill it into ideas we can ship. * **Identify high‑ROI projects:** Partner with GTM and ops teams to spot bottlenecks in products; define ML projects that unlock significant leverage for customers. * **Build targeted models:** Own the full cycle—data curation, training, evaluation, and deployment—delivering systems that solve real customer pain points. * **Productionize solutions:** Integrate models into our real\-time platform via robust APIs and streaming pipelines, ensuring model performance and guardrails from day one. * **Self‑direct \& ship:** Operate like a founder—set technical roadmap, validate quickly, and iterate based on real\-world results. **What You'll Bring:** * **Deep ML experience:** Extensive work with cutting\-edge ML techniques; fluent in PyTorch or JAX and modern serving frameworks. * **Research‑to‑revenue record:** Proof you’ve taken novel ML concepts from paper prod with measurable $$ impact or user growth. * **Full‑stack pragmatism:** Comfortable with ETL, feature stores, cloud\-native infrastructure, and A/B experimentation. * **Data engineering skills:** Experience working with complex, real\-world data streams and building reliable training pipelines. * **Product intuition:** Ability to understand customer workflows and translate business needs into technical solutions. * **Ownership model:** You default to action, uphold a high craftsmanship bar, and treat failure modes as learning‑rate multipliers. **Our values** * Obsess over the customer * Every second counts * Sweat the details * There are no blockers * Be self\-directed * Seek and speak the truth * Enjoy the ride *We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.* Compensation Range: $145K \- $330K
