jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Architect (AI)
jobs.description: **Artificial Intelligence (AI) Architect** **Reports To:** CFO **Company Overview:** Netlist, Inc. (OTCQB: NLST) is a leading provider of high\-performance modular memory subsystems and next\-generation storage\-class memory solutions. We specialize in cutting\-edge technologies that enable innovation in AI, cloud computing, and enterprise infrastructure. Our product portfolio includes DDR4/DDR5 DIMMs, NAND\-based SSDs, and advanced interconnect technologies such as **CXL** and **PCIe**. Join our world\-class engineering team and be part of shaping the future of memory and storage architecture. **Position Summary:** This Artificial Intelligence (AI) role will lead the development and execution of the company's AI strategy, driving innovation across AI\-enabled products, infrastructure, and business operations. This role will oversee the identification, design, and implementation of machine learning, generative AI, advanced analytics, and AI infrastructure initiatives that support both current and future business objectives. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in AI/ML with strong business acumen and executive leadership skills. This individual will work closely with engineering, product management, marketing, and executive leadership to identify opportunities where AI can create competitive advantage and accelerate growth. **Essential Responsibilities** * Develop and execute the company's AI vision, strategy, and roadmap. * Identify new AI\-based products, services, and revenue opportunities. * Lead AI and machine learning initiatives from concept through deployment. * Build and manage high\-performing teams of AI engineers, data scientists, and software developers. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and platforms. * Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into products and systems. * Partner with executive leadership to align AI investments with business objectives. * Establish AI governance, security, privacy, and ethical\-use standards. * Drive innovation in generative AI, predictive analytics, automation, and intelligent systems. * Define KPIs and measure the business impact of AI initiatives. * Manage external partnerships with AI vendors, research institutions, and technology providers. * Present AI strategies, business cases, and project outcomes to executive leadership and the Board as required. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. * 10\+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, machine learning, data science, or artificial intelligence. * 5\+ years of leadership experience managing technical teams. * Experience building and deploying AI solutions at enterprise scale. * Strong knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, LLMs, generative AI, and AI infrastructure. * Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. * Proficiency with Python and modern AI frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain, or similar technologies. * Strong communication and executive presentation skills. * Proven ability to translate business requirements into AI\-driven solutions. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. * Experience in the semiconductor, memory, storage, cloud infrastructure, or data center industries. * Experience with AI hardware acceleration, inference optimization, or large\-scale distributed systems. * Track record of developing AI products from concept to commercial deployment. **Range:** $220,000 \- $280,000 Base Salary

jobs.title: SCADA Engineer
jobs.description: Do you want to be a part of the clean energy movement? Are you passionate about improving our environment for this generation and those to follow? Are you ready to take on new challenges and collaborate with a future\-focused team leading the way into new markets? Join Nexamp! This is where you can learn from industry leaders and become one yourself. It's fast\-paced, mission\-based work that challenges the status quo. Be on the team that's changing the world. **What** **we're** **looking for:** Nexamp is looking to hire a SCADA Engineer. You will be responsible for supporting the reliable monitoring and control of Nexamp's solar photovoltaic and battery energy storage assets by engineering, integrating, and maintaining SCADA systems and field communications. This role ensures accurate telemetry, dependable remote control and alarming, and timely resolution of operational issues that support Nexamp's 24/7 Operations Center. By maintaining reliable and secure SCADA functionality across the asset portfolio, in this role you'll contribute directly to asset availability, operational performance, and the continued growth of Nexamp's renewable energy fleet. You will be hybrid out of the Lawrence or Boston office. You will report to the Director, Operational Technologies. **What you'll do:** * Support and troubleshoot SCADA, telemetry, communications, alarming, and control issues for Nexamp's 24/7 Operations Center, restoring reliable monitoring and control of field assets and participating in the after\-hours on\-call rotation as required. * Maintain and optimize SCADA databases, point configurations, alarm logic, HMI graphical displays, and control mappings to ensure accurate, usable, and reliable real\-time operational information. * Commission and integrate new solar PV and battery energy storage assets into Nexamp's SCADA environment, including field\-device configuration, communications setup, protocol configuration, I/O mapping, and end\-to\-end functional testing. * Troubleshoot and resolve SCADA communications, telemetry, networking, and field\-device issues across centralized and site\-level OT infrastructure to minimize downtime and maintain reliable remote operations. * Configure and support SCADA\-connected field equipment and supporting OT infrastructure, including RTACs, meters, reclosers, routers, switches, and related control and communications devices. * Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Cybersecurity, vendors, and other stakeholders to maintain data integrity, reliable telemetry, secure remote control, and continuous improvement of SCADA performance. * Maintain accurate technical documentation, including SCADA point lists, system configurations, network diagrams, technical specifications, commissioning records, and operating procedures. **What you'll bring: (adding in required skills AND Nexamp competencies)** * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience working with SCADA systems in energy, utilities, or industrial automation sectors. * Experience with HMI/SCADA platforms such as Ignition and AVEVA System Platforms. * Experience in managing SCADA databases containing electrical components, such as maintaining SCADA point lists and parameters, control mappings, etc. * Skilled in configuring and troubleshooting SEL RTACs, reclosers, meters, and industrial control devices. * Good understanding of industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC/UA, and IEC 61850\. * Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, including troubleshooting within OT/ICS environments. * Experience in commissioning and resolving site technical issues, independently troubleshooting challenging SCADA related technical issues * Proficient with operational and analytical software tools, including Microsoft Excel, Word, and database platforms such as Microsoft Access or similar. * Commitment to Nexamp's mission and have a passion for solving tomorrow's climate crisis today. * Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization. * Experience in showcasing initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across the organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality. * Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions. * Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry. * Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions. ***If you don't meet 100% of the above qualifications, but see yourself contributing, please apply.*** ***At Nexamp, our mission is to build the future of energy so it is clean, simple, and accessible for all. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. By encouraging a culture where ideas and decisions come from all people, we believe it will help us grow, innovate, and be a part of environmental and social change.*** **You'll** **love working here because:** Not only will you get to take part in meaningful work and have the chance to change the world alongside innovative, dedicated, and motivated peers, but you will also have access to all the benefits that Nexamp offers! This includes our competitive compensation package; a 401(k) employer\-match; health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one; flexible paid time off and holiday PTO; commuter benefits, and cell phone reimbursement. We have headquarters in Boston, MA and Chicago, IL, in addition to growing offices nationwide. We provide healthy snacks, coffee, service days and other volunteer opportunities, company outings, and more! **Compensation** (only for required states) *The reasonably estimated hourly rate for this role at Nexamp ranges from $45 \- $50 per hour. In addition to base pay, the competitive compensation package may include, depending on the role, participation in an incentive program linked to performance (for example, annual bonus programs based on individual and company performance, non\-annual sales incentive plans, or other non\-annual incentive plans). Additionally, you may be eligible to participate in the Company's stock option plan. Actual base salary may vary based upon, but is not limited to, skills and qualifications, internal equity, performance, and geographic location.* *Nexamp's People team manages all aspects of recruitment and hiring within our organization. jobs.title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: NikoHealth is a rapidly growing SaaS company transforming how Durable Medical Equipment (DME) and Home Medical Equipment (HME) providers operate. Our innovative, all\-in\-one platform streamlines business operations, empowering providers to work smarter and more efficiently.### **About The Rol****e** This is a newly created role, and one of the first two engineering hires NikoHealth has made in the United States. You'll report directly to the CTO and own how data gets into our platform, out of it, and between the databases underneath it. Almost everything hard about bringing on a new customer is a data problem. Getting years of patient, order, and billing history out of a competitor's system and into ours currently runs on hand\-run scripts, CSVs on a shared drive, and transform logic that lives outside version control. There's no CI on it, no dry run, and no safe way to re\-run a failed load. Every migration adds weeks to an onboarding. Your first job is to turn that into a tested, repeatable pipeline, and then make how long onboarding takes a number we can actually report. It's the single clearest path we have to landing revenue we've already signed. The scope is the databases themselves and everything that moves data in and out of them. It's deliberately focused: this is the constraint on how fast we can bring customers live, and we'd rather you fix it properly than spread across everything. **What you'll do in the first 6 months*** Get the migration pipeline into version control and under CI, with a dry\-run mode and re\-runs that don't corrupt anything. * Publish our import contract, so onboarding teams and customers both know what good input looks like before anyone starts. * Put a real measurement on onboarding time\-to\-live, reported separately for enterprise and small business. We can't currently tell a prospect how long it takes. * Own database configuration, backup, and restore across the fleet, and prove a restore actually works. * Plan the consolidation of our two database engines. Every customer runs both MySQL and PostgreSQL side by side with a live bridge between them, and untangling that is yours to scope, sequence, and execute. **What we're looking for*** 5\+ years in data engineering, data platform, or a closely related role. * Strong SQL, including performance work on large tables, against PostgreSQL or MySQL. You'd work in both. * Production ingestion pipelines you built and operated, where idempotency and safe re\-runs were a design concern rather than an afterthought. * Experience migrating customer data between systems where the source was messy and the customer was watching. * Python, C\# to the level where you own the transform layer outright. * Daily working use of AI coding agents such as Cursor or Claude Code, including the harness around them: tests, project instructions, and a loop you can run again. ### **Nice to have** * dbt, or a strong opinion about what the ETL layer should look like. * Healthcare claims formats, particularly X12 837 and 835\. * A MySQL to PostgreSQL consolidation you've actually done. We're not asking for HL7 or FHIR. If you have it, great, but it isn't what this job needs. ### **How we work** **We're honest about what this is.** The current state is rough and needs dedicated investment. Some of the tooling was built as a workaround years ago and quietly became permanent. We're also genuinely mid\-decision on real things and we'd rather hire someone who helps make those calls than pretend they're already made. **We work with AI agents, seriously.** The team works agentically and so will you. What matters is what you do after the agent produces something: tests, linters, project instructions, a loop you can run again. If your answer to a bad result is a longer prompt, we're probably not a fit. **Most application development is done by a long\-standing engineering partner.** Some data work runs through them today as ticketed requests, and part of the point of this role is that it stops having to. **No layers, and no new bottlenecks.** You'd be one of the first two engineering employees here, reporting to the CTO. Nobody sits between you and the person who decides. In return, we'd ask that what you build outlives you being on call for it: automation only its author understands is a different dependency, not a fix for the first one. Everyone here is remote, and we'd like your hours to overlap the US East Coast. **This is the start of the engineering team, not the end of it.** We're hiring more engineers through 2027\. The people who join first get the widest scope, the most say in how the team gets built, and first choice about what they own as it grows. ### **How to apply** Apply through the link on this page. Instead of a cover letter, we ask one question: **tell us about the messiest data migration you've run, and what you'd do differently.** A few sentences is plenty. Use AI to help write your application if you want to, we do too. We read every one ourselves, and we can tell when nobody read the posting. Your first conversation will be with our CTO, who is the hiring manager and will walk you through the rest of the process. ### **Compensation and benefits** * The range shown for this role is **base salary**, and does not include equity or bonus. We post it because we expect to pay inside it. * Equity in the company. * Medical / dental / vision, 401(k) \- up to 4% matching, Unlimited PTO policy This is a remote role, but candidates must be based in the U.S. **The pay range for this role is:** 175,000 \- 215,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description: NikoHealth is a rapidly growing SaaS company transforming how Durable Medical Equipment (DME) and Home Medical Equipment (HME) providers operate. Our innovative, all\-in\-one platform streamlines business operations, empowering providers to work smarter and more efficiently.### **About The Rol****e** This is a newly created role, and one of the first two engineering hires NikoHealth will made in the United States. You'll report directly to the CTO and own how our software gets released and run while working closely with other senior engineers. We operate dozens of .NET services deployed per\-customer on Windows Server and IIS in AWS, managed with Terraform and Octopus Deploy. Across hundreds of provider tenants that's thousands of running application instances. Today a change waits for the next release train, and the train then takes weeks to reach the whole fleet, so end\-to\-end a given feature takes months. Improving our deployment and development experience is the first job. After that there are dozens of areas of platform investment needed to support how fast we're scaling. **What You'll Do*** **Own our CI/CD pipeline end to end**, with the authority to change what it deploys and how. * **Own developer experience**. Reproducible builds, a local environment someone can actually stand up, and fast honest feedback on every change. This is half the job, not a side effect of the other half. * **Get our automated regression suite running in CI**. It exists, it's substantial, and it isn't currently executed. * **Cut release lead time** and get the fleet inside a published, committed release window. * **Make fleet version state answerable by a query** instead of by a person, so anyone can see what a customer is running. * **Design and publish an access model**, so provisioning stops routing through one inbox. * **Start bringing runtimes and dependencies current**, beginning with the shared libraries everything else depends on. * **Document and share what you learn**, so infrastructure knowledge stops being concentrated in one place. **What You'll Bring*** 5\+ years in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering. * Production Terraform, including state you owned and drift you had to reconcile. * Production Windows Server and IIS, application pools included. * End\-to\-end ownership of a CI/CD pipeline in a previous role. * AWS at the level this estate uses it: EC2, ALB, VPC, IAM. * A track record of replacing a manual process with a measured and automated one, where you can tell us the before and after. * Evidence you've made other engineers faster, not just the systems. Build times, local setup, test feedback, whatever it was. * Daily working use of AI coding agents such as Cursor or Claude Code, including the harness around them: tests, project instructions, and a loop you can run again. ### **Nice to have** * Octopus Deploy, or another deployment orchestrator you owned. * Single\-tenant or multi\-tenant SaaS at meaningful scale. * Healthcare, HIPAA, or another regulated environment. ### **How we work** **This is brownfield and we're honest about it.** Some of this estate is well\-built and some of it grew. We're not asking you to rewrite it, because hundreds of providers bill claims through it every day. We're asking you to make it measurable, make it safe to change, then change it. If you've built a career inheriting other people's systems and making them boring, you'll like it here. **We work with AI agents, seriously.** The team works agentically and so will you. What matters is what you do after the agent produces something: tests, linters, project instructions, a loop you can run again. If your answer to a bad result is a longer prompt, we're probably not a fit. This is also why developer experience sits in this role rather than somewhere else: an agent is only as good as the feedback loop it runs in, and ours needs work. **Most application development is done by a long\-standing engineering partner.** You'd own the pipeline, the infrastructure, and the environments, and over time the standards their code meets before it ships while working closely with our off\-shore development team. **Two people isn't a platform team, it's the start of one.** Until it's three, coverage is shared between you, the CTO, and our head of engineering. Everyone here is remote, and we'd like your hours to overlap the US East Coast. **This is the start of the engineering team, not the end of it.** We're hiring more engineers through 2027\. The people who join first get the widest scope, the most say in how the team gets built, and first choice about what they own as it grows. ### **How to apply** Apply through the link on this page. Instead of a cover letter, we ask one question: **tell us about a system you inherited, and the first thing you measured.** A few sentences is plenty. Use AI to help write your application if you want to, we do too. We read every one ourselves, and we can tell when nobody read the posting. Your first conversation will be with our CTO, who is the hiring manager and will walk you through the rest of the process. ### **Compensation and benefits** * The range shown for this role is **base salary**, and does not include equity or bonus. We post it because we expect to pay inside it. * Equity in the company. * Medical / dental / vision, 401(k) \- up to 4% matching, Unlimited PTO policy This is a remote role, but candidates must be based in the U.S. **The pay range for this role is:** 175,000 \- 215,000 USD per year(Remote)

jobs.description: **About Norm** Norm builds AI\-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale. Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services. Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management. We look for practical, hands\-on experience, not theoretical familiarity. **About the role**: You want to design and run ambitious experiments to understand and shape the nature of the work performed by our firms and the power of our AI systems. You care about understanding the world and the essence of things, specifically in the case of judgement\-heavy professional services the nature of which is evolving rapidly and certain to continue to do so. You are a researcher, an engineer, and a multi\-disciplinary thinker. As a Researcher at Norm, you will contribute to research centered on firm data analysis, agent simulations, publications (internal and external), and novel AI systems and architectures. You will collaborate with our Agent, Firm Systems, and Improvement Loop engineering teams to set direction for the AI platform that powers our firms. **You may be a good fit if**: * You are ready to move quickly and take a research project to completion every month. * You prefer fast\-moving collaborative projects over long\-term solo efforts. * You have experience with LLMs, evaluations, and self\-directed research. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- **Base salary:** $275,000\-$375,000 plus equity depending on level The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. jobs.title: Staff Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Northbeam** Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi\-touch attribution, MMM\+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser\-accurate first\-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions. We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product\-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast\-moving, high\-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey. We're a remote\-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles. **About the role** ------------------ As a Staff Infrastructure Engineer working at Northbeam, you will work with a small engineering team to create a scaleable, observable, reliable platform for data ingestion, processing, and serving. Responsibilities will range widely and evolve, as they tend to at startups. The following all fall within the Infrastructure team's remit: * CI/CD and dev infrastructure * Security * DR policies * SSL cert management and DNS * Infrastructure as Code * Kubernetes Care and Maintenance * Capacity planning and budgeting * Observability * Scaling plans and automation * Guidance for best use of cloud infrastructure * … and more Success in this role will require significant existing experience, interest in continuously learning and iterating on existing solutions, a penchant for automation over "clickops" and one\-offs, and ability to effectively collaborate with engineers, auditors, product managers, and more. **Your Impact** --------------- You'll wear many hats, juggle diverse tasks, and probably find yourself learning new skills on the fly – while also teaching a few. If you thrive on variety and love diving in, you'll fit right in. Here's a taste of what might come up: * **Capacity management:** tune the footprint you have, project what you'll need. Cloud provider out of hardware in Iowa? No problem, you and the team can ship multi\-region support in under 3 weeks. * **Migrations:** move a high\-volume pipeline off a managed service onto Kubernetes with zero data loss, cut its cost by a meaningful amount, and find a bug the old system had been hiding for years. * **Incident response:** handle the traffic spike nobody saw coming, then build the thing that takes care of it automatically next time. * **Reliability and DR:** run failover drills at peak traffic, restore production in another region, handle providers taking a 4 hour downtime "maintenance window" without anyone noticing. * **Security:** automate workflows to route automated security discoveries to the right people, fix critical CVEs, create structures and automations that help the rest of the eng team stay on top of the recent flood of vulnerabilities. * **AI infrastructure:** run the LLM gateway the company builds on, and work alongside AI agents that triage incidents and draft PRs with you. * **Developer platform:** introduce on\-demand preview environments, manage CI runners, and make it easy for app teams to do the right thing without filing a ticket. * **Communication:** Create technical documentation that's useful for engineers, understandable for stakeholders, and not soul\-crushing to read. You will work with great people who have done this many times before. You will teach them some new tricks, and maybe learn some old ones. You'll be a key player in keeping our platform reliable, efficient, and scalable. We'll laugh, we'll cry, we'll tell stories of yore. If this sounds like your kind of chaos, we'd love to hear from you. **What You Bring** ------------------ * **Experience and judgement:** When it comes to **cloud infrastructure**, you are the person people go to with their thorniest questions. Everyone has Claude; you have Claude, lived experience, and taste. * **Bias for Automation:** **You automate things**. You create bots. You might have a home lab. You are allergic to clickops. * **Technical direction**: You've **set the infrastructure roadmap for a team or company**, not just executed one. You can take something vague like "we should be multi\-region," turn it into a phased plan with real tradeoffs, get buy\-in, and see it through. * **Security as a practice**: You've led a company through **security certifications** and kept it there. You decide where to invest and where to accept risk, explain those calls to leadership in plain terms, and build processes that make the secure path the easy one without slowing everything to a crawl. * **Reliability ownership:** You've designed for failure before it happened: DR, failover, capacity planning, cost. When incidents happen you lead the response, and afterward you work with the team to fix the root causes. * **Observability strategy**: You make it, you tweak it, you don't tolerate neither alert noise nor silent failure. Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, whatever; you've used enough of them to have opinions, and you can use any of them to get the job done. * **Effective collaboration**: You work across engineering, data, product, and leadership. People follow your standards because they make their lives easier, not because they were told to. **Bonus Skills and Experience:** -------------------------------- * Experience in marketing, e\-commerce, or ad\-tech, where traffic spikes on someone else's schedule. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company\-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work\-from\-home stipend to support your remote setup. **Interview Process** The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30\-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role\-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co\-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5\-7 interviews total and requires around 5\-8 hours of your time. We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Sr. Systems Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.** **The Opportunity** Are you an experienced technical professional with a passion for driving customer success and a knack for articulating complex solutions? If so, you'll thrive on our dynamic Systems Engineering and Solution Sales team at Nutanix, where you'll have the opportunity to build meaningful relationships with clients, collaborate with a passionate group of experts, and contribute to impactful business transformations in a flexible, remote work environment. Location: Working remotely in Raleigh or Richmond, VA. **About the Team** In this role, you will be part of the Systems Engineering Sales team in Commercial, a group of 9 dedicated professionals located across the eastern United States. Our team culture is characterized by being hungry, humble, and honest, always striving to exceed expectations while maintaining genuine relationships with one another and our clients. We believe that collaboration and a supportive atmosphere are key drivers of our success, fostering a space where innovative thinking and shared goals are paramount at Nutanix. You will report to the Senior Manager, Systems Engineering, who is committed to empowering the team to achieve great results while supporting personal and professional growth. This position offers the flexibility of a remote work setup, eliminating the need to work from an office. Instead, you will focus on building relationships by visiting customer and partner sites, allowing you to work autonomously within your designated territory. The role requires approximately 20% travel, predominantly within your territory and for event\-based opportunities, enabling you to engage directly with our clients and partners while also balancing your remote work responsibilities. **Your Role** * Demonstrate and articulate the features and advantages of Nutanix solutions to influence customer purchasing decisions. * Size and configure Nutanix solutions tailored to customer needs. * Build and maintain long\-term relationships with customers, acting as their trusted resource. * Collaborate with sales counterparts to develop account plans and proposal creation, recommending solutions based on Nutanix offerings. * Gather and communicate customer feedback to enhance the Nutanix ecosystem. * Partner with the presales team to secure technical wins and streamline the sales process. * Manage project urgency, execute detailed action plans, and ensure flawless proof of concepts, including hardware installation. * Continuously develop personal and professional skills to contribute to team success and meet/exceed performance objectives. **What You Will Bring** * 5\+ years of experience, with at least 3\+ years in a customer\-facing pre\-sales role. * Experience from an infrastructure/solutioning perspective with Cloud Native, Kubernetes and AI. * Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Information Technology. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to suggest effective solutions. * Excellent communication and presentation skills in English. * Proven ability to manage multiple projects and execute detailed action plans. * Advanced virtualization knowledge and/or enterprise application expertise. * Ability to execute a flawless proof of concept, including physical handling of equipment (up to 50 lb servers). **Work Arrangement** Remote: This position is primarily remote. There is no specific in\-office requirement, however, there may be circumstances where you may be required to come into a local office for a specific purpose, and/or to travel to other locations based on business needs. The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $207,000 and USD $311,000 per year. However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign\-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an “at\-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: Olive Systems partners with fast\-growing AI and technology companies across the United States to help them build and scale their engineering teams. We’re looking for experienced **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)** who can bridge the gap between complex customer challenges and real\-world technical solutions. Rather than hiring for a single position, we’re building a network of strong engineers interested in working with innovative startups and technology companies. Based on your technical background, experience, and career preferences, we’ll connect you with relevant opportunities across our partner companies. **This is not an internal engineering position at Olive Systems.** **What You’ll Do** As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work closely with customers and engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges, often without predefined requirements. Your responsibilities may include: * Working directly with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into technical solutions. * Designing, developing, and deploying production\-ready applications and systems. * Building prototypes and turning successful concepts into scalable products. * Working across backend, frontend, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data, and AI technologies. * Making architectural and technical decisions independently. * Collaborating with founders, product managers, and engineering teams. * Identifying opportunities to turn custom solutions into reusable product capabilities. * Taking full ownership of technical solutions, from initial discovery through production deployment. **Who We’re Looking For** We’re interested in engineers who combine strong technical expertise with product thinking, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. You might currently be a: * Forward Deployed Engineer * Senior / Staff Full\-Stack Engineer * Founding Engineer or Technical Founder * AI / Applied AI Engineer * Solutions Architect with hands\-on development experience * Senior Software Engineer with end\-to\-end product ownership **What matters most:** * Strong hands\-on software engineering experience. * Proven track record of building and shipping production systems. * Ability to take ownership of complex technical challenges from start to finish. * Experience designing software architecture and making technical trade\-offs. * Confidence working with ambiguous or evolving requirements. * Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to move quickly from problem discovery to implementation. **Nice to Have:** * Experience building AI\-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, or AI agents. * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. * Background in early\-stage startups or fast\-paced product environments. * Previous experience working directly with enterprise customers. * Experience developing MVPs, prototypes, or custom integrations. **Our Hiring Process** **1\. Initial Technical Evaluation** We’ll invite you to a short AI\-powered interview focused on your real engineering experience. We’ll explore systems you’ve built, architectural decisions, technical challenges, and how you approach solving complex problems. No algorithm puzzles or generic coding questions. **2\. Conversation with Olive Systems** We’ll discuss your professional background, career goals, compensation expectations, preferred working environment, and availability. **3\. Introduction to Relevant Opportunities** When we identify a suitable opportunity, we’ll introduce you to the company and coordinate the next steps. Depending on the company, additional technical interviews or assessments may be required. **Location \& Work Setup** We work with technology companies hiring across the **United States**. Opportunities may be fully remote, hybrid, or onsite, depending on the company. Specific location, compensation, employment arrangements, and work authorization or sponsorship requirements vary by opportunity. **Why Join Our Network?** Instead of applying to multiple companies individually, you can complete our initial evaluation once and be considered for relevant opportunities as they become available. Our goal is to connect experienced engineers with companies where their technical expertise, problem\-solving abilities, and career ambitions are a strong match. **Interested?** Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile. If your experience aligns with what our partner companies are looking for, we’ll contact you with the next steps. Pay: $160,000\.00 \- $220,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Flexible schedule * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in Boston, MA 02110

jobs.title: Senior HPC Platform Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra\-low\-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore. The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis. Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries. ### **About the Job** Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean's harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention. You will join Panthalassa's Compute Infrastructure team, a small platform engineering team that builds and operates shared infrastructure as internal products. The team owns a Kubernetes\-based compute platform on GKE (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions runners, Terraform modules) and is bringing our on\-premises HPC clusters under the same model: a managed HPC platform that CFD engineers consume through a documented golden path rather than through ad\-hoc requests to an administrator. Your work will directly support our mission to deliver abundant renewable energy and affordable green fuels. You will own that HPC platform end to end: Linux, Slurm, storage, interconnects, provisioning, and scientific software. Your initial scope is our primary CFD cluster, with the expectation that you grow into ownership of our second cluster and define how both are operated under the same configuration management and operational standards as the rest of our infrastructure. This is a hands\-on role with broad ownership and room to shape how our computing infrastructure grows. You will work closely with CFD engineers on production workloads and performance, and with an on\-site datacenter technician who carries out physical hardware work. We are looking for someone who follows problems through to resolution, communicates clearly, and builds systems that others can operate confidently and that engineers can consume without needing to understand how they work underneath. The services running on these clusters, including scheduling, software environments, storage, and license servers, are products with users. You will treat them that way: measure how they are used, reduce friction, and iterate. Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis. ### **Responsibilities** #### **Platform** * Contribute to defining the HPC platform as a product: its service catalog, service levels, and roadmap, in partnership with CFD engineering leads, and prioritize work by user impact. * Build the golden path for running simulations: standard job templates, submission tooling, software environment conventions, and documentation that lets a new CFD engineer go from zero to a correctly placed production job without a ticket. * Replace manual, ticket\-driven operations with self\-service wherever practical: account and project onboarding, storage allocation, module requests, license visibility, and job diagnostics. * Instrument platform usage and health (utilization, queue wait, job failure modes, storage growth) and use it to drive capacity planning and roadmap decisions. * Contribute to shared team tooling and conventions so HPC and cloud compute are operated the same way. * Design future HPC capacity and workflows with the GKE platform in mind: burst, hybrid scheduling, shared identity, and shared artifact and container registries. #### **Platform operations** * Automate cluster configuration with Ansible and Git so system state is reproducible, reviewable, and applied through CI. Manual changes to cluster state are the exception, not the norm. * Own the day\-to\-day operation, configuration, and reliability of our HPC clusters, including compute and head nodes, storage, and interconnects. * Plan and bring up new compute capacity: specify hardware, define rack and network layouts, and provision and validate nodes after installation. * Administer Slurm end to end, including partitions, QoS, accounting, scheduling policy, and job troubleshooting for CFD engineers. * Build and maintain scientific software environments, including Environment Modules or Lmod, MPI stacks, and compiler toolchains tuned for our i mpilers, and managing configuration with Ansible and Git. * Experience operating infrastructure as an internal product: defining service levels, building self\-service tooling or interfaces, and prioritizing work by user impact rather than ticket order. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and GitOps workflows beyond cluster configuration management, including Terraform, CI pipelines, and pull\-request\-driven change. * Familiarity with CFD or other engineering simulation workloads, including scaling behavior and scheduler, storage, and fabric requirements. * Experience implementing infrastructure monitoring and alerting, building user\-facing dashboards, and writing runbooks others can follow. * Ability to guide on\-site staff through physical hardware work remotely with precise, unambiguous instructions. * Excellent communication with engineers and vendors, and excitement about renewable energy and building foundational infrastructure at a mission\-driven company. ### **Desired Qualifications** * Experience tuning solver performance through profiling, NUMA and process placement, and interconnect tuning. * Experience with HPC telemetry and performance analytics, including node, fabric, and job\-level metrics. * Experience with ZFS, high\-availability head nodes using DRBD, Corosync, or Pacemaker, or parallel filesystems. * Experience with HELYX, OpenFOAM, or commercial CFD packages, and FlexLM or RLM license servers. * Experience planning cluster expansions, including hardware selection, rack layout, power and cooling budgets, and fabric topology. * Familiarity with Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana for infrastructure observability. * Experience with Kubernetes and running batch or HPC workloads on it, such as Kueue, Volcano, or Slurm on Kubernetes. * Experience building developer\- or researcher\-facing tooling: CLIs, job submission wrappers, Open OnDemand or a similar portal, or internal APIs. * Experience with platform engineering practices, including internal developer platforms, service catalogs, and golden\-path design. * Experience with container\-based HPC software delivery using Apptainer, Spack, or EasyBuild. * Experience extending on\-premises HPC into cloud compute, preferably GKE on GCP. The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed. ### **Additional Requirements** * Legal authorization to work in the United States. * Intermittently able to work longer hours and weekends to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work\-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours. ### **Compensation and Benefits** If hired for this full\-time role, you will receive: * Cash compensation of $160,000 \- $220,000\. * Equity in the company. We're all owners and if we're successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation. * A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: + Flexible paid time off + Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold\-level PPO plan for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full\-time employees, their partners, and dependents) + Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long\-term financial support if you become disabled) + Ability to contribute to tax\-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA * Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed). ### **Location** Our offices, lab, and shop are located in Portland, Oregon. We strongly prefer candidates based in Portland, Oregon, but exceptional remote candidates will be considered with regular travel to our offices and relevant facilities.

jobs.description: 46807 Los Angeles, CA, US, 90038 Technology Los Angeles Full\-Time On\-Site **Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.** Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator\-first, audience\-focused, tech\-forward, globally scaled. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next\-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO! **Job Title**: Lead ML Engineer **Team**: Technology \- Enterprise Solutions **Location**: Los Angeles (Burbank) **Overview** Paramount’s Platforms \& Intelligent Automation team (Enterprise Solutions \& Technology) is building a knowledge layer for the company. This layer helps AI agents and decision\-makers access important information. It includes titles and content, rights and contracts, talent and participants, and other business data that connects them. As our Lead Machine Learning Engineer for Enterprise Knowledge Graph \& Ontology, you will design Paramount’s enterprise ontology and knowledge graphs. You will build machine learning systems to ensure these graphs are precise. This includes tasks like entity resolution, LLM\-based information extraction, and graph learning. You will also deploy models and graph services. This will help create knowledge\-grounded AI agents. They will have a consistent and semantically linked view of the business. You will set the technical direction for this program. This includes data modeling, MLOps, and production operations. You will work autonomously, with minimal oversight. Close collaboration with data owners, enterprise architects, and agent developers across Enterprise Solutions \& Technology and the business units will be key. **Key Responsibilities** * Enterprise ontology and semantic modeling (25%). Design and manage Paramount’s enterprise ontology and domain models. This includes content and title hierarchies. It also covers rights and obligations, talent and participants, organizations, deals, and financial and operational entities. Ensure that all of these align with industry standards. You make the modeling decisions; enterprise\-wide changes are ratified with data owners and architecture review. * Knowledge graph construction and entity resolution (25%). Build scalable pipelines that control both structured and unstructured systems. This includes structured data from rights management, ERP, contract and talent systems, and metadata catalogs. It also includes unstructured sources like contracts, scripts, and documents. The goal is to create knowledge graphs using platforms like Spanner Graph, Neo4j, or Amazon Neptune. Use machine learning for entity resolution and record linkage, along with LLM\-based information extraction and data quality scoring. Manage the master\-identity process to align entities across these systems. * Advanced machine learning on graphs (20%). Develop, evaluate, and deploy graph\-based learning techniques. These techniques include node and link prediction, graph neural networks, and graph embeddings. Work on predictive and semantic search as well. This includes GraphRAG retrieval, which supports knowledge\-grounded agents. Additionally, set the evaluation methodology. Establish the quality standards for the program. * MLOps and production knowledge services (15%). Use Vertex AI Pipelines and MLflow to productionize models and graph services. Implement versioning and use feature stores. Set up automated evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection. Share knowledge through well\-governed APIs and MCP tools. Make sure agent applications can use these tools while meeting security, privacy, and audit requirements. * Stakeholder partnership and program management (10%). Partner with Rights, Finance, Content Operations, and Talent business leads. Work with engineers in enterprise data governance and AI platforms. Define key questions and service levels. Create a plan. Translate requirements for offshore and vendor data engineers, and review their work. * Standards, reuse and mentorship (5%). Establish modeling standards, reusable graph and ML components and documentation; mentor engineers and data scientists in knowledge engineering and graph machine learning. * Ad hoc. Perform various ad hoc projects as needed, including executive proofs\-of\-concept and evaluation of emerging graph, retrieval and model capabilities. **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of experience in machine learning, data, or softwar rience with classical predictive modeling is also needed. Involving thorough offline and online evaluation. * Experience deploying ML on a major cloud (Google Cloud preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable) with MLOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, model registry, and monitoring. * Proficient communication skills: able to gather requirements from business experts, document models clearly, and present trade\-offs to senior stakeholders. Experience working with distributed or offshore teams is a plus. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Science or a related field, or equivalent applicable experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Media and entertainment experience (e.g., rights and royalties, content metadata, distribution and avails) or experience with rights\-management platforms. * Experience with GraphRAG, including hybrid retrieval (vector search plus graph traversal) and connecting knowledge to agent frameworks (e.g., Google ADK, LangGraph) via MCP. * Experience with master data management and data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Informatica, Google Dataplex), and with data\-product or data\-mesh delivery. * Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning or Information Science; publications, patents or open\-source contributions in knowledge graphs, NLP or graph ML. * Experience with Wikidata / Wikibase, Palantir Foundry Ontology as enterprise context layers for AI agents. \#LI\-JC1 **About Skydance** Skydance is a next\-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct\-to\-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount\+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION Hiring Salary Range: $156,800\.00 \- 235,200\.00\. In compliance with local law, we are disclosing compensation, or a range thereof, for roles where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on a variety of job\-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, external market data, internal equity, skill set, experience, training, education, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of our total compensation package. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short\- and long\-term incentives, and program\-specific awards. This position is bonus eligible. **What We Offer**: * Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here. * Generous paid time off. * Complimentary subscriptions to HBO Max, Paramount\+, and other Skydance streaming services and digital news products. * Robust employee engagement opportunities, including access to exclusive screenings and events, speaker series, volunteer activities and more. Skydance is an equal opportunity employer (EOE) We embrace the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit. In line with the laws of the country or region in which the role is based, this includes consideration without regard to race, color, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship status, religion or belief, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or protected veteran status, union status or any other category protected by applicable law. jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **AI Platform Engineer** The AI Platform Engineer is responsible for deploying and managing the computing and storage platform backbone that powers AI models. Working on\-site alongside AI Data Engineering, IT Infrastructure, Security, and business stakeholders, this role is central to the reliability, performance, and scalability of our AI/ML infrastructure. **Responsibilities:** * Provision and maintain CPU and GPU compute clusters, high\-bandwidth network equipment, and scalable, high\-throughput storage systems for AI/ML training and inference, working on\-site and virtually to coordinate hands\-on configuration and troubleshooting with infrastructure teams. * Develop and maintain scripts and infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) modules for automated configuration of AI/ML infrastructure using tools such as Terraform and Ansible; participate in in\-person and virtual code and design reviews with the platform engineering team. * Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes, Flux); troubleshoot pipeline failures and escalate to more senior engineers or other teams as needed, collaborating in person and virtually to resolve issues quickly and effectively. * Set up and monitor data stores (file systems, block storage, traditional and vector databases) to support LLMs and RAG pipelines, with regular on\-site coordination with AI Data Engineering teams to ensure data infrastructure meets evolving model requirements. * Monitor system performance and log metrics to ensure reliability and uptime; implement system improvements under guidance of more senior engineers, including attending in\-person and virtual planning and incident review sessions. * Collaborate in person with AI Data Engineering, IT Infrastructure, Security, and Business Leaders to optimize infrastructure for performance and cost, including participating in cross\-functional working sessions, architecture reviews, and stakeholder briefings. * Deploy and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors and ensure secure, scalable infrastructure for MCP integrations, coordinating directly with security and engineering teams to validate configurations and address emerging requirements. **Basic Qualifications:** * At least two (2\) years of experience working in an infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering role, with at least some exposure to AI/ML workloads. * Proficiency in cloud computing, container orchestration, and infrastructure\-as\-code. * Knowledge of networking and distributed storage; * Experience with monitoring and observability tools to track performance and system health. * Ability to troubleshoot complex systems and collaborate in person with Data Engineering, Infrastructure, AI Engineering, Security, and Business Leaders. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and teamwork skills; comfortable working in a collaborative, on\-site team environment. * Foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Knowledge of GPU acceleration. **Travel:** * 10% Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company** PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. **Job Summary:** This job will design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms to solve complex problems. You will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to enhance services through innovative AI/ML solutions. Your role will involve building scalable ML pipelines, ensuring data quality, and deploying models into production environments to drive business insights and improve customer experiences. **Job Description:** **Essential Responsibilities:** * Develop and optimize machine learning models for various applications. * Preprocess and analyze large datasets to extract meaningful insights. * Deploy ML solutions into production environments using appropriate tools and frameworks. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate ML models into products and services. * Monitor and evaluate the performance of deployed models. **Minimum Qualifications:** * 3\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. * Experience with ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit\-learn. * Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and tools for data processing and model deployment. * Several years of experience in designing, implementing, and deploying machine learning models. **Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications****:** **Subsidiary:** PayPal **Travel Percent:** 0 * The base pay for this role will depend on where you work and the relevant experience and expertise you bring. The expected range of pay for this role by location is: **Primary Location \| Pay Range:** San Jose, California: ($159,500\.00 \- $236,500\.00 Annually) **Additional Location(s) \| Pay Range:** No other locations are assigned to this requisition currently. Additional compensation for this role may include an annual performance bonus, equity, or other incentive compensation, as applicable. PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one\-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact\-us. For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in\-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. **Our Benefits:** At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset\-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice\-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. **Who We Are:** **Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com. **Belonging at PayPal:** Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community. We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

This is a multi\-year project with enormous strategic value and high revenue growth. You will work with a distributed development team spread across the US, Europe and Asia. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist - Marketing
jobs.description: ### **About Point** **✨ Real Impact, Real People:** Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals. **✨ Funding:** With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we're scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage. **✨ Game\-changing Product:** We're building a category defining company in home equity. We've earned a 4\.7 Trustpilot rating and an A\+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000\+ customers. **✨ Great Place to Work:** Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area. **✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection:** Work from anywhere in the U.S. while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people\-first culture. Select roles may require onsite work at our Palo Alto office one day per week. **Local or 100% Remote** **About the role** Point helps homeowners unlock the equity in their homes without taking on a monthly payment. Our customer acquisition strategy leverages multiple touchpoints across direct mail, paid search and social, affiliates, CTV and a fast\-growing broker channel. We can say what each channel spent and what it reported. We cannot yet say, channel by channel, how much of the resulting funding would have happened anyway, and that is the job. You will be the first scientist dedicated to marketing measurement: incrementality and attribution across every channel, a universal holdout that no campaign touches, the controlled tests that check what our media mix model claims, and the power calculations that decide whether a test is worth running. You sit on the data science team next to the people who build our targeting models, and you work every week with the marketing analysts and channel owners who act on what you find. You will have real spend to test against, data already modeled in Snowflake and dbt, and a growth leadership team that you will closely partner with. **Your responsibilities** * Measure incrementality channel by channel: design and run holdout and controlled tests, keep a running read of incremental funding per channel, and reconcile it against the dollar attribution we report each month. * Own the universal control: define and operate a 5 to 10% holdout at the qualified stage that no campaign or channel touches, so tests stop contaminating each other, and make sure web and non\-web experiments both respect it. * Size every experiment before it runs: power calculations, minimum detectable effects and pre\-declared readouts for every test in the registry, web or sales\-side, so no test ends in a confidence interval too wide to act on. * Lead the media mix modeling work from our side: evaluate vendors with the marketing team, specify the feeds with the marketing analytics engineer, and own interpretation once the model is live, including the tests that check its claims. * Extend model\-based targeting beyond direct mail: with the data science team, build and refresh propensity and expected\-value models for paid search and other channels as volume allows, scored onto the audience table with suppressions applied. * Publish the measurement layer the company reads: incremental jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering

The role will lead data engineering delivery across Azure, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Power BI, establishing reliable data pipelines, curated data layers, reusable data models, and enterprise reporting capabilities.
