solutions and deliver measurable outcomes. **What you will do** -------------------- * Lead, coach, and develop a team of data engineers and analytics engineers responsible for delivering and supporting IAA global operations data solutions. * Plan and manage delivery of data engineering projects and workstreams, including scope, milestones, dependencies, resource plans, risks, and delivery commitments. * Design, build, and modernize scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions using Azure services, Azure Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric. * Establish and implement robust data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and integration patterns for batch and near\-real\-time data from enterprise and operational source systems. * Partner with business and technology stakeholders to understand requirements, define data products and reporting needs, and translate them into clear technical designs and delivery plans. * Develop and maintain curated data layers, dimensional models, reusable datasets, and semantic models that support trusted enterprise reporting, analytics, and self\-service consumption. * Lead engineering practices across the data delivery lifecycle, including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment automation, environment management, and release governance. * Ensure data solutions meet expectations for data quality, accuracy, freshness, availability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency. * Establish monitoring, alerting, logging, and operational support practices for data pipelines and platforms; drive timely issue resolution and root\-cause remediation. * Define team goals, delivery plans, engineering metrics, and operating cadences; communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to stakeholders and leadership. * Mentor engineers in data architecture, engineering standards, coding practices, performance optimization, troubleshooting, and pragmatic solution delivery. * Implement data security and compliance practices, including role\-based access, least privilege, sensitive\-data protection, secure secrets management, auditability, and governed data access. * Coordinate with architecture, infrastructure, security, governance, BI, and implementation partners to deliver integrated solutions across multiple systems and teams. **Core leadership accountabilities** ------------------------------------ This role is expected to demonstrate strong people leadership, hands\-on technical judgment, and accountability for delivery across the following areas: **Results \& Impact** --------------------- * Deliver high\-quality data engineering solutions that address business priorities and improve operational visibility, decision\-making, and efficiency. * Manage multiple project activities and priorities, remove delivery impediments, and adjust plans when outcomes, timelines, or quality are at risk. **Ownership \& Decision Making** -------------------------------- * Take ownership of the reliability and supportability of data pipelines and products within the team's domain; drive root\-cause analysis and durable corrective actions. * Make sound technical and delivery decisions, balancing business value, quality, scalability, maintainability, and cost; escalate material risks and decisions appropriately. **Operational Excellence** -------------------------- * Establish consistent engineering practices for development, testing, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and production support. * Maintain solution documentation, data lineage, runbooks, support procedures, and operational readiness standards. **Planning \& Change Management** --------------------------------- * Translate the data platform and analytics roadmap into achievable team plans, estimates, milestones, and delivery increments. * Lead the team through platform modernization, evolving business requirements, and changes in priorities while maintaining delivery focus. **Talent \& Culture** --------------------- * Recruit, onboard, coach, and develop team members; set clear expectations, provide feedback, and support performance and career development. * Promote consistent engineering standards for data pipeline design, Python/SQL development, data modeling, orchestration, testing, and reusable components. * Apply Azure and Databricks platform capabilities and Microsoft Fabric services appropriately to build secure, scalable, maintainable data solutions. * Promote effective Power BI practices, including governed semantic models, reusable datasets, performance optimization, and secure self\-service reporting. * Strong hands\-on experience designing and implementing enterprise data engineering solutions using SQL and modern data processing technologies. * Strong experience with Microsoft Azure data services and cloud fundamentals, including identity, networking, security, monitoring, and cost management. * Demonstrated experience with Databricks and/or Microsoft Fabric for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, lakehouse patterns, and production data workloads. * Build a collaborative, inclusive, accountable team culture focused on engineering quality, continuous improvement, and business outcomes. **Technical Craft** ------------------- * Guide technical design and implementation discussions with an emphasis on data quality, reliability, scalability, performance, security, and simplicity. * Promote reusable patterns, automation, documentation, and engineering standards that reduce complexity and long\-term maintenance effort. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 15\+ years of overall IT experience, including 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in data engineering, data integration, data platforms, or related data disciplines. * Demonstrated experience leading data engineering teams and managing delivery of enterprise data engineering projects or programs. * Strong experience designing, developing, and supporting data pipelines, data transformations, data models, and production data solutions at enterprise scale. * Hands\-on experience with Azure and one or more modern data platforms, with strong working knowledge of Azure Databricks and/or Microsoft Fabric. * Experience with SQL and data engineering languages such as Python; familiarity with Spark, Delta Lake, lakehouse architecture, and medallion patterns is highly desirable. * Experience implementing data orchestration, CI/CD, source control, automated testing, deployment practices, and SDLC controls for data solutions. * Experience with Power BI, including semantic models, datasets, data integration, performance optimization, and enterprise reporting practices. * Strong understanding of data architecture, dimensional modeling, data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, and secure data access principles. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts, manage dependencies, and drive alignment across business and technology teams. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience modernizing enterprise data warehouses, ETL/ELT platforms, or legacy reporting environments to cloud\-based lakehouse or modern analytics architectures. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric workloads such as OneLake, Data Factory, Lakehouse, Warehouse, and Direct Lake, or equivalent Azure/Databricks capabilities. * Experience developing enterprise Power BI reporting solutions and governed self\-service analytics capabilities. * Experience supporting operationally critical or regulated data environments with strong security, audit, data retention, and change\-management requirements. * Exposure to cloud cost optimization, capacity planning, platform performance tuning, and establishing service\-level expectations for data products.

jobs.title: AI Enablement & Infrastructure Engineer (Contract)
jobs.description: **Job Overview** **Help shape how AI works at sea, at one of the most unique communities on the planet.** We are a private residential community on a ship that never stops travelling. We're growing with AI, and what feels advanced today will look simple in a few years. We'd like you to be part of that journey: supporting our teams as they learn and build, and helping IT keep it all secure. Our teams already use AI every day, and we have a clear AI policy in place. Your job is to help them go further, faster and safely. * **Educate.** Run practical sessions for office and shipboard teams, share prompting best practices, and turn our AI Usage Policy into quick guides people actually use. * **Mature our AI products and services.** Help improve the AI tools, agents and automations we already have, so they become more reliable, useful and well supported over time. * **Support the business.** Work side by side with teams and department champions to turn good ideas into agents and apps on our approved platforms, and share the wins. * **Evaluate and manage risk.** Help teams register new agents and apps, assess their data, access and security risks, and keep safeguards in place as they grow. You'll support our Infrastructure \& Cybersecurity Manager across day\-to\-day operations and security, ashore and on board. * **Keep people productive.** Install and troubleshoot desktop apps (Microsoft 365, Teams, Adobe, browsers, AI tools) and hardware, from laptops and docks to printers, phones and meeting\-room AV. * **Run the Microsoft backbone.** Manage accounts, groups and device policies in Active Directory, Entra ID and Intune. Support SharePoint sites, permissions and sync, and Exchange Online mail flow, lists and filtering. * **Keep everyone connected.** Support wired and wireless networks, VPN, zero trust access, web security, remote desktop, and our Teams phone system and call queues. * **Onboard and offboard.** Set up laptops, accounts and apps for new joiners, and close access cleanly for leavers. * **Stay patched.** Track exploitable vulnerabilities and drive operating system and application updates and hardening, automating where possible. * **Protect and recover.** Monitor backups across cloud and on\-premises, run test restores, and help with recovery. * **Respond to threats.** Help contain and investigate incidents with our endpoint, SIEM and SOC tools, and handle phishing alerts. * **Support our cloud.** Provision, size and maintain virtual servers in Azure and AWS. * **Secure our AI.** Help assess agents and apps before go\-live, set up agent identities and approved connectors, and spot shadow AI. Who we think is the right candidate * **AI application development** — Has built and deployed an internal AI application, such as a knowledge assistant or workflow tool, using model APIs and approved company data. Can explain how the application enforces user permissions and how its outputs were tested. * **Autonomous agent development** — Has built and deployed an agent that can carry out a multi\-step business workflow and take authorized actions in connected systems. Can explain what triggers the agent, which actions it can take independently, and when it asks for human approval. * **Technical skills** — Proficient in Python or TypeScript, REST APIs, authentication, and Git. Has hands\-on experience integrating AI applications and agents with business systems such as Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or internal APIs. * **Security and governance** — Knows how to apply least\-privilege access, manage service identities and secrets, log agent actions, prevent duplicate actions during retries, and pause or disable an agent when needed. * **Evidence of experience** — Can walk through one AI application and one autonomous workflow they personally built, including how they tested failures, monitored quality and cost, and handed over ongoing operations to a named owner. **Bonus points:** Azure or AWS, Teams Phone, SIEM or EDR tools, vulnerability management, GitHub Enterprise, hospitality or maritime experience, a security certification. Pay: $76,800\.00 \- $92,600\.00 per year Application Question(s): * Have you worked in a corporate environment with formal AI governance policies or guidelines? If so, what was your role? * Have you helped establish procedures for monitoring AI performance, accuracy, or regulatory compliance? Ability to Commute: * Sunrise, FL 33323 (Required) Work Location: In person

We're looking for a hands\-on, solutions\-oriented engineer who approaches IT with a builder's mindset. jobs.description: **Category:** Engineering **Job ID:** R\_107207 **Job Type:** Regular **Job Description:** Job Description: At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Whether it’s supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we’re not just here to move money — we’re here to move our global customers forward. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer on the Global Card team, you will own features end to end: the screens customers see, the APIs behind them, and the services that issue cards, hold balances, and move money. Represent Remitly's cultural values and technical competencies in interviews. * **Collaborate cross\-functionally:** Partner with Product, Design, Analytics, and other engineering teams to translate customer needs into scalable technical solutions and deliver on shared outcomes. * **Communicate with clarity:** Effectively articulate complex technical problems, trade\-offs, and proposals to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **You Have:** * A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Expertise in one or more backend or full\-stack programming languages (e.g., Go, Kotlin, Java, TypeScript) and the ability to adapt to new languages and frameworks as needed. * Experience designing secure, scalable, and performant software using cloud\-based infrastructure solutions (e.g., AWS). * Experience leading projects at the team level, including breaking features into parallel workstreams, estimating timelines, and coaching other engineers through mentoring, reviews, and retrospectives. * Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity in product requirements, technical design, and cross\-team dependencies while driving decisions to resolution. * Ability to articulate best practices for error handling, observability, and operational excellence. * 5\+ years of software engineering experience in a collaborative, cross\-functional team environment. **Compensation Details.** The starting base salary range for this position is typically $180,000\-$225,000\. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in\-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster. Under the Company's current hybrid\-work expectations, employees in this position work onsite Tuesday through Thursday each week. Additional onsite attendance may be required based on business needs, and the Company may modify its hybrid\-work expectations from time to time. These intentional in\-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most. Remitly is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description: **About Renaissance** When you join Renaissance®, you join a global leader in pre\-K–12 education technology! Renaissance's solutions help educators analyze, customize, and plan personalized learning paths for students, allowing time for what matters—creating energizing learning experiences in the classroom. Our fiercely passionate employees and educational partners have helped drive phenomenal student growth, with Renaissance solutions being used in over one\-third of US schools and in more than 100 countries worldwide. Every day, we are connected to our mission by exemplifying our values: trust each other, win together, strive for the best, own our actions, and grow and evolve. **Job Description** As a Software Engineer III, you will build features across the discovery layer and the products behind it: the search and browse experiences teachers use to find the right lesson, the curation tools admins use to govern what their district sees, and the services that make four separate products feel like one library. You will be making it fast and intuitive for admins to govern and curate, for teachers to find and instruct, and for students to explore and grow their respective libraries. You will work with a high degree of independence and help ensure that problems and solutions are appropriately scoped. In addition, you will be the first team to adopt Renaissance's S3 model of software development. You will be expected to build **multi\-agent orchestration**, where specialized agents coordinate on complete features and engineers shift from managing individual tasks to designing the systems that produce the work. **In this role as a Software Engineer III, you will:** * Build features across the discovery layer and the products it connects — search and browse for teachers, curation and governance for admins, exploration for students. * Develop backend services that leverage relational databases, non\-relational datastores, message queuing, and cloud infrastructure, against typed contracts. * Build and test frontend experiences in TypeScript and React, contract\-tested against the backend, with accessibility treated as a requirement rather than a follow\-up. * Write the tests and the instrumentation with the feature — unit, component, and contract tests, plus the traces, metrics, and logs that make the system debuggable. **Qualifications** **For this role, you must have:** * Professional experience building and shipping production web applications or services. * Experience developing backend services against relational databases, and comfort with non\-relational datastores, message queuing, and/or cloud infrastructure. * Excitement to help craft a new, AI\-first software development lifecycle. The idea of encoding engineering understanding into formal constraints that can be consumed by an AI workflow is an interesting problem to you, not a necessary evil. * Working knowledge of cloud operations — you can deploy across environments, read a dashboard, and troubleshoot an application problem in a cloud environment. * Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate well with distributed engineering, product, and design teams. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent industry experience. **Experience with various engineering technologies such as:** * SQL (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, etc.) * Proficiency in a typed language, ideally TypeScript, and comfort working in a strictly typed codebase. **Optionally, you could have:** * Experience leading and mentoring others * Experience with the AWS technologies * Knowledge of DevOps processes and technologies **Additional information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. #### **Salary Range:** **The base range for this position is $99,500\.00 \- $136,800\.00\. jobs.description: **Position Details** -------------------- Position Information **Recruitment/Posting Title** Assistant Professor Tenure Track AY\-Chemical and Biochemical Engineering **Department** Chemical \& Biochemical **Salary Details** Commensurate with experience \- Minimum $100,000 Academic Year **Offer Information** The final salary offer may be determined by several factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and expertise, and availability of department or grant funds to support the position. We also take into consideration market benchmarks, if and when appropriate, and internal equity to ensure fair compensation relative to the university’s broader compensation structure. We are committed to offering competitive and flexible compensation packages to attract and retain top talent. **Benefits** Rutgers provides a comprehensive benefits package to eligible employees. The specific benefits vary based on the position and may include: * Medical, prescription drug, and dental coverage * Paid vacation, holidays, and various leave programs * Competitive retirement benefits, including defined contribution plans and voluntary tax\-deferred savings options * Employee and dependent educational benefits (when applicable) * Life insurance coverage * Employee discount programs **Posting Summary** The Department of Chemical and Biochemical Engineering invites applications for a tenure\-track position at the level of Assistant Professor. Applications from exceptional candidates at a higher rank will also be considered. We seek outstanding candidates in the broad areas of pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, and advanced chemical processes and manufacturing, including experimental, computational, and data\-driven approaches in these areas. Applications of particular interest include biomanufacturing; pharmaceutical process engineering, development, scale\-up, and manufacturing; electrified and sustainable chemical processes; carbon circularity and industrial decarbonization; and waste upcycling and resource recovery. Computational and data\-driven areas of interest include applied AI/ML and data science, self\-driving laboratories and autonomous experimentation, digital twins, and advanced process monitoring, control, and optimization. The successful candidate is expected to develop a strong, externally funded research program, contribute to existing and new teaching and training programs at the graduate and undergraduate levels in the field of Chemical and Biochemical Engineering, and provide service to the department, the school, and the university. **Position Status** Full Time **Posting Number** 26FA1049 **Posting Open Date** 11/20/2026 **Posting Close Date** Qualifications **Minimum Education and Experience** Applicants are expected to hold a doctoral degree in Chemical Engineering or a closely related discipline. The successful candidate will develop and sustain a research program leading to national and international recognition and demonstrate excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration in an interdisciplinary environment. Accomplishments appropriate to the candidate’s career stage will be considered. **Certifications/Licenses** **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** **Preferred Qualifications** **Equipment Utilized** **Physical Demands and Work Environment** **Overview** ***About Rutgers Chemical and Biochemical Engineering*** The Department of Chemical and Biochemical Engineering (CBE) includes 25 full\-time faculty, more than 255 undergraduate students, and 110 graduate students. Located in central New Jersey, the department is situated in the heart of one of the nation’s leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and advanced manufacturing corridors, offering exceptional opportunities for research collaboration and engagement with industry. CBE faculty conduct interdisciplinary research in pharmaceutical engineering, biotechnology and biomanufacturing, energy and sustainability, materials, nanotechnology, and catalysis, as well as computational and data\-driven approaches to chemical and biological systems. jobs.title: Associate Solutions Engineer - AI
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ **Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.** **Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:** * **Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority\- and woman\-owned enterprise in the U.S.** * **Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.** * **Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.** * **World\-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.** **Job Summary** =============== The Associate Solutions Engineer / Data Center Engineer is a hands\-on technical role responsible for deploying, maintaining, and troubleshooting physical server infrastructure within lab and data center environments. This role supports the full server hardware lifecycle, including equipment installation and cabling, server configuration, out\-of\-band management, Linux administration, diagnostics, firmware management, hardware replacement, and production\-ready handoff. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable working at a Linux command line and physically installing or troubleshooting enterprise server equipment, with the ability to identify and resolve issues across hardware, BMC, networking, storage, firmware, and operating system layers. **Role Description** **Server Hardware Management** * Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise server hardware. * Diagnose failures involving CPUs, DIMMs, storage devices, RAID controllers, power supplies, network interface cards (NICs), GPUs, fans, and system boards. * Perform hardware swaps, component upgrades, firmware updates, and break/fix activities. * Review system health, hardware inventory, event logs, temperatures, power consumption, and component status. Work with enterprise GPU server platforms such as Dell XE Series, NVIDIA H200, Cisco UCS, or equivalent systems. * **Baseboard Management Controller (BMC)** * Configure and manage server BMC interfaces and out\-of\-band management using technologies such as Dell iDRAC, HPE iLO, IPMI, and Redfish. * Configure BMC networking, credentials, firmware, remote consoles, virtual media, and power controls. * Use BMC logs and hardware telemetry to diagnose server faults. Perform remote power cycling, system configuration, and operating system installation when appropriate. * **Equipment Racking and Cabling** * Rack and unrack servers, switches, storage equipment, Power Distribution Units (PDUs), and related infrastructure. * Install rails, cable\-management hardware, and other rack components. * Perform structured copper and fiber cabling, including Ethernet connections and management networks. * Maintain accurate port, cable, rack\-unit, hostname, and asset labeling. * Follow rack elevation, power distribution, airflow, and cable\-management standards. Trace and troubleshoot physical connectivity issues throughout the rack infrastructure. * **Linux Administration** * Install, configure, and support Linux operating systems, including Ubuntu Server or equivalent distributions. * Troubleshoot Linux boot, kernel, storage, networking, service, and hardware\-related issues. * Perform system administration using SSH and command\-line tools. * Configure interfaces, IP addressing, DNS, routes, bonding, and VLAN\-related settings. * Use Linux utilities such as systemctl, journalctl, dmesg, ip, ethtool, lsblk, lspci, dmidecode, and smartctl. Create Bash or Python scripts to automate repetitive server\-management activities where appropriate. * **Behaviors and Competencies** ------------------------------ * **Problem\-Solving:** Can systematically identify, isolate, and resolve hardware, firmware, networking, storage, and operating system issues. * **Detail\-Oriented:** Can identify errors or inconsistencies in configurations, logs, cabling, labeling, and component status and make necessary corrections. * **Organization:** Can prioritize technical tasks, manage personal workflow, and maintain accurate infrastructure records. * **Follow\-Up:** Can independently track assigned work and technical issues through completion without requiring reminders. * **Communication:** Can clearly communicate technical issues, findings, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions to appropriate stakeholders. * **Documentation:** Can independently create and maintain accurate technical, infrastructure, and troubleshooting documentation. * **Collaboration:** Can work effectively with engineers, infrastructure teams, vendors, and other technical resources. * **Results Orientation:** Can take ownership of assigned server infrastructure activities and drive work through successful validation and handoff. **Skill Level Requirements** **Required Skills** * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting physical servers, data center infrastructure, hardware labs, or a comparable environment. * Strong knowledge of enterprise server hardware and component\-level troubleshooting. * Hands\-on experience with BMC and out\-of\-band management technologies, including IPMI, Redfish, Dell iDRAC, HPE iLO, or comparable technologies. * Demonstrated experience racking, unracking, installing, and cabling server equipment. * Strong working knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting. * Understanding of TCP/IP networking, Ethernet, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and basic network troubleshooting. Ability to interpret hardware logs and systematically isolate hardware, firmware, network, storage, and operating system problems. * **Preferred Skills** * Experience supporting GPU or AI compute infrastructure, including NVIDIA GPU\-based servers. * Familiarity with high\-density or high\-performance computing environments. * Experience with IPMI tools, Ansible, Bash, or Python for server automation. * Experience with PXE/network\-based provisioning and automated Linux installation. * Familiarity with RAID, NVMe, SAS/SATA storage, and enterprise storage concepts. * Experience performing firmware and BIOS/UEFI configuration at scale. * Familiarity with server asset\-management or Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) systems. Linux certification such as Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) is a plus. * **Other Requirements** ---------------------- * Ability to safely lift, install, move, rack, and unrack server and other rack\-mounted equipment in accordance with applicable workplace safety requirements. * Ability to perform hands\-on equipment installation, cabling, component replacement, and troubleshooting within lab and data center environments. * Ability to work independently on assigned infrastructure activities and escalate issues appropriately when additional support is required. * Ability to manage a server through the deployment lifecycle, including rack installation, power and network cabling, BMC configuration, firmware/BIOS setup, Linux installation, hardware and network validation, and production\-ready handoff. The estimated annual pay range for this position is $75,000 \- $150,000 which includes a base salary. The compensation for this position is dependent on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending. Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

jobs.title: Reservoir Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** The Reservoir Engineer is SOGC’s technical authority on the oil and gas assets it owns. The role determines how much oil and gas the SOGC’s assets in North Dakota and the Midland Basin can produce and what they are worth. It owns the reserves reporting relied on by leadership, the Board, auditors, and the SEC, finds ways to increase production from existing wells, and provides the technical analysis behind acquisition and divestiture decisions. The role reports findings to executive leadership and turns reservoir data into decisions that drive the company’s growth and value. **Responsibilities** * Lead midyear and year\-end reserves evaluations in coordination with third\-party auditors. * Maintain and update the corporate reserves database. * Prepare and present reserves reports to executive leadership and the Board of Directors. * Ensure compliance with SEC and SPE\-PRMS standards. * Build and maintain reservoir simulation models (e.g., CMG, Eclipse, or similar). * Conduct decline curve analysis, volumetric assessments, and material balance calculations. * Integrate geological, petrophysical, and production data to characterize reservoir performance. * Forecast production and estimate ultimate recovery for development planning. * Analyze well performance and identify opportunities to enhance production. * Recommend and design workovers, stimulations, artificial lift changes, and other interventions. * Collaborate with operations and completions teams to implement optimization strategies. * Monitor post\-intervention performance and update models accordingly. * Lead technical evaluations of potential acquisition targets and divestiture candidates. * Perform reservoir due diligence, including reserves validation, production forecasting, and economic modeling. * Support data room preparation and review third\-party engineering reports. * Collaborate with land, finance, and executive teams to inform strategic decisions. * Build and maintain dashboards tracking relevant A\&D across the industry. * Serve as the company’s subject matter expert on reservoir engineering. * Develop and maintain internal workflows and best practices for reservoir analysis. * Support cross\-functional teams with technical insights and mentoring as needed. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum Engineering or related field. * 7\+ years of reservoir engineering experience, preferably in unconventional plays. * Proficiency in reservoir simulation software and reserves/economics tools (e.g., Aries, PHDWin). * Strong understanding of Bakken/Three Forks and Midland Basin geology and production trends. * Experience supporting A\&D transactions from a technical perspective. * Excellent communication skills and ability to present technical data to non\-technical stakeholders. * Self\-starter with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. * Experience with Spotfire, Python, sql, database, machine learning, AI and other data analytics tools. * Familiarity with SEC reserves reporting and third\-party audit processes. * Ability to work in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment. jobs.description: ### **Company Overview** Samsung SDS is the digital arm of the Samsung group and a global provider of cloud and digital transformation innovations. We enable our customers in government, financial services, healthcare, and other industries to drive business in a hyper\-connected economy helping them to increase productivity, safeguard assets, and make smarter decisions. ### **Position Summary** Samsung SDS America is seeking an experienced software\-minded infrastructure engineer to join our IT organization. You will design, build and operate the Python\-based automation and data services that run SARC IT: the ITDB/CMDB API on Jira Assets, the command\-line tooling around it, and the integrations that keep server, network and storage records accurate and drive provisioning and configuration management. own releases, release notes, documentation, SLAs and resilience * Build integrations and event\-driven automation: Jira Assets/AQL endpoints, webhooks that trigger Jenkins jobs, generated Ansible inventory, and automated attribute discovery for servers, network and storage devices (SNMP, CLI or Assets discovery) * Maintain data quality and provisioning guardrails for server lifecycle records (required\-field validation, role framework, default values, duplicate and inconsistency cleanup) * Support and troubleshoot production automation services: respond to PagerDuty alerts and incidents, perform root\-cause analysis, write incident reports, and maintain runbooks * Support Linux and configuration management operations: CFEngine and Ansible, SSH trust and host\-key management, and validation testing of new RHEL releases and test clusters * Enable AI\-assisted engineering: administer and support Claude and Claude Code for engineering teams (access, spend and token limits, usage analysis, troubleshooting), build and maintain MCP integrations for Atlassian, Bitbucket and Webex, and document safe\-use patterns * Develop AI\-assisted automation workflows; make automation responsive, self\-healing and data driven * Participate in platform migrations and upgrades, such as ITDB version releases and the Atlassian Cloud/Assets migration * Deploy production\-ready code using standard testing and deployment processes: unit and acceptance tests, test environments, CI/CD, code review * Improve and refine server OS deployments and provisioning processes using automation * Contribute to configuration management policy development to further automate and streamline operations * Work with cross\-functional teams and internal customers to understand requirements, automate workflows, and build tools, dashboards and monitoring * Continuously evaluate and improve best practices for IT process automation * Contribute to project plans defined by the SARC IT team **Requirements*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field * 7\+ years of experience in IT automation or DevOps engineering * Strong Python proficiency, including building and supporting REST APIs (Flask, Django or similar) * Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet or CFEngine * Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins preferred), source control, pull requests, code reviews, and software testing frameworks * Significant experience designing and developing enterprise\-scale software solutions against customer and stakeholder requirements * Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, with experience building, configuring, monitoring and supporting open\-source tools and application stacks * Experience operating production services, including on\-call response, incident management and root\-cause documentation * Hands\-on experience using LLM\-based tools (such as Claude Code) in engineering work, and building integrations with them (MCP or similar) * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills; excellent communication and collaboration skills; self\-starter who works independently and, in a team. **Preferred Qualification** --------------------------- * Experience with CMDB / Jira Assets (AQL) or similar asset\-management platforms * Knowledge of Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket administration * Server provisioning knowledge: Red Hat Satellite, Foreman, PXE, Kickstart * Containers and orchestration: OpenShift, Kubernetes, Podman, Docker * Databases and observability: PostgreSQL, MariaDB, InfluxDB, Grafana, ELK stack, Splunk, GraphQL * Knowledge of internet protocols and services: TCP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP, SSH, LDAP and AD * Virtualization (VMware, vCenter) and cloud experience (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) * Linux administration in environments with hundreds or thousands of clients * Knowledge of EDA workflows **Benefits** Samsung SDSA offers a comprehensive suite of programs to support our employees: * Top\-notch medical, dental, vision and prescription coverage * Wellness program * Parental leave * 401K match and savings plan * Flexible spending accounts * Life insurance * Paid Holidays * Paid Time off * Additional benefits Samsung SDS America, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: APPLICATIONS DEVELOPER II

Experience with AI code generation tools is desirable, and familiarity with Tyler Odyssey or Enterprise Justice reports is a plus. The recruitment is anticipated to close **December** **13, 2026,** or when a sufficient number of applications have been submitted. **DEFINITION** Under direction, performs professional\-level systems and business process analyses and designs; develops, codes, tests, implements, enhances, and maintains applications and program modules including complex systems impacting Court\-wide operations; performs other duties as assigned. **SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED** Receives direction from assigned supervisory and management personnel. For additional details about the role, please review the full job description: APPLICATIONS DEVELOPER II **Essential Functions** ----------------------- **EXAMPLES OF TYPICAL JOB FUNCTIONS (Illustrative Only)** *Management reserves the right to add, modify, change, or rescind the work assignments of different positions and to make reasonable accommodations so that qualified employees can perform the essential functions of the job.* * Collaborates with managers, users, and development teams to identify and document user business rules and processes and data requirements; defines project scope for approval; develops and writes system and program specifications, diagrams processes and data flows; develops and demonstrates prototypes for approval; conducts project status meetings with managers, stakeholders, and users. * Designs, develops, or modifies applications to meet user and court business requirements, using defined development standards and best practices; of automated reporting systems and strategies including dashboarding options. * Researches, tests, evaluates and makes recommendations on potential software packages and development; provides input on hardware requirements; analyzes and documents test results following installations and upgrades; communicates with vendors on behalf of users to resolve problems. * Designs and conducts unit and systems testing to ensure applications perform as designed and meet user requirements; analyzes test results and develops fixes to resolve problems identified; plans and executes conversion and installation processes; works with other information technology staff in executing comprehensive quality assurance processes; develops and implements security and access rights for applications. * Uses best practices and techniques to achieve technical problem resolution for databases and applications; trains users on new applications and features; prepares training materials, user manuals and instru ters and software programs relevant to work performed. **Ability to:** * Analyze and define problems and apply sound technology and business management processes to recommend technology solutions to meet user operational, productivity and service delivery needs. * Obtain accurate and complete information from users, in person, by telephone, or virtually to identify their needs and problems and develop responses and solutions. * Apply critical thinking skills to reach sound, logical conclusions regarding user needs and business requirements. * Plan, organize and complete applications development projects over the full systems development life cycle efficiently and effectively to meet customer needs and requirements. * Understand and apply functional requirements to the development of systems proposals, specifications and recommendations for efficient, cost\-effective information systems and technology solutions. * Read, interpret, explain, and apply technical information on business processes, software and hardware for technical and non\-technical users. * Perform accurate mathematical calculations. * Maintain accurate program records and files. * Maintain confidentiality of Court documents, records, and systems. * Understand, interpret, and apply all pertinent laws, codes, regulations, policies and procedures, and standards relevant to work performed. jobs.title: Coastal Water Resources Engineer - Mid-Level
jobs.description: Responsibilities: As a valued member of our dynamic team, you’ll collaborate with project and technical leads to deliver water resources and coastal engineering analyses. You will contribute to hydrologic, hydraulic, and coastal flood\-hazard evaluations, including work that uses the ADCIRC model as a primary analytical tool. Your role will involve participating in multidisciplinary project teams and developing, applying, and interpreting numerical models and engineering analyses for power plant sites and other infrastructure projects. Responsibilities may encompass:* Developing, configuring, running, and interpreting ADCIRC simulations for coastal water levels, storm surge, tides, and related flood hazards. * Preparing and reviewing ADCIRC model inputs, boundary conditions, computational meshes, and output data; documenting assumptions and model limitations. * Evaluating ADCIRC results and communicating implications for flood elevations, site exposure, and engineering design. * Supporting model setup, calibration, validation, sensitivity analyses, and quality reviews using available project data and guidance. * Applying coupled ADCIRC\+SWAN or other coastal wave\-modeling tools when appropriate to project needs. * Analyzing coastal and riverine flood hazards, including extreme water levels and relevant rainfall, streamflow, tide, and storm data. * Developing hydrologic and hydraulic models using tools such as HEC\-HMS and HEC\-RAS (1D and 2D), as appropriate. * Using GIS, digital elevation models, and geospatial data to characterize watersheds, coastlines, terrain, and project sites. * Performing statistical analyses of rainfall, streamflow, tide, and other hydrometeorological records. * Preparing technical calculations, reports, figures, and supporting documentation. * Traveling occasionally as project requirements dictate. **This position is based on a hybrid work schedule and will require in\-office work 3 days per week.** Qualifications: **We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.** Essential skills and experience: * Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline from an ABET\-accredited program, with relevant coursework in hydrology, hydraulics, coastal engineering, or numerical modeling. * Three (3\) or more years of relevant experience in water resources, coastal, hydrologic, or hydraulic engineering. * Demonstrated hands\-on knowledge of the ADCIRC model; experience developing or modifying model inputs, running simulations, and interpreting results is a primary qualification for this position. * Experience running ADCIRC models for storm\-surge analysis. * Experience automating the SLOSH model to run multiple simulations. * Understanding of coastal processes and flood drivers such as storm surge, tides, wind forcing, and extreme water levels. * Experience analyzing hydrometeorological data, including rainfall, streamflow, tide, or coastal water\-level records. * Experience with hydrologic or hydraulic modeling, such as HEC\-HMS and HEC\-RAS (1D and/or 2D), and familiarity with GIS tools and terrain data. * Ability to prepare clear technical reports and communicate model methods, assumptions, results, and limitations. * Familiarity with programming or scripting languages such as Python, MATLAB, R, or similar tools for data processing and analysis. * Strong teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary teams. Valued but not required skills and experience: * Professional Engineer (PE) license, or progress toward licensure. * Master of Science in Civil Engineering with focus on Coastal Engineering * Experience with additional GIS, numerical modeling, or engineering tools such as QGIS, ArcGIS, Global Mapper, Civil 3D, or AutoCAD. Technology \& Innovation: Sargent \& Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high\-quality outcomes for our clients. We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology\-assisted tools. Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description. About Sargent \& Lundy: At Sargent \& Lundy, we care about the health and well\-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work\-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award\-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024\. **Health \& Wellness** **Financial Benefits** **Work\-Life Balance** * Health Plans: Medical, Dental, Vision * Life \& Accident Insurance * Disability Coverage * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Back\-Up Daycare * FSA \& HSA * 401(k) * Pre\-Tax Commuter Account * Merit Scholarship Program * Employee Discount Program * Corporate Charitable Giving Program * Tuition Assistance * First Professional Licensure Bonus * Employee Referral Bonus * Paid Annual Personal/Sick Time (PST) * Paid Vacation * Paid Holidays * Paid Parental Leave * Paid Bereavement Leave * Flexible Work Arrangements Compensation Range: $74,353 \- $113,595 Transparency Statement: Sargent \& Lundy discloses compensation ranges that comply with all local and state regulations. The total compensation package for eligible positions will include a base salary or an hourly rate and a comprehensive benefits package, reflecting our commitment to rewarding performance and supporting the overall well\-being of our employees. Individuals may also be eligible to participate in our yearly discretionary bonus. About This Business Unit: The Energy \& Industrial Group (EIG) specializes in delivering advanced engineering solutions across various sectors, including power generation, environmental compliance, oil \& gas, and industrial projects, from new plant design to plant betterment and upgrade services for operating facilities. We have designed nearly 900 conventional power plants, yielding over 100,000 megawatts (MW) of generation capacity. Our expertise includes numerous recent and ongoing combined cycle projects that leverage the latest advanced machinery, including combustion turbines, steam turbines, and heat recovery steam generators from all leading suppliers. jobs.title: Principal, AI Data Scientist
jobs.description: Job Description: Help turn emerging AI technology into the next generation of Schneider Electric offers. A multidisciplinary team of data scientists, software engineers, architects, and domain experts engages early with customers and offer teams to identify valuable problems, test the riskiest assumptions, and build high\-quality proofs of concept that demonstrate what is possible and provide a strong foundation for production teams to take forward. We work close to customers, close to data, and close to the technology. Our work spans energy management, buildings, data centers, industrial systems, predictive maintenance, equipment reliability, and optimization. jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960\. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all\-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built\-in gas\-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! #### **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck \& rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: * Own the configuration, operation, and evolution of enterprise AI platforms, primarily Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform, including Power Apps and code apps. * Establish and maintain tenant settings and environment strategies for development, testing, and production. * Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to promote agents, applications, and automations across environments. * Establish application lifecycle management standards, including source control, testing, deployment, versioning, and recovery. * Configure platform policies, connectors, access controls, and supporting services. * Partner with Infrastructure and Security teams to implement secure identity, integration, and platform practices. * Establish reusable components, templates, and integration patterns that enable citizen developers and other builders. * Define production\-readiness standards and guardrails that balance innovation, security, and supportability. * Monitor platform health, reliability, capacity, and usage. * Evaluate platform releases and emerging capabilities and maintain the technical platform roadmap. * Automate platform administration, deployment, and operational processes. * Troubleshoot platform, integration, identity, and deployment issues. * Document architecture, standards, deployment processes, and operational runbooks. * Provide operational coverage for broader AI infrastructure and automation platforms when needed. **Location \& Travel Expectations**: * This role will be based out of the **Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC**. * This role requires 4 days per week in the office, with regular in\-person meetings and events. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. #### **What you'll bring** We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related field, or equivalent work experience. * 8\+ years of experience in platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or enterprise application platforms. * Hands\-on experience configuring and operating Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio. * Experience establishing enterprise environment strategies, platform governance, and production operating practices. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, and application lifecycle management. * Experience supporting production deployment of agents, applications, or automation solutions. * Knowledge of Power Platform solutions, Dataverse, connectors, and environment\-specific configuration. * Knowledge of platform security, identity, access controls, data policies, and connector governance. * Experience integrating enterprise platforms using APIs, connectors, and web services. * Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and production support practices. * Scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar languages. * Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code. * Familiarity with AI and automation platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, n8n, or similar technologies. * Ability to independently own platform configuration and operations while partnering with Infrastructure and Security teams. * Effective communication and collaboration skills. * A teaching and coaching approach to enabling engineers, citizen developers, and business teams. * Minimum of High School Diploma, GED or equivalent required for all roles at Scout Motors, Inc. #### **What you'll gain** The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: * Competitive insurance including: + Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans * 401(k) program with: + An employer match and immediate vesting * Generous Paid Time Off including: + 20 days planned PTO, as accrued + 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually + Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders + Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave #### **Pay Transparency** This is a full\-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. Initial base salary range \= $140,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00 Internal leveling code: IC8 **Notice to applicants:** * To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older. * Residing in **San Francisco**: *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* * Residing in **Los Angeles**: *Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.* * Residing in **New York City**: *This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.* **Equal Opportunity** Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre\-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Core Infrastructure
jobs.description: Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise. **Culture at Scribd, Inc.** --------------------------- We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer. We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in\-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in\-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location. So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long\-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude. This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization. **About the team and role** * Core Infrastructure builds and operates the foundations of Scribd, Inc.: the paved roads of cloud infrastructure, networking, databases, and observability that let every product team move fast with confidence. Over the past two years, our charter has grown, and today we own the Content Library, the unified storage and governance platform for all content across Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable. * The Content Library is one of the more interesting storage problems you'll find anywhere. Nearly twenty years of accumulated content, hundreds of billions of objects in S3, served to hundreds of millions of people every month. It provides transactional storage, dataset transforms with full lineage tracking, low\-latency online reads, and the governance layer (access control, trust, deletion propagation) for our most valuable asset: the content that powers our products and our inference\-driven features. * The core of the platform is written in Rust and built on the excellent Rust data ecosystem (Apache Arrow, Parquet, and DataFusion), with a Python "userland" that teams across the company contribute to directly. If you want a taste of the work, read about Content Crush on our tech blog: https://tech.scribd.com/blog/2026/content\-crush.html * This role will join an existing team of Senior, Staff, and Principal engineers building the Content Library and Core Infrastructure of Scribd, Inc. for all our production datastores. Working alongside the Content Library's architect and Staff engineers, who set the platform's technical direction, you'll own features and services end to end, become a go\-to expert in parts of the codebase, and help the teams that build on the platform get their work into production. **About you** * You're a systems engineer who loves owning features end to end: design, implementation, deployment, operations, and the inevitable "why is this slow?" investigations. * You're pragmatic about technology choices; you keep things simple, and you write things down. Design docs, runbooks, and thoughtful code reviews are part of how you work. * You enjoy helping the engineers who build on your systems, whether that's reviewing their contributions, unblocking an integration, or breaking a fuzzy request into well\-scoped milestones. * You've made agentic AI tools part of your daily engineering practice, and you know they accelerate great engineers rather than replace engineering judgment. You review AI output for quality and security before it ships, and you stay accountable for every change. **What you will do** * Design, build, and operate features in the Content Library's core Rust services (transactional storage, transform coordination, and low\-latency retrieval paths) at the scale of hundreds of billions of objects. * Own your projects end to end, from technical design through implementation, deployment, and production operations, including the testing and performance plan, observability, on\-call, and incident response. * Evolve the Python userland (the transform framework, tooling, and developer experience) and support engineers across the company who build on the platform through code reviews, guidance, and clear documentation. * Lead cross\-functional projects with partners in ML, search, product, and data teams: define scope, estimates, and milestones with your manager, drive the work to completion, and contribute to the team roadmap. * Improve performance and cost\-efficiency in the areas you own: query execution (DataFusion), Parque  investment in agentic engineering practices, using tools like Claude Code as a core part of your development workflow while keeping human review at the center of quality and security. \- At Scribd, Inc. your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location. San Francisco is our highest geographic market in the United States. In the state of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $151,000 \[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market within California] to $235,000 \[maximum salary in our highest geographic market within California]. In the United States, outside of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $124,000 \[minimum salary in our lowest US geographic market outside of California] to $223,000 \[maximum salary in our highest US geographic market outside of California]. In Canada, the reasonably expected salary range is between $159,000 CAD\[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market] to $210,500 CAD\[maximum salary in our highest geographic market]. We carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to experience; job\-related skill sets; relevant education or training; and other business and organizational needs. The salary range listed is for the level at which this job has been scoped. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for a competitive equity ownership, and a comprehensive and generous benefits package. **Working at Scribd, Inc.** --------------------------- **Are you currently based in a location where Scribd, Inc. can employ you?** Employees must have their **primary residence in or near** one of the following cities. This includes surrounding metro areas or locations within a typical commuting distance: **United States****:** Atlanta \| Austin \| Boston \| Dallas \| Denver \| Chicago \| Houston \| Jacksonville \| Los Angeles \| Miami \| New York City \| Phoenix \| Portland \| Sacramento \| Salt Lake City \| San Diego \| San Francisco \| Seattle \| Washington D.C. **Canada****:** Ottawa \| Toronto \| Vancouver **Mexico****:** Mexico City **Benefits at Scribd, Inc.** * Scribd Flex (flexible work model) * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Mental health support and disability coverage * Generous paid time off, including vacation, sick time, holidays, winter break, volunteer time, and sabbaticals * Paid parental leave and family support benefits * Retirement matching and employee equity * Learning and development programs and professional growth opportunities * Wellness and home office stipends * Complimentary access to the Scribd, Inc. suite of products * Enterprise access to leading AI tools **Get to Know Scribd, Inc.** **About Scribd, Inc.** **Life at Scribd, Inc.** *We want our interview process to be accessible to everyone. You can inform us of any reasonable adjustments we can make to better accommodate your needs by emailing accommodations@scribd.com about the need for adjustments at any point in the interview process.* *If you apply for a job with Scribd, Inc. or otherwise engage with us in connection with employment (including as an employee, contractor, or other personnel), the personal information we process in that context is subject to our Employee and Applicant Privacy Policy, which is available* *here**.* *Scribd, Inc. is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply, and believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.*

jobs.title: Automation Controls Engineer

Minimum of 5–8 years of hands\-on industrial controls and automation experience required. Equivalent technical training and extensive relevant experience will be considered. * Strong hands\-on experience troubleshooting and programming industrial PLCs, particularly Allen\-Bradley and/or Siemens. * Experience with industrial automation, electrical controls, VFDs, servo systems, and HMIs. * Ability to read and use electrical schematics, control drawings, industrial wiring diagrams, and hydraulic schematics to diagnose equipment faults. * Solid understanding of industrial networking, instrumentation, hydraulics, pneumatics, and electromechanical systems used in automated manufacturing. * Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing complex equipment failures and developing effective solutions. * Takes initiative, works independently, and follows problems through to resolution. * Eager to learn new equipment, processes, and controls platforms. * Works with Maintenance and Operations to resolve issues safely and efficiently. **Additional Experience We'd Love to See** * Hands\-on industrial maintenance experience across multiple disciplines, especially electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, is strong preferred. * Rockwell Automation / Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, and SEW Eurodrive systems. * HMI platforms such as FactoryTalk, WinCC, or Ignition. * FANUC robotics, including programming and troubleshooting. * Industrial communication networks such as Ethernet/IP, Profinet, DeviceNet, and ControlNet. * PID control, instrumentation calibration, and process control. * AutoCAD, SQL databases, historians, and CMMS systems. * Experience in aluminum extrusion, continuous casting, robotic packaging, or other heavy industrial manufacturing environments. At SCM, we believe great employees deserve great benefits, opportunities to grow, and a company that values their contributions. * Competitive compensation based on experience * Bonus program * Paid vacation and sick time * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions * FREE on\-site health clinic for employees and eligible family members * Company\-paid life insurance * Gym membership discounts * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Career advancement and professional growth opportunities **Do You Have the SCM Can\-Do Attitude?** We're looking for someone who takes pride in their work, thinks critically, solves problems, and doesn't hesitate to jump in when equipment needs attention. jobs.title: Analyst II, Cloud Engineering
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE: Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers — the Comfort Technology Company® — has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high\-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand. ABOUT THE ROLE: This role handles daily operations, troubleshooting, and governance support across our multi\-cloud environment(AWS, GCP, and OCI) and the tooling that supports them, including Terraform, identity services, and backup platforms. Responsibilities include access reviews and offboarding, resource audits and cleanup, incident triage, log and cost analysis, and documentation. In partnership with cloud engineers, the role improves and automates processes to reduce manual toil. The ideal candidate is organized, detail\-oriented, comfortable with CLI tools, scripting, and Infrastructure as Code, and able to work independently while knowing when to escalate.**WHAT YOU'LL DO:** * Triage and investigate operational issues across AWS, GCP, and OCI (connectivity, service degradation, access problems). * Perform log investigations (CloudWatch Logs/Insights, GCP Cloud Logging) to pull targeted evidence for incidents and support cases. * Support incident response for outages; document timelines, root cause, and resolution. * Execute user offboarding across cloud platforms: audit and remove IAM permissions, roles, and group memberships; consolidate and document findings. * Conduct periodic access reviews and least\-privilege audits. * Support directory services work (AWS Directory Service, WorkSpaces registrations, AD integration cleanup) in coordination with the AD/Identity team. * Audit cloud resources to identify orphaned, unused, or misconfigured assets and drive their cleanup (e.g., empty directory registrations, stale functions, unused compartments). * Enforce resource tagging standards; remediate untagged/non\-compliant resources. * Produce teardown/decommission plans with clear order\-of\-operations and backout considerations. * Analyze cloud spend and billing data; identify cost\-optimization opportunities. * Maintain operational dashboards and team KPIs; produce recurring reports. **WHAT YOU'LL BRING:** * 2–4 years of hands\-on cloud operations / cloud analyst experience. * Working proficiency with AWS (IAM, EC2/VPC networking, CloudWatch, Directory Service/WorkSpaces, S3, RDS); familiarity with GCP and/or OCI. * Comfortable in the CLI (AWS CLI, gcloud) and reading/writing shell scripts. * Solid understanding of IAM concepts, least privilege, and access reviews. * Experience with log analysis and troubleshooting across cloud services. * Strong documentation habits and attention to detail. * Familiarity with change\-management processes and ticketing (e.g., ServiceNow/Jira). * Organized and self\-directed; manages a queue of varied requests. * Clear written and verbal communicator. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Associate\-level cloud certification (AWS Certified Solutions Architect / SysOps Administrator, or GCP Associate Cloud Engineer). * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Git\-based workflows. * Exposure to backup/DR tooling, SFTP/managed file transfer, and directory services / Active Directory integration. * Experience with cost management and tagging governance at scale. * Scripting for automation (Python or shell). * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field required. The pay range for this position is $90,000\-$115,000/yr USD. **About Skechers** Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e\-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Skechers is committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and respectful work environment. Skechers provides equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment without regard race, color, religion, gender, gender identification and expression, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, military status, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic established by local, state or federal law. **Reasonable Accommodation** Applicants for employment who require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job should request appropriate accommodation by emailing benefits@skechers.com. The skills, abilities and physical demands described are representative of those duties that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. jobs.description: Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company operates Snapchat , a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc. , a wholly\-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji , Saturn, and other digital services. Snap Security teams protect the trust and safety of our global community by securing the systems and data that power Snapchat. We safeguard hundreds of millions of Snapchatters every day, ensuring that every product and service is built on a foundation of security and resilience. **Our values** guide everything we do \- from how we anticipate and mitigate threats to how we collaborate across Snap. We move fast, with precision, and always execute with privacy at the forefront. We’re looking for a Staff Security Engineer to join our Offensive Security Team! The team specializes in designing comprehensive engagements and exercises that simulate advanced adversarial tactics, highlighting strengths in our security and privacy posture while uncovering vulnerabilities and inadequate defenses, informing the business where we need to tactically and strategically address gaps. What you’ll do: * Design, execute, and lead offensive security and privacy engagements, including red, purple, and orange team exercises, across corporate environments, cloud projects/accounts, internal applications, and mobile client applications. * Maintain a comprehensive understanding of real\-world threat actors, their tools, tactics, and procedures, with a propensity to target Snap, collaborating extensively with the threat intelligence team to enumerate exhaustive killchains that seed and prioritize the future engagement roadmap. * Deliver detailed post\-engagement reports that identify vulnerabilities, highlight strengths and weaknesses in our security posture, assess detection coverage, and provide actionable recommendations, including prioritized risk mitigation strategies and improvements to defensive measures. * Implement and manage offensive security engagement infrastructure and tooling to conduct covert operations and mimic the tactics of relevant adversaries, including the development of custom implants, payloads, and exploits to thoroughly test and evaluate our defenses. * Collaborate closely with other security and privacy teams to share insights from engagements, informing strategic roadmaps by identifying priority areas for improvement and aligning on initiatives. * Serve as a subject matter expert and consultant to other security and privacy teams, participating in security reviews, reproducing vulnerabilities, and contributing to high\-stakes incident response efforts. Explore novel research topics relevant to our tech stack to proactively improve our security posture and integrate lessons learned into future exercises. * Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities: * Proven experience in leading offensive security engagements, coordinating multiple security engineers, and managing and executing assessments to thoroughly test and evaluate security measures. * Expert knowledge in four or more of the following: operating system internals, networking, application development, mobile client development, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), and payload/implant/exploit development. * Coding proficiency in one or more modern languages, including Java, Python, Go, etc. * Adept at threat modeling and establishing killchains * Proficiency in scripting languages like Bash and PowerShell to automate security tasks and improve efficiency of engagements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please provide us some information .
