To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable). Our Benefits : Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success! jobs.description: **Hiring Manager:** Maninder Sahota **Job Abbreviation:** ENG900\_P4\_E **Pay Grade:** Exempt \- 35 **Pay Range:** $143,900\.00 \-$215,800\.00 **Join the Clean Energy Revolution** Southern California Edison’s Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) 2\.0 Program is a transformational initiative that is modernizing the company’s metering, communications, and data capabilities to support the evolving energy landscape. This enterprise\-wide program will replace and support more than 5\.7 million meters across SCE’s service territory while advancing the technology and systems that power a smarter, more connected grid. AMI 2\.0 brings together professionals across engineering, technology, operations, cybersecurity, customer service, and program management to deliver innovative solutions that enhance grid reliability, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen the customer experience. Employees who support AMI 2\.0 will have the opportunity to contribute to a high\-impact program that is helping shape the future of energy delivery and enabling Southern California’s transition to a more resilient, intelligent, and sustainable electric grid. Become a **Senior Engineer, AMI Technology Strategy \& Vendor Management** at Southern California Edison (SCE) and lead the technology strategy, end\-to\-end technical requirements governance, and vendor roadmap management for SCE’s AMI 2\.0 ecosystem. In this job, you will drive technical requirements, architecture alignment, and technology roadmaps across meters, communications networks, head\-end systems, MDMS, analytics platform, and supporting IT/OT systems. Interfacing with AMI technology vendors, you will influence product direction, drive interoperability and cybersecurity alignment, ensure certification readiness and cross\-vendor integration, and provide technical leadership to deliver secure, scalable, and operationally ready solutions that support SCE’s long\-term AMI 2\.0 vision and business objectives. In partnership with engineering, operations, cybersecurity, procurement, IT, and AMI vendors, you will provide technical leadership, decision guidance, and risk management to enable successful AMI 2\.0 technology delivery and sustainment. As a **Senior Engineer, AMI Technology Strategy \& Vendor Management**, your work will help power our planet, reduce carbon emissions, and create cleaner air for everyone. Are you ready to take on the challenge to help us build the future? **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Oversees engineers performing diagnostics, monitoring and inspecting equipment, and reviewing grid technologies, building relationships to facilitate cross\-functional knowledge transfer of related work groups. * Leads the preparation of technical reports, presentations, and other documentation to communicate project status, findings, and recommendations to stakeholders. * Collaborates and leads with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless development, integration and implementation of future technologies and asset performance management strategies. * Assists in a variety of engineering and business initiatives and grid strategies, including development of innovative procedures and design recommendations. * Provides support for new equipment installation and startup, then leads the hand over processes to the ramp and sustaining phases. * Leads junior engineers in investigation of threats on the distribution system infrastructure based on observations and findings. * Gathers and correlates basic data using engineering studies and procedures, which may include routine and diagnostic testing of components and systems. * Facilitates training and professional development opportunities for engineering team members to enhance their skills and knowledge. * A material job duty of all positions within the Company is ensuring the protection of all its physical, financial and cybersecurity assets, and properly accessing and managing private customer data, proprietary information, confidential medical records, and other types of highly sensitive information and data with the highest standards of conduct and integrity. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Bachelor's Degree in a scientific/technical/math field. * Seven or more years of experience in engineering within operations, production, construction or maintenance environments. * Possess a valid Class C Driver's License. **Preferred Qualifications** * Five or more years of experience leading project teams or supervising a team. * Experience developing long\-term vision and strategic roadmaps for IT and/or engineering projects. * Experience in technical leadership, vendor, and contract management, and promoting industry\-wide standards adoption. * Strong understanding of AMI systems, interoperability standards, and wireless communication protocols. * Excellent communication with internal and external audiences, including strong written, presentation and oral skills. * Familiarity with utility operations and stakeholder coordination **Additional Information** * This position’s work mode is **hybrid.** The employee will report to an SCE facility for a set number of days with the option to work remotely on the remaining days. Unless otherwise noted, employees are required to work and reside in the state of California. Further details of this work mode will be discussed at the interview stage. The work mode can be changed based on business needs. * Visit our Candidate Resource page to get meaningful information related to benefits, perks, resources, testing information, hiring process, and more! * Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. * The primary work location for this position is **Westminster, CA**. However, the successful candidate may also be asked to work for an extended amount of time at alternate work locations, including Rosemead and Pomona. * Position will require up to 5% traveling and being out in the field throughout the SCE service territory. * This position has been identified as a NERC/CIP impacted position \- Prior to being hired, the successful candidate must pass a Personnel Risk Assessment (PRA) or Background Investigation. Once hired, the candidate must complete specified training prior to gaining un\-escorted access to assigned work location and performing necessary job duties. * Relocation may apply to this position. **About Southern California Edison** The people at SCE don't just keep the lights on. Our mission is so much bigger. We’re fueling the kind of innovation that’s changing an entire industry, and quite possibly the planet. Join us and create a future with cleaner energy, while providing our customers with the safety and reliability they demand. At SCE, you’ll have a chance to grow personally and professionally, making a real impact in Southern California and around the world. Southern California Edison is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. We are committed to ensuring individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process, including the job application, testing, interviewing, and onboarding. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability or a religious accommodation, please contact HR Services at AskHR@sce.com or (626\) 302\-3456\. **Nearest Major Market:** Orange County **Nearest Secondary Market:** Los Angeles

Our next Program begins in Summer 2027\. **Position Location:** Miami, FL **What You Need to Know** Open the door to a groundbreaking tech career with an industry leader. Southern Glazer’s Wine \& Spirits is North America’s preeminent wine and spirits distributor, as well as a family\-owned, privately held company with roots that go back to 1933\. To create a new era in alcohol beverage sales and service, we’re heavily invested in the most transformative new technologies – and the most brilliant tech professionals. Southern Glazer’s was named by Newsweek as a Most Loved Workplace and is included on the Forbes lists for Largest Private Companies and Best Employers for Diversity. As a full\-time employee, you can choose from a full menu of our Top Shelf Benefits, including comprehensive medical and prescription drug coverage, dental and vision plans, tax\-saving Flexible Spending Accounts, disability coverage, life insurance plans, and a 401(k) plan. organization. **Qualifications** * Must be a graduating senior (December 2026 or May 2027\) pursuing a bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Management ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences * Foundational knowledge of application and software development, including software design and programming principles (e.g., SDLC, jobs.title: Early Career Data Engineer
jobs.description: Early Career Data Engineer*Are you ready to combine your passion for design with a meaningful and multifaceted career in the cycling industry? At Specialized, our teammates are encouraged to explore roles across a variety of functions throughout their careers. We value curiosity, a desire to try new things, and an eagerness to learn about all aspects of the business. Join us in making the world a better place through the power of bicycles and build your dream career at the same time!* As a Specialized Early Career Data Engineer, you won’t be watching from the sidelines. You’ll step into meaningful work, bring a fresh perspective, and help shape **the future of Specialized and how we show up for riders around the world.** Bring your curiosity. Bring your ideas. Bring the courage to challenge what’s been done before. You’ll work alongside people who are constantly pushing what’s possible, learn from experienced leaders, and have the opportunity to leave your mark on a brand built around riders. If you’re ready to learn fast, think differently, and **help write the next chapter of Specialized**, come ride with us. The Junior Data Engineer is responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing trusted data products, data pipelines, and AI\-ready data assets that power reporting, analytics, operational decision\-making, and emerging AI capabilities across the organization. Working within a modern cloud\-based data platform, this role helps improve data accessibility, quality, reliability, and scalability while enabling self\-service analytics and AI innovation. The Junior Data Engineer partners closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver curated, business\-ready datasets that accelerate decision\-making and maximize the value of enterprise data. This position provides critical delivery capacity for the Data \& Analytics team while creating a sustainable pipeline of future engineering talent. The role allows senior engineers and architects to focus on platform modernization, governance, AI enablement, and strategic initiatives while ensuring day\-to\-day engineering execution is delivered effectively. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Data Engineering \& Data Product Development** ------------------------------------------------ * Build, maintain, and optimize data pipelines, integrations, and data products. * Develop ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform, and deliver data from enterprise systems. * Support the development of trusted, reusable datasets for analytics, reporting, operational processes, and AI initiatives. * Assist with data warehouse, lakehouse, and semantic layer development. * Contribute to scalable cloud\-based data platform solutions. **Data Quality, Reliability \& Observability** ---------------------------------------------- * Monitor pipeline performance, data quality, and platform health. * Implement data validation, reconciliation, and automated quality controls. * Support data observability and proactive issue detection. * Troubleshoot production issues and participate in root\-cause analysis. * Help establish and maintain data reliability standards and service levels. **Analytics \& Self\-Service Enablement** ----------------------------------------- * Deliver curated datasets that enable self\-service reporting and analytics. * Partner with business and analytics teams to understand and translate data requirements. * Support semantic models and business\-friendly data structures. * Improve data accessibility, documentation, and usability across the organization. * Reduce manual reporting effort through automation and standardized data assets. **AI \& Data Foundation Support** --------------------------------- * Prepare and curate data for AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics use cases. * Support the development of AI\-ready datasets, metadata, and lineage documentation. * Collaborate with governance and analytics teams to ensure data is trusted, documented, and fit for AI applications. * Support responsible AI initiatives through strong data quality and governance practices. * Assist with integrating new AI\-related data sources and capabilities into the enterprise platform. **Continuous Improvement \& Delivery Excellence** ------------------------------------------------- * Participate in Agile planning, sprint execution, and team ceremonies. * Follow modern engineering practices including source control, testing, and CI/CD. * Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve efficiency. * Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, datasets, and integrations. * Continuously develop technical skills across cloud, analytics, and AI technologies. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** ------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Analytics, or a related field. * 1\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or similar technical roles. * Strong SQL skills and understanding of data modeling concepts. * Experience with Python or another modern programming language. * Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data integration principles. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving abilities. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. * Familiarity with modern orchestration and transformation tools. * Experience with Git, CI/CD, and testing frameworks. * Understanding of data warehousing, lakehouse architecture, and semantic models. * Exposure to machine learning, AI, or Generative AI concepts. * Experience working in Agile product teams. * Knowledge of data governance and metadata management practices. **Success Measures** ==================== Within the first 12 months, the Junior Data Engineer will: * Successfully build and support production data pipelines and integrations. * Improve data quality, reliability, and observability across key business domains. * Deliver trusted datasets that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases. * Reduce manual data processing through automation and engineering best practices. * Increase team delivery capacity by owning operational and repeatable engineering activities. * Demonstrate proficiency with enterprise data platforms and engineering standards. * Contribute to the organization's AI readiness by improving the quality and accessibility of enterprise data. **Tell Me More** **Benefits include:** * Compensation: $76,000 to $104,000 annually * Medical, Dental, \& vision insurance available * Company sponsored life insurance * Competitive vacation package\* * 401(k) with match * Paid company holidays * Employee discounts on all product * Deep partner retail discounts *Here at Specialized we believe that bikes have the power to change lives. Our culture is one of passion, striving to break barriers and have a positive impact on the world.* *We want to increase representation of all races, genders, and body types in the cycling industry and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce where all people thrive. We encourage everyone – especially those from marginalized groups – to apply to our job postings and help us earn the position as the rider’s brand of choice. We are always looking for creative, innovative, and passionate people who are eager to contribute to our mission of pedaling the planet forward. Regardless of your qualifications, if you are ready to make a difference, please apply and let us know how you can make an impact at Specialized!* *See what we are up to on* *LinkedIn**,* *Instagram**, and most importantly, our \#**DogsofSpecialized**.*

jobs.title: Senior GTM Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.** ------------------------------------------------------------ Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage. Our AI\-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self\-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners. As an AI\-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission. Spring Health is actively seeking a Senior GTM Data Engineer to join our Revenue Operations team. Reporting to the Senior Director of Sales Systems \& Data and partnering closely with Marketing Operations, Sales, Data \& Analytics, and AI/Agent teams, the Senior GTM Data Engineer will architect and maintain the integrated data infrastructure that powers analytics, AI agents, and go\-to\-market automation. We're looking for a data architect and engineer who can do three things equally well: build analytics data models, design data pipelines for AI/ML agents and skills, and bridge disconnected systems to ensure data flows where it's needed. You'll own data quality and governance across the entire GTM stack, working at the intersection of analytics, AI enablement, and system integration. This is a full\-time, remote position, with occasional travel required for team offsites and company events. **What you'll do:** ------------------- * Build and maintain well\-documented, tested data models in Snowflake and dbt that unify CRM, marketing automation, campaign, engagement, and enrichment data. * Design and govern a consistent semantic layer with reusable business logic and metric definitions across accounts, buying groups, campaigns, and opportunities. * Partner with GTM and business stakeholders to turn operating questions into durable data products, including funnel, account engagement, lead scoring, and multi\-touch attribution reporting. * Create analytics\-ready datasets and actionable dashboards in tools such as Hex, Looker, or Tableau, explaining data logic and limitations clearly to non\-technical partners. * Enable self\-service analytics across GTM teams by publishing curated models, metric guides, and practical usage documentation. * Design and implement data pipelines that consolidate data from disparate systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Slack, Marketo, 6sense, etc.) into Snowflake, using orchestration tools like Fivetran, custom connectors, or APIs. * Build custom data connectors and integrations (e.g., Zendesk Salesforce) to bridge data gaps where commercial connectors don't exist, using APIs and event\-driven architecture. * Manage D360 and other third\-party data enrichment services, ensuring data quality, deduplication, and proper mapping into core tables. * Implement automated reconciliation checks and lineage tracking to ensure data consistency across all source systems and transformations. * Own the end\-to\-end data pipeline architecture, ensuring low\-latency, reliable data availability for both analytics and operational use cases. * Build feature stores and data models specifically designed for AI agents and skills, including entity resolution, historical snapshots, and contextual enrichment. * Design data structures that support LLM\-based agents and automated workflows, ensuring data freshness, quality, and actionability for model inference. * Develop data governance and versioning practices for AI models, including tracking data lineage and dependencies for training datasets and feature sets. * Partner with AI/ML engineers to define data requirements for new agents, skills, and autonomous workflows, translating business logic into queryable datasets. * Implement quality gates and monitoring for AI\-critical data to ensure models receive accurate, timely, and complete input. * Build and maintain retrieval\-ready datasets and knowledge structures that provide LLM\-powered agents with accurate, current, and structured business context, including source attribution, clear entity relationships, and defined refresh schedules. * Establish and enforce data quality standards across analytics, AI, and operational pipelines using automated testing, anomaly detection, and reconciliation checks. * Monitor data freshness, completeness, and accuracy, with rapid root\-cause identification and resolution in collaboration with system owners and data producers. * Build data c equirements. * Hands\-on experience with D360, identity resolution, or data enrichment platforms. * Demonstrated AI fluency, using AI tools in daily workflows to draft queries, debug code, accelerate documentation, and validate data outputs. * Experience with GTM, marketing, revenue, or sales operations analytics. * Familiarity with multi\-touch attribution, lead/account scoring, and funnel velocity measurement. * Exposure to orchestration tools (Airflow, dbt Cloud, Prefect), data quality frameworks (dbt test, Great Expectations), or warehouse monitoring practices at scale. * Experience building data contracts, governance frameworks, or data mesh architectures. * Clay or comparable enrichment orchestration experience **Nice to Have:** ----------------- * Experience with real\-time or streaming data pipelines. * Familiarity with event\-driven architecture and custom API integrations. * Knowledge of data privacy, compliance frameworks (GDPR, CCPA), or data security practices. * Open\-source contributions or published work on data engineering, analytics engineering, or AI infrastructure. **Benefits provided by Spring Health:** --------------------------------------- **Note**: We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in\-depth information as you continue in the interview process. Benefits are subject to individual plan requirements and eligibility criteria. * Health, Dental, Vision benefits start on your first day at Spring. You and your dependents also receive access to **One Medical**accounts HSA and FSA plans are also available, with Spring contributing up to $1K for HSAs, depending on your plan type. * Employer sponsored 401(k) match of up to 2% for retirement planning * A yearly allotment of no cost visits to the Spring Health network of therapists, coaches, and medication management providers for you and your dependents. * We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave and company holidays. * At 6 months tenure with Spring, we offer parental leave of 18 weeks for birthing parents and 16 weeks for non\-birthing parents. * Access to **Noom****,** a weight management program—based in psychology, that’s tailored to your unique needs and goals. * Access to fertility care support through **Carrot**, in addition to $4,000 reimbursement for related fertility expenses. * Access to**Wellhub**, which connects employees to the best options for fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep in one subscription * Access to **BrightHorizons**, which provides sponsored child care, back\-up care, and elder care * Up to $1,000 Professional Development Reimbursement a year. * $200 per year donation matching to support your favorite causes. **Not sure if you meet every requirement?** Research shows that women and people from historically underrepresented communities often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every qualification compared to other similarly\-qualified candidates. At Spring Health, we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and supported to Thrive. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. ***Our privacy policy:*** ***https://springhealth.com/privacy\-policy/*** *Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.* Compensation Range: $159\.1K \- $175K

jobs.title: principal data engineer-AI
jobs.description: As Principal Engineer, Data Engineering, you will provide technical leadership for the data platforms, products, and engineering capabilities that power enterprise analytics, operational decision\-making, and AI\-enabled experiences. You will define the engineering direction for scalable, reliable, governed, and AI\-ready data solutions while remaining deeply engaged in architecture, design, and implementation. You will operate across engineering, product, analytics, architecture, and data science teams, solving complex technical problems, establishing reusable engineering patterns, and raising the technical bar across the organization. **Define the Future of Data Engineering** Develop multi\-year technical roadmaps for enterprise data engineering capabilities, platforms, and data products. Establish target\-state architectures for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, serving, and consumption of enterprise data. Define engineering strategies that support both analytical and operational workloads while enabling AI and intelligent experiences. jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
jobs.description: **Position Overview** ===================== Storable is seeking a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to lead the organization's information security strategy, program, and culture at a pivotal moment in our growth. As a multi\-vertical SaaS company serving tens of thousands of businesses across self\-storage and adjacent industries, Storable operates complex, high\-availability platforms on AWS that handle sensitive customer and payment data. This is not a compliance\-only role. The CISO Storable needs a business\-minded security leader who can translate risk into language executives and boards understand, build a security organization that enables speed rather than slows it, and establish Storable as a trusted partner to customers who care deeply about data protection. The CISO will own the full security program: strategy, governance, architecture, operations, compliance, and culture. They will serve as the primary security voice to the executive team, the board, and customers — and will inherit a security organization with strong foundations that is ready to mature. Critically, this leader must be equipped to govern AI at enterprise scale. Storable is an active and growing user of AI and is committed to both accelerating AI adoption and governing it responsibly. The CISO will be a key partner, driving AI security strategy, Shadow AI monitoring, and alignment to emerging AI regulatory frameworks. **Scope and Strategic Impact** ============================== The CISO operates at the intersection of security, technology strategy, compliance, and business enablement. Key areas of impact include: * Owning and maturing Storable's enterprise security program across a distributed AWS\-native SaaS environment spanning multiple product verticals. * Driving AI security governance — including Shadow AI detection, AI risk tiering, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 alignment, and OWASP LLM/Agentic AI security integration into the SDLC. * Ensuring continuous SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS compliance * Maturing the monitoring and detection stack — SIEM, DLP, EDR, and CASB (Cloudflare Zero Trust/Gateway), to provide full visibility across cloud, SaaS, and AI surfaces. * Serving as the executive\-level security partner to our team and enterprise customers who conduct security due diligence. * Building a security culture that treats AI as both an asset to leverage and a risk surface to govern, enabling velocity without creating exposure. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Security Strategy \& Leadership** ----------------------------------- * Define and execute a multi\-year information security strategy aligned to Storable's business objectives, growth trajectory, and AI adoption roadmap. * Own the enterprise risk management framework, including threat modeling, risk appetite definition, and risk reporting to the executive team and board. * Lead, grow, and mentor the security team; build a high\-performing organization that scales with the business. * Serve as the primary security spokesperson to customers, prospects, auditors, regulators, and executive leadership. **AI Security \& Governance** ----------------------------- * Govern AI security at enterprise scale, including policy enforcement, Shadow AI detection via Cloudflare Zero Trust, and DLP controls for AI prompt content. * Lead AI risk tiering and formal use case risk assessments aligned to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act's four\-tier risk classification. * Partner with the AI Tools Committee to formalize AI governance charters, coordinate cross\-committee escalation paths, and produce unified AI governance reporting. * Integrate OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and OWASP Agentic AI controls into the secure development lifecycle for engineering teams building AI\-powered features. * Oversee AI vendor risk assessments vendors against Storable's AI vendor risk framework covering training data practices, data retention, and sub\-processor disclosures. **Compliance \& Regulatory** ---------------------------- * Own SOC 2 Type II compliance program — including control design, evidence collection, and auditor relationships across all Trust Services Criteria. * Ensure PCI DSS compliance across applicable product verticals handling payment card data. * Maintain alignment and evaluate the business case and timeline for any compliance requirements. * Own enterprise privacy governance across Storable's digital assets, including consent banner and preference framework oversight, alignment with applicable privacy regulations, integration with website and marketing technologies, and controls for consent logging, script/category enforcement, and coordination with Legal, Product, Marketing, and Engineering. * Implement and govern enterprise data lifecycle management policies and controls across collection, classification, retention, archival, and secure disposal, ensuring alignment with legal, regulatory, contractual, and business requirements. *  who can build a security culture that earns the trust of engineers, customers, and the board alike, this role was built for you. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Storable is a fully distributed company and currently employs individuals residing in all U.S. states except Alaska, Hawaii, and New Hampshire. About Us: At Storable, we're redefining property management for specialty real estate. Powered by AI, our end\-to\-end platform seamlessly integrates management software with marketplace listings, websites, CRM, insurance, payments and more. Tailored for self\-storage, marine, and RV \& camping operators, Storable helps you Win More every day. Benefits and Perks: * Generous health coverage for you and your family, including fully paid short\- and long\-term disability coverage and two\-times base salary life insurance. * 401(k) match after 60 days, 100% vested after 1 year. * Employer contribution to your HSA, plus an HRA to help offset your deductible. * Instant access to flexible vacation. We trust you, so we have a 'take what you need' vacation policy. * Be More – company rewards and recognition that add up and can be redeemed for personalized gifts and experiences! Storriors have been able to enroll in SCUBA certification classes, travel overseas, and redo their back patio, among many other things. * 8 hours of Volunteer Time Off each year and the opportunity to get active in the community by joining one of our offsite volunteer and community service events. * 8 hours of Rest, Relax, Recharge time to care for your mental health. * Access a range of mental well\-being resources for yourself and your dependents, including counseling services, stress management programs, and mindfulness workshops * Fully paid parental leave: 12 and 6 weeks for primary and secondary caregivers, respectively. * 'Paw'ternity Leave and Pet Bereavement \- we understand that pets are a part of the family and have generous time\-off policies, which honor that commitment. * Caregiver Leave: four weeks of fully paid time away from work to care for aging dependents or family members, if needed. * $50 monthly home data stipend, plus a home office sign\-on bonus of $250\. * Fertility care support options to help in your journey towards parenthood. * Access to financial experts to help you make informed decisions and achieve your financial goals. * Direct Student Loan Payment Program, some qualifications and eligibility rules apply. Storable is committed to providing equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Storable will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Important Notice: To protect yourself from fraudulent activities, please consider the following: * Official Communication: All genuine communication from Storable will come from official email addresses, ending in "@storable.com." Be cautious of any communication that doesn't match this criteria. * No Unsolicited Offers: We do not extend job offers without a formal interview process. If you receive an unsolicited job offer claiming to be from Storable or any of its representatives, it's a red flag. * Verification: If you're uncertain about the legitimacy of any job offer or communication claiming to be from Storable, please contact our HR department directly at POps@storable.com for verification. Your security and trust are paramount to us. If you suspect you've been contacted by someone falsely claiming to be from Storable or using our company's name for any dubious purpose, please immediately report the incident to POps@storable.com

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Video
jobs.description: Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. Substack’s model, based on direct subscriptions, has fueled an explosion of independent publishing. It empowers creators with economic autonomy, creative ownership, and a direct connection to their most engaged audiences. As a Software Engineer at Substack, you are responsible for the core product platform, from APIs, low\-level services, and database operations, to frontend UI and testing. On the Video team you’ll be working on podcasting, live streaming, video and audio recording, uploading, clipping, and everything related to an excellent video product experience. Full Stack Engineers work in close partnership with designers, product thinkers, and customers directly to build out new product offerings and tooling across the platform. They are on the front\-lines of product development and are responsible for creating what’s next for Substack. **Responsibilities** * With the support of the engineering team, develop the core Substack product for creators and consumers. This is a dynamic organization with needs across the board. We expect that engineers will be able to jump into any area of the product, learn quickly and add value. * Support and collaborate with other team members, including engineers, designers, creators, support staff, and many others. * Own your work and deliver high\-quality solutions from product concept and proposal to implementation, experimentation, and measurement. * Work directly with customers to solve their problems. The entire company (CEO included) participates in customer support in order to drive empathy for our users and help us build better products. * We work with TypeScript, especially Node/Express and React, and Postgres. It’s helpful if you know these technologies already, if not, we’ll be excited to help you learn. * We work to stay on the leading edge of AI tooling, to both improve our internal workflows, as well as utilize them in product to improve publisher capabilities and experiences **Requirements** * 4\+ years of non\-internship professional full stack web software development. * Proficiency with Node.js and React is an advantage. * Have a degree in Computer Science or have the equivalent industry experience. * Independent and autonomous. We’re too small to micromanage, and expect that every person at the company owns their work and can be a leader. * Take pride in building elegant and delightful product experiences. Substack works best when it gets out of the way so creators can focus on creating and connecting with their readers. * Enjoy collaboration with a diverse group of thinkers while bringing our own unique experience and background to the team. * Believe in Substack’s mission to build a better business model for content creation. * Proficiency with video processing frameworks and libraries such as FFmpeg is an advantage. * Experience with workflow systems such as Temporal is an advantage. Substack’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, and exceptional benefits. Our cash compensation salary range for this role is $140,000 \- $260,000\. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above. Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you. Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Substack's collection and use of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here.

jobs.title: IT Service Operations and Incident Lead
jobs.description: At Sunlighten, we're not just about infrared saunas, we are on a mission to improve lives through innovative health and wellness solutions. As we advance our Sunlighten 2\.0 vision, we are investing in smarter systems, better employee experiences, and technology that helps our business scale. The **IT Service Operations and Incident Lead** combines technical support and help desk leadership with incident coordination and practical AI development. Supporting more than 140 business applications and the hardware and infrastructure behind them, this person keeps employees productive while improving how IT services are delivered. You will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, coach support staff, and coordinate incidents through resolution. You will also design, build, test, deploy, and maintain AI support agents, self\-service resources, and workflow automations that reduce repetitive tickets and manual work. This role requires demonstrated ability to deliver working solutions, beyond simply using AI tools or identifying opportunities. You will partner with IT AI \& Automation Engineering on solution design, integrations, security, and production deployment, while taking responsibility for agreed support automations and their ongoing performance. Daily troubleshooting, ticket resolution, and employee support remain core responsibilities. If you're eager to jump in, collaborate with teams around the world, and keep our technology running smoothly, we want you on our team to tackle challenges and find quick and effective solutions! **Duties/Responsibilities:** **Technical Support \& Help Desk Leadership** * Lead daily help desk operations, including ticket triage, assignment, prioritization, workload balancing, documentation, and follow\-through against service\-level agreements (SLAs). * Resolve support requests and serve as the escalation point for complex Tier I and Tier II issues involving devices, software, Microsoft 365, servers, virtualization, and networking. * Support installations, configurations, employee onboarding and offboarding, and hardware and access needs. Coordinate with application owners when specialist expertise is required. * Coach and develop support staff through training, feedback, clear expectations, and consistent service practices. * Participate in evening, weekend, or on\-call support for critical incidents as needed. **Incident Management \& Service Coordination** * Develop, document, and continuously improve incident classification, priority levels, escalation procedures, response expectations, and service reporting across the application and hardware environment. * Serve as the central incident coordination point: confirm impact, assign an accountable owner, engage responders, and track incidents through resolution and service restoration. * Maintain documented ownership and escalation paths across applications, hardware, infrastructure, and vendors. * Coordinate technical response with the Lead of Internal Business Systems, Principal Sr. Engineer of Product \& Connected Systems, infrastructure teams, application owners, and third\-party vendors. * During major incidents, maintain a clear record of impact, actions, owners, and decisions; provide timely stakeholder updates and escalate unresolved risks. * Lead post\-incident reviews, identify recurring problems, and track corrective actions with the teams responsible for technical fixes. **AI Agents, Automation \& Employee Self\-Service** * Analyze ticket trends and repetitive workflows; prioritize improvements based on employee impact, expected time savings, effort, and reliability. * Build and maintain AI support agents that use approved internal documentation to answer questions, guide troubleshooting, and hand unresolved issues to support staff with useful context. * Design, configure, script, test, implement, and troubleshoot production automations using tools such as Power Automate, PowerShell, APIs, and comparable platforms. * Automate practical support activities such as ticket classification and routing, incident notifications, routine troubleshooting, approved software requests, and onboarding and offboarding steps. * Create and maintain clear self\-help guides, troubleshooting instructions, and a searchable knowledge base that support both employees and AI agents. * Partner with IT AI \& Automation Engineering on architecture, integrations, access controls, and deployment standards; directly implement and maintain agreed solutions within those standards. * Validate AI answers and automated actions before release and during ongoing use. Include appropriate permissions, human approvals, escalation paths, monitoring, exception handling, and recovery procedures. * Document solution ownership and maintenance requirements; train support staff and employees, gather feedback, and improve adoption. * Measure ticket reduction, self\-service resolution, time saved, response accuracy, and automation reliability; report results and improvement priorities to the Director of IT. **Requirements** * 3\-5 years of progressively responsible IT support, help desk, service operations, or incident management experience, including leadership or senior\-level responsibilities. * An associate degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience. * Strong troubleshooting across Microsoft 365, endpoint devices, servers, virtualization, and networking; experience with infrastructure such as VMware, Fortinet, switches, and VLANs. * Demonstrated understanding of incident management, escalation procedures, SLAs, service reporting, and coordination across multiple technical teams and application owners. * Demonstrated experience delivering working AI\-enabled support solutions and workflow automations, with specific examples of what you built, how it was deployed, and the results achieved. * Proficiency with Power Automate, PowerShell, APIs, or comparable tools, including design, configuration, testing, implementation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of production solutions. * Experience building AI assistants or agents grounded in internal knowledge, with appropriate permissions, evaluation of answer quality, and escalation to a person when needed. * Strong organizational, communication, documentation, and problem\-solving skills; ability to turn technical issues into clear employee guidance. * Ability to balance day\-to\-day support and incident response with planned improvements, and exercise sound judgment about automation and human review. **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with CRM, ERP, and contact center environments, ideally including Salesforce, NetSuite, and Five9\. * Experience with Copilot Studio or comparable AI agent platforms, help desk integrations, identity systems, device management, and automated provisioning. * Understanding of ITIL incident and problem management practices. * Experience measuring automation benefits and improving self\-service adoption through training and employee feedback. **Benefits** * **Compensation:** Starting at $30/HR, with some flexibility for candidates whose experience and qualifications closely align with the role. * Competitive Paid Time Off Policy \+ Paid Holidays \+ Floating Holiday * Fully Equipped Fitness Center On\-Site * Lunch Program featuring a James\-Beard Award Winning Chef * Health (HSA \& FSA Options), Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401(k) with company contributions * Profit Sharing * Life and Short\-Term Disability Insurance * Professional Development and Tuition Reimbursement * Associate Discounts on Saunas, Spa Products and Day Spa Services Sunlighten provides equal employment opportunity. Discrimination of any type will not be tolerated. Sunlighten is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Hub \- San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Engineering, Product, Design, and MarketingEngineering **Compensation** ---------------- $227K – $284K • Offers Equity *Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role, requiring 3 days per week in our SF Hub. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in\-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.* **About Superhuman** -------------------- Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer who takes real ownership and does well in a fast\-moving, ambitious, and problem\-oriented environment. You’ll work hands\-on with improving our LLMs, and using them to solve for high\-impact product opportunities. You’ll own part of the direction of our AI work: framing the right problems, finding their most effective solution, and helping shape the roadmap. This role is a bit of a hybrid of machine learning/engineering with product. It would suit someone already in an AI Engineering role, as well as software engineers or data scientists that have gone deep into shaping models (themselves) to propel them forward. What you’ll do * Lead entire AI/ML initiatives from problem definition through delivery. * Influence technical direction and roadmap decisions by framing problems clearly and backing choices with evidence. * Partner with product, engineering, and design to deliver high\-impact models. * Strengthen our ML practices and infrastructure, including evals, training pipelines, and model serving. * Mentor teammates and share knowledge to raise the bar across the team. By 30 days, you will have: * Upgraded an existing feature to be meaningfully smarter and/or faster, and shared what you learned with the team. * Reviewed our evaluation approach and improved or built evals for our core features. * Found the highest\-leverage opportunities in our AI stack and started shaping priorities with the team. By 90 days, you will have: * Led the delivery of AI features that address valuable customer use cases. * Fine\-tuned models for our specific needs and set repeatable practices others can build on. * Developed new processes to speed up how we utilize new AI models. **Qualifications** ------------------ * A track record of owning and shipping production AI/ML systems end\-to\-end, with the independence and judgment expected of a senior engineer. * A blend of modern LLM expertise and structured problem\-solving. You can work backward from a user problem, frame the right technical question, and define how to evaluate success. That structured problem\-solving might come from product engineering, technical consulting, or comparable experience. * Deep hands\-on experience in LLM post\-training and/or inference optimization, with evidence of exceptional results in a specific problem area. For example: + Building a model that outperforms strong alternatives on a specialized task through thoughtful dataset development, supervised fine\-tuning, preference tuning, or reinforcement learning. * Making LLMs substantially faster or more efficient through tailored quantization, speculative decoding, or other inference techniques.The ability to go beyond established recipes: diagnosing failure modes, designing experiments, and adapting methods to the problem at hand.Strong evaluation judgment. You design evals grounded in user needs, distinguish meaningful improvements from benchmark gains, and establish practices that catch regressions before users do. * Experience serving and optimizing models at scale, with a practical understanding of the trade\-offs between latency, throughput, uptime, and cost. * Strong production Python and fluency with data, including building and cleaning datasets, analyzing results in Python or SQL, and working comfortably with modern training and serving stacks. * Experience influencing technical direction and helping other engineers succeed through clear reasoning, collaboration, and mentoring. Nice to have * Experience spanning both LLM post\-training and inference optimization. * Successful application of preference tuning or reinforcement learning to improve real\-world model performance. * Speech or long\-context experience, especially with noisy, lengthy transcripts. * Experience establishing ML infrastructure, evaluation practices, or model development workflows at a startup or growth\-stage company. How you work * Ownership: You take ambiguous problems and drive them to clear outcomes without waiting for perfect specs. * High standards: You care about quality and detail, you’re tenacious, and you raise the bar for everyone around you. * Pragmatic and results\-driven: You pick the right hills to climb and find the fastest way up. * A generalist who dives deep: You might work on data one day and training methods or infrastructure the next. * Clear communicator: You explain technical results and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non\-technical partners. * Multiplier: You make the people around you better through mentorship, reviews, and knowledge\-sharing. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more: * Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits) * Disability and life insurance options * 401(k) and RRSP matching * Paid parental leave * 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time * Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more) * Annual professional development budget and opportunities Superhuman takes a market\-based approach to compensation, so base pay may vary by location. For more information about our compensation zones and locations where we currently support employment, please refer to this page. If a location of interest is not listed, please speak with a recruiter for additional information. Base pay may vary considerably depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined by compensation zone and may be modified in the future. **We encourage you to apply** ----------------------------- At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: SLDS Data Engineer
jobs.description: Dear Candidate Please find the below requirement **SLDS Data Engineer** Rate : ALAP Location: Denver, Colorado 80203 Fulltime\- Direct Client Rate $70 to $80 as per the exp **Candidate must be within 100 miles** **Work Arrangement: Remote / Telecommuting** **(Candidate must reside within the State of Colorado; strong preference for local / Denver Metro candidates)** Preferred Skills \& Experience * Prior experience working with public sector, longitudinal education, and workforce data systems (e.g., CDE, CDHE, CDLE, CDEC, National Student Clearinghouse). * Experience with record linkage, entity resolution, and deterministic/probabilistic identity matching across disparate public records * Familiarity with federal and state student/workforce privacy regulations, including FERPA, COPPA, and cell suppression standards * Experience authoring and executing structured test plans in Azure Test Plans * Work Arrangement: Remote / Telecommuting (Candidate must reside within the State of Colorado; strong preference for local / Denver Metro candidates) The Data Engineer is responsible for realizing the vision of the Data Architect through the technical implementation of data pipelines using Snowflake and Informatica. Data Engineers are technical coding experts focused on moving data from line\-of\-business, transactional, or partner agency source systems into analytical data platforms, building transformations, managing data cleansing and quality, and presenting structured data for consumption by analysts and scientists. In the context of the Statewide Longitudinal Data System (SLDS / COdata) an OIT Data Engineer is expected to join the project team in January 2027 under a shared delivery model with a 3rd party implementor. The OIT Data Engineer will participate in a structured knowledge\-transfer progression (shadowing, co\-running, and checking), leading specific new source ingestions, and progressively will take over production operations and upkeep of the SLDS data foundation and analytics layer. 1\. Scope of Responsibilities * Data Ingestion \& Pipeline Engineering: Design, develop, test, and deploy automated ETL/data pipelines in Informatica and Snowflake to ingest data from partner state agencies and third parties into the SLDS common data model. * Transformation \& Analytics Layer Support: Implement transformation logic to convert raw agency feeds into harmonized, linked longitudinal records and analytics layer data models, adhering to core naming and modeling standards established with the Data Architect. * Record Linkage \& Identity Matching: Execute the SLDS internal matching logic to link newly ingested agency records to master longitudinal student and workforce profiles, handling match exceptions and cross\-agency reconciliations. * Production Pipeline Operations \& Incident Response: Maintain operational ownership of scheduled feed runs, monitoring job execution, resolving run failures, reloading late or corrected files, reconciling row counts, and rebuilding downstream objects. * Data Quality \& Governance Compliance: Implement L1 (structural/format), L2 (completeness/de\-duplication), and L3 (referential integrity/logic) validation checks, layout\-change detection, and audit trails; enforce data privacy, suppression rules, and compliance standards (FERPA, COPPA, ADA, and state statutes). * Performance Optimization \& Platform Stewardship: Optimize query execution, warehouse compute, and pipeline performance for cost and latency; identify and tune heavily used models and performance hot spots in Snowflake. * Quality Assurance, Code Review \& Promotion: Adhere to the unified release process across Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments using Azure DevOps and Azure Test Plans; author and execute test cases, conduct peer code reviews, and maintain release change logs. 2\. Activities Performed A. Ingestion \& Pipeline Development (OIT\-Led Feeds) * CDHE Courses Data Ingestion: o Ingest and validate annual postsecondary course\-level data files from CDHE per data sharing agreements. o Build ETL mapping processes from CDHE course files into the SLDS common data model based on design specifications provided by 3rd party implementation partner. o Pair with 3 party implementation team during ETL construction, validation, and promotion. * Postsecondary SES \& Disability Data Ingestion (Conditional): o Ingest and validate demographic, Pell Grant eligibility, and disability classification codes from postsecondary sources. o Apply mandated privacy protections, cell suppression rules, and permissible\-use governance requirements. * PSAT/SAT Assessment Data Ingestion (Conditional): o Ingest, validate, and map section/composite assessment scores and grade levels from the College Board or CDE. o Execute identity matching to connect assessment records to existing longitudinal student profiles. B. Knowledge Transfer \& Operational Transition (Jan–April 2027\) * Shadowing \& Co\-running (Jan–Feb 2027\): o Shado 4\. Analytics Layer Transformation Objects: Production views, tables, and metric models in Snowflake aligned with longitudinal reporting use cases . 5\. De\-Identified Data Extraction Scripts: Data extraction scripts that generate de\-identified, suppressed outcome files for participating IHEs per specification. Documentation \& Engineering Specifications 6\. ETL Pipeline Design Documents: Technical architecture and transformation specifications detailing source\-to\-target logic, schemas, and dependencies. 7\. Mapping \& Transformation Specifications: Contribution to enterprise data mapping documents aligning source fields to the SLDS common data model. 8\. Lineage Documentation \& Dependency Maps: As\-built data lineage records and dependency diagrams detailing object\-level upstream and downstream flows. 9\. Operational Runbooks \& Incident Procedures: Standard operating procedures for running feed cycles, handling late or malformed files, performing failover, and reconciling row counts. Governance, Testing \& Operational Reporting 10\. Azure Test Plans \& Execution Records: Fully documented test plans, test suites, manual test run results, and defect logs for all pipeline modifications prior to production promotion . 11\. Release Change Logs: Detailed audit entries for all OIT\-led production releases, detailing changes, rationales, linked Azure DevOps work items, test results, and deployment timestamps]. 12\. Feed Operation Run Logs \& Match Summaries: Run completion records, reconciliation totals, exception logs, and data\-quality summaries produced for agency loads. Required Qualifications \& Technical Experience * Snowflake ETL/ELT: Minimum 5 years of demonstrated experience building, orchestrating, and optimizing complex ETL/ELT data pipelines and transformation logic natively within the Snowflake platform. * Informatica CDGC: Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience working with Informatica Cloud Data Governance and Catalog (CDGC) for metadata management, data profiling, cataloging, and automated data quality validation. * Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing Terraform to provision, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure and resources. * CI/CD \& DevOps: Demonstrated proficiency implementing automated build, test, and release deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps. * Version Control: Expert proficiency with Git / version control workflows (branching strategies, pull requests, automated merge checks, code reviews). * Location Constraint: Must currently reside within the State of Colorado for the duration of the engagement. Preferred Skills \& Experience * Prior experience working with public sector, longitudinal education, and workforce data systems (e.g., CDE, CDHE, CDLE, CDEC, National Student Clearinghouse). * Experience with record linkage, entity resolution, and deterministic/probabilistic identity matching across disparate public records * Familiarity with federal and state student/workforce privacy regulations, including FERPA, COPPA, and cell suppression standards * Experience authoring and executing structured test plans in Azure Test Plans * Work Arrangement: Remote / Telecommuting (Candidate must reside within the State of Colorado; strong preference for local / Denver Metro candidates) Thanks Please do share your profile to Amyjohns at thinkdevelopment.com Pay: $87,200\.00 \- $106,000\.00 per year Application Question(s): * what is your Prior experience working with public sector, longitudinal education, and workforce data systems (e.g., CDE, CDHE, CDLE, CDEC, National Student Clearinghouse). 2\. what is your Experience with record linkage, entity resolution, and deterministic/probabilistic identity matching across disparate public records 3\.Familiarity with federal and state student/workforce privacy regulations, including FERPA, COPPA, and cell suppression standards 4\.Location: Location: * Denver, CO 80203 (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Denver, CO 80203

Responsibilities: * Facilitate daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews and retrospectives for your assigned teams. * Line up sprint and PI plans across teams that depend on each other, so that dependencies are planned, not discovered. * Back up the other Scrum Master during leave and PI Planning. * Position 2 (Agile Operations): support teams in more than one sub\-product line at a time when assigned, learn each backlog and cadence quickly, and hand teams back cleanly when an assignment ends. * Prepare the team for quarterly PI Planning: capacity, draft features, dependencies and risks. Professional Scrum Master (PSM I) is accepted as equivalent. **Preferred certifications:*** SAFe Advanced Scrum Master (SASM) * SAFe Agilist (SA) or SAFe Practitioner (SP) * ICAgile Certified Professional in Agile Coaching (ICP\-ACC) * PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI\-ACP) **Education:** -------------- * Bachelor's degree in information technology, business, engineering, computer science or a related field. jobs.title: Applied AI Architect
jobs.description: ### **About the role** Talkdesk partners sell and design Customer Experience Automation (CXA) solutions. This role makes sure they can deliver them. As the Applied AI Architect for EMEA, you are the design authority for partner\-led paid pilots and production deployments of AI agents on the Talkdesk platform across the region. You set the architecture, define what success looks like, and review the work at each gate. Where a use case or product area is new, you build it hands\-on, then hand it to the partner. Your measure of success is a pilot that proves its value, reaches production, and leaves the partner able to deliver the next one alone. This is a post\-sales role on a new team. You will be the first senior Partner Delivery lead in EMEA, so you will work with a high degree of autonomy and help shape how Talkdesk works with partners on delivery. ### **What you'll do** **Lead paid pilots** * Scope each pilot with the partner and customer: use cases, success criteria, evaluation plan and the exit criteria for production. * Design the agent architecture: multi\-agent orchestration, knowledge and retrieval, tools and integrations, guardrails and human handoff. * Account for data residency, GDPR and EU AI Act requirements in every design. * Build the hard parts hands\-on when the pattern is new, then transfer the work to the partner team. * Report results against the success criteria and give a clear go or no\-go recommendation for production. **Guide delivery to production** * Run design reviews at discovery and pre\-go\-live gates across about 10 active partner projects, working hands\-on in two or three at a time. * Review partner configurations, test results and evaluation results before go\-live. * Act as the regional technical escalation point. Resolve what you can, and route the rest to Voice Engineering, Product and Engineering, or Professional Services. * Recognize when a project has outgrown partner\-led scope and move it to Talkdesk delivery teams under agreed rules of engagement. **Make partners self\-sufficient** * Launch the partner certification program in EMEA, certify partner architects, and run onsite and virtual workshops. * Build reference architectures, design patterns and delivery playbooks from what works in the field. * Work closely with the EMEA Partner Solutions Engineering team so partners get a consistent handover from pre\-sales to delivery. * Bring recurring patterns and product gaps back to Product and Engineering. * Support partners in other regions, such as APAC, when needed. ### **What you bring** * 8\+ years in solution architecture, professional services or technical delivery for CCaaS or customer experience platforms, including leading enterprise implementations to go\-live. * 2\+ years designing and shipping LLM\-based or agentic solutions in production: prompt design, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool calling, guardrails and evaluations. * Hands\-on skills. You read and write code in Python or TypeScript and work comfortably with REST APIs, webhooks and OAuth. * Contact center depth: routing, IVR, omnichannel, telephony basics, and integration with CRM, workforce management and knowledge systems such as Salesforce, ServiceNow and Microsoft Dynamics. * A record of running pilots or proofs of concept against measurable success criteria and converting them to production. * Experience working through partners across several European markets, such as telcos, system integrators, VARs, resellers and BPOs, and a preference for coaching over doing the work yourself. * Working knowledge of European data protection and AI regulation as it applies to customer\-facing AI. * Clear communication with both executives and engineers, in writing and at a whiteboard. * Professional fluency in English. German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Portuguese is a strong plus. * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. ### **Nice to have** * Experience with Talkdesk products (Studio, Navigator, Autopilot, Copilot, Knowledge Management, Multi\-Agent) or with another enterprise CCaaS or conversational AI platform. * Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent frameworks, and evaluation or observability tooling. * Delivery experience in regulated industries, especially financial services and insurance. * Experience building a certification or enablement program, or being the first hire of a function in a region. ### **Travel** Up to 30% across EMEA, for partner workshops, pilot kickoffs and go\-lives. **Pay Range (OTE):** $220,000 \- $330,000 **Other Types of Pay**: Based on level and role the employee may be eligible for long term incentives in the form of equity and short term incentives of either bonus or commission. **Health Insurance**: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP). **Retirement Benefits**: 401(k) plan **Paid Time Off**: Talkdesk offers an uncapped paid time off program for exempt employees and an accrual\-based program for non\-exempt employees; both are subject to manager approval and consistent with business needs. **Paid Holidays**: Talkdesk offers 14 paid holidays each year. **Paid Sick Leave**: Exempt employees have uncapped paid time off and non\-exempt sick leave follows accrual standards; both are subject to manager approval and consistent with business needs. **Method of Application**: Apply online. **Application Window**: The application window is expected to close at least 5 days from the posting date. jobs.title: Digitization Engineer II
jobs.description: *When Alfred Fain founded a small Rhode Island tire store in 1924, at the time no one could have predicted how Teknor Apex would become an international custom compounder sought out by companies around the world. After a nearly hundred\-year journey that’s carried us through acquisitions and expansion, we now have nine U.S. locations, as well as operations in Belgium, Singapore, Germany, and China.* *Throughout this global expansion Teknor has remained a privately held company, and today Fain’s grandson sits at the helm, maintaining the family’s tradition of fostering deep employee and customer relationships. These relationships are what allow us—together—to deliver customized compound solutions and help our customer’s create better products.* *“Manufacturing is a team sport and we work together to achieve our goals.” \~Jon Fain* **Join the team behind our custom compounds.** The Digitization Engineer II utilizes agentic AI development as a core software engineering capability, leveraging AI agents to design, generate, test, refactor, and document software solutions. The engineer is responsible for validating AI\-generated outputs, ensuring code quality, maintainability, cybersecurity, and alignment with enterprise software standards. As we transition to Agentic AI development the Digitization Engineer II still needs to be an experienced software engineer responsible for independently designing, developing, implementing, and supporting software solutions that improve manufacturing operations and business processes. This role owns technical projects from concept through deployment while partnering directly with manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, and business stakeholders. The Engineer II serves as a technical contributor capable of leading medium\-sized projects while mentoring junior engineers and contributing to architecture discussions. **Responsibilities** * Design and implement software solutions utilizing agentic AI development workflows. * Build reusable AI\-assisted development patterns, prompt libraries, and engineering accelerators. * Validate, optimize, and refactor AI\-generated code to meet enterprise quality, security, and performance expectations. * Mentor junior engineers in effective AI\-assisted software development techniques. * Evaluate new AI coding platforms and recommend adoption strategies for the Digital Management team. * Develop AI\-enabled software solutions that improve manufacturing productivity, reliability, quality, and operational decision\-making. * Independently design, develop, deploy, and support enterprise manufacturing applications. * Lead software development efforts for assigned projects. * Design APIs, databases, and system integrations. * Develop web, cloud, mobile, and desktop applications. * Partner directly with business stakeholders to define software requirements. * Develop dashboards, reporting solutions, and analytics platforms. * Integrate ERP, MES, Quality, SCADA, and manufacturing systems. * Participate in architecture reviews and technical planning. * Conduct code reviews. * Mentor Manufacturing Solutions Engineer I team members. * Improve application performance and maintainability. * Participate in source control, versioning, deployment, and release management. * Support cybersecurity and secure software development practices. * Evaluate emerging technologies. * Travel to manufacturing sites to support deployments and continuous improvement initiatives. **Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent * 3–6 years software development experience * Strong proficiency in C\#, .NET, Python, JavaScript or similar languages * SQL, REST APIs, Azure/AWS * Manufacturing systems experience preferred * Experience with Ignition, MES, ERP integration preferred * Lean Six Sigma Black Belt Certified or will commit to training and certification within 12 months of hire date. **Physical Requirements** * Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA, FMLA and other federal, state and local standards, including meeting qualitative and/or quantitative productivity standards. * Must be able to lift and carry up to 15 lbs. * Must be able to talk, listen and speak clearly on telephone. * Ability to perform duties under specific time requirements. This description is a summary of principal responsibilities and is not intended to include all duties that may be assigned. ***Teknor Apex is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any protected status under state or federal laws. Must be 18 years of age or older to work at Teknor Apex.*** Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description: **Role Summary** ---------------- We have an opening to hire a **Staff Software Engineer \- Agent Optimization** Temporal provides a reliable foundation powering AI leaders such as OpenAI, NVIDIA, Cursor, Lovable, and others.
