Most of Temporal’s work is open source—see for yourself here: https://github.com/temporalio \[new window] **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design and build agentic systems * Work with customers to understand and advance the state of the art in agentic coding * Develop a deep understanding of AI application development patterns and techniques, including emerging approaches and architectures. * Take end\-to\-end ownership of new features, working with other teams to deliver exceptional reliability and a great developer experience. * Work with multiple programming languages: Python and TypeScript, Java, Go. * Serve as a domain expert on AI design patterns, collaborating with field staff to provide best\-practices and canonical examples. * Work directly with our developer community to debug issues that need expert attention and get feedback on Temporal features and APIs. * Write public technical documentation describing Temporal concepts and APIs. * Go the extra mile to support a customer in need, on the rare occasion that our teams’ engineering expertise is needed. * Travel to meet your coworkers for a week once or twice a year. * Attend the occasional developer conference to talk about how great Temporal is (optional). **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * 8\+ years of professional work experience. * Proven experience in optimizing AI systems using both machine learning and systems techniques * Experience and passion for harnessing generative AI, particularly for agents and coding. * A deep appreciation for how to use AI to improve quality, not only to increase quantity. * A sense of taste in code and software development practice. Your approach should be opinionated and thoughtful, but not dogmatic. * Fluency in multiple programming languages, and an affinity for learning new ones. * Deep experience with concurrent programming—you should know how to use mutexes, atomics, and other concurrency primitives safely. * Experience designing APIs and writing documentation for publicly\-available libraries or modules. * Strong technical communication skills—written and verbal—in English. * BS or MS in Computer Science (or a closely\-related degree), or equivalent work experience writing production\-grade software. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Familiarity with Temporal’s programming model (e.g. you’ve written an app on Temporal). * A track record of open source software contributions, including contributions to 3rd party libraries. * Experience contributing to the architecture and design of large\-scale distributed systems. * Deep background in machine learning, model training, data science, or machine learning systems. * Graduate degree in Computer Science. jobs.title: Sr. Platform Engineer
jobs.description: The Sr. Platform Engineer is a senior, hands\-on engineer on the Platform Engineering team, the consolidated cloud and DevOps team that gives Baldwin's application teams what they need to build, ship, and run software. This role carries a defined technical leadership track. Beyond delivering complex platform work, the Sr. Platform Engineer leads workstreams end to end, mentors other engineers, owns day\-to\-day intake and triage, coordinates incident response, and deputizes for the Manager, Platform Engineering in technical matters. The role has no direct reports. Perform other duties as assigned to support the team and the firm. * **Required Education, Experience, Skills and Abilities:** --------------------------------------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * \[5\+] years of experience in cloud, infrastructure, platform, or DevOps engineering. * Strong, hands\-on experience with AWS, including multi\-account environments, networking, IAM, and core compute, storage, and serverless services. * Working knowledge of Azure and Microsoft Entra ID. * Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or the ability to ramp up on it quickly. * Advanced Terraform skills, including reusable module design and CI/CD\-driven execution. * Strong experience with GitHub and GitHub Actions for source control and CI/CD. * Experience with containerized and serverless workloads on AWS, such as ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, and Step Functions. * Experience with Datadog or a comparable observability platform. * Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, TypeScript, or PowerShell. * Practical, hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted coding and agentic tools in engineering work. * Demonstrated experience leading a technical workstream or mentoring other engineers, formally or informally. * Familiarity with change management and control requirements in a regulated environment. * Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across teams and explain technical trade\-offs. * Strong troubleshooting skills and sound judgment under pressure. Demonstrates the organization's core values, exuding behavior that is aligned with the firm's culture. * **Preferred Education, Experience, Skills and Abilities:** ---------------------------------------------------------- * AWS Associate\- or Professional\-level certification. HashiCorp Terraform, Azure, or Google Cloud certification is a plus. * Experience building internal developer platforms or self\-service infrastructure. Experience in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry. * **Special Working Conditions:** ------------------------------- May require occasional after hours attention or participation in an on\-call rotation. * **Important Notice:** --------------------- This position description is intended to describe the level of work required of the person performing in the role and is not a contract. jobs.title: Research Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Department** BSD PED \- Quackenbush Lab **About the Department** In the Department of Pediatrics at the University of Chicago, we strive to provide the highest level of complex care for children. From diagnosis and treatment, to conducting research, to finding promising new therapies with a focus on teaching. We are committed to advancing the frontiers of knowledge, and the education and training of future clinical pediatricians, subspecialists, educators, clinical investigators, physician\-scientists and researchers. The Department of Pediatrics is a dynamic, stimulating place to work, and because we are focused on growth and improved excellence, our staff have particularly challenging and rewarding roles. The Laboratory for Network Medicine and Complex Systems, led by John Quackenbush in the Department of Pediatrics at the University of Chicago, is seeking an outstanding Research Software Engineer to help build the next generation of open\-source software for computational systems biology. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, network science, and biomedical research. The successful candidate will play a central role in modernizing and expanding the NetZoo software ecosystem—one of the world’s leading open\-source platforms for gene regulatory network analysis—and in developing intelligent software systems that fundamentally change how scientific software is created, maintained, and used. **Job Summary** We are undertaking a major redesign of the NetZoo software ecosystem that will make our tools more robust and sustainable. The successful candidate will lead software engineering efforts that include: Refactoring the NetZoo codebase into a modular, extensible, and maintainable software architecture. Designing and implementing modern software engineering practices across the entire project. Developing the next generation of NetBooks, an interactive educational and analytical environment that combines executable tutorials, reproducible workflows, and best practices for computational biology. Building AI\-assisted and agentic software systems that automate testing, documentation, software maintenance, code review, dependency management, issue triage, and developer support. Developing intelligent agents that help scientists construct, execute, and interpret complex network analyses. Building scalable cloud\-native and high\-performance computing workflows for large biological datasets. Working closely with computational biologists to translate cutting\-edge algorithms into robust, production\-quality software. The position provides substantial opportunity for innovation. We are particularly interested in exploring how large language models, autonomous software agents, and modern AI development tools can improve both scientific software engineering and the user experience for computational biology. Our Philosophy We believe that scientific software should be engineered with the same rigor as the science it enables. The Laboratory for Network Medicine and Complex Systems is deeply committed to: Open\-source software development Reproducible computational research Transparent scientific workflows Modern software engineering practices Comprehensive testing and continuous integration Community engagement and long\-term software sustainability All software developed by the laboratory is intended to become a lasting resource for the scientific community. We value clean architecture, thoughtful design, careful documentation, reproducibility, and maintainability as essential components of scientific excellence. Equally important is our collaborative culture. We function as an integrated research team in which software engineers, computational biologists, statisticians, postdoctoral fellows, students, and faculty work closely together. Every member of the laboratory is expected to contribute to a shared scientific mission by participating in collaborative software design, code reviews, scientific discussions, manuscript preparation, mentoring, and the continuous improvement of our research ecosystem. What We Offer This position provides the opportunity to help shape software used by researchers around the world. The successful candidate will contribute to a rapidly growing open\-source ecosystem that supports investigations into cancer, aging, neuroscience, immunology, and many other areas of biomedical research. Research software engineers are valued as intellectual partners in our scientific mission. Depending on interests and qualifications, opportunities include: Co\-authorship on methodological and biological publications Leadership of major software initiatives Presentation of software at scientific conferences and developer meetings Collaboration with an international network of computational scientists Participation in grant development and long\-term software strategy Professional development in scientific software engineering  s. * Machine learning or artificial intelligence. * Large language models and agentic AI systems. * Cloud computing and containerized workflows. * Nextflow, Snakemake, or workflow management systems. * High\-performance computing. * Computational biology or bioinformatics. * REST APIs and web application development. * Interactive visualization. * Documentation systems and developer tooling. * Pays close attention to detail in code, documentation, and data handling. * Communicates clearly, both in writing and verbally, with technical and non technical audiences. * Works effectively with faculty, researchers, and trainees, and translates scientific needs into technical requirements. * Works collaboratively as part of a team, giving and receiving constructive feedback during code and design reviews. * Manages multiple tasks and priorities and meets deadlines with a moderate level of guidance. * Takes initiative to identify problems and propose solutions. * Learns new tools, methods, and scientific concepts quickly. * Documents work so that others can understand, reproduce, and maintain it. **Working Conditions** * Hybrid work arrangement at the Knapp Center for Biomedical Discovery. * Office environment with extended periods of computer work. * Occasional evening or weekend hours may be needed to meet project deadlines. * No direct patient contact. **Application Documents** * Resume (required) * Cover Letter (required) The University of Chicago uses AI\-assisted tools to streamline and augment some recruitment processes; jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data & AI Tools
jobs.description: **About Tires\-Easy** Every day, Tires\-Easy ships more than 10,000 tires across the United States, changing how people shop for tires and reshaping the $60B replacement tire market through a faster, smarter approach to automotive e\-commerce. We pair deep coverage of top\-name and budget\-friendly brands with a nationwide drop\-ship network, and we use technology, automation, and AI to make every step faster and easier for our customers. Our leadership team comes from outside traditional tire retail, and it shows. We operate in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment with a strong emphasis on operational excellence, accountability, and disciplined growth. Decisions take days, not quarters. We’re building a team that owns results, sees its impact quickly, and drives execution at scale. If you’re curious, action\-oriented, and ready to help build a fast\-growing business, apply now. **About the role** ------------------ Build the software that connects Tires Easy’s existing data sources to employees and AI assistants. You'll own the semantic layer, supporting services, and internal tools that help teams answer business questions, build reports, and automate recurring work. You'll also define and roll out our internal knowledge platform, exploring document retrieval, enterprise search, and knowledge graphs to determine what best serves users. You'll shape the roadmap with business owners and see your work used across the company. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll report to the VP of Technology, who leads Data, AI, Infrastructure, and IT. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own the semantic software layer: data models, measures, caching, and the implementation of agreed business metrics * Define metrics with business owners, obtain their approval, and reconcile implementations against source systems and existing reports * Build regression tests that detect unintended changes to metric logic using controlled test data and approved expectations * Build and operate services, APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect users and AI assistants to approved data, with authentication, access controls, and performance monitoring * Build AI skills and agent workflows that automate recurring business processes, with evaluations and appropriate human review * Connect existing warehouse and business\-system data to end users through the semantic layer and application services; partner with infrastructure and data engineers who deliver the underlying data * Write and optimize SQL for data consumption, and collaborate with data engineers on the models your services need * Train and support users, document workflows, and use feedback and adoption data to prioritize improvements * Evaluate, build, and roll out knowledge retrieval and search capabilities, preserving source permissions and measuring answer quality * Use coding agents throughout delivery while maintaining engineering standards for architecture, testing, security, code review, and production support **What success looks like in the first six months** --------------------------------------------------- * Deliver an agreed set of business metrics with owner\-approved definitions, reconciled results, and automated regression tests * Roll out a priority AI workflow that business teams adopt, and measure its effect on recurring manual work * Evaluate knowledge\-platform approaches and launch an initial capability with permission\-aware retrieval and documented quality checks **Eligibility requirements** ---------------------------- * At least 50% overlap with Pacific Time working hours * Available for occasional after\-hours support for production incidents * Fluent in speaking, reading, and writing English * Reliable high\-speed internet access for remote work **Skills \& experience** ------------------------ * Substantial professional software engineering experience, typically 7\+ years, including delivery of data products or internal tools used by business teams * 5\+ years of Python experience * 5\+ years of deploying applications on AWS * Strong agentic coding skills: break problems into tasks, guide coding agents, review changes, diagnose failures, and verify production behavior. We value demonstrated delivery and judgment over expertise in a particular language * Strong SQL and relational data modeling skills, with the ability to investigate query performance and reconcile results * Experience translating business definitions into reusable data models and tested metrics; semantic\-layer experience is valuable * Strong software engineering fundamentals: service and API design, debugging, testing, and the ability to work across languages and unfamiliar codebases * Hands\-on experience building LLM applications with tool use and structured data access, and evaluating their reliability and output quality * Testing discipline across software and data, including automated regression tests in CI * Able to work directly with business leaders, turn ambiguous questions into precise definitions, and explain results clearly * Independent and self\-motivated, with the ability to take a tool from an unclear need through rollout and ongoing support * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience **Nice to have** ---------------- * Semantic platforms such as Cube, dbt Semantic Layer, or LookML, and Power BI data models or DAX * Retrieval\-augmented generation, enterprise search, knowledge graphs, or knowledge\-base systems * Docker and AWS * E\-commerce, retail, supply chain, or pricing background **The pay range for this role is:** 150,000 \- 200,000 USD per year(El Segundo, CA)

jobs.description: ### **Build Innovative Technology. Make an Impact. We're looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys tackling technical challenges, and wants to contribute to the success of the entire team. **Bring your ideas. Build your expertise. Create what's next.** ### **Apply Today!** Take the next step in your engineering career and explore what you can accomplish with TouchTronics, Inc. *TouchTronics, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

jobs.description: **Shape the Future with TribalScale** ===================================== TribalScale is a digital innovation firm that helps organizations adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing world. We partner with clients to build transformative digital products, modernize technology platforms, and apply emerging technologies—including artificial intelligence—to meaningful business challenges. Our teams work closely with clients from strategy through execution. We value curiosity, ownership, practical innovation, and people who are comfortable turning ambiguity into action. **Our Digital Expertise** * **Transformation Experts:** We transform traditional business models into agile, AI\-powered ecosystems. * **Strategic Visionaries:** We navigate the uncharted waters of technological evolution. * **Product Virtuosos:** We orchestrate the creation of world\-class digital solutions. * **Code Optimizers:** We leverage AI to refine and perfect digital systems. **Our Technological Toolkit** * **Mobile \& Web Development:** (iOS, Android, React Native, React, Node.js) * **Voice\-Activated Platforms:** (Amazon Alexa, Google Home) * **Connected Ecosystems:** (Cars and Homes) * **Streaming Platforms:** (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, tvOS) **The TribalScale Professional** You thrive in challenging environments where innovation is key. Your passion for technology is matched only by your drive to redefine its limits. You seek more than a job; you seek a calling—a chance to make a lasting impact on the digital landscape. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We are looking for a talented and driven developer to join a client of TribalScale's team and build the shared, cloud native agent infrastructure on AWS that our AI\-assisted modeling pipeline and our internal AI\-enabled development workflow run on. A client of TribalScale, builds virtual Arm devices: phones, IoT boards and automotive controllers that run real, unmodified firmware on a client of TribalScale's CHARM hypervisor. Atlas is our product for virtual IoT, automotive and embedded hardware. Today each new device model takes a team of modeling engineers weeks of reading reference manuals and hand\-writing peripheral models. We are building an AI\-assisted modeling pipeline that collects vendor documentation, extracts per\-peripheral specifications, generates register and system definitions, synthesizes behavioral C code, and validates the result by booting vendor firmware. We use it on our own bring\-ups first, then hand it to Atlas partners so they can build and validate their own models. This role sits on our AI \& SDLC Platform team, which supplies agent infrastructure and AI platform support to the delivery teams. Model Delivery owns the modeling backlog and its outcomes. You own the substrate that pipeline runs on: job orchestration, multi\-model inference, evaluation hooks, observability and secure deployment. Your work takes the pipeline from an engineer\-run prototype to a reliable, measured service. You apply the same infrastructure to replace parts of our internal software development process with AI\-enabled workflows. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design and implement orchestration for long\-running agent pipelines on AWS: job orchestration, artifact and manifest generation, checkpointing, retries, and prompt and model versioning. * Run multi\-model inference across Amazon Bedrock and self\-hosted models, with routing, an independent judge model, semantic caching and token\-cost and latency controls. * Provide shared evaluation and tracing hooks so Model Delivery can measure each pipeline stage and compare models, prompts and pipeline versions. * Build and operate the internal AI gateway, agent runtime and tool integrations that engineers use in the AI enabled SDLC: code review, ticket\-to\-merge\-request workflows and knowledge retrieval. * Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK) with secure secrets management and least\-privilege access. * Instrument agents and pipelines (success rate, cost, latency, failure modes) and maintain dashboards, alerts and runbooks. * Work with the product teams that own customer\-facing MCP and API surfaces so internal agent tools and product interfaces stay consistent. **What You Bring** ------------------ * Hands\-on experience with AWS services including Bedrock, Lambda, ECS or EKS, S3 and Step Functions. * Experience with GenAI infrastructure: LLM integration, agent frameworks, MCP, semantic caching and LLM evaluation. * Familiarity with Amazon EKS and Kubernetes\-based deployments. * Familiarity with GitHub/GitLab workflows, secrets management and secure deployment practices. • * Knowledge of observability tools like Datadog and log aggregation strategies. * Ability to write clean, maintainable code and contribute to shared documentation and best practices. * Experience collaborating directly with customers, stakeholders, or cross\-functional delivery teams. * Excellent wr  with tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, or similar platforms for monitoring and evaluating AI systems. * **Embedded Systems \& Virtualization:** Exposure to Arm architectures, firmware development, IoT devices, hypervisors, or hardware virtualization. * **Model Context Protocol (MCP):** Experience building MCP servers, integrating external tools, or developing reusable agent tooling. * **Infrastructure Scalability:** Experience with distributed systems, Kubernetes, container orchestration, and scaling production AI workloads. * **AI Workflow Automation:** Experience automating software development processes, including code generation, automated testing, code reviews, and CI/CD workflows. * **Open\-Source Contributions:** Contributions to open\-source AI frameworks, developer tools, or cloud infrastructure projects. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- In your first few months, you will have built trusted relationships with client and TribalScale teams, developed a strong understanding of the client's operating environment, and contributed working software to a meaningful business challenge. As you grow in the role, you will: * Turn loosely defined client needs into clear, executable technical plans. * Deliver AI\-enabled products that perform reliably outside of controlled demonstrations. * Establish evaluation and observability practices that make quality measurable and regressions visible. * Improve agent behavior by refining harnesses, loops, tools, graphs, context, and safeguards—not only by changing prompts or models. * Help client teams understand what their AI systems can do, where they can fail, and how they should be operated responsibly. * Create reusable technical patterns that accelerate future TribalScale engagements. * Become a trusted partner who can navigate uncertainty, solve difficult technical problems, and help promising ideas reach production. **Why TribalScale** ------------------- * Work on high\-impact challenges across industries and technology domains. * Build real products and production systems—not just recommendations or presentations. * Work directly with clients and see the impact of your decisions. * Explore emerging approaches to AI, agentic systems, product development, and software delivery. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams that value experimentation and continuous learning. * Influence both client outcomes and TribalScale's evolving technical practices. * Join an environment where ownership, diverse perspectives, and thoughtful innovation are encouraged. **Why Choose TribalScale** At TribalScale, collaboration is at the heart of our innovative approach. We don't simply work for clients; we form partnerships, building transformative solutions that redefine what's possible. Our team, once at the forefront of the mobile revolution, now leads the charge in AI\-driven innovation. We empower each team member to be a catalyst for change, adhering to our principles of meritocracy, empowerment, and transparency. Diversity isn't just celebrated—it's fundamental to our strength. Our mission to "Right the Future" is a call to action to make a significant impact in the world of innovation. **Diversity: Our Collective Strength** TribalScale proudly stands as a beacon of equal opportunity in employment and workplace culture. We are steadfastly committed to equal employment opportunity, transcending the boundaries of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, able\-bodiedness, or gender identity. We not only welcome but actively encourage applications from individuals of all abilities, ages, citizenships, marital statuses, and gender identities. Your unique perspective is the key to our collective innovation. Should you require any accommodations, we implore you to inform us. Our commitment to inclusivity knows no bounds, and we stand ready to adapt our processes to ensure your comfort and success.

jobs.description: About the Role Uber One is Uber's flagship membership program, serving more than 50 million members globally across Mobility, Delivery, Grocery, and other Uber experiences. Membership combines savings, benefits, priority experiences, and exclusive offerings while driving engagement, cross\-platform adoption, and long\-term retention. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will build product\-focused ML systems for targeting, personalization, offers, and member engagement. Your models will directly influence the Membership experiences consumers see across Uber and Uber Eats. What You Will Do * Own targeting and personalization models from problem framing through deployment and monitoring. * Build treatment\-effect and uplift models to estimate incremental impact of Membership interventions. * Design budget\-aware allocation systems for consumer offers under real business constraints. * Build ranking and sequencing models for Membership messaging across Mobility and Delivery. * Productionize models in real\-time serving paths and large\-scale batch pipelines. * Design and analyze experiments to measure incremental product impact. * Translate ambiguous Membership growth problems into concrete ML solutions with cross\-functional partners. Basic Qualifications * 3\+ years of experience building and shipping production ML models. * Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, scikit\-learn, XGBoost, or LightGBM. * Strong understanding of SQL and large\-scale data processing experience with Spark, Hive, Presto, or similar technologies. * Experience with experimental design, A/B testing, and measurement of noisy product outcomes. * Experience working on ML systems from offline development through serving, monitoring, and retraining. * Experience applying ML to user\-facing product or business decisions. * Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field or equivalent practical experience. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: About the Team The Uber Eats Delivery Search team builds large\-scale machine learning systems that help consumers discover relevant merchants, products, and items across Uber Eats. We are transforming Search through two major initiatives: Search as an LLM (SaaL), evolving traditional retrieval and ranking into an LLM\-native Search architecture, and Whole\-Page Quality, developing AI\-powered evaluation and diagnostic capabilities to systematically identify customer\-facing defects and improve end\-to\-end Search experiences. Our team tackles challenging ML problems spanning large language model training and optimization (CPT, SFT, RL), semantic retrieval, generative Search, model evaluation, and production ML systems at Uber scale. Role \& Responsibilities As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Delivery Search team, you will design, develop, and deploy ML solutions that power next\-generation Search experiences. Specifically, you will: * LLM Training \& Optimization: Develop, train, and optimize large language models for Search using continued pretraining (CPT), supervised fine\-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and advanced model optimization techniques. * Search Relevance \& Semantic Understanding: Build and improve ML models for semantic retrieval, ranking, and catalog understanding to deliver relevant, personalized, and context\-aware Search results across diverse markets and merchant catalogs. * Whole\-Page Quality \& Evaluation: Develop LLM\-based quality judges, automated evaluation frameworks, and defect detection models to assess end\-to\-end Search experiences, identify recurring quality issues, and drive measurable improvements. * ML Experimentation \& Production Systems: Design scalable model training, evaluation, and inference pipelines; conduct offline and online experiments; and deploy and monitor ML models in production. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Independently drive complex ML projects from design through production, partnering with ML Infrastructure, Backend Engineering, Data Science, and Product teams to deliver measurable customer impact. Basic Qualifications * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands\-on development and deployment of production ML systems. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Solid foundation in machine learning, deep learning, algorithms, and scalable software engineering. * Experience developing, training, and evaluating ML models using large\-scale datasets. * Proven ability to independently deliver ML solutions from problem formulation and experimentation through production deployment. * Experience with model evaluation, performance analysis, and offline or online experimentation. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with large language models, generative AI, and training techniques such as CPT, SFT, or RL. * Experience with large\-scale Search, recommendation, information retrieval, or ranking systems. * Familiarity with LLM\-based evaluation, automated quality assessment, or defect detection. * Experience with distributed ML training, inference optimization, or production ML infrastructure. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate across engineering teams, lead technical projects, and mentor other engineers. jobs.description: Software Engineer II \| Global Intelligence, Data Platform About the team Global Intelligence helps Uber understand competitive landscapes and marketplace dynamics across Mobility and Delivery. We partner with scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to transform complex data into trusted insights that inform product, pricing, and marketplace decisions. Our engineering team builds the data foundations behind these insights: integrating external sources, developing scalable data pipelines and models, and creating reusable platform capabilities. We leverage AI to accelerate data integration, improve data understanding, and make our platform easier to operate and use. About the role We’re looking for a Software Engineer II to build reliable, scalable, and intelligent data systems for Global Intelligence. You will take ownership of data platform capabilities from problem definition and technical design through implementation and production operations. Working with engineers, scientists, and product, you’ll navigate incomplete requirements, resolve ambiguity, and translate business and analytical needs into maintainable engineering solutions. You’ll build ETL/ELT pipelines, design data models and contracts, strengthen data quality, and apply AI to meaningfully improve our workflows and products. jobs.title: CONSULTANCY: Website Developer - SSA-2026-IPCC -1
jobs.description: **Background** The IPCC is in its seventh assessment cycle. In this cycle, the Panel is preparing a Special Report on Climate Change and Cities, two Methodology Reports, and a comprehensive Seventh Assessment Report (AR7\) with contributions from the three Working Groups and a Synthesis Report. The IPCC is looking for a Web Developer to support the release of the Special Report on Climate Change and Cities and all components of the AR7 by creating purpose\-built, public facing, report\-specific microsites that present each report’s findings in an accessible, visually engaging and clear format. The specific reports requiring microsite development are as follows: * Special Report on Climate Change and Cities * Working Group I contribution to AR7 * Working Group II contribution to AR7 including the updated IPCC Technical Guidelines on impacts and adaptation as well as adaptation indicators, metrics and guidelines * Working Group III contribution to AR7 * AR7 Synthesis Report **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** **:** Under the overall supervision of the IPCC Head of Communications, the Consultant will be working with the Technical Support Units responsible for each report to undertake the following: **Website Design and Production** * Develop a custom visual design that is consistent with IPCC’s brand guidelines (colour palette, typography, logo usage), with the aim of prioritizing readability, accessibility, and modern usability standards. The design should take inspiration from earlier IPCC report microsites while improving navigation clarity and mobile responsiveness. The websites will be developed upon agreement with relevant Working Group or Synthesis Report TSU and IPCC Secretariat on the final structure and design. * Provide an analysis of existing IPCC AR6 microsites and suggest areas of improvement. * Develop the microsites’ structure, features, and visual language for each microsite, providing templates to be approved by the relevant teams in the IPCC. The report microsites will have a similar structure, look and feel to the main IPCC website, and multimedia components, with some possible variations in each report. While there may be some variations, the general structure, look and feel should be such that end users will feel that they are navigating products from the same group of reports. * Present design mockups (for desktop and mobile views) for approval prior to development of each report. The consultant should state the number of sketches and revisions they are able to provide. * The consultant will design microsites that can be edited by non\-technical staff, who should be able to edit the content of the microsites and update downloadable files after launch, without developer assistance. This can look like a headless Content Management System (CMS) editorial interface, with content editing handled through a separate user\-friendly web dashboard without touching code. * Content Editing * For each microsite report, the consultant will be responsible to populate the templates with content provided by the relevant IPCC TSU. * Quality control will be provided by the TSUs. **Multimedia Support** The consultant will develop a site that shall support the following media types: * Embedded video: Videos hosted on YouTube or Vimeo shall be embedded onto the website. The consultant is not responsible for obtaining video hosting rights and videos will be provided by the IPCC. * Downloadable images and figures: High\-resolution images shall be available for download by site visitors, which can be presented via the lightbox component. Provision of the figures, licensing and rights clearance for all images is the responsibility of IPCC. * PDFs: Full report and chapter PDFs shall be linked for download. Files will be provided by IPCC. * Infographics and data visualizations: The consultant may implement static or interactive charts and infographics, based on assets or specifications provided by IPCC. If possible, IPCC would like to also embed alt text in graphics on the website. **Accessibility and Performance** * The consultant shall develop microsites that shall: * Conform to Accessibility Guidelines by the United Nations (https://www.un.org/en/webaccessibility/) as much as feasible. If and where feasible, these microsites would be translated into and accessed in the official UN languages. Approved by: Annett Moehner, 20 November 2026 12:53 UTC\+1, Doc ID: WMOIPCC\-1787797416\-6797463 * Fully responsive and optimized for mobile and desktop viewports. * Implement basic on\-page SEO (meta descriptions, Open Graph tags, structured page titles). Technology stack and hosting * The site shall be deployable to a static hosting platform. The consultant shall advise on the most appropriate platform given the proposed stack. * The final microsites will be hosted by the IPCC, and the consultant will support the IPCC technical team to ensure that the microsites are successfully produced and accessible on the main site. * Main rts that IPCC will deliver between 2027 and 2029 for the following reports: a. Special Report on Climate Change and Cities b. Working Group I contribution to AR7 c. Working Group II contribution to AR7 including the updated IPCC Technical Guidelines on impacts and adaptation as well as adaptation indicators, metrics and guidelines d. Working Group III contribution to AR7 e. AR7 Synthesis Report 3\. Training materials and training sessions with the relevant staff members of the IPCC Secretariat **Required Skills and Experience** **Education:** An advanced degree (Master’s Degree or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field. A first\-level university degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field combined with additional demonstrated qualifying experience in programming, building complex report websites similar to the reports of the IPCC. **Experience:** Proven experience designing and developing public\-facing reports or publication of microsites, with a portfolio of at least two comparable projects, if possible. The developer must have demonstrated experience developing static websites with strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS, JavaScript frameworks, and responsive web design. Approved by: Annett Moehner, 20 November 2026 12:53 UTC\+1, Doc ID: WMOIPCC\-1787797416\-6797463\. The developer must be experienced in generating optimised static builds for deployment in LAMP\-based hosting environments as plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript assets. Experience with website performance optimisation, SEO, accessibility and maintaining secure, scalable, and cross\-browser\-compatible web solutions is required. **Other Requirements:** Portfolio demonstrating proven experience designing and developing public\-facing reports or publication of microsites, with a portfolio of at least two comparable projects, if possible. Technical proposal of a maximum of 4 pages on the proposed approach and technology stack. **Languages:** English is the working language. An additional UN Official language would be an added advantage. **Salary and Allowances** PAYBAND: B **Additional Information** : **DURATION:** 12 months spread between October 2026 to the end of 2029 as deliverables require that the various report be ready for publication. **Focal point and email for additional information:** Mudathir Abdallah (mabdallah@wmo.int) and Werani Zabula (wzabula@wmo.int) **Probation** Possibility of renewal subject to the availability of funds and pending satisfactory performance after an initial probationary period of one year which can be extended up to a maximum of two years. **Applications:** Applications should be made online through the WMO e\-recruitment system. Do not send your application via multiple routes. WMO no longer accepts applications via post or email. Only applicants for whom WMO has a further interest will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be required to sit a written test and/or an interview. **Statements:** WMO is committed to achieving diversity and a balanced workforce. Applications are welcome from qualified women and men, including those with disabilities. The statutory retirement age is 65\. Pursuant to WMO Standing Instructions, the minimum age to be eligible for consideration for vacant positions is 18, and the maximum age must enable the candidate to serve for at least the term of the contract before reaching mandatory age of separation. **Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority** WMO does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles. **Scam alert** WMO does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, and hiring processes (i.e., application stage, interview stage, validation stage, or appointment and training). WMO will not ask for applicants’ bank account information.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Agentic AI and Knowledge Extraction
jobs.description: At **Universal Display Corporation (Nasdaq: OLED)** (UDC), we’re changing the way people see the world. If you’re reading this on a smartphone, there’s a good chance UDC’s materials are producing the light and color shining from your screen right now. UDC’s OLED ingredients are key parts of stunning, energy\-efficient displays used in everything from smartwatches to phones, tablets, laptops, monitors, TVs and automobiles. Virtually every OLED consumer electronics product around the world uses UDC’s phosphorescent OLED materials and technologies. UDC is a publicly traded company and pioneer in the OLED industry. When you join our global team, you are embarking on a journey at the forefront of display technology and organic electronics that impacts the daily lives of people around the world. From engineers to chemists, Ph.D. scientists, technicians, lawyers and more, our UDC team is continuously advancing our field. With a focus on energy efficiency, UDC’s team is contributing to making a better, more sustainable planet. Please visit us at www.oled.com. **Job Summary:** Universal Display Corporation is seeking a Research Scientist to develop and deploy agentic AI systems and scientific knowledge\-extraction workflows that accelerate molecular discovery and materials research. This role will build multi\-agent systems that explore chemical space and propose candidate materials, while developing pipelines that convert patents, scientific literature, and chemical structure images into machine\-readable knowledge that these systems can use. The position will contribute to a broader AI/ML and synthetic chemistry team advancing OLED chemistry across the discovery process, from ideation through synthesis and testing. The ideal candidate has hands\-on experience building LLM\-based agents or scientific information\-extraction systems, sufficient chemistry knowledge to evaluate their outputs, and the ability to collaborate with ML scientists, computational chemists, and synthetic chemists to move new materials from concept toward experimental validation. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, implement, and evaluate multi\-agent AI systems for molecular discovery, including database\-driven exploration and open\-ended, chemistry\-guided search. * Develop workflows that extract molecular structures, properties, and design knowledge from patents, scientific literature, and chemical structure images, including generic and Markush structures. * Build retrieval and knowledge\-management systems, including vector, graph, and relational databases, that allow agents to search curated scientific corpora. * Develop tools, APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect agents to predictive models and computational chemistry workflows. * Design persistent and shared\-memory approaches that enable agentic systems to build on prior discovery efforts. * Evaluate agent performance against expert review and incorporate feedback from synthetic chemists into the continuous improvement of agentic workflows. * Contribute to secure, reproducible AI infrastructure for deploying agentic systems in isolated cloud and on\-premises environments. **Required** **Qualifications:** * Ph.D. in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field, with demonstrated experience applying large language models or agentic AI to scientific problems. * Proven experience developing agentic AI workflows, LLM tool harnesses, or AI\-enabled scientific applications that connect models, tools, data, and user workflows. * Experience extracting structured information from scientific text, patents, or chemical structure images. * Proficiency in Python for scientific programming, including hands\-on experience with RDKit and working knowledge of SMILES and SMARTS. * Experience with retrieval systems, knowledge graphs, or databases, including vector, graph, or SQL databases. * Strong working knowledge of molecular chemistry sufficient to assess the validity of proposed molecules and extracted structures. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across scientific and engineering disciplines. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience building MCP servers or custom APIs for agent tool use. * Experience with optical chemical structure recognition (image\-to\-SMILES) or Markush structure handling. * Experience with agent memory, multi\-agent coordination, or agent\-evaluation methods. * Experience fine\-tuning or distilling language models, including small models for domain\-specific tasks. * Experience with chemistry\-specific language models or generative molecular design. * Background in molecular chemistry, organic electronics, OLED materials, or organic semiconductors. * Experience with patent\-literature analysis or prior\-art search. * Experience deploying AI systems in secure or isolated computing environments. **Current Benefits at UDC:** * Competitive base salary and annual bonus program * Medical/Prescription Drug coverage, Dental, and Vision for employees and family * Option of Health and Dependent Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) * Option of Health Savings Account (HSA) * Group Term Life insurance, short term disability, and long\-term disability benefits for employees * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) * 401(k) company contribution * Ewing Worldwide Headquarters (HQ) cafeteria provides breakfast and lunch to employees at no cost to them * Annual charitable matching gift * Generous Paid Time Off **Annual compensation range: $115k\-140k** At Universal Display Corporation, base pay is one part of our total compensation package. Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the annual salary range only, and does not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable.

jobs.description: **Florida Center for Students with Unique Abilities:** Signed into law by Florida’s governor on January 21, 2016, the Florida Postsecondary Comprehensive Transition Program Act (the Act) (S 1004\.6495, FS) established the Florida Center for Students with Unique Abilities at the University of Central Florida (the Center) and charged the Center with managing the Florida Postsecondary Comprehensive Transition Program (FPCTP) application and approval process. The Act also established criteria for FPCTP approval, scholarship awards for eligible students to attend approved programs, grant awards to promote new program development and existing program enhancements, and accountability requirements associated with these opportunities. The Center works with higher education institutions across Florida to support implementation of the Act in three primary ways: (a) facilitate application and approval of their program that serves students with intellectual disabilities as a FPCTP, (b) provide scholarship awards to students attending an institution’s approved FPCTP, and (c) provide grant funding to foster starting up new and/or enhancing existing programs. jobs.title: Assistant Professor of Industrial Engineering, Tenure Stream
jobs.description: Assistant Professor of Industrial Engineering, Tenure Stream Industrial Engineering \- Pennsylvania\-Pittsburgh \- (26007004\) The Department of Industrial Engineering at the University of Pittsburgh invites applications for a tenure/tenure\-track faculty position at the Assistant Professor rank, with an expected start date of Fall 2027\. jobs.description: **Overview** **This is a HYBRID role; selected candidate will need to be local or willing to relocate here for as\-needed on\-site work.** *As a patient\-focused organization, University of Utah Health exists to enhance the health and well\-being of people through patient care, research and education. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, LLM
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team:** At Upstart, our Applied AI team's mission is threefold: * **Agent Platform:** Build and support the platform that makes it straightforward for non technical users across Upstart to build, launch, and operate AI agents (voice/chat/text) reliably. * **Borrower and Applicant Assistant Orchestration:** Build the orchestration layer behind a unified personal assistant that shares context across specialized agents, giving applicants and borrowers a cohesive, assistant\-like experience. * **Borrower\-Connected Internal Workflows:** Improve internal operational workflows that directly connect to applicant and borrower experiences, making them faster, smarter, and more efficient. As **Principal Engineer, LLM** you will serve as a technical pathfinder and force multiplier for this team and the product squads we partner with. Rather than owning internal developer\-tooling infrastructure or training foundation models from scratch, your mandate is to compress the time between an ambiguous idea and a reliable, user\-facing AI system, while raising the applied AI bar across every squad you touch. This role operates on an explicit **80/20 charter**: * **0\-to\-1 Product and Architecture Pathfinder (\~80%):** Rapidly prototype high\-ambiguity bets across our agent platform, cross\-agent context orchestration, borrower\-facing assistant experiences, and internal workflows. Partner directly with Product and Design to validate non\-deterministic UX, establish clean architectural patterns, and hand off battle\-tested evaluation contracts for engineering squads to scale. * **AI\-Native Engineering Catalyst (\~20%):** While dedicated internal teams own Upstart's broader AI developer tooling and software\-factory initiatives, you will serve as a visible practitioner on the product side. You will lead by example with agentic coding workflows and tight verification harnesses, partner with our internal tooling teams as an early adopter ("customer zero"), and help product squads adopt higher\-leverage ways of working. Because AI systems are non\-deterministic, user experience is part of the architecture. Whether you are designing cross\-agent handoffs, borrower\-facing assistant flows, or internal operational tools, you will navigate real\-world trade\-offs across latency, unit economics, reliability, and user trust, and push back constructively when a simpler deterministic approach is the right call. **How you’ll make an impact** * **De\-risk 0\-to\-1 bets across the stack:** Rapidly prototype ambiguous initiatives spanning multi\-agent context sharing, UX for non technical users, platform primitives for launching agents, and borrower\-connected internal workflows. * **Deliver durable evaluation contracts, not throwaway handoffs:** Treat prototype code as disposable proof of concept, and hand off to engineers what they actually need to build production services with confidence: golden datasets, automated evaluation harnesses, documented failure\-mode maps, latency/cost benchmarks, and clean architectural blueprints. * **Partner cleanly from spike to production:** Align early with receiving squad tech leads to surface system constraints, support joint go/no\-go decisions with Engineering and Product leadership (including killing unviable bets early), and stay engaged through initial productionization to review early PRs and debug edge\-case model behavior. * **Design non\-deterministic n, and user trust are critical. **Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote **Time zone requirements** The team operates on the East/West coast time zones. **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in\-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in\-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2\-4 consecutive days at a time. At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). United States \| Remote \- Anticipated Base Salary Range $238,400—$330,200 USD **What you'll love** At Upstart, our benefits for full\-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well\-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices. *If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate\_accommodations@upstart.com* https://www.upstart.com/candidate\_privacy\_policy

jobs.description: Sr. DevOps Engineer **About Ursa Space Systems** Ursa Space Systems builds the software and AI agents that guide the acquisition, analysis, and integration of satellite and geospatial data into customer workflows, delivering valuable insights for global security and commodity markets. By leveraging satellite data and advanced analytics, Ursa Space provides fast, actionable information to a range of industries, including finance, energy, and defense. **Job Summary** As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Ursa Space Systems, you will help architect and operate the robust, secure, and highly scalable infrastructure that powers our satellite intelligence platform. This is a high\-impact role where you will bridge software development and cloud operations to build resilient, auto\-scaling environments capable of AI\-assisted querying on massive geospatial datasets with high levels of concurrent system activity. A key focus of this role is strengthening the scalability and security of our backend platform and evolving our infrastructure to support increasing concurrency, reliability, and operational efficiency at scale. You will play a critical role in designing systems that are secure by default, observable in real time, and resilient under production load. You will also serve as a technical leader in defining the “paved roads” for CI/CD and infrastructure best practices, enabling engineering teams to deploy quickly without compromising reliability or security. Your work will span cloud infrastructure, automation, observability, DevSecOps, and platform scalability, with a strong emphasis on AWS\-based architectures and services. Our core technology stack includes AWS, Terraform, and Python. Deep expertise with AWS cloud infrastructure and services is essential for success in this role. This position is fully remote, or optionally in\-person at our headquarters in Ithaca, NY. This position may have on\-call responsibilities. ### **What Success Looks Like** * Security and reliability is integrated into the CI/CD pipeline(DevSecOps) so that breaks and vulnerabilities are caught before code is even deployed. * Ensuring users and services have exactly the permissions they need and nothing more (e.g., RBAC, advanced IAM policies). * All systems have real\-time monitoring and alerting capabilities for failures and suspicious activity. * Designing infrastructure that can withstand an attack or misconfiguration without a total system failure. * Make our infrastructure and systems easy to configure, maintain and observe. We can debug and resolve production issues quickly with the help of monitors, logging and metrics. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available AWS infrastructure supporting Ursa Space production systems. * Develop and manage infrastructure\-as\-code solutions using Terraform and AWS\-native tooling. * Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices to enable fast, reliable, and secure deployments. * Improve backend scalability, reliability, and system performance to support high levels of concurrency and production traffic. * Implement monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting systems to improve observability and incident response. * Develop and maintain self\-service infrastructure tooling and platform automation to improve engineering productivity. * Support containerized applications and microservice\-based architectures in cloud\-native environments. * Implement security best practices across infrastructure, including IAM, RBAC, secrets management, and compliance controls. * Partner closely with software engineering teams on architecture, deployment, operational excellence, and production reliability initiatives. * Participate in architecture reviews, incident response, on\-call rotations, and continuous improvement efforts across the platform. **Requirements** * B.S. in Computer Science, or other engineering discipline in which software development is a focus * Industry experience in a DevOps, SRE or software engineer role * Strong experience with AWS Cloud stack like S3, ECS, CloudFront, EFS, API Gateway etc. * Strong experience with Kubernetes both in AWS and other deployment environments * Experience using AI\-assisted tools for rapid development and testing * Expert knowledge of common software development tooling (Git, Docker, IDEs, linters, formatters, testing frameworks, terraform and python modularization) * Experience with AWS GovCloud as well as associated governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) tooling * Proficient in Terraform, AWS CDK, and Python * Experience with NoSQL and/or SQL databases (Mongo, MySQL, Postgres) * Experience with managing code and container repositories as well as CI/CD functions at scale (GitLab, Amazon ECR preferred) * Familiarity with release processes for SaaS products * Experience with microservice\-based architectures and related design principles * Organized and self motivated, able to successfully work with a remote team * A creative, intuitive, and flexible mindset to approach complex problems and build innovative solutions. * A fast, reliable internet connection if you are working remotely is a must. **Preferred Skills** * Experience in GIS tools and libraries like SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog jobs.title: Software Engineer, Front End
jobs.description: **Company Description** System High is a wholly owned subsidiary of Veilant, delivering advanced protection and secrecy solutions that secure and strengthen critical missions, programs, and intelligence activities. We support some of the nation’s most sensitive efforts, and our team plays a direct role in protecting what matters most. As part of Veilant, System High combines deep mission expertise with the resources and capabilities of a broader organization focused on protecting and advancing critical national security missions. **Job Description** **Want to build instead of inherit?** System High is looking for a Software Engineer specializing in frontend development to take ownership of the user\-facing application layer of a new software product being built from the ground up. This is a true greenfield opportunity. You won’t be inheriting years of legacy frontend code or simply working through an established backlog. You’ll have the opportunity to help establish the frontend architecture, component patterns, development workflows, and technical standards that shape the application as it grows. We’re looking for an engineer who combines strong frontend development skills with broader software engineering fundamentals. You should be comfortable building modern web applications, integrating with APIs, working within GitHub and CI/CD workflows, and collaborating closely with backend engineers and other technical specialists. React is our preferred direction, but because the application is still being built, we value strong engineering fundamentals and experience with modern frontend frameworks over expertise in one narrowly defined stack. We also want someone who knows how to use modern AI\-assisted development tools effectively. AI should make you faster at tasks like documentation, testing, scaffolding, debugging, and repetitive development but it shouldn't replace your ability to understand the code, challenge the output, and make sound engineering decisions. If you're energized by a blank canvas, enjoy solving problems without having every step prescribed, and want to see your technical decisions directly influence a new product, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact. **What You’ll Do** * **Own the Frontend Application Layer:** Help design and build the frontend from the ground up, establishing scalable patterns for components, routing, state management, performance, accessibility, and maintainability. * **Build Production\-Ready Experiences:** Translate product requirements and UI/UX concepts into responsive, intuitive, high\-quality application features. * **Integrate with APIs:** Build reliable integrations between the frontend and backend services, confidently working with API contracts, data structures, payloads, application state, error handling, and asynchronous workflows. * **Shape Frontend Architecture:** Participate in technical decisions around frameworks, libraries, application structure, reusable components, testing strategies, and development standards. * **Work Across Engineering Boundaries:** Collaborate with backend development, AI/technical specialists, QA, and product leadership to solve problems that span multiple parts of the application. * **Build Efficient Development Workflows:** Work within GitHub, AWS/GIT\-based workflows, and CI/CD pipelines to support reliable development, testing, integration, and deployment. * **Use AI to Increase Engineering Velocity:** Apply AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate documentation, testing, debugging, code scaffolding, and repetitive engineering tasks while independently reviewing, validating, and improving generated output. * **Automate Where It Makes Sense:** Write lightweight scripts or utilities to eliminate repetitive tasks, manipulate data, support development environments, or improve engineering workflows. * **Deliver Iteratively:** Break complex requirements into manageable technical tasks and deliver working software through an Agile/Scrum development process. * **Contribute Beyond Your Code:** Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, sprint planning, estimation, and continuous improvement of the team's engineering practices. **What Success Looks Like** **Within your first six months, you will have:** * Helped establish the technical foundation and architecture of a new frontend application. * Built and delivered production\-ready features that turn product requirements into an intuitive user experience. * Established reliable integrations between the frontend and backend APIs. * Contributed reusable components, patterns, and development standards that make the application easier to extend and maintain. * Demonstrated the ability to independently troubleshoot issues across the frontend, API, data, and development workflow layers. * Integrated AI\-assisted development into your workflow in ways that measurably improve speed and efficiency without compromising engineering quality. * Become a trusted techni t. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote engineering environment. **Nice to Haves** * Experience helping build a new application, product, or significant feature from the ground up. * Experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. * Familiarity with GIT/AWS development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud\-based application delivery. * Experience working across frontend/backend boundaries or collaborating closely with backend engineering teams. * Familiarity with scripting or automation using Node.js, Python, Bash, or similar technologies. * Experience establishing frontend architecture, component libraries, design systems, or engineering standards. * Experience with automated frontend or unit testing. * Exposure to applications incorporating AI/LLM capabilities or other intelligent application services. * Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments. **Who Will Thrive in This Role** You’re likely to enjoy this role if you like building more than maintaining. You don’t need someone else to define every implementation detail before you can get started. You’re comfortable taking a requirement, asking the right questions, evaluating different approaches, making a recommendation, and turning that recommendation into working software. You also recognize that modern engineering is changing. You’re interested in using AI and automation to remove repetitive work and increase your output, but you understand that engineering judgment still matters. You can explain your code, defend your technical decisions, identify when generated code is wrong, and improve a solution rather than accepting the first answer a tool provides.
