jobs.title: Junior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** *Vertex Service Partners is a home improvement services company focused on residential roofing and other exterior services across the United States. Backed by Alpine Investors, a top\-decile private equity fund with $4\.0 billion of committed capital, Vertex is building a best\-in\-class national platform.* *Our company is built on our core values—****servant leadership, unwavering character, a growth mindset, persistence, empowerment, pace, and fun****—and guided by three pillars: being the* ***Employer of Choice****,* ***Partner of Choice****, and* ***Contractor of Choice****. We offer transformative support in operations, marketing, training, talent, finance, and technology, all while preserving the autonomy of local brands.* **Mission of the role** *As a Junior AI Engineer on the AI Engineering team, you help build the AI\-powered applications, automations, and models our brands use every day: tools that route leads to sales reps, calculate commissions, staff call centers, onboard and offboard field employees, and deliver the morning reports leadership relies on. Working alongside the Senior Manager of AI Engineering, you take features from request to production. You gather context from the business, build with AI\-assisted development (e.g., Claude Code), connect to our business systems and data warehouse, and prove your work with tests before it ships. You start on well\-scoped pieces of live applications and grow into owning features, LLM capabilities, and machine learning models end\-to\-end.* **Where** **you'll** **make an impact** * **Internal applications** — Build and improve full\-stack web applications in TypeScript, React, and Node on Postgres using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code), working in GitHub with pull requests, code review, and CI/CD. * **LLM\-powered features** — Ship features built on large language models (e.g., the Claude API and Snowflake Cortex), such as plain\-English summaries in automated reports, in\-app assistants that answer "how do I…" questions, and routing requests to the right team. Evaluate the output so quality is measured, not assumed. * **Machine learning** — Help train, deploy, and monitor predictive models in our data warehouse, such as lead\-to\-rep matching scores and revenue predictions, including scheduled scoring and retraining. * **System integrations** — Connect our applications to the platforms the business runs on, including field\-service management, HR and payroll, recruiting, sales/CRM, SMS, and email. Make those integrations safe to re\-run, resilient to failure, and easy to audit. * **Data modeling in dbt** — Write dbt models in SQL with the help of AI coding assistants while understanding the dbt methodology yourself: declaring sources, layering staging, intermediate, and mart models, building the DAG with ref(), choosing materializations (view, table, incremental), and adding tests and documentation in YAML. Know how data flows from raw source to the mart an app or report reads, and what breaks downstream when a model changes. * **Reporting \& alerting automation** — Build scheduled reports, data\-quality checks, and watchdogs (Python, serverless functions) that tell the right people when something has gone wrong in the business or in one of our own services. * **Cloud deployment \& operations** — Deploy and run services on Azure (App Service, Functions, Key Vault, Entra ID sign\-in, Application Insights) and help keep them healthy once they are live. * **Business partnership** — Work directly with sales, operations, recruiting, and finance users to understand what they need, demo what you built, and document it so others can support it. **Key outcomes** * **Ships to production early** — Delivers small, reviewed changes to live applications in the first month and owns a feature end\-to\-end by the end of the first quarter. * **Capacity multiplier** — Takes well\-defined features, fixes, and enhancements off senior engineering's plate so senior time goes to architecture and the hardest problems. * **Reliable, tested work** — Changes ship with tests and documentation; integrations don't double\-send, double\-pay, or fail silently. * **Measured AI** — LLM and ML features have an evaluation set or a before/after measurement, so we know they work. * **Trusted by users** — The business teams who use our tools see their requests understood, delivered, and followed up on. **This role allows you to** * Put AI into production. Sales reps, managers, and executives use your work every day; it doesn't sit in a demo. * Learn full\-stack, data, and applied\-AI engineering at the same time, with direct mentorship from a senior AI engineering leader. * Build with modern AI\-assisted tooling and learn how to direct it, review it, and ship it responsibly. * Grow quickly in a collaborative, entrepreneurial, fast\-growing company. **Who you are** * You have 0–2 years of professional software, data, or AI engineering experience, or a CS/engineering degree, bootcamp, or equivalent portfolio. * You write working Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, and solid SQL (joins, CTEs, window functions, CASE statements). * You have built and deployed at least one project that someone other than you has used. * You have called an LLM API from code (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) and understand prompts, tool use, and the limits of model output. * You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) daily, and you review, test, and question what they produce rather than accepting it as\-is. * You're comfortable with Git/GitHub: small commits, clear pull requests, and having your code reviewed and iterating on feedback. * You understand, or can quickly learn, how data moves from source systems through modeled layers in a data warehouse. * You're a clear communicator who can explain a technical fix to a non\-technical manager in a couple of sentences. * You're curious about how the business runs and enjoy turning a vague request into something that works. **Nice to have** * dbt, Snowflake, or a modern data stack. * React (Tailwind, TanStack Query) and Postgres with an ORM. * Azure or another major cloud (serverless functions, app hosting, identity). * ML fundamentals: training, evaluating, and serving a classification or regression model. * RAG, agent, or tool\-use patterns with LLMs, and evaluating LLM output. * Automated testing (Vitest/Jest, pytest, Playwright). * Field\-service, home services, or multi\-site experience. **Personal characteristics** * **Data\-driven decision\-maker** — Skilled at working with data and finding meaning and action in numbers. * **Flexible \& adaptable** — Willing to take on new projects and challenges to support the evolving needs of a high\-growth company. * **Get\-it\-done attitude** — Problem\-solves on the fly and completes time\-sensitive work to drive the business forward. * **Service\-oriented** — Builds strong relationships with peers across the corporate team and operating companies. * **Resourceful** — Drives action and achieves results creatively with finite resources. * **Critical thinker and learner** — Picks things up quickly and asks "why" rather than taking "yes" for an answer. * **Culture carrier** — A humble servant leader with unyielding integrity who is self\-aware, open to feedback, and respectful of others. **Benefits:** Full\-time employees are eligible to participate in the following benefits: * Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401(k) with company match * Company sponsored Life and AD\&D coverage * Paid Time Off * Opportunities for growth and on\-the\-job training **Why Join Us?** * **Build Something Big** – Shape processes for a rapidly growing organization. * **Growth\-Oriented Culture** – Work in a dynamic, people\-first environment. * **Make an Impact Across Regions** – Partner with business leaders to drive meaningful change. **Apply Today!** *Vertex Service Partners is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, age, military service, or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability, please contact Human Resources with your request and contact information.* *Applicant Privacy Policy*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About us** At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space. We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action. **What you'll do** The System Software team owns the foundational OS layer — AlmaLinux\-based embedded servers called Mobility Access Servers (MAS) — that powers inflight WiFi and streaming content on the world's leading airlines. You'll work on the software stack from bootloader to application services: storage health, container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, security hardening, and field incident investigation. When something goes wrong on a production aircraft, your team is the one that figures out why and ships the fix. This is a site\-based role; employees work 3\+ days (60%\+) per week from a Viasat office or work location within a standard five\-day workweek. **The day\-to\-day** \- Software engineering as part of an agile development team \- Actively design and drive software architecture involving a Linux\-based operating system with custom support applications involving REST, HW interfaces, ARINC controllers, cellular device controllers, and other low\-level driver support \- Participate in the design, development, and testing of software products we support \- Maintain and improve our current setup for continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) systems, with a focus on applying GitHub Actions, Artifactory, Vault, and GitHub \- Improve and implement testing, both virtual and on bare metal hardware, to improve software quality by catching issues before they reach production \- Debug and investigate production system failures using log analysis tools (syslog\-ng, fluent\-bit, journalctl) and field data from live aircraft deployments \- Manage and maintain ZFS storage pools, disk health monitoring, and storage subsystem reliability \- Develop, deploy, and maintain containerized services using Docker and k3s (lightweight Kubernetes) on embedded hardware \- Drive security posture improvements including secret/key rotation, file integrity monitoring, and remediation of penetration test findings \- Participate in code reviews with a view to deliver quality products in the short and long term \- Travel up to 10% **What you'll need** \- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering \- Hands\-on proficiency in C/C\+\+/Rust/Go/Bash/Python in embedded environments, independently designing, implementing, testing, and debugging solutions for well\-defined subsystems or features, with a track record of delivering that scope reliably to schedule and quality goals. \- Hands\-on experience with Object Oriented methodology and development \- Proficiency with Linux system administration: systemd service lifecycle, boot process debugging, and log\-based forensics (journalctl, syslog) \- Experience with container technologies (Docker) and/or container orchestration (Kubernetes/k3s) \- Experience investigating and debugging field incidents and production system failures, including reading system logs, correlating events across services, and driving to root cause \- Experience with developing and delivering software using CI/CD and DevOps practices \- Familiarity with common development and infrastructure tools including Git, GitHub, Docker, HashiCorp Vault, and artifact management platforms (e.g. Artifactory) \- Ability to champion modern software practices and uphold software quality standards in all phases of development \- Strong analytical skills and the ability to evaluate software architecture \& design, including existing codebases \- Performing tests following a requirement\-based testing approach \- Familiarity with AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development **What will help you on the job** \- Experience working with Linux distributions and embedded optimized frameworks (e.g. AlmaLinux, OpenWRT, Yocto, Buildroot) \- Deep understanding of the bootloader and application bring\-up process \- Experience orchestrating and optimizing resources (CPU, memory, disk) using tools such as cgroups and MGLRU \- Deep familiarity with ZFS storage management — pool creation and recovery, persistent device naming (udev/wwn), disk failure mode analysis, and systemd unit integration for storage subsystem services \- Kubernetes/Helm chart authoring for containerized service deployment on embedded hardware \- Familiarity with infrastructure and security tooling such as HashiCorp Vault, Jenkins, Artifactory, Git, GitHub, and GitHub Actions **Salary range** $140,500\.00 \- $221,500\.00 / annually. jobs.title: Computer Systems Validation Specialist/Engineer
jobs.description: **Experiencing together a unique human adventure** Animal health is key to the health of the planet. Working at Virbac means taking part in a unique human adventure in which the engagement of each individual contributes to its evolution. Encouraging internal mobility between positions and countries, offering individual development plans and building a partnership based on trust between managers and employees are as many perspectives of motivation for our teams. We also offer them a work environment conducive to exploring new territories and balancing their professional and personal lives. Finally, fostering their engagement to animal health also means listening to them and helping them to acquire new skills, preparing them for the challenges of tomorrow and encouraging them to contribute to an ever more responsible approach to our business. **Computer Systems Validation Specialist/Engineer** Virbac Animal Health is seeking a Computer Systems Validation Specialist/Manager to join our MSAT team. The Computer Systems Validation Specialist / Engineer is an individual contributor responsible for hands\-on drafting, executing, and summarizing lifecycle validation deliverables across GxP computerized systems, laboratory automated instruments, manufacturing equipment control systems, and enterprise software platforms. This position ensures that all computerized systems used in GxP operations are compliant with site Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), GAMP 5 risk\-based methodologies, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and ALCOA\+ data integrity principles. The Specialist/Engineer manages individual CSV project deliverables and serves as the technical validation lead on cross\-functional teams collaborating with Quality Assurance, Information Technology, Engineering, and Operations. **Qualified Candidates should have in the following:** * **Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Computer, Biomedical, Chemical)** Computer Science, Information Technology, Chemistry, or a related scientific/technical discipline. * **3 to 6 years of experience in a GxP environment** (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device manufacturing). * **Minimum of 3 years** of direct, hands\-on experience authoring and executing computer systems validation documentation (URS, FRS, IQ, OQ, PQ, VSR). * Strong understanding of cGMP regulations (21 CFR Parts 210, 211, 820\), 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, Annex 15, and GAMP 5 risk\-based validation frameworks. * Practical knowledge of Data Integrity principles (ALCOA\+) and audit trail review procedures. * Proven experience validating computerized systems such as LIMS, ERP, MES, electronic document management systems (eDMS), environmental monitoring systems, or SCADA/PLC equipment control interfaces. * Familiarity with Quality Risk Management tools (FMEA, System Impact Assessments). **Benefits:** 13 Company paid Holidays; 5 Floating Holidays (prorated); 15 vacation days (prorated); 5 floating holidays (prorated); 6% 401k match; competitive pay and bonus opportunity; growth opportunities within the department and much more! **Area of responsibility 1: CSV Lifecycle Documentation \& Protocol Execution** Main activities * Author, review, and execute System Life Cycle (SLC) deliverables, including User Requirement Specifications (URS), Functional Requirement Specifications (FRS), Design Specifications (DS), Traceability Matrices (RTM), Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ) protocols. * Perform risk assessments (e.g., FMEA) to evaluate system criticality, software categorization (GAMP 5\), and data integrity impact. * Execute test scripts, generate traceable raw data packages, investigate protocol exceptions/deviations, and author audit\-ready Validation Summary Reports (VSR). * Qualify both on\-premise and cloud\-based/Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) applications, automated laboratory systems (e.g., LIMS, CDS, HPLC), and process automation systems (PLC/SCADA/HMI). **Expected results:** High\-quality, compliant validation documentation packages completed on schedule with zero unmitigated regulatory risks. **Area of responsibility 2: Project Coordination \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** Main activities * Lead individual computer system validation projects and define execution timelines, resource requirements, and milestone tracking. * Act as the CSV subject matter representative on multidisciplinary project teams alongside IT, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing Science \& Technology (MSAT), and Operations personnel. * Review vendor validation packages (FAT/SAT), evaluate supplier quality documentation, and align third\-party deliverables with internal site standards. * Coordinate system testing windows with production and laboratory schedules to minimize operational disruption. **Expected results:** Validation project milestones achieved on schedule in alignment with site capital and operational goals. **Area of responsibility 3: Change Control, Periodic Reviews, \& System Governance** Main activities * Evaluate proposed modifications to validated computerized systems through the formal site Change Control process, performing impact assessments to establish requalification requirements. * Conduct routine periodic reviews of validated GxP computer systems to verify sustained compliance, configuration stability, and operational readiness. * Implement and execute risk\-based audit trail review governance across assigned GxP platforms, ensuring compliance with electronic record and signature requirements. * Maintain current knowledge of evolving regulatory trends, FDA/EMA guidance, and industry standards regarding CSV and data governance. **Expected results:** Continuous validated state of computer systems maintained throughout their operational lifecycle **Area of responsibility 4: Develop and implement templates** Main activities * Develop, maintain, and review CSV document templates, such as user requirement specifications (URS), functional requirement specifications (FRS), design specifications, risk\-analysis, traceability matrices, installation qualification protocols, operation qualification protocols, performance qualification protocols, validation master plans, and summary reports. * Ensure templates are used by other site personnel when required. **Expected results:** Templates for use in Computer System Validations are available and maintained. **Area of responsibility 5: Audit Support, CAPA, \& Program Continuous Improvement** Main activities * Participate in internal quality audits and regulatory agency inspections as a technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) for assigned CSV deliverables. * Support root cause analysis (RCA) investigations for system deviations, non\-conformances, or audit observations, and implement assigned Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). * Assist in authoring and updating CSV Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), technical policies, and standardized validation document templates. **Expected results:** High audit readiness and timely closure of protocol deviations, audit findings, and CAPA commitments. Virbac provides numerous career opportunities, thanks to the diversity of its jobs and their international dimension. Joining Virbac means joining dynamic teams ambitious for success. Add Your Talent to Ours!

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Solutions
jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Visa will accept applications for this role until at least 12\-11\-2026**Job Description** We are seeking a highly skilled AI developer with deep expertise in Agentic and Generative AI to drive the next wave of intelligent automation and digital transformation. In this role, you will be at the forefront of designing, implementing, and optimizing AI\-powered solutions integrated into the ServiceNow platform. Your primary focus will be on leveraging artificial intelligence, including custom MCP tooling, Agentic scoped applications, and third\-party Large Language Models—to enhance workflows, automate complex processes, and deliver innovative business outcomes. You will architect and build custom AI solutions and ensure seamless user experiences through intelligent automation. As a thought leader in AI, you will collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for AI adoption, experiment with emerging technologies, and contribute to Visa’s enterprise AI strategy. In addition to your AI responsibilities, you will develop and configure integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise applications, manage the full lifecycle of these integrations (from API development and scripting to framework deployment), and ensure robust, secure, and scalable connections. Roles and responsibilities: * Designing, developing, and optimizing AI\-powered solutions (built within the ServiceNow platform and/or integrated through external custom solutions), including the creation of custom MCP tooling and Agentic solutions. * Leveraging AI solutions to integrate and orchestrate third\-party Large Language Models (LLMs) such as OpenAI, Google Gemini, etc, driving intelligent automation and enhanced user experiences. * Collaborating with stakeholders to identify opportunities for AI adoption, experiment with emerging technologies, and deliver innovative, AI\-driven business outcomes. * Troubleshooting and resolving issues with ServiceNow configurations and AI components, ensuring seamless operation and reliability. * Identifying requirement gaps to ensure high\-quality solutions and providing configuration options with clear pros and cons. * Designing and implementing intuitive, user\-friendly software that enables customer\-led customization and flexibility. * Collaborating with internal customers and business analysts to clarify requirements and architect effective, AI\-driven solutions. * Authoring comprehensive technical design and build documentation for all facets of the technical infrastructure. * Conducting research and analysis of existing systems to provide accurate time estimates and recommendations to project managers. * Actively participating in project meetings and daily scrums to communicate development status, progress, and technical insights. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Visa will accept applications for this role until at least December 11, 2026\. **Qualifications** Basic Qualifications * 5\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8\+ years of relevant work experience. Preferred Qualifications * Proven ability to deliver projects on time and within budget by writing high\-quality code, mentoring junior developers, understanding workload and usage requirements, and producing clear technical documentation that enables knowledge transfer and long\-term supportability across global teams. * Experience designing robust, scalable, and moderately complex architectural solutions that integrate across a broader technical ecosystem, while effectively operating as a collaborative member of a globally distributed team across diverse time zones and cultures. * Minimum of 2 years of relevant professional experience including hands\-on work with AI\-powered solutions, with a bachelor’s degree; or at least 2 years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master’s, MBA, JD, MD). * In\-depth knowledge of APIs, web services, and standard relational database concepts. * Proven experience with JavaScript, AJAX, JSON, CSS, REST, SOAP, and HTML. * Strong Python skills and hands\-on experience building RESTful or GraphQL APIs. * Demonstrated experience building GenAI solutions, agents, or conversational applications, exhibiting the ability to differentiate reasoning approaches like ReAct and Chain\-of\-Thought (CoT). * Demonstrate ability to design and architect Agentic Systems, applying various agent architectures (symbolic, BDI, LLM\-based) to design intelligent agents tailored for specific tasks and environments. * Implement Core Agent Capabilities. Develop agents that can perceive, reason, plan, act, and learn, utilizing Python and relevant AI libraries and frameworks. * Analyze and Evaluate Agent Behavior. Critically assess agent performance, understand the complexities of multi\-agent systems and human\-agent interaction, and identify risks. * Navigate Ethical Landscapes. Identify, analyze, and address the ethical challenges and safety considerations inherent in developing and deploying autonomous AI systems, applying principles of responsible AI. * Apply Agentic AI to Solve Problems. Conceptualize and build functional AI agents for practical applications, demonstrating the ability to integrate diverse concepts into cohesive business solutions. * Deep understanding of prompt engineering concepts, LLM fine\-tuning, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Familiarity with MCP servers or comparable model\-serving/hosting platforms. * Excellent problem\-solving skills, strong communication, and a collaborative attitude. * Strong analytical skills with the ability to extensively analyze and improve business processes and workflows. * Demonstrated expertise in designing, implementing, and optimizing AI\-driven functionalities integrated with ServiceNow, such as custom Agentic AI skills, GenAI integrations, and intelligent automation. * Strong technical background in ServiceNow\-specific development tools and frameworks (UI Policies, UI Macros, UI Pages, Client Scripts, Script Includes, Business Rules, Mid Server Configuration \& Architecture, Import Sets, Transform Maps, Update Sets). * Strong knowledge of the CMDB, data modeling, data strategies, and integrations. * Knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM/ITOM product portfolio including Change Management, Discovery, and Service Mapping. * Relevant certifications such as Certified ServiceNow Admin (CSA), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS), or Certified Application Developer (CAD) are highly desirable. **Information for US Applicants** For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $127,000\.00 to $ 202,700\.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job\-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours** Varies upon the needs of the department. **Travel Requirements** This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time. **Mental/Physical Requirements** This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. **Visa is an EEO Employer** Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary** =========== Vital Services is seeking a talented and experienced Mid\-Level Software Engineer to join our growing Application Engineering department. This is an extraordinary opportunity to be a part of, and play an integral role in, the expansion of our Information Technology team. The core focus of this role is to write clean, secure, and highly efficient code that successfully implements functional requirements, ensuring rapid features delivery and high system reliability across active product and T\&M client queues. **Roles \& Responsibilities of the Software Engineer** ====================================================== * **Feature Implementation \& Delivery:** Writing well\-structured, testable, and maintainable application code that fulfills documented user stories and technical design specs. * **Defect Resolution \& Support Execution:** Investigating, triaging, and patching software bugs and performance issues efficiently across SaaS platforms and custom client applications. * **API \& Data Flow Execution:** Building and consuming secure web services, endpoints, and third\-party API extractions based on the patterns outlined by the Architect. * **Code Quality \& Testing Discipline:** Participating actively in peer code reviews, adhering to organizational standards, and writing comprehensive unit and integration tests. * **Sprint Hygiene \& Operational Visibility:** Estimating assigned tasks accurately, updating Jira tickets daily, and actively raising dependencies during sprint ceremonies to protect velocity. **Skills \& Experience of the Software Engineer** ================================================= * **Professional Core Experience:** 3\-6 years of verified full\-stack or backend software engineering experience operating within an agile team ecosystem (experience in multi\-client agency or SaaS environments is a plus). * **Technical Stack Proficiency:** Solid proficiency in C\# languages and core object\-oriented programming methodologies in a Microsoft tech stack environment. * **Database Conversance:** Clear comfort writing optimized queries and interacting with relational or non\-relational database engines (e.g., SQL/MySQL). * **Version Control Mastery:** Complete fluency with Git workflow mechanics, branching strategies, and handling merge conflicts cleanly. * **Implementation Mindset:** A strong track record of taking well\-defined, abstract functional requirements and successfully transforming them into live, working software capabilities without needing extensive architectural oversight. **Success Metrics of the Software Engineer** ============================================ * **Individual Sprint Say/Do Ratio:** \>\= 80% predictability on completing committed sprint tasks and feature points. * **Code Review Turnaround Time:** Review and provide actionable feedback on peer pull requests within an average of \< 24 hours to prevent pipeline blockages. * **Post\-Deployment Defect Leaks:** Maintain a threshold of \< 2 critical execution defects or breaking bugs introduced to production environments per quarter. * **Jira \& Time\-Tracking Accuracy:** 100% weekly compliance on task logging, feature estimations, and accurate time log entries. **Compensation \& Culture** =========================== * Salary Range: $95,000 – $115,000 (Mid\-Level) \- *Final offer will be commensurate with experience and technical assessment results.* * Hybrid Flexibility: We value our culture in our offices in Allen, TX and Oak Ridge, TN, but offer a flexible hybrid or remote schedule based on team project needs rather than a rigid clock\-in / in\-office requirement. * Growth Path: This position was created by a team member's promotion. We actively invest in our engineers' career trajectories into senior engineering or architecture roles.

jobs.title: Sr. System Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Sr. System Software Engineer** ================================ Wayne State University is searching for an experienced **Sr. System Software Engineer** at its Detroit campus location. Wayne State is a premier, public, urban research university located in the heart of Detroit, Michigan where students from all backgrounds are offered a rich, high\-quality education. Our deep\-rooted commitment to excellence, collaboration, integrity, diversity and inclusion creates exceptional educational opportunities which prepare students for success in a global society. **Essential functions (job duties):** ------------------------------------- **Basic Purpose:** Positions in the Systems Software Engineer job family are responsible for evaluating, selecting, installing, and maintaining enterprise operating systems and technical applications for assigned platforms including enterprise servers and networks and for serving as a technical resource on enterprise hardware issues. Incumbents interact with technical and business customers to provide training and expertise in the design of specific applications to ensure the optimization of the platforms or technologies involved. The focus of work is on the efficient operation of enterprise operating platforms to support customer applications and the effective use of hardware and operating software in new or enhanced applications. **Essential Functions:** The functions within the job family will vary by level and specific assignment but will include the following: * Evaluate, install, customize, configure, and maintain enterprise operating systems including installing and testing new releases; * Evaluate operating efficiency, analyze performance and tuning, and assist in capacity planning and DASD management; * Analyze and troubleshoot operating problems to find problem areas and make fixes or work with the vendor for correction; * Advise technical staff in complex applications development to assist in avoiding problems of incompatibility with software capabilities; * Document changes to system functions and/or configurations for technical and customer reference; and * Review and evaluate new or upgraded systems software packages and related hardware and make recommendations based on established standards. Comments (Level Descriptions): The Systems Software Engineer family has four levels: **Systems Software Engineer I** This is the proficiency level where incumbents apply their basic skills and expertise, typically with a specific operating system and platform. They perform routine assignments to complete system change and modification requests and assist higher level staff in all aspects of maintaining, updating, documenting, and monitoring the operating systems. Incumbents also provide continuing support for their assigned operating system, trouble\-shooting and resolving common immediate problems. Work is assigned to provide a broader knowledge of the technology supported and to develop a high level of creative problem\-solving in preparation for qualification at the next level of the family. **Systems Software Engineer II** This is the career level where incumbents are fully knowledgeable in the operating system and platform supported and work as a part of a team to develop or install new systems software or supporting applications. The emphasis at this level is the incumbent’s ability to identify and resolve all but the most unusual operating systems problems quickly and with dispatch. While at this level, incumbents are increasing their knowledge and expertise in a complex operating system and platform or are expanding their capabilities in a second technology. They may also have specific assignments in areas such as performance tuning, security, disaster recovery, and the like to broaden their overall knowledge of their assigned technology. **Senior Systems Software Engineer** This is the specialist level where incumbents have full and specialized knowledge in their assigned operating system(s). This may be a single, highly complex system or multiple, less complex systems. Incumbents have primary accountability for the installation, maintenance, and operating efficiency of their assigned systems. They work with a high degree of independence, providing technical leadership and work review for less experienced staff. Individuals at this level are able to identify and resolve the most complex system\-related problems and deal directly with key vendor service representatives. Their work is characterized by the rapid application of technical knowledge to increase the efficiency and operation of the platform(s) supported. Incumbents may also be a Subject Matter Expert for their assigned system serving as third\-tier support for operating problems and technical consultant on complex applications development projects. They are key members of project teams for enterprise applications involving their assigned system. **Lead Systems Software Engineer** This is the leadership level where incumbents are recognized experts in a complex operating system and related areas such as network or database applications. Incumbents lead projects for major upgrades or installations, providing technical guidance and work direction to technical staff and ensuring that projects are completed smoothly and on time. Incumbents may also be a Subject Matter Expert for an enterprise\-wide system, assisting in technology planning and serving as a technical consultant on enterprise applications development project teams. They may also have formal leadership responsibilities for enterprise\-wide functions such as security, disaster recovery, and the like. ### **Unique duties:** **Qualifications:** ------------------- **Minimum Qualifications:** Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: * Knowledge of the specific operating systems, networks, and/or platforms supported; * Understanding of the hardware supported including mainframe, servers, workstations, peripheraldevices, and the like; * Skill in the use of operating system software, companion software, utilities, and the like; * High level skill in identifying and resolving technical problems and/or effectively communicating the problems to vendor representatives; and * Ability to analyze complex operating problems, working independently until the problem is resolved. * Knowledge of operating systems software, platforms, and computer operations typically acquired through an undergraduate program in Computer Science with an emphasis on systems software or the equivalent and one to two years of related experience; and * Specific knowledge and experience in at least one related platform and operating system. ### **Preferred qualifications:** **School/College/Division:** ---------------------------- H25 \- Computing \& Info Technology ### **Primary department:** H25 Computing \& Info Technology **Employment type:** -------------------- * Regular Employee * Job type: Full Time * Job category: Staff/Administrative **Funding/salary information:** ------------------------------- * Compensation type: Annual Salary * Hourly rate: * Salary minimum: * Salary hire maximum: **Working conditions:** ----------------------- **Job openings:** ----------------- * Number of openings: 1 * Reposted position: No * Reposted reason: None (New Requisition) * Prior posting/requisition number: **Background check requirements:** ---------------------------------- University policy requires certain persons who are offered employment to undergo a background check, including a criminal history check, before starting work. jobs.description: **E T Consultant** **Job \#:** req39425 **Organization:** World Bank **Sector:** Disaster Risk Management **Grade:** EC2 **Term Duration:** 1 year 0 months **Recruitment Type:** Local Recruitment **Location:** Washington, DC,United States **Required Language(s):** English **Preferred Language(s):** French, Spanish or Portuguese **Closing Date:** 12/4/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC **Description** At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1\.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data\-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who\-we\-are/ibrd The World Bank Group (WBG) Infrastructure Vertical provides public and private solutions to operational teams and clients across the WBG to produce scalable impact. Its mandate is to deliver knowledge for impact to support the WBG to achieve its goals in support of our mission and specifically: providing guidance on creating more and better jobs by: (i) supporting foundational infrastructure and human capital, (ii) policy environment, and (iii) enabling and mobilizing private sector capital. With 60 years of experience, the WBG is poised to support the sector becoming an engine of growth and jobs through improving policies and governance, foundational infrastructure and private sector investments. WBG lending in the sector is expected to grow substantially. The Infrastructure VPU’s objectives in driving outcomes include replicating and scaling effective solutions, enhancing thought leadership and innovation, and delivering timely knowledge to client teams. For more information: https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/infrastructure The Disaster Management, Solutions \& Impact Unit (KIUSD) supports low and middle\-income countries to understand, manage, and reduce their risks from natural hazards and climate change. Within KIUSD, the Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR) umbrella trust fund is a global partnership that helps low\- and middle\-income countries better understand and reduce their vulnerability to natural hazards and climate change. GFDRR supports analytics and technical assistance to governments in the most vulnerable countries and communities where it will have the greatest positive impact. As a donor\-funded program, GFDRR consults regularly with donors and actively strives to maintain and develop new partnerships for increased impact. For more information: https://www.gfdrr.org/en GFDRR follows a demand\-driven model, linking country needs with technical expertise, financing, and partnerships to deliver impact at scale. GFDRR’s 2026\-20230 strategy emphasizes measurable results, introducing a strengthened results framework with specific quantitative targets, including a goal to improve climate resilience for 100 million people by 2030\. GFDRR is structured in four priority areas, two crosscutting areas and comprised of 10 thematic areas (or global programs): **Priority 1: Strengthening Risk\-Informed Decision Making** * Digital Earth * Disaster Risk Analytics **Priority 2: Reducing Risk and Mainstreaming Disaster Risk Management (DRM)** * Building Regulation for Resilience \- Resilient Housing * City Resilience – Urban Heat Resilience * Nature\-based Solutions for Climate Resilience * Resilient Infrastructure * Resilient Human Development Infra \- Safer Schools \- Health Systems **Priority 3: Enhancing Financial Preparedness and Leveraging Financing to Manage Disaster and Climate Risks** * Disaster Risk Finance **Priority 4: Improving Disaster Preparedness and Resilient Recovery** * Emergency Preparedness and Response * Hydromet Services and Early Warning Systems **Crosscutting areas:** * Disaster \-Fragility, Conflict, and Violence Nexus * Inclusive Disaster Risk Management and Gender Equality Each thematic area invests in knowledge and tools development being responsive to the needs of WBG clients. Tools range from policy and regulatory frameworks review, stakeholder engagements, geospatial analysis combined with solution suitability analysis, rapid post\-disaster assessments, risk quantification (some tool and their applications can be accessed on GFDRR’s website). Additionally, GFDRR has teams dedicated to grant monitoring and GFDRR impact evaluation and learning, as well as communications and knowledge management. Please note this position is financed by a Trust Fund and renewal is contingent upon availability of funding, in addition to other factors, including but not lim for tool development. * Contribute to program deliverables, including preparation of GFDRR communication and dissemination materials, results monitoring, reporting, budgeting, and branding. * Influence capability development at enterprise scale, not just within a single tool or team. * Conduct other tasks, as needed, to support the overall objective of the position. **Selection Criteria** * Advanced University Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics, or related field with strong computational elements, with minimum five years of relevant experience; a bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience. * At least five years of progressively responsible professional experience (internships excluded), with a focus on software development and integration of technologies. * At least three years of experience designing and delivering hands\-on capacity building programs for enterprises. **Technical expertise:*** Demonstrated expertise in designing and building autonomous, multi\-step AI agents and utilizing advanced orchestration frameworks. * Expert\-level knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), generative AI architectures, and text analytics, including Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques. * Extensive experience implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures using enterprise\-grade managed search services and vector databases, incorporating continuous feedback loops (e.g., human\-in\-the\-loop/human\-in\-command labeling, relevance tuning) to improve retrieval quality. * Demonstrated ability to design, develop, and deploy scalable, high\-quality software and AI solutions across multiple platforms. Hands\-on experience building enterprise applications that meet complex business requirements with minimal supervision. * Strong programming, geospatial, and quantitative skills, including fluency in Python for geospatial workflows, cloud computing, Google Earth Engine, and open\-source GIS tools (e.g., QGIS). * Experience with and/or interest in disaster risk management, urban planning, civil infrastructure systems and financing are strongly preferred. **International \& Interpersonal Skills:*** International experience and demonstrated ability to work in diverse, multicultural environments are required. * Knowledge of the World Bank key Resilience and Disaster Risk Management priorities and programs is a plus but not essential. * Excellent organizational skills with ability to work under tight deadlines and handle multiple requests simultaneously, while being detail oriented. * Mentors and guides junior engineers to elevate the team’s core competencies, while simultaneously establishing foundational AI practices, such as enterprise prompt design frameworks and user personalization strategies. * Excellent written and spoken English is essential; knowledge of other languages—especially Spanish, French, and Portuguese—is highly desirable. **WBG Culture Attributes:** 1\. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders. 2\. Thoughtful risk\-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact. 3\. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results. jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience designing, building, and operating large\-scale distributed systems, with a focus on scalability, fault tolerance, and reliability. * Experience developing recommender/ranking/prediction systems for personalized content delivery. * Experience in building and architecting ML systems and infrastructure (e.g., for model training, evaluation, deployment, serving). * Experience working with consumer\-facing video, audio or streaming platforms. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience in building and deploying recommendation systems models (retrieval, prediction, ranking, personalization, search quality, embedding) in production. * Experience in distributed Machine Learning and Machine Learning infrastructure, distributed systems and with Machine Learning algorithms at scale. * Experience in designing, building, and operating large\-scale distributed systems, with a focus on scalability, fault tolerance, and reliability. * Experience in Machine Learning model development and deployment frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Tensorflow, Jax, Ray), AI accelerators (e.g., TPUs, GPUs), model architectures (e.g., encoders, decoders, transformers), or APIs. * Experience in search and information retrieval. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. As a (TL) Technical Lead, you will work on improving Machine Learning (ML) algorithms and end\-to\-end solutions to empower live recommendations and grow live ecosystems responsibly. You will set up growth metrics and goals, conduct analysis and research to identify growth areas, and lead a team of engineers to iterate experiments toward launch. Additionally, you will communicate across YouTube engineering teams and leads, to align with the design direction and future plans of your projects. In this position, you will work with YouTube Discovery teams (e.g., Home, Shorts, WatchNext, Notifications, Living Room), Live Infrastructure, and Live Experience teams, and collaborate with Google DeepMind, YouTube Knowledge, and YouTube Trust and Safety (TnS) teams. At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Lead the technical goal and architecture for YouTube Live discovery and recommendation ML systems. * Develop state\-of\-the\-art deep learning models to improve real\-time engagement and viewer retention on live streams. * Scale high\-throughput, low\-latency machine learning pipelines to handle massive real\-time streaming data concurrent traffic. * Mentor junior and senior engineers, fostering technical growth and engineering excellence across the ML organization. * Design ranking, retrieval, and candidate generation algorithms tailored for live and real\-time content. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.title: Sr Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together** **Our Meaningful Mission** At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross\-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech. Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognises and supports global connections. **Who You'll Be Joining** We look for mission\-driven builders who thrive in a fast\-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk. **Our Core Commitments — What We Live By** Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact: * **Integrity:** We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other. * **Outcomes:** We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering. * **Velocity:** We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve. **Perks of Joining Our Team** We are embarking on an exciting journey to build out our global Marketing analytics capability. Our culture is built on high trust, which empowers colleagues and fosters the high ownership necessary to meet our shared expectations and deliver high performance. As a remote\-first company, you have the flexibility to work wherever you feel most focused and productive within your employing country. This freedom comes with wonderful, tailored, location\-specific perks designed to support your whole life, not just your work. These benefits include unlimited annual leave, great healthcare, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact, and in turn, we expect high ownership and commitment. This is a place where trust and high performance are valued, and we provide the environment and support you need to excel. We prioritise an environment where we openly share ideas, embrace our mistakes, and learn from them—collaboration is key to everything we do! **About the role** As a Senior Data Scientist, you will champion data science within our FinCrime\-Fraud\-AI\-ML team. You will design, build and own the machine learning models that stop bad actors, while improving the experience for our legitimate customers. You'll start by finding the quick wins, then lead more ambitious, innovative work. You'll join a highly collaborative FinCrime squad of Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers and Backend Engineers, and partner closely with fraud analysts, operations and product. Your initial focus is fraud detection; as the role evolves, you'll have the chance to extend your impact into areas such as risk and credit rating. **What you'll do*** **Model lifecycle:** own fraud detection models end to end, from problem framing and feature engineering to training, evaluation and deployment. Automate training and deployment so models are scalable, documented, tested and monitored for drift. * **Fraud detection:** build models that score transactions, accounts and customer behaviour in real time, covering threats such as account takeover, stolen payment credentials, first\-party fraud, scams and mule activity. * **Data and features:** work with Data and Analytical Engineering to bring new data sources into our models using dbt best practices, including transactional, device, behavioural and identity signals. * **Experimentation:** design and run experiments to measure the impact of new models, third\-party data sources and emerging tools on fraud losses, approval rates and customer experience. * **Commercial translation:** turn complex business needs into solvable data science projects, and set thresholds that balance fraud losses against friction for legitimate customers. * **Continuous improvement:** keep scrutinising our methods to improve model accuracy and the quality of data inputs, and respond quickly as fraud patterns change. * **Empowerment:** build tools and strategies that help non\-technical stakeholders understand and act on model results. * Leadership: mentor other data scientists, review their work and help set technical standards for the team. **What you'll bring** * 6\+ years' in the Data Science space, including but not limited to, hands on experience with regression analysis, clustering methods, boosting algorithms, feature/model selection, training and deploying models that deliver measurable value * Results Driven: Excels at driving technical results in a business oriented framework. * Experience in fraud, financial crime, risk or a similar adversarial domain, ideally in payments, fintech or banking, including imbalanced classification and delayed or noisy labels. * Strong Coding Skills in Python and ability to use Python for automation, application deploymentSQL: Expert skills in CTEs, joins, and subqueries to manipulate complex datasets for modeling. * The ability to deploy your own models and set up the monitoring they need. * Familiarity with a modern stack: scikit\-learn, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks, and visualisation tools such as Looker, Tableau or Streamlit. * A problem\-solving mindset that balances technical excellence with commercial impact. You're comfortable over\-communicating and adapt quickly to changing priorities. **Nice to have** * Experience with AWS services such as SageMaker, ECS and EMR. * Advanced knowledge of experimentation design and evaluation. * Graph analytics or graph ML for detecting fraud rings and mule networks. * Real\-time or streaming ML with low\-latency scoring. * Model explainability techniques such as SHAP, and experience with model risk governance. * Knowledge of cross\-border payments or remittances, and the regulations around fraud and AML. * A “tenacious” attitude—you are willing to do things manually when necessary but seek to automate at every opportunity. **AI Literacy \& Tools** As Zepz continues to build AI into how we work, we expect everyone to engage with it as a core part of their role. For this position we are looking for: * A genuine curiosity about AI and how it can be applied in your area of work — from accelerating analysis and insight generation, to improving how we design and deliver processes and communications. * Practical experience using AI tools in a professional context — whether to connect information, draft content, build frameworks, or create insights from data. We want people who actively use AI to increase productivity, not those who are waiting to be told to. * Strong AI literacy — an understanding of what AI assistants can and cannot do, how to prompt effectively, and how to critically evaluate AI\-generated output before using it. * Awareness of the ethical considerations and responsible use of AI in the workplace, particularly in the context of sensitive data, customer experience, and compliance. * Prior experience using Claude (Anthropic) is a nice\-to\-have but not essential — what matters most is that you are genuinely engaged with AI as a tool, comfortable experimenting, and eager to share what works with your wider team Our global team of 800\+ people is spread across six continents. We aspire to hire the best mix of people from former Olympians to YouTube influencers and we speak over twenty languages. This incredible diversity isn't a bonus; it's the engine that lets us serve the world. **Ready to Apply? Let’s Go!**

jobs.title: Android Engineer
jobs.description: **About Zero Homes** -------------------- Our mission is to rebuild American communities through healthy, affordable homes. At Zero Homes, we operate on a simple premise: when you make contractors successful, homeowners win. The current home services industry is fragmented, complex, and opaque, which is frustrating for homeowners and exhausting for contractors. We are changing this by building a home upgrade marketplace that enables a simple, central, transparent process for homeowners and contractors to complete projects. Through our platform we handle design, quoting, procurement, and customer service, allowing our contractor network to focus on what they do best and make them money: delivering projects. For homeowners, this delivers a predictable, high\-quality, and transparent experience—transforming home upgrades from a source of anxiety into a seamless experience.Our vision is to create a world where homeowners and contractors in all 50 states can leverage our platform to execute thousands of projects every week within the next 36 months. We work by a clear set of values: * **Be a "can kid," not a "can’t kid":** We own our outcomes and go to extraordinary lengths to solve problems. * **Go fast, be clear:** Speed is our advantage, and we sweat the details to deliver an extraordinary customer experience. * **Customer \& Contractor Obsessed:** We have a deep, personal understanding of the work to be done. We stay curious about our contractors' craft and the stories of our homeowners. * **Win, as a team:** We are building an iconic business that will reinvent the industry, and will do so together. If you are ready to build a world\-class consumer experience that genuinely rebuilds American communities, come build with us. **About the Role \& Your Impact** --------------------------------- The ZeroHome app is our most important digital touchpoint with homeowners. It lets them get a design and quote for their HVAC project without an in\-person sales visit. As an Android Engineer, you will own features end to end on Android, and grow into iOS as you go. You will work in six\-week cycles on a small team of a designer, a product representative, one or two engineers, and a lead engineer. You will take well\-scoped projects, bring options and questions, and grow quickly with guidance and review from senior engineers. You will also help build Field, a contractor tool we have not built yet. How we work: our team builds the app with AI as the main interface to the code, and we will be upfront about that from your first conversation. We consider applicants at more than one level, and we share the likely level and pay range before any onsite. **Who You Are** =============== You go where the product needs you, even when that means learning a part of the stack you have never touched. You treat a customer\-reported bug as the most important signal you get, and you dig into the rough edges real users hit. You are curious about what AI lets one engineer do. You would rather reuse a sound solution than invent a novel one, and you lean on tests, established patterns, and your teammates' review. You are building your judgment about the line between recklessness and accepted risk, and you like working in person with your team, in front of a whiteboard. **What You'll Do** ================== * **Ship Features:** Deliver well\-scoped features end to end on Android, with review from senior engineers. * **Fix What Users Hit:** Drop in\-flight work to unblock a homeowner who hits a bug, and make sure the fix stays fixed. * **Grow Across Platforms:** Build from Android into iOS by shipping real work. * **Go Beyond the App:** Pick up the backend and data work a feature needs, with support from the team. * **Work Through AI:** Build with AI as your main interface to the code, and help make the team's AI\-assisted workflow and tooling faster and more reliable. * **Measure Your Work:** Instrument features before they ship and watch whether they work. * **Help Build Field:** Contribute to our future contractor tool from its earliest version. **What You Bring** ================== * At least one year of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful time building native mobile apps that real users rely on. * Strength on Android (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose), and eagerness to grow into iOS (Swift, SwiftUI). * Hands\-on use of agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, and a point of view on where they help and where a human needs to check the work. * Habits that make work hold up in production: tests, established patterns, and teammates' review. * Curiosity beyond the app, and a willingness to dig into APIs, data, or backend code when a feature needs it. * Interest in observability and in working with a product analytics platform (we use PostHog). * Enthusiasm for in\-person work: you live within 50 miles of Denver, Colorado, or are planning your own move to the area, and you will be in the office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday at minimum. * Bonus: full\-stack experience, such as push notification servers, lightweight APIs, Cloud Functions, or REST API work with backend engineers. * Bonus: on\-device ML, ARCore, camera frameworks, or computer vision. * Bonus: early\-stage startup experience, a math or data science background, or experience in climate tech. *Relocation Assistance Available* **Benefits \& Perks** * Equity: every Zero Homes employee gets a stake in the company * Medical, dental, and vision: we cover 100% of your premium on our base medical plan and on vision, plus most of your dental premium. Coverage starts the first of the month after you join * 401(k) with Roth and traditional options * 4 weeks PTO, paid company holidays, and unlimited sick leave * Paid parental leave: up to 12 weeks for primary caregivers, 6 for secondary (after 9 months with us) * $500 workstation stipend **Equal Opportunity Employer** Zero Homes is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive, accessible, and diverse workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees and do not discriminate or tolerate harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We encourage people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. If you require a reasonable accommodation or assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know. Compensation Range: $140K \- $160K

monitoring, alerting, triage, and fixes. * Daily use of agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, and a clear view of where they excel, where they fail, and how you verify the work. * Examples of working beyond the app, such as changing an endpoint, writing a migration, or pairing with a backend engineer. * Examples of making other engineers better through code review, pairing, or leading a project. * Experience with a product analytics platform (we use PostHog). * Enthusiasm for in\-person work: you live within 50 miles of Denver, Colorado, or are planning your own move to the area, and you will be in the office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday at minimum. * Bonus: on\-device ML, ARCore, camera frameworks, or computer vision. * Bonus: early\-stage startup experience, a dental, and vision: we cover 100% of your premium on our base medical plan and on vision, plus most of your dental premium. Coverage starts the first of the month after you join * 401(k) with Roth and traditional options * 4 weeks PTO, paid company holidays, and unlimited sick leave * Paid parental leave: up to 12 weeks for primary caregivers, 6 for secondary (after 9 months with us) * $500 workstation stipend **Equal Opportunity Employer** Zero Homes is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive, accessible, and diverse workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees and do not discriminate or tolerate harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
