Success in this role requires adaptability, sound judgment, and a willingness to balance immediate production support with launch activities while helping build reliable, sustainable support practices as operations mature. **What You’ll Do:*** Provide hands\-on support for MES applications, operator interfaces, and production\-floor technology. * Troubleshoot issues involving workstations, industrial PCs, thin clients, scanners, printers, applications, network connections, machine interfaces, databases, and related production systems. * Support production transactions, work\-order execution, downtime tracking, production counts, equipment status, quality and scrap data, material tracking, and electronic production records. * Assist with Ignition applications, including Perspective and Vision clients, while gathering logs, screenshots, error details, and equipment status for escalated incidents. * Help diagnose communications between shop\-floor equipment, MES applications, Ignition gateways, databases, and enterprise systems. * Coordinate MES/OT incidents by assessing production impact, resolving issues within your authority, and escalating to engineering, cybersecurity, vendors, integrators, or management when needed. * Maintain accurate incident records, troubleshooting procedures, support documentation, and shift\-handoff information. * Participate in root\-cause problem solving and continuous\-improvement activities that strengthen MES/OT reliability. **Expand Your Controls and Automation Experience** As a secondary part of the role, you may assist qualified Controls, Maintenance, Engineering, IT, or OT personnel with approved troubleshooting of PLCs, HMIs, sensors, industrial networks, I/O devices, drives, servo systems, vision systems, instrumentation, safety circuits, and automated equipment. PLC or HMI changes, backups, restores, testing, and version checks are performed only when you are trained, authorized, and working within established change\-control procedures. **What You Bring:*** Experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment supporting manufacturing technology, MES, industrial automation, IT/OT infrastructure, controls, or production systems. * An associate degree in Information Technology, Industrial Technology, Automation, Electronics, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant technical and manufacturing experience. * Hands\-on knowledge of MES processes, production data collection, operator interfaces, Windows\-based devices, industrial PCs, scanners, or production printers. * Basic understanding of Ethernet/TCP/IP, industrial\-network connectivity, SQL/database fundamentals, or system\-to\-system communications. * Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to stay calm and methodical during production\-impacting incidents. * Clear communication, strong documentation habits, and a service\-oriented approach when supporting manufacturing users. * The ability to work onsite, respond promptly to plant\-floor needs, and work the assigned shift with occasional overtime or planned\-downtime coverage. **Preferred Experience:*** Ignition by Inductive Automation, including Perspective, Vision, Tag Historian, alarms, reporting, gateway configuration, or MES modules. * MES, SCADA, HMI, PLC communications, industrial controls, or automation systems. * OPC UA, EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP, MQTT, managed switches, VLANs, remote I/O, or industrial communications. * Python or Ignition scripting, computerized maintenance\-management systems, help\-desk ticketing, or industrial cybersecurity. * Inductive Automation Ignition credentialing, industrial\-controls training, or a networking certification. * Comfort working in a rapidly changing startup or launch environment, with the ability to adjust priorities as systems and production needs evolve.

jobs.title: Database Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Mecka AI** Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI. We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware\-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems. We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real\-world data, simulation, learning\-based systems, and deployed hardware. ### **About the role** Our database layer sits under everything Mecka ships, and it's growing quickly. We're looking for someone to own it: learn what we've built, set the plan for where it goes next, and help us scale. As part of our Platform Engineering \& Infrastructure team, you'll work hands\-on with MongoDB and ClickHouse at scale and take on challenges no one has solved for us yet. We need someone who brings both speed and quality, and who wants real ownership. ### **What you'll do** * Own the database layer: Take full ownership of Mecka's MongoDB and ClickHouse, and make the decisions that keep them healthy. * Learn it, then own it: Get a real grasp of the current setup in your first months, including a short overlap with a MongoDB engineer on contract, and take it from there. * Design the schema path: Come in with a medium\- and long\-term plan for schema and database design. * Plan the scale\-up: Map out what 2x to 10x data growth looks like, and how we avoid outages without a ton of compute and cost. * Solve what's new: Take on the unique problems that come with scaling, and find the path forward quickly without cutting corners. ### **What you'll need** * 3\+ years owning databases in a growing, fast\-paced environment. * Expert in MongoDB and ClickHouse, including advanced features at scale. * You've scaled databases through rapid growth before, and you bring those lessons with you. * You can ramp up, and you're ready to own the database layer. * You move quickly, and you have a point of view on how we should scale, avoid outages and keep this sustainable. This posting is for an existing vacancy (a newly created role). If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs. We may use AI\-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered. Compensation Range: CA$160K \- CA$195K

jobs.title: Senior Android Engineer - Offroad
jobs.description: ### **ABOUT onX** We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further. We’re a high\-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt \- continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver. Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals \- Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish \- is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most. We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact. Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access. ### **ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY** onX is seeking a talented Senior Android Engineer who will contribute to meaningful, real\-world outcomes that have a lasting impact for customers and the Offroad business. This role is critical to delivering best\-in\-class mobile experiences for overlanders and trail riders, leveraging the Android platform to bring mapping, GPS, and outdoor discovery features directly to our users’ fingertips. As a Senior Android Engineer, you will own major components of the Android app, drive technical decisions, and collaborate cross\-functionally to ship impactful features. This position is ideal for an engineer who thrives on solving complex problems with a collaborative team, cares deeply about the user experience, and can influence both the technical direction and team culture. This role will report to the Offroad Engineering Manager. ### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ***Essential Job Duties \& Functions*** * Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of complex features in the Android Offroad application. * Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and QA to deliver intuitive, performant, and reliable user experiences. * Mentor and support junior and mid\-level engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance. * Influence architectural direction for the Android app, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance. * Participate in technical discussions and make high\-judgment decisions with long\-term business impact. * Proactively identify opportunities for innovation and process improvement within the mobile platform. * Actively contribute to the hiring process by upholding a high bar for technical and cultural fit. * Collaborate effectively with other team members in verbal and written communication. * Integrate AI\-driven experimentation into daily workflows, applying sound judgment and validation. * Look for opportunities to embed AI as a repeatable co\-pilot in daily workflows by integrating experimentation into real work, and continuously refining its use with sound judgment and validation. ### **WHAT YOU’LL BRING** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years of experience is required. * Expert in Kotlin and the Android ecosystem, with demonstrated experience shipping production Android apps at scale. * Strong grasp of Android frameworks (Jetpack Compose, Android Views, etc.) and architectural patterns. * Experience designing and debugging asynchronous, multi\-threaded applications (e.g., Kotlin Coroutines). * Proven ability to design and implement scalable mobile systems that integrate with backend APIs. * Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and their performance tradeoffs in production environments ￼. * Ability to operate independently on end\-to\-end workstreams, from concept through delivery. * Demonstrated ability to facilitate technical discussions and build consensus across cross\-functional teams. * Proven track record of mentoring and elevating engineering standards. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, unit/UI testing frameworks, and monitoring tools for mobile applications (e.g., Firebase Crashlytics). * Passion for exploring emerging technologies, including the practical application of AI. * A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values. * Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX. * Ability to travel quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp. ### **ADDED BONUSES** Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following: * Experience working with mapping software or apps * Experience with Analytics, c n Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60\-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration. We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members. At this time, we are **NOT** able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming. ### **HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED** onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, we are open to considering candidates ranging in two levels (level II and level III). Spanning these levels, applicants can expect to make between $146,000 to $182,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based on experience, skills, certifications, and education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full\-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and a potential annual bonus of 10% based on company performance. ### **WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU** * Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth * Comprehensive health benefits, including a no\-monthly\-cost medical plan * Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non\-birthing parents * 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3\-5% * Company\-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks * Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle * Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays ### **PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS** In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem\-solving, essential for our computer\-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at PC@onxmaps.com. **Position open until filled.** **\#LI\-Remote** **At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger.** By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us! onX Maps will never ask for credit card or SSN details during the initial application process. For your digital safety, apply only through our legitimate website at onXmaps.com onX does not sell any Personal Information, but we may transfer employment related records to our service providers or third parties that provide business services to onX or as required by law. As part of our interview process, your conversation may be recorded for documentation purposes to allow interviewers to focus fully on the discussion. Recordings are confidential and accessible only to authorized personnel. Please note, onX respects all applicable laws regarding recording consent, and you will have an opportunity to opt\-out if preferred.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Application Security (all levels)
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ SF or Remote (US/Canada) **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Department** -------------- EngineeringEngineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $170K – $290K • Offers Equity *Our openings span more than one career level. The provided salary depends on many factors, such as work experience and transferable skills, business needs and impact, location, and market demands.* At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI\-native, full\-stack, multi\-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer\-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer\-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built\-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real\-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM\-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. **Applying to Render** ---------------------- We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. **About the Role** ------------------ Render hosts applications for millions of developers, from solo builders to enterprises with strict security requirements. Our Application Security team keeps our product, and the internal apps we run, safe. It also builds the security features our customers use to keep their apps safe. We are an engineering team. We build patterns and guardrails so product teams move faster and safer, rather than adding review gates. This is not a role where you will run a scanner and file tickets. You'll build production features that ship to customers, and partner with other teams to build solutions for sign\-in, secrets management and how AI agents access resources on Render. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Keep Render's Applications Secure at Scale** * Own code and dependency scanning and tune it to be high signal and autonomous. * Operate Render's bug bounty program. * Build secure code patterns to accelerate development. * Protect Render's software supply chain from vulnerable dependencies and malicious packages. * Harden authentication and authorization for both the Render product and internal applications. **Build security into the product** * Partner with product engineering teams to inform and build security features for our customers. * Directly ship products that give customers visibility and protection for what they are running on Render. * Make storing and injecting secrets into applications on Render safer. * Create safe access patterns for agents to autonomously use Render. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Strong software engineering skills. You've built and shipped production web applications, APIs, or developer\-facing products. * Experience with running application security at scale. * Strong judgment toward security risks and tradeoffs. * A sense of ownership to take projects from idea to shipped. * Empathy for our engineering team and our customers. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Experience with any of the technologies the Render product runs on: Go, Typescript, Kubernetes, Postgres, Terraform, Temporal. * Experience securing build systems and container images * Offensive security experience through pentesting, AI red\-teaming or exploit development. * Experience securing LLM or agent\-based products from vulnerabilities such as prompt injection. * Contributions to the security community through research, talks, or open source. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need. **Benefits** ------------ * 4 weeks of paid vacation. * 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return. * Long\-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans. * 100% employer\-paid medical coverage and 99% employer\-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well. * Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc. * Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy. * Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders. * Continuous learning benefits \& related support. *This position is generally not eligible for new visa**sponsorship. At Render's discretion, the business may sponsor existing visa transfers. Applicants who require sponsorship must receive business authorization.* *Render is an equal\-opportunity employer. We know that employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, product, and community to flourish. We make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional, and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy\-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.* *We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.* *We encourage all who are interested to apply. We can't wait to hear from you!* Render — CCPA Applicant Privacy Notice Render — GDPR Applicant Privacy Notice Compensation Range: $170K \- $290K
